items.title_zh: 欧盟对中国盘条启动反倾销日落复审：生产商抽样登记窗口仅7日（C/2026/5244）
items.title_en: EU opens expiry review of anti-dumping measures on Chinese wire rod; producer sampling window is seven days (C/2026/5244)
items.title_original: Notice of initiation of an expiry review of the anti-dumping measures applicable to imports of wire rod originating in the People’s Republic of China
items.summary_zh: 欧委会依据《条例（EU）2016/1036》第11(2)条启动日落复审，案件R877，申请由EUROFER于2026年6月30日代表欧盟产业提交。范围为铁、非合金钢或合金钢（不锈钢除外）热轧、不规则盘卷条杆，涉及CN 7213 10 00、7213 20 00、7213 91 10、7213 91 20、7213 91 41、7213 91 49、7213 91 70、7213 91 90、7213 99 10、7213 99 90、7227 10 00、7227 20 00、7227 90 10、7227 90 50、7227 90 95。现行措施为实施条例（EU）2021/1805项下最终反倾销税。申请人以秘鲁为拟议代表国，主张措施到期可能导致倾销和损害再现。复审调查期为2025年7月1日至2026年6月30日，损害趋势考察期自2023年1月1日起。
items.summary_en: The Commission opened expiry review R877 under Article 11(2) of Regulation (EU) 2016/1036 following a 30 June 2026 request by EUROFER. The product is hot-rolled bars and rods in irregularly wound coils of iron, non-alloy or alloy steel other than stainless, under fifteen listed CN codes in headings 7213 and 7227. Existing definitive duties were imposed by Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/1805. The applicant proposes Peru as a representative country and alleges likely recurrence of dumping and injury. The review investigation period is 1 July 2025–30 June 2026; the injury trend period starts 1 January 2023.
items.impact_zh: 这是正式立案且应诉窗口正在运行，不是已决定续征或调整税率。中国盘条生产商及关联出口商应立即核对CN范围和案件R877：生产商抽样信息须在公告发布后7日内提交（按日历推算约10月19日，以TRON和欧委会通知为准）；启动意见、听证请求和代表国/投入资料分别有37日、15日和15日期限，事实资料期限为65日。尽快确定欧盟律师、TRON登记主体、关联公司边界、产销量/出口量和投入数据。调查通常12个月内完成，法定最迟约2028年1月12日。
items.impact_en: This is a formal initiation with live participation windows, not a decision to renew or change duty rates. Chinese wire-rod producers and related exporters should immediately verify CN scope and R877. Producer sampling information is due within seven days of publication (about 19 October by calendar count, subject to TRON/Commission instructions); initiation comments, hearing requests and representative-country/input submissions carry 37-, 15- and 15-day windows, while factual normal-value material has 65 days. Confirm EU counsel, TRON registrant, related-party scope and production, sales, export and input data promptly. The review normally ends within 12 months and no later than about 12 January 2028.
items.follow_up: 立即核对R877并在公告后7日抽样窗口内行动；随后跟踪抽样决定、秘鲁代表国意见、问卷、披露和终裁。所有具体截止时点以TRON及欧委会通知为准。
items.coverage: 2026-10-13已通过欧盟出版局官方CELLAR下载并通读C/2026/5244全部12页，核对申请人、产品及15个CN编码、现行措施、拟议代表国、调查期、案件号、抽样与其他提交期限及结案期限；未读取TRON受限卷宗、EUROFER机密申请或企业问卷答复。

items.title_zh: 欧盟2026/1788：删除两项误留紧固件税号，相关反倾销税可按海关法退还
items.title_en: EU 2026/1788 removes erroneous fastener codes and provides repayment
items.title_original: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1788 of 23 July 2026 amending Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/191 imposing a definitive anti-dumping duty on imports of certain iron or steel fasteners originating in the People’s Republic of China
items.summary_zh: 条例删除7318220031和7318220095两项源于马来西亚发运反规避措施的TARIC编码：该旧措施2016年到期，但编码误留，导致自2022年无有效法律依据征税。7月25日生效、追溯自2022年2月18日适用；第2条规定相关已缴税依海关法退还。
items.summary_en: The regulation deletes TARIC 7318220031 and 7318220095, retained from an expired Malaysian-consignment measure. It applies retroactively from 18 February 2022 and provides repayment under customs law.
items.impact_zh: 原看板把这项修订解释成加强贸易限制，现予纠正。进口商应筛查相关历史报关与税单、核对退税期限；其他中国紧固件反倾销措施仍需逐项核对。
items.impact_en: Corrects the earlier restrictive interpretation. Screen historical entries and repayment deadlines; other fastener measures must be checked separately.
items.coverage: 已核对条例序言及第1—3条正文。

items.title_zh: 欧盟2026/1457：钢铁配额按国家和季度分配，现行实施期至12月31日
items.title_original: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1457 of 29 June 2026 on the distribution of tariff quotas opened under Regulation (EU) 2026/1384 addressing the negative trade-related effects of global overcapacity on the Union steel market
items.summary_zh: 实施条例(EU)2026/1457自7月1日至12月31日适用，落实2026/1384的26类钢材配额。普通最惠国部分与FTA部分资格不同，中国不得因转运取得FTA资格；先到先得、非优惠原产地规则适用。附件例：中国3B类非取向电工钢CN72251990/72261980年度47,351.25吨、每季11,837.81吨，配额号09.9828；表列超配额附加税50%。此数为法规分配量，非实时余额。
items.impact_zh: 输欧订单应逐项匹配CN、原产地、配额号及报关时余额，区分中国专属与剩余配额；合同约定超配额风险。12月底前跟进替代实施条例，不能把本条例自动延续到2027年。
items.summary_en: Regulation 2026/1457 applies July–December 2026 with origin-specific MFN/FTA quotas and first-come-first-served access. China's category 3B allocation is 47,351.25 tonnes annually and 11,837.81 quarterly, order 09.9828; the listed out-of-quota duty is 50%, not a live balance.
items.title_en: EU 2026/1457 distributes steel quotas by origin and quarter through 31 December
items.impact_en: Match CN, origin and order numbers to live customs balances; allocate quota risk contractually and track replacement rules before year-end.

follow_up.zh: 跟进2027年配额分配实施条例；本条例适用期截至2026-12-31。
follow_up.en: Track the successor quota-distribution act before the current act expires on 31 December.

items.coverage: 已核对正文第1–6条、附件表头和中国3B类别；未逐行核算全部类别及实时配额余额，2026/1384主条例正文遇访问验证墙。

items.title_zh: 美国续行中国一次性钢瓶反倾销、反补贴令，10月14日起继续有效
items.title_en: US continues AD/CVD orders on Chinese non-refillable steel cylinders effective 14 October
items.title_original: Non-Refillable Steel Cylinders From the People's Republic of China: Continuation of Antidumping Duty Order and Countervailing Duty Order
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部根据其与USITC在首次五年日落复审中的肯定裁定，正式续行对中国一次性钢瓶的反倾销令A-570-126和反补贴令C-570-127，有效日期为2026年10月14日。范围包括符合或按照美国交通部Specification 39、加拿大39M或ISO 11118制造的焊接或钎焊便携式不可重复充装钢瓶，水容积300立方英寸（4.9升）至1526立方英寸（25升），可带或不带阀门/泄压装置、进口时可为空瓶；装压缩空气且符合描述的产品也包括。无缝一次性钢瓶明确排除。列示HTSUS 7311.00.0060、7311.00.0090，并可能从7310.29.0025、7310.29.0050进入，但书面范围优先。美国海关将继续按进口时有效税率收取反倾销和反补贴现金保证金；本通知没有公布一项适用于所有企业的新统一税率。
items.summary_en: Commerce has continued AD order A-570-126 and CVD order C-570-127 on non-refillable steel cylinders from China following affirmative Commerce and USITC sunset-review determinations, effective 14 October 2026. The scope covers specified welded or brazed portable cylinders of 4.9–25 litre water capacity made to USDOT 39, Transport Canada 39M or ISO 11118 requirements; seamless non-refillable cylinders are excluded. Listed HTSUS numbers are 7311.00.0060/0090 and potentially 7310.29.0025/0050, but the written scope controls. CBP will continue cash deposits at rates in effect on entry; the notice does not announce one new uniform rate.
items.impact_zh: 中国钢瓶生产商和出口商应立即按结构（焊接/钎焊或无缝）、容积、适用标准、是否带阀以及书面范围复核对美订单，不能仅凭HTS编码判断。报价和合同应沿用企业/组合在入境日适用的反倾销、反补贴保证金安排，并让美国进口商核对CBP指令；“续行”意味着现行令继续，不代表所有企业税率相同，也不应从本公告推算具体税额。
items.impact_en: Review US orders against construction, capacity, standards, valve configuration and the written scope, not HTS codes alone. Price using the producer/exporter combination and cash-deposit instructions applicable on entry; continuation does not create one uniform rate.

source.name: U.S. Federal Register / 美国联邦公报

items.source_excerpt: As a result of the determinations by the U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) and the U.S. International Trade Commission (ITC) that revocation of the antidumping duty (AD) and countervailing duty (CVD) orders on non-refillable steel cylinders the People's Republic of China (China) would likely lead to the continuation or recurrence of dumping, countervailable subsidies, and material injury to an industry in the United States, Commerce is publishing a notice of continuation of these AD and CVD orders.
items.follow_up: 下一次五年复审拟不迟于本次USITC裁定五周年前30天启动；当前订单应按入境日有效CBP保证金指令持续核对。
items.coverage: 2026-10-29已通读美国《联邦公报》公开检查版4页PDF，核对命令编号、续行日期、完整产品描述、排除项、HTSUS及现金保证金规则；未替任何企业核对其专属税率、范围裁定或CBP入境指令。

items.title_zh: 欧盟对取向电工钢实施临时保障措施，涉及配额与价格门槛
items.title_en: EU imposes provisional GOES safeguards with quotas and price thresholds
items.title_original: Commission imposes provisional safeguard measures on imports of grain-oriented electrical steel
items.summary_zh: 欧委会于 9 月 18 日宣布对进口取向电工钢采取临时保障措施，形式为关税配额结合价格门槛。范围包括加工后的叠片和铁芯，以及已装入变压器的铁芯。
items.summary_en: On 18 September the Commission announced provisional safeguards on grain-oriented electrical steel, using tariff-rate quotas and price thresholds. The scope includes laminations, cores and cores incorporated in transformers.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：出口取向电工钢及相关下游产品需核对正式法规中的产品范围、配额与价格条件；该公告不是最终保障措施。
items.impact_en: Monitoring assessment: exporters should check the legal product scope, quotas and price conditions. These are provisional measures.
items.source_excerpt: News article 18 September 2026 Commission imposes provisional safeguard measures on imports of grain-oriented electrical steel Today, the European Commission imposed provisional safeguard measures on imports of grain-oriented electrical steel products, in the form of tariff-rate quotas coupled with price thresholds. 2 min read

items.title_zh: 英国：对中国及俄罗斯部分冷轧板的旧反倾销措施于8月5日到期
items.title_en: UK: historical cold-rolled steel anti-dumping measure expired on 5 August
items.title_original: Trade remedies notices: anti-dumping duty on cold-rolled iron and steel products from China and Russia (expired)
items.summary_zh: 英国官方集合页及2022/04公告明确：部分冷轧平板反倾销税于2026年8月5日到期，2022/04公告不再适用。历史范围为未镀覆、加工不超过冷轧的非不锈钢平板，并排除部分电工钢、黑板及高速钢；旧税率表是历史信息。
items.summary_en: The official collection and notice 2022/04 expressly state that the cold-rolled measure expired on 5 August 2026 and no longer applies. The historical product scope excludes specified electrical steel, black plate and high-speed steel; old duty tables are historical.
items.impact_zh: 英国冷轧业务应更新报价税负底表，勿继续套用旧22.1%余项税率。仍需核对当前英国税则、配额措施及任何后续新措施；不能据此判断欧盟反倾销税到期。
items.impact_en: Update UK cold-rolled costing and stop treating the historical 22.1% residual rate as current. Check current UK tariffs and quotas; this does not imply EU duties have expired.

items.coverage: 已核对集合页到期更新及2022/04公告正文；未将历史税率作现行税率。

items.title_zh: 欧盟2026/2498明确第三国已付碳价抵扣CBAM：中国全国ETS列入附件II，须扣除免费配额并证明真实支付
items.title_en: EU Regulation 2026/2498: CBAM credit for carbon prices effectively paid; China national ETS listed in Annex II
items.title_original: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2498 of 5 November 2026 laying down rules for the application of Regulation (EU) 2023/956 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the conversion of the carbon price paid in a third country into a corresponding reduction in the number of CBAM certificates to be surrendered, the evidence of payment of that carbon price, the qualifications of the independent person and conditions to ascertain its independence and qualifications
items.summary_zh: 【正式法规】实施条例(EU)2026/2498于11月5日签署、11月16日公布，按第36条11月19日生效并自2026年1月1日起适用。第4条及附件II明确将China National Emissions Trading System列为符合相关机制定义的ETS，附件同步标注免费配额和履约责任上限；这不是认定每家中国钢厂均已实际付费或保证自动抵扣。第3、9条要求按具体产品对应的嵌入排放核算净已付碳价，扣除免费分配、返还与补偿；按第6条以报告年度官方年均汇率折欧元。第7条：采用独立核证的实际支付路径，减交CBAM证书量=单吨商品合格净已付碳价(欧元/吨商品)×申报吨数÷进口年度CBAM证书参考价格(欧元/吨CO₂)；采用欧委会默认碳价路径，按适用默认碳价(欧元/吨CO₂)×对应嵌入排放强度×申报吨数÷同一年度参考价换算。实际排放值可在合格实际碳价与默认碳价路径间选择；若嵌入排放用默认排放值，则仅能用官方默认碳价。第7(3)条的年度参考价为进口年度公布CBAM证书价格的平均值，不等于某次EUA成交价或单一季度价格。符合强制碳定价制度的履约碳信用可按限制计入；国际信用须符合《巴黎协定》第6条授权发行条件且最多为相关报告排放的10%。第11条允许符合条件的现有CBAM核查机构在2026—2027报告期暂承担已付碳价核证角色，2028年后须取得专项认可；过渡角色原则上最迟2028年9月30日终止。欧委会尚待发布各国默认碳价及方法，用于2027年9月30日前首轮CBAM申报。
items.summary_en: Regulation 2026/2498 was published 16 Nov, enters into force 19 Nov and applies from 1 Jan 2026. Annex II explicitly lists China's national ETS, with free allowances/liability cap—not an automatic credit. Deduct only verifiable net carbon prices attributed to CBAM-relevant embedded emissions, after rebates/free allocation. Actual-price route: certified EUR/tonne of goods × declared quantity ÷ annual CBAM reference price; default-price route: default EUR/tCO2 × embedded emissions intensity × quantity ÷ annual reference price. With default emission values, only default carbon prices may be claimed. Transitional verifier qualification covers 2026–27; special accreditation is needed from 2028. Default country carbon-price values are still forthcoming.
items.impact_zh: 【出口研判】对中国板坯、冷轧板等CBAM覆盖产品，国内ETS纳入并不等于全额按全国碳市场挂牌价减免。钢厂须证明有偿履约数量、实际支付与清缴凭证，按CBAM直接排放和前驱体等适用边界将碳价归属具体产品；国内ETS核算边界与CBAM边界可能不一致。可先比较欧委会未来默认碳价路径与独立核证的实际支付路径，避免为争取很小抵扣额付出过高审计成本。一般性示意：若1000吨进口钢材经核证净已付碳价为5欧元/吨商品，年度CBAM参考价为90欧元/吨CO₂，理论减交约55.56张证书；这不是中国实际碳价或2027年证书价格。2027年欧盟进口合同应区分CBAM法律缴证主体与商业成本分担，核对净成本是否扣除合格第三国碳价抵扣及相关资料责任；公开看板不披露任何客户私有合同条款。
items.impact_en: China ETS coverage does not automatically generate full EU credit. Mills need evidence of net paid allowances, surrender/payment and product-level attribution under CBAM boundaries, including relevant precursors. Compare default carbon-price and audited actual-price routes once Commission values are available. For 2027 EU imports, contract CBAM-sharing provisions should define net liability and data responsibilities without disclosing confidential customer terms.
items.follow_up: 钢厂财务/碳管理部门核对2026年度覆盖工序与CBAM产品边界、免费配额、履约缺口、购入配额成本/清缴凭证、退款补偿、前驱体及分品种碳价归属；确认核证机构能否承担2026—27年已付碳价核证；跟踪欧委会默认碳价与申报模板，比较默认和实际路径；欧盟进口商与合同方核对净CBAM成本分担。
items.coverage: 2026-11-17核对欧盟官方公报实施条例(EU)2026/2498第3—11、36条及附件I、II中中国ETS条目，并与DG TAXUD 2026-11-16正式通告交叉确认。公式为第7条变量关系的文字化表达；未使用未公布的中国默认碳价或具体钢厂实缴数据，也未据此判断具体合同已可减免。原采集published_date=2026-11-15为观察日期，官方公报日为2026-11-16。

items.title_zh: 欧盟2026/2547冷轧钢反倾销终裁：五地分企业征税3%—27.9%，11月17日生效
items.title_en: EU Regulation 2026/2547: definitive cold-rolled steel AD duties of 3–27.9% on five origins effective 17 November
items.title_original: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2547 of 13 November 2026 imposing a definitive anti-dumping duty on imports of certain cold-rolled flat steel products originating in India, Japan, Taiwan, Türkiye and Vietnam
items.summary_zh: 【正式法规】欧委会2026年11月13日签署实施条例(EU)2026/2547，11月16日刊登官方公报，依第3条11月17日生效。针对原产印度、日本、台湾地区、土耳其和越南的部分未镀覆冷轧铁/非合金钢/其他合金钢扁平材（不锈钢除外）征最终反倾销税，税基为欧盟边境未完税净价。第1条分企业税率：印度JSW及其他均9.5%；日本日本制铁/大同特殊钢及其他均27.9%；台湾地区中钢、中鸿与附件所列合作企业20.7%、其他27.0%；土耳其Tatmetal 3.0%、附件合作企业4.9%、Borçelik及其他7.8%；越南POSCO Vietnam及其他16.0%。范围为部分CN 72091500、72091690、72091790、72091891、72091899、72092500、72092690、72092790、72092890、72112330、72112380、72112900、72255080、72269200，带ex的子目须核对TARIC细码。排除规定的电工钢、特定小于0.35毫米退火黑板卷、硅电钢、高速钢；已镀锌/涂层卷不因冷轧基板而自动涉案。适用个别企业税率须出示第1(3)条规定的签字商业发票及附加TARIC代码，否则按原产地其他企业税率。序言(1067)—(1070)认定本案未实施临时税，因此不追溯向此前登记进口征收本案最终反倾销税。欧委会还首次就印度铁矿石政府措施、台湾地区受中国冷轧供给影响的市场价格认定特殊市场状况(PMS)，属于调查方法重要先例。
items.summary_en: Regulation 2026/2547 was signed 13 Nov, published 16 Nov and takes effect 17 Nov. Definitive AD rates: India 9.5%; Japan 27.9%; Taiwan 20.7% for CSC/Chung Hung/listed cooperators and 27% otherwise; Türkiye 3% Tatmetal, 4.9% listed cooperators, 7.8% Borçelik/others; Vietnam 16%. Scope is specified uncoated cold-rolled flats (exclusions and CN/TARIC subcodes apply). Individual rates require a signed invoice declaration. No retroactive collection in this investigation (recitals 1067–1070). The Commission established particular market situations in India and Taiwan.
items.impact_zh: 【出口研判】欧盟采购日本及台湾地区普通CRC的税负增加可能改变服务中心、家电和部分汽车冷轧材采购比较；土耳其企业税率仅3%—7.8%，仍需按厂别评估竞争力。中国出口商不因第三国被征税而自动免除自身反倾销、保障措施配额、CBAM和认证门槛。对潜在订单应分别核对CN/TARIC、工厂、发票、放行日期及客户技术认证，再测算DDP/CFR到岸成本。受限竞争品种可能转向中东/北非等市场，属于需要实证跟踪的贸易转移风险，不是已发生的事实。PMS调查逻辑值得关注以后对第三国本地原料成本与中国供应链关系的审查。
items.impact_en: This decision changes EU landed-cost comparisons for Japanese and Taiwanese CRC while some Turkish producers remain competitive at lower rates. Chinese origin is not exempt from its own AD, safeguards, CBAM or customer qualification. Compare supplier-specific landed costs and watch for possible (not confirmed) trade diversion to MENA. The PMS method is relevant to future origin/cost investigations.
items.follow_up: 按五地实际生产企业、CN/TARIC附加码与发票核对欧盟客户的既有及新采购；列中国替代供应商对照表并分别计算自身税负、配额、CBAM和认证条件；关注中东及北非竞争报价，不把可能的贸易转移当成既成事实。
items.coverage: 2026-11-17对照欧盟DG TRADE 11月16日正式通告及(EU)2026/2547官方公报163页PDF，目视核对第160—162页第1—3条、企业税率、排除品种、CN/TARIC、发票条件与生效日；核对序言(1067)—(1070)追溯征税问题及欧委会PMS解释。未逐票验证商品归类，也未计算中国具体钢厂适用税率。来源记录原采集published_date=2026-11-15系观察日期，正式官方公报日为2026-11-16。

items.title_zh: 欧盟普通法院驳回Özkan球扁钢反倾销诉讼，未撤销2024/209号条例
items.title_en: General Court dismisses Özkan bulb-flat anti-dumping challenge; Regulation 2024/209 is not annulled
items.title_original: Case T-175/24: Judgment of the General Court of 2 September 2026 – Özkan v Commission (Dumping – Imports of steel bulb flats originating in China and Türkiye – Definitive anti-dumping duty – Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/209 – Article 2(10)(j) of Regulation (EU) 2016/1036 – Currency conversions – Article 2(4), (10) and (11) of Regulation 2016/1036 – Ordinary course of trade – Fair comparison between the export price and the normal value – Quarterly dumping margin calculation)
items.summary_zh: 10月12日欧盟公报C/2026/5067公布9月2日T-175/24案判决结果：驳回土耳其Özkan诉讼并令其承担双方诉讼费用。争议涉及条例（EU）2024/209对中国及土耳其球扁钢的反倾销措施；判决所述该土耳其企业税率13.6%。法院在本案具体事实下认可用订单日确定换汇日期，同时按发票日把交易归入调查期；不能据此说所有案件必须统一改用订单日。
items.summary_en: OJ C/2026/5067 of 12 October publishes the 2 September T-175/24 dismissal and costs order. The underlying regulation covers Chinese/Turkish bulb flats; 13.6% is the Turkish applicant’s rate. On these facts, order-date currency conversion and invoice-date allocation to the investigation period were accepted, not made universal rules.
items.impact_zh: 中国涉案企业不能套用Özkan的13.6%税率；应查本企业、产品和原产地对应条例。应诉材料应串联订单、发票、交货、公差和币种风险证据；本判决没有为中国球扁钢创设豁免，也不代表所有类似诉讼结果已确定。
items.impact_en: Chinese firms must check their own product/origin/company rate. Retain order, invoice, delivery, tolerance and currency evidence; this judgment creates no Chinese exemption.
items.coverage: 2026-10-22：EUR-Lex及InfoCuria入口受限；通过出版局CELLAR官方目录取得判决HTML及公报原件，核对判决第1—72、84—106、220—238段和裁判主文。本条限诉讼结果、汇率日期与调查期划分，不声称完整评注全部论证。

items.title_zh: 欧盟理事会确定将CBAM纳入EEA的谈判立场：附件仍待联合委员会通过
items.title_en: Council sets the EU position on incorporating CBAM into the EEA; annex remains a draft
items.title_original: Council Decision (EU) 2026/2240 of 24 September 2026 on the position to be adopted, on behalf of the European Union, within the EEA Joint Committee concerning an amendment to Annex XX (Environment) to the EEA Agreement (CBAM) (Text with EEA relevance)
items.summary_zh: 理事会决定（EU）2026/2240于9月24日通过并生效，10月6日刊登公报，确定欧盟在EEA联合委员会中的立场。所附联合委员会决定仍明确标为草案，拟把条例（EU）2023/956及其简化修订2025/2083纳入EEA，并要求冰岛、挪威等EFTA国家在非优惠原产地、CN/TARIC对应编码、海关数据报送和CBAM登记册等方面与欧盟保持一致。草案拟在联合委员会通过且满足通知条件后生效，不能把理事会立场当成附件已经通过。
items.summary_en: Council Decision (EU) 2026/2240, adopted and effective on 24 September and published on 6 October, establishes the Union position in the EEA Joint Committee. Its annex is expressly a draft Joint Committee decision to incorporate Regulations (EU) 2023/956 and 2025/2083, align EFTA-state origin and tariff classifications, customs data and registry operation. The draft still requires Joint Committee adoption and its notification conditions.
items.impact_zh: 向冰岛、挪威出口的钢厂和贸易商应跟踪EEA联合委员会正式决定及当地配套法，不应据本理事会决定提前认定所有CBAM申报义务已经在当地生效；同时准备与欧盟一致的CN编码、非优惠原产地和排放数据。
items.impact_en: Exporters to Iceland and Norway should track the final EEA Joint Committee decision and local implementation rather than treating all obligations as already effective. Prepare EU-aligned CN classification, non-preferential origin and emissions data.
items.coverage: 已读官方CELEX全文及附件，核对第1—2条、草案序言、原产地／编码／海关数据安排和草案生效条款；未核验后续EEA联合委员会是否已经采纳。

items.title_zh: 欧盟启动中国与台湾冷轧不锈钢板卷反倾销到期复审
items.title_en: EU opens expiry review of Chinese and Taiwanese cold-rolled stainless steel
items.title_original: Notice of initiation of an expiry review of the anti-dumping measures applicable to imports of cold rolled stainless steel sheets and coils originating in the People’s Republic of China and Taiwan
items.summary_zh: 欧盟公报 C/2026/4830 启动冷轧不锈钢板卷到期复审，涉及 CN 7219、7220 下列明子目。复审调查期为 2025 年 7 月 1 日至 2026 年 6 月 30 日；针对立案的意见原则上须在 9 月 15 日公布后 37 天内提交。
items.summary_en: Notice C/2026/4830 opens an expiry review of cold-rolled stainless flat products under listed CN 7219/7220 subheadings. Review period: 1 July 2025–30 June 2026. Comments on initiation are generally due within 37 days of publication on 15 September.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：这不是撤税或新税率公告。涉及不锈钢出口的企业应让应诉团队确认适用范围、抽样与已过/尚未到期的不同提交期限。
items.impact_en: Assessment: this is not a duty-removal or new-rate notice. Counsel should distinguish scope, sampling and separate submission deadlines.

items.title_zh: 欧盟对中国和土耳其焊接钢丝网进口实施登记
items.title_en: EU requires registration of welded steel mesh imports from China and Türkiye
items.title_original: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2022 of 10 September 2026 making imports of welded steel mesh originating in the People’s Republic of China and Türkiye subject to registration with a view to allowing the levy of anti-dumping duties on the imports subject to registration
items.summary_zh: 欧盟实施条例(EU) 2026/2022自2026年9月12日起生效，要求海关登记原产于中国和土耳其的交点焊接普通钢丝格栅、网片、网和围栏，不论是否镀锌、涂层或卷装，现列CN 7314 20 90、7314 31 00和7314 39 00。登记为期9个月，目的是在法定条件满足时允许追溯征收反倾销税。
items.summary_en: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2022 took effect on 12 September 2026 and directs customs authorities to register welded-at-intersection grill, mesh, netting and fencing of plain wire from China and Türkiye, whether plated, coated, galvanised or in rolls, currently under CN 7314 20 90, 7314 31 00 and 7314 39 00. Registration lasts nine months and may support retroactive duties if the legal conditions are met.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：登记不是反倾销终裁，也未确定实际税率。投诉材料中的中国倾销幅度26%至73%、损害消除水平18%仅供现阶段参考。涉欧订单应自9月12日起单列登记进口、保存产品规格和报关记录，并在报价中保留追溯征税条款。
items.impact_en: Assessment: registration is not a final anti-dumping determination and sets no actual duty rate. Complaint estimates of 26–73% dumping and an 18% injury-elimination level for China are informational only. Segregate registered EU entries from 12 September, preserve specifications and customs records, and address retroactive-duty risk in contracts.
items.follow_up: 跟踪反倾销调查临时/终裁及是否追溯征税；现行登记期最长至2027-06-12。
items.coverage: Official EUR-Lex full text checked, including product scope, CN codes, registration purpose and nine-month duration.

items.title_zh: 欧盟对中国钢制货架及部件进口实施登记
items.title_en: EU requires registration of Chinese steel shelving units and components
items.title_original: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2023 of 10 September 2026 making imports of bolted and boltless steel shelves originating in the People’s Republic of China subject to registration with a view to allowing the levy of anti-dumping duties on the imports subject to registration
items.summary_zh: 欧盟实施条例(EU) 2026/2023自2026年9月12日起生效，要求登记中国原产的螺栓式和无螺栓钢制货架及部件，包括具有两个平面连接面的钢立柱、无焊接立柱连接件的钢横梁，以及包含上述部件的货架（可有或无任何材质层板）。现列CN ex 9403 20 80、ex 9403 99 10，TARIC 9403 20 80 20、9403 99 10 20；登记为期9个月。
items.summary_en: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2023 took effect on 12 September 2026 and requires registration of Chinese bolted and boltless steel shelving units and components, including steel uprights with two flat connecting surfaces, steel beams without welded upright connectors and shelving containing those components, with or without decks of any material. Current codes are CN ex 9403 20 80 and ex 9403 99 10, TARIC 9403 20 80 20 and 9403 99 10 20; registration lasts nine months.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：登记不等于已征税，投诉中的62%至103%倾销幅度和290%至310%损害消除水平不是最终税率。中国货架供应商及欧盟进口商应从9月12日起筛查对应TARIC条目，留存产品结构、连接方式和进口记录，并在合同中安排可能追溯征税的承担机制。
items.impact_en: Assessment: registration does not itself impose a duty. Complaint estimates of 62–103% dumping and 290–310% injury elimination are not final rates. Chinese suppliers and EU importers should screen the listed TARIC entries from 12 September, retain product-structure and import records, and allocate potential retroactive-duty risk contractually.
items.follow_up: 跟踪反倾销调查临时/终裁及是否追溯征税；现行登记期最长至2027-06-12。
items.coverage: Official EUR-Lex full text checked, including scope wording, CN/TARIC codes, registration purpose and duration.

items.title_zh: 欧盟对中国预应力钢丝及钢绞线启动反倾销日落复审（C/2026/4636）
items.title_en: EU opens expiry review of anti-dumping measures on Chinese PSC wires and strands (C/2026/4636)
items.title_original: Notice of initiation of an expiry review of the anti-dumping measures applicable to imports of certain pre- and post-stressing wires and wire strands of non-alloy steel (PSC wires and strands) originating in the People’s Republic of China
items.summary_zh: 欧委会依据《条例（EU）2016/1036》第11(2)条启动日落复审，案件R868，申请由European Stress Information Service于2026年6月1日代表欧盟产业提交。产品为含碳量不低于0.6%、最大横截面尺寸超过3毫米的非合金钢预应力钢丝及不超过18股的钢绞线，现列CN ex 7217 10 90、ex 7217 20 90、ex 7312 10 61、ex 7312 10 65、ex 7312 10 69；对应TARIC为7217 10 90 10、7217 20 90 10、7312 10 61 91、7312 10 65 91、7312 10 69 91。仅镀锌且中心丝直径不高于其余6丝直径3%的七丝绞线不在措施和本次复审范围。复审调查期为2025年7月1日至2026年6月30日，损害趋势考察期自2023年1月1日起；调查通常12个月内完成，最迟不超过立案公告后15个月。公告中的7日、15日、37日及65日提交期现均已届满。
items.summary_en: The Commission opened expiry review R868 under Article 11(2) of Regulation (EU) 2016/1036 following a 1 June 2026 request by the European Stress Information Service. The review covers specified non-alloy steel PSC wires and strands under CN ex 7217 10 90, ex 7217 20 90, ex 7312 10 61, ex 7312 10 65 and ex 7312 10 69, with listed TARIC subcodes. A narrowly defined galvanised seven-wire strand is excluded. The review investigation period is 1 July 2025–30 June 2026; the injury trend period starts 1 January 2023. The review should normally finish within 12 months and no later than 15 months after publication. The notice's 7-, 15-, 37- and 65-day submission windows have passed.
items.impact_zh: 这是一项正式日落复审立案，不是撤销现有反倾销措施，也不是已经决定续征。相关中国生产商应立即核对产品和TARIC范围、既有客户报关编码及案件R868公开卷宗；常规早期应诉期限已过，如未登记参与，应由欧盟贸易救济律师确认是否仍有程序性参与空间。业务计划需继续监测抽样、正常价值资料来源和最终结论，最迟法定结案时间约为2027年12月1日，具体以欧委会后续文件为准。
items.impact_en: This is a formal expiry-review initiation, not termination of the existing measures and not yet a decision to renew them. Affected Chinese producers should verify product/TARIC scope, customer declarations and the R868 file. Ordinary early participation deadlines have passed; counsel should assess any remaining procedural options. Monitor sampling, normal-value sources and the final decision, due no later than about 1 December 2027 subject to Commission documents.

items.follow_up: 跟踪案件R868抽样、正常价值资料来源及终裁；公告法定最迟结案时间为立案后15个月，约2027年12月1日。

items.title_zh: 欧盟对华硅锰焊丝临时反倾销：税率 75.3%—102.4%
items.title_en: EU provisional AD on Chinese silico-manganese welding wire: 75.3%–102.4%
items.title_original: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1929 of 7 August 2026 imposing a provisional anti-dumping duty on imports of certain wires of silico-manganese steel originating in the People’s Republic of China
items.summary_zh: 条例 (EU) 2026/1929 于 8 月 10 日公布、次日生效，针对符合成分及直径条件的硅锰钢丝，TARIC 7229200010。常州运河 75.3%，Juli 集团 102.4%，其他合作企业 93.1%，其他中国进口 102.4%；个别税率需符合规定的商业发票。
items.summary_en: Regulation (EU) 2026/1929, published 10 August and effective the next day, imposes provisional duties on specified silico-manganese wire (TARIC 7229200010): Yunhe 75.3%, Juli 102.4%, other cooperating firms 93.1%, all other Chinese imports 102.4%. Individual rates require a compliant invoice.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：仅对该产品条件适用，不能外推到普通线材；放行需相当于临时税额的担保，后续终裁可能调整。
items.impact_en: Assessment: apply only to the defined wire, not all wire rod. Release requires security equivalent to the provisional duty; definitive findings may change.

items.title_zh: 欧盟给予Ningbo Orange紧固件新出口商待遇，适用39.6%反倾销税
items.title_en: EU grants Ningbo Orange new-exporter treatment at 39.6%
items.title_original: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1926 of 7 August 2026 amending Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/191 imposing a definitive anti-dumping duty on imports of certain iron or steel fasteners, originating in the People’s Republic of China following acceptance of a request for a new exporting producer treatment
items.summary_zh: 实施条例2026/1926将Ningbo Orange Hardware Co., Ltd加入2022/191附件，适用未抽样合作企业39.6%的反倾销税率，TARIC附加码88FE；8月10日公布，8月11日生效。调整针对该企业及母条例所涉某些钢铁紧固件。
items.summary_en: Regulation 2026/1926 adds Ningbo Orange Hardware Co., Ltd to the 2022/191 annex at the 39.6% cooperating non-sampled rate, TARIC additional code 88FE. Published 10 August, effective 11 August; this is company-specific.
items.impact_zh: 相关报关须核对生产商身份、商业发票和母条例产品范围；其他企业不得套用该税率。
items.impact_en: Check producer identity, invoices and the parent regulation's scope; other exporters cannot use this rate.
items.coverage: 原OJ入口404，已通过官方CELEX入口读取2026/1926全文；未逐项核对母条例2022/191的全部CN编码。

items.title_zh: 欧盟2026/1785：浙江Yitai获紧固件新出口生产商待遇，税率39.6%
items.title_en: EU 2026/1785: Zhejiang Yitai receives new-exporter treatment at 39.6%
items.title_original: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1785 of 23 July 2026 amending Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/191 imposing a definitive anti-dumping duty on imports of certain iron or steel fasteners originating in the People’s Republic of China following acceptance of a request for new exporting producer treatment
items.summary_zh: 7月24日公布的实施条例(EU)2026/1785将Zhejiang Yitai Mechanical Technology Co., Ltd列入2022/191未抽样合作企业名单，TARIC附加代码88ES，反倾销税率39.6%，公布翌日生效。申请满足原调查期2019年7月1日至2020年6月30日未对欧出口、无相关受措施企业关联、调查期后实际出口三项条件；不是取消中国紧固件整体反倾销税。
items.summary_en: Published 24 July and effective the next day, Regulation 2026/1785 adds Zhejiang Yitai to the non-sampled cooperating fastener producers at 39.6%, TARIC code 88ES. It is company-specific new-exporter treatment.
items.impact_zh: 该企业及进口商应核对英文法人名称、88ES与商业发票要求。其他新出口企业可评估资格证据，但不得套用他人附加代码或39.6%税率。
items.impact_en: Match the legal producer identity, 88ES and invoice requirements; other exporters cannot use this company's code or rate.
items.coverage: 已核对2026/1785条例正文；完整产品范围及发票条件仍按其引用的2022/191及后续修订核对。

items.title_zh: DELVE 2判决：紧固件发票可事后补交，但不自动取得企业税率
items.title_en: DELVE 2: retrospective invoices do not automatically secure individual duty rates
items.title_original: Case C-889/24, Delve 2: Judgment of the Court (Second Chamber) of 21 May 2026 (request for a preliminary ruling from the Administratīvā rajona tiesa – Latvia) – DELVE 2 SIA v Valsts ieņēmumu dienests (Reference for a preliminary ruling – Customs union – Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/191 – Imposition of a definitive anti-dumping duty on imports of certain iron or steel fasteners originating in the People’s Republic of China – Article 1(3) – Customs declaration – Application for amendment – Presentation by the importer, after making the customs declaration, of a commercial invoice meeting the requirements of that provision)
items.summary_zh: C-889/24、ECLI:EU:C:2026:413的5月21日判决允许报关后补交符合2022/191第1(3)条的有效商业发票；发票只是必要条件，海关仍可核实真实生产商和单据信息。援引海关法典第173(3)条的报关更正期限为接受申报起3年；本条7月20日日期为公报公告版本，不是判决作出日。
items.summary_en: The 21 May judgment, C-889/24 (ECLI:EU:C:2026:413), permits retrospective valid invoices under Article 1(3) of 2022/191, but they do not automatically secure individual rates. Customs can check producer identity and evidence. Article 173(3) provides a three-year declaration-amendment window. The item's 20 July date is its OJ notice version.
items.impact_zh: 中国紧固件企业应向进口商提供可追溯生产及运输证据；历史申报更正须核对期限和个案条件，不能承诺仅补发票即可退税。
items.impact_en: Provide traceable production and shipping evidence. Check deadlines and case-specific conditions; a replacement invoice alone cannot guarantee repayment.
items.coverage: EUR-Lex入口仍受访问检查限制；已读CURIA官方公告及判决全文，核对两项裁判、海关检查和三年更正期限；未判断个别进口商退税资格。

items.title_zh: 欧盟钢铁新规2026/1384：10月起须提供熔炼与浇铸国证明
items.title_original: Regulation (EU) 2026/1384 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 17 June 2026 addressing the negative trade-related effects of global overcapacity on the Union steel market and amending Regulation (EU) 2020/2170
items.summary_zh: 正式条例设置关税配额及配额外50%关税；第4条要求以钢厂证书等可核验证据证明首次液态熔炼和首次凝固浇铸所在国，自2026年10月1日起适用。熔炼浇铸国不应直接等同现行配额分配原产地；第12条要求最迟2028年6月30日评估是否以其作为配额依据。
items.impact_zh: 对欧出口应立即把钢厂证书、炉号和贸易单据关联；逐项核对产品附件、配额及原产地规则，不能仅凭熔炼国推定可用配额。
items.summary_en: The regulation sets tariff-rate quotas and a 50% out-of-quota duty. Article 4 requires verifiable evidence of initial melting and first solid casting, applicable from 1 October 2026. Using melt-and-pour country as the quota allocation basis remains subject to assessment by 30 June 2028.
items.title_en: EU steel regulation 2026/1384: melt-and-pour evidence required from October
items.impact_en: Link mill certificates and heat numbers to shipment records now. Check product annexes, quota availability and origin rules separately.
items.coverage: 已读取官方条例正文，重点核对第2—4、12、14条；本解读不逐项核验产品附件、企业配额余额或全部实施细则。

items.title_zh: 欧委会通过CBAM证书购售和回购细则，平台每张收取0.05欧元
items.title_en: Commission adopts CBAM certificate sale and repurchase rules with a EUR 0.05 per-certificate platform fee
items.title_original: Sale and repurchase of CBAM certificates
items.summary_zh: 欧委会11月25日通过授权条例C(2026) 8367 final，理事会公开转送文本ST 16474/26。细则自2027年2月1日起适用，至核验时未查见欧盟官方公报刊登，仍须履行欧洲议会和理事会审查。第2、3、13和15条规定，授权申报人在CBAM登记册提交购买申请，每单1至99,999张，通过统一平台以欧元付款，证书在确认付款后入账。款项若在相关证书价格变更当日或其后才到账，申请取消，含手续费原路退回。每售一张收0.05欧元，沿用7月草案金额。第4条将草案的每年一次明确为每个进口年度原则上一次，完成有关年度交证或符合豁免等规定后可申请回购。2026年进口仍按进口季度证书价计算，2027年9月30日首次交证。按基本条例，针对2026年排放在2027年买入的证书仅可在2027年回购，相关年度交证后的回购申请截至10月31日。
items.summary_en: On 25 November the Commission adopted delegated act C(2026) 8367 final, transmitted in Council document ST 16474/26. It is to apply from 1 February 2027, subject to scrutiny and Official Journal publication. Submit 1–99,999 certificates per request in the CBAM Registry and pay in euros on the central platform. The EUR 0.05 fee per certificate remains from the July draft. If funds clear on or after a price change, the request is cancelled and the payment, including the fee, is refunded. The adopted text clarifies the ordinary repurchase limit as once per import year. Imports in 2026 retain import-quarter prices, with first surrender on 30 September 2027 and repurchase requests after surrender due by 31 October 2027 for those certificates.
items.impact_zh: 输欧板坯、热卷、冷轧及涂镀板的进口商可据此预排证书采购与资金。在跨年合同中，将证书单价、实际归属的购证数量、每张平台手续费和回购退款分别留痕，并确认手续费是否计入合同结算的CBAM成本。对2027年进口订单另按适用的周度证价及季度持证要求规划，确认付款能在换价前到账。继续按既有税则与申报规则清关。
items.impact_en: EU slab and flat steel importers can schedule purchases and funding. Record the certificate price, purchased quantities allocated to the shipment, platform fee and repurchase refund separately. Agree how the fee is treated under cost-sharing clauses. Plan weekly price and quarterly holding requirements for 2027 imports and allow time for funds to clear before repricing.

items.title_zh: 美国第三次日落复审续行中国预应力混凝土用钢绞线双反令，自11月10日延续
items.title_en: US continues China PC strand antidumping and countervailing duty orders effective 10 November
items.title_original: Prestressed Concrete Steel Wire Strand From the People's Republic of China: Continuation of Antidumping Duty and Countervailing Duty Orders
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部于11月25日刊登第2026-23992号公告，续行中国预应力混凝土用钢绞线反倾销令A-570-945和反补贴令C-570-946，自2026年11月10日起适用。8月商务部认定若撤销措施，倾销和补贴可能持续或重现，国际贸易委员会随后确认产业损害风险。美国海关继续按入境时适用的保证金率收取。原令覆盖预张拉和后张拉用的特定非不锈钢钢绞线，参考HTSUS 7312.10.3010、7312.10.3012。使用镀锌钢丝的产品，只有锌或氧化锌镀层达到或超过ASTM A475的0.40盎司/平方英尺时才按该条件排除。具体适用以文字范围为准。
items.summary_en: Commerce published its continuation notice on 25 November, effective 10 November 2026, after Commerce and ITC's third sunset determinations. CBP continues collecting entry-date AD/CVD deposits. The scope covers specified prestressed concrete strand, with reference HTSUS 7312.10.3010 and 7312.10.3012 and a zinc-coating exclusion threshold of 0.40 oz/ft² for qualifying strand made from galvanized wire.
items.impact_zh: 中国钢绞线输美继续核对钢厂、出口商和入境时保证金率。拟依据镀层排除报价时，让美国报关行先核对镀层检测和书面范围；规格确认前应保留适用双反成本。
items.impact_en: Confirm the producer, exporter and entry-time deposit rates before quoting. Where a coating exclusion is claimed, have the US broker validate the written scope and coating test data.

source.name: U.S. Federal Register / 美国联邦公报

items.source_excerpt: As a result of the determinations by the U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) and the U.S. International Trade Commission (ITC) that revocation of the antidumping duty (AD) and countervailing duty (CVD) orders on prestressed concrete steel wire strand (PC strand) from the People's Republic of China (China) would likely lead to the continuation or recurrence of dumping, countervailable subsidies, and material injury to an industry in the United States, Commerce is publishing a notice of continuation of these AD and CVD orders.

items.coverage: 核对第2026-23992号公告的有效日期、产品范围与保证金条款，及美国国际贸易委员会10月28日公告和8月商务部日落复审。本次公告未增设企业新税率，日落复审幅度不作为清关保证金报价。

items.title_zh: 美国初裁认定越南使用中国热轧钢制车轮构成规避，保证金追溯起点为2026年3月19日
items.title_en: US preliminarily finds Vietnam-finished steel wheels using Chinese hot-rolled steel circumvent China orders
items.title_original: Certain Steel Wheels from the People's Republic of China: Preliminary Affirmative Determination of Circumvention of the Antidumping Duty and Countervailing Duty Orders
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部11月24日公布A-570-082、C-570-083全国性肯定初裁，涉及用中国原产热轧钢在越南组装或制成并输美的涉案钢制车轮。拟指示美国海关对2026年3月19日起报关进口或从保税仓提取进入消费、且尚未清算的涉案报关单暂停清算并收取反倾销及反补贴预估保证金。原令主要涵盖名义直径22.5和24.5英寸的商用车无内胎道路钢轮、轮辋和轮辐，参考税号包括8708.70.4530、8708.70.4560、8708.70.6030、8708.70.6060、8716.90.5045及8716.90.5059，铝轮、钢材重量占比不足50%的车轮及部分有内胎车轮排除。非中国热轧基料生产的越南车轮在本次调查范围外，但报关仍需核查认证，NCC Vietnam等企业须证明具备认证资格。本次初裁没有独立新税率表，保证金适用既有令和海关执行指令。书面意见于公布后14日内提交，反驳为其后7日，听证请求为公布后30日内。
items.summary_en: On 24 November Commerce issued a country-wide affirmative preliminary finding under A-570-082 and C-570-083. It will instruct CBP to suspend liquidation and collect estimated AD/CVD deposits for covered unliquidated entries from 19 March 2026. The written order covers specified on-road steel wheels, rims and discs, primarily 22.5 and 24.5 inches. Non-Chinese hot-rolled inputs fall outside this inquiry, subject to evidence and certification requirements. Initial briefs are due 14 days after publication.
items.impact_zh: 如供应车轮用热轧料，按越南客户的成品用途及输美订单排查风险。请越南车轮厂与美国进口商核对3月19日起未清算单据、卷号和原产地证明、认证资格及保证金率，确认后方可锁定含税价格和清关安排。
items.impact_en: For hot-rolled steel supplied to Vietnamese wheel manufacturers, identify US-bound covered wheels. Ask the manufacturer and US importer to check entries still unliquidated since 19 March, coil-level origin evidence, certification eligibility and applicable deposits before committing to duty-paid pricing.

source.name: U.S. Federal Register / 美国联邦公报

items.source_excerpt: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) preliminarily determines that imports of certain steel wheels (steel wheels), completed in the Socialist Republic of Vietnam (Vietnam) using hot- rolled steel (HRS) produced in the People's Republic of China (China), are circumventing the antidumping duty (AD) and countervailing duty (CVD) orders on steel wheels from China. Interested parties are invited to comment on this preliminary determination.

machine_translation.title_zh: 中华人民共和国的某些钢轮:对反倾销税和反补贴税命令的规避的初步肯定性确定
machine_translation.excerpt_zh: 美国商务部(商务部)初步确定,在越南社会主义共和国(越南)用中华人民共和国(中国)生产的热滚钢完成的某些钢轮(钢轮)的进口,绕过中国的反倾销税(AD)和反补贴税(CVD)对钢轮的订单,请有关各方对这一初步决定发表意见。

items.title_zh: 美国初裁认定印尼使用中国热轧或冷轧基料加工的特定耐腐蚀钢板未规避中国双反令
items.title_en: US issues preliminary no-circumvention finding for Indonesian CORE made from Chinese HRS or CRS
items.title_original: Certain Corrosion-Resistant Steel Products From the People's Republic of China: Preliminary Negative Determination of Circumvention of the Antidumping Duty and Countervailing Duty Orders
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部11月24日公布A-570-026、C-570-027的全国性否定初裁。3月25日立案后，本次认定限于印尼用中国热轧或冷轧基料制成并从印尼输美的特定耐腐蚀钢板（CORE），调查期2021年1月1日至2025年12月31日。产品包括符合书面范围的镀锌、镀铝或其他耐腐蚀金属镀层钢板，原令参考税号有7210.49.0030及7210.61.0000，镀锡板、无锡钢等有明确排除。本公告未指示基于本次初裁新增保证金。商务部将开展核查，书面意见日期另行通知，反驳期为案情陈述截止后7日，听证请求为公告后30日内。
items.summary_en: Commerce issued a country-wide negative preliminary finding on 24 November under A-570-026 and C-570-027. It covers specified CORE completed in Indonesia using Chinese hot- or cold-rolled steel for US export, with a 2021–2025 inquiry period. The notice does not instruct new deposits on the basis of this finding. Verification and further comments precede the final determination.
items.impact_zh: 印尼镀层钢加工使用中国基料的输美报价有望减少一项反规避风险。请进口商逐票核对基料、印尼实际工序、产品范围及其他适用税费，并在合同中约定终裁变化后的成本分担。
items.impact_en: The ruling reduces one preliminary risk for Indonesian coated output from Chinese substrate. Verify substrate, Indonesian processing, scope and other US duties with the importer; allocate final-ruling risk in contracts.

source.name: U.S. Federal Register / 美国联邦公报

items.source_excerpt: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) preliminarily determines on a country-wide basis that imports of certain corrosion- resistant steel products (CORE) completed in Indonesia using hot-rolled steel (HRS) or cold-rolled steel (CRS) manufactured in the People's Republic of China (China) are not circumventing the antidumping duty (AD) and countervailing duty (CVD) orders on CORE from China. The period of inquiry is January 1, 2021, through December 31, 2025. Interested parties are invited to comment on this preliminary determination.
items.follow_up: 跟踪核查、ACCESS意见截止、最终裁定和海关指令。

items.title_zh: 英国CBAM注册指南更新：区分拟豁免原产货物与经欧洲转运的第三国货物
items.title_en: UK CBAM threshold guidance distinguishes eligible origin from transit through Europe
items.title_original: Imported Carbon Border Adjustment (CBAM) goods that may not contribute towards the registration threshold
items.summary_zh: HMRC 11月23日更新5万英镑注册门槛操作指引。按同日草案，欧盟、欧洲经济区或瑞士原产的合格货物拟排除在门槛之外；经这些地区转运、原产地仍为第三国且无其他排除情形的货物计入。原产地按英国非优惠规则认定，进口商对范围内货物保留记录。
items.summary_en: On 23 November HMRC clarified how the planned exemption affects the GBP 50,000 registration threshold. Eligible EU, EEA and Swiss-origin goods would be omitted; third-country covered goods routed through these markets count unless a separate exclusion applies. The draft remains subject to enactment.
items.impact_zh: 把英国进口商的门槛测算与货物路线区分开。中国冷轧、镀锌等在范围内的钢材走欧洲仓或港口出运时，应向进口商提供正确原产地和报关资料，按其合计进口额核算门槛及成本。
items.impact_en: Model the threshold by importer and goods origin. Provide correct origin and declaration data for in-scope China-origin CRC or galvanized steel moving via a European port or warehouse.
items.source_excerpt: Find out which imported CBAM goods may not contribute towards the registration threshold of £50,000. If you import CBAM goods of UK origin, they’re exempt from CBAM even when released into free circulation. You import aluminium wire (which is in scope of the CBAM ) from China. The aluminium wire was originally made in the UK. CBAM will be charged on goods which originate from outside of the UK according to the UK’s non-preferential rules of origin . CBAM tax will not apply to goods that originate in the EU , EEA or Switzerland and then are imported to the UK. Any goods originating from the EU , EEA or Switzerland being imported to the UK do not count towards the £50,000 CBAM registration threshold. This relief applies whether you or someone else originally imported the CBAM goods. If CBAM goods enter an inward processing procedure and are processed into non- CBAM goods that are imported to the UK (you pay any customs duties due, and they’re released into free circulation), only the va…

items.title_original: Draft legislation: exemption for EU, EEA and Swiss-origin goods from CBAM
items.summary_zh: 11月23日，英国税务海关总署发布草案全文，落实11月20日峰会公布的政策意向。欧盟、欧洲经济区和瑞士原产的范围内货物拟按英国非优惠原产地规则免征英国CBAM，不计入5万英镑注册门槛，且无需列入英国CBAM申报表。草案预计在2027年1月1日后获御准，届时拟追溯适用于自该日起进口的合格货物。草案另拟赋权财政部按条件对其他合格ETS互联国家或地区的指定商品设置豁免。法案通过前，进口商需遵守届时有效的法律和留档要求。
items.summary_en: HMRC published draft text on 23 November, following the 20 November summit. Covered goods of EU, EEA or Swiss non-preferential origin would incur no UK CBAM and be omitted from the GBP 50,000 registration test and the UK CBAM return. Royal Assent is expected after 1 January 2027, with retrospective application once enacted. Importers are to keep appropriate records and comply with the rules in force.
items.impact_zh: 对2027年英国热轧、冷轧、镀层板及其他纳入范围的钢材订单，先按商品编码及非优惠原产地识别货物。中国原产钢材经欧盟仓储或转运后，其英国CBAM成本仍按适用规则计入报价。与进口商确认税费承担、原产地和排放资料留存，并将欧洲供应商可能取得的豁免计入竞争报价情景。
items.impact_en: For 2027 UK HRC, CRC and coated products, check the commodity code and non-preferential origin. Continue allowing for UK CBAM on in-scope China-origin material shipped via European stock or transit. Agree importer records and cost allocation and evaluate eligible European offers under a separate exemption scenario.
items.source_excerpt: This draft legislation sets out the proposed treatment under the UK Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) of goods originating in countries whose emissions trading schemes are linked to the UK Emissions Trading Scheme (UK ETS).

items.title_zh: 欧盟与英国完成ETS互联协议谈判：拟于2028年实施，CBAM相互豁免仍须立法
items.title_en: EU and UK conclude ETS linking negotiations, targeting 2028 and future mutual CBAM exemptions
items.title_original: Negotiations finalised to link EU and UK Emissions Trading Systems
items.summary_zh: 【欧盟及英国2026年11月20日官方公告】双方在欧英峰会宣布完成排放交易体系互联协议谈判，目标2028年1月1日起实施，但须双方批准、正式生效及登记系统技术衔接。互联后两地配额拟可交叉用于履约。欧盟税务总司明确：英国原产货物未来免征欧盟CBAM，尚须依CBAM基本条例第2(11)条修改附件III，不能把谈判完成视为已经豁免。英国政府解释文件预计欧盟CBAM对英国原产货物的豁免从2028年1月1日起适用，取决于欧盟立法；英国拟自2027年1月1日起豁免欧盟、欧洲经济区和瑞士原产货物的英国CBAM。原产于中国等第三国的货物并不因经英国或欧盟转运、进口而自动取得原产地豁免；英国政府称第三国原产货物跨境仍可按规定享受碳价减免。英国还将从2028年起调整相关免费配额退出路径以与欧盟衔接。
items.summary_en: On 20 Nov 2026 the EU and UK announced completed ETS-linking negotiations, targeting operation from 1 Jan 2028 subject to ratification, entry into force and technical work. Cross-use of allowances and mutual CBAM exemptions are envisaged; EU Annex III still requires a delegated amendment. UK expects an EU-origin CBAM exemption from 2027 and an EU exemption for UK-origin goods from 2028, subject to relevant legislation. Non-UK/EU-origin goods are not automatically exempt by transshipment.
items.impact_zh: 【重点出口研判】2027年中国板坯、热轧和冷轧出口英国仍须按英国CBAM实际规则核算，不能提前视作免税；2028年欧英原产钢材跨境竞争成本可能下降，英国或欧盟加工商的原产地与实质性加工路径会更重要。中国钢材经英国港口转运或简单加工不当然取得英国原产地，亦不能自动免除欧盟CBAM。欧洲客户应分别核对进口国、货物真实原产地、2027/2028适用法规、第三国已付碳价减免和进口商承担义务；留意碳配额价格趋同对报价及采购的影响。
items.impact_en: Do not assume Chinese steel entering the UK in 2027 or transshipped via Britain is CBAM-exempt. Assess origin, substantial transformation, UK/EU CBAM rules and potential 2028 competitive effects separately. ETS price convergence may affect costs.

items.summary_zh: HMRC于2026年11月19日更新进口CBAM货物排放强度指引，新增核查机构说明：英国CBAM要求具备适用认可机构颁发的英国CBAM专项认可，其他CBAM制度的认可及报告不会自动满足英国要求；同一机构若分别符合多项制度要求，可同步开展核查，但英国仍须专门合规报告。认可机构负责公布并维护获认可核查机构名单，HMRC目前不计划自行发布名单。2027年进口可使用2027年核证排放强度，尚不可得时可使用上一年度合格核证数据。
items.summary_en: HMRC's 19 Nov update confirms UK-specific CBAM verifier accreditation and reports are required; EU/other CBAM accreditation or reports are not automatically accepted. Accreditation bodies, rather than HMRC, publish verifier lists. Relevant verified 2026 data may be used when 2027 data are unavailable under the 2027 import rule.
items.impact_zh: 【出口影响】中国钢厂不能假定已有欧盟CBAM核查报告可直接用于2027年英国进口；应提前询问核查机构是否取得英国认可及能否按英国规则出具独立报告，比较额外核证费用和默认值方案。
items.impact_en: Chinese mills should confirm UK-specific verifier accreditation and report formats, rather than assuming EU CBAM verification automatically suffices; compare verification costs against UK default-value use.

items.title_original: Trade remedies notice: hot-rolled steel plates originating from South Korea (anti-dumping)
items.summary_zh: 【正式公告】英国政府2026年11月18日发布贸易救济通知2026/32，自11月19日实施、期限五年至2031年11月19日。针对原产韩国的特定非卷状热轧中厚板（涉及7208、7210、7225下11个税号，通常厚度≥4.75毫米并有产品排除项），按宽度区分：≤2100毫米的韩国生产商现代钢铁7.04%（附加码8A78）、POSCO 12.19%（8A79）、其他23.07%（8A80）；>2100毫米适用0%（8A81），均为同一最终反倾销措施的一部分。税基为进口英国边境未完税净价。享受指定生产商税率需有效商业发票附签字声明；否则适用剩余税率。该决定拒绝TRA对全范围征税5.98%—25.71%的建议，并终止此前进口登记。不得把TRA建议税率当成最终税率。
items.summary_en: UK notice 2026/32 published 18 Nov and effective 19 Nov 2026 to 19 Nov 2031. For Korean hot-rolled plate ≤2,100 mm: Hyundai Steel 7.04% (8A78), POSCO 12.19% (8A79), others 23.07% (8A80). Plate >2,100 mm attracts 0% (8A81). Specific invoice declarations are required for producer-specific rates. The Secretary of State rejected the TRA's broader recommended rates.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】英国进口商采购韩国中厚板的到岸成本将按实际制造商与2100毫米宽度阈值分化，宽板韩国货仍可保持零反倾销税竞争力。中国板材可能获得局部替代询价，但必须独立核对中国原产货物适用的英国贸易救济、保障措施、UK CBAM及客户认证，不可视为自动获益。跟踪韩国≤2100毫米中厚板是否转向其他市场属于预测，尚无证据确认。建议对英国客户按生产厂、宽度、税号、附加码及商业发票逐项核价。
items.impact_en: Korean plate costs now vary materially by producer and the 2,100 mm threshold. Chinese substitution is only a possibility subject to separate UK measures, quotas, carbon obligations and customer approvals. Monitor potential diversion without treating it as established.
items.source_excerpt: Trade remedies notices published by the Secretary of State for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade (BIST) relating to the dumping investigation on imports of hot-rolled steel plate originating from South Korea.

items.title_original: Extension of CBAM to Iceland and Norway
items.summary_zh: 欧委会税务与海关总司2026年11月18日官方公告确认，EEA联合委员会第283/2026号决定于11月18日生效；2027年1月1日起挪威和冰岛进口CBAM覆盖货物适用相同规则。钢铁、铝、化肥、水泥年度50吨门槛在欧盟、挪威和冰岛合计计算，电力和氢不适用该吨数门槛；三地授权申报人资格相互承认。挪威和冰岛进口商须办理授权，2027年3月31日前申请者有过渡便利；列支敦士登不在CBAM区域。
items.summary_en: EEA Decision 283/2026 entered into force 18 Nov. From 1 Jan 2027 CBAM extends to Norway and Iceland. The 50-tonne annual threshold for four sectors is cumulative across the EU and both EEA states; authorisations are mutually recognised.
items.impact_zh: 向挪威及冰岛出口板坯、热轧/冷轧等涉案产品需准备CBAM排放数据，并与欧洲集团进口商核对跨三地累计进口量及授权状态；不能将50吨门槛分拆适用。
items.impact_en: Steel exporters should prepare emissions data and coordinate group-wide import volumes and declarant authorisations across the three customs territories.
items.source_excerpt: Extension of CBAM to Iceland and Norway EEA Joint Committee Decision No 283/2026, which extends CBAM to Iceland and Norway, entered into force on 18 November 2026. From 1 January 2027, the same CBAM rules will apply to imports of covered goods into Iceland and Norway as to imports into the EU.

items.title_en: EU definitive anti-dumping duties on cold-rolled steel from India, Japan, Taiwan, Türkiye and Vietnam take effect on 17 November
items.title_original: Commission imposes anti-dumping duties on certain cold-rolled flat steel products
items.summary_zh: 【正式法规】欧盟执行条例(EU)2026/2547于11月13日通过、11月16日刊登，按第3条于11月17日生效。第1条规定：印度9.5%；日本27.9%；台湾合作企业20.7%、其他27%；土耳其Tatmetal 3%、Borçelik及其他企业7.8%、附件列明的其他合作企业4.9%；越南16%。税基为未完税欧盟边境净价。范围为特定未镀覆冷轧铁、非合金钢及其他合金钢扁平材，涉及部分7209、7211、7225、7226税号；不含不锈钢，另排除规定的电工钢、硅电钢、高速钢，以及厚度小于0.35毫米的退火卷状黑铁皮。企业单独税率须凭符合第1(3)条的商业发票声明，具体产品及TARIC附加码以条文和附件为准。
items.summary_en: Regulation (EU) 2026/2547 was adopted on 13 November, published on 16 November and enters into force on 17 November 2026 under Article 3. Article 1 sets duties of 9.5% for India, 27.9% for Japan, 20.7% for cooperating Taiwanese producers and 27% otherwise; Türkiye: Tatmetal 3%, Borçelik and residual imports 7.8%, other listed cooperators 4.9%; Vietnam 16%. Duties apply to the net Union-frontier price before duty. Specified uncoated cold-rolled iron/non-alloy/other-alloy flat products are covered under parts of CN 7209, 7211, 7225 and 7226. Stainless steel, specified electrical/silicon-electrical and high-speed steels, and annealed black-plate coils below 0.35 mm are excluded. Individual rates require the prescribed invoice declaration; consult Article 1 and the Annex for exact scope and additional TARIC codes.
items.impact_zh: 【业务研判】即使本案没有把中国大陆列为涉案原产地，也会改变欧盟进口冷轧的到岸成本比较。可向欧洲汽车、家电、服务中心客户核对上述来源在途与新采购，按具体钢厂税率、产品范围和交货时间重算报价；土耳其不同企业不能统一按最高税率估算。部分受影响供货可能转向中东、北非等市场，形成新的报价压力，这属于需跟踪的贸易转移情景。中国钢材是否具备替代机会仍需另核对其自身适用措施、配额、CBAM和客户认证，不能由本案推定自动受益。
items.impact_en: Business assessment: the measure changes EU landed-cost comparisons even though mainland China is not a named origin. Check customers’ shipments and sourcing plans against producer-specific duties, scope and delivery timing, particularly the differing Turkish rates. Diversion into the Middle East or North Africa could intensify price competition; this is a scenario to monitor, not an established outcome. Any substitution opportunity for Chinese steel still depends on its own applicable measures, quotas, CBAM and customer qualification.

items.title_zh: 英国CBAM：2027年起保存进口记录，2028年开放注册
items.title_en: UK CBAM: record-keeping starts in 2027, registration opens in 2028
items.title_original: Prepare for the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)
items.summary_zh: 【事实】HMRC于2026年11月10日更新官方CBAM总指南，明确CBAM于2027年1月1日对特定铝、水泥、化肥、氢、钢铁进口货物生效；自该日起进口商必须保存记录，即使不需注册也应保存可证明不承担税务责任的记录。CBAM注册于2028年1月1日开放。此为官方指南的澄清更新，不代表税制生效推迟至2028年。
items.summary_en: HMRC updated its CBAM collection on 10 November 2026: CBAM applies from 1 January 2027 to specified imports, with record-keeping from that date including evidence of non-liability. Registration opens 1 January 2028. The latter is not a deferral of the tax.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】中国钢厂对英国出口应从2027年货物开始准备商品编码、进口商、交易及实际嵌入排放数据；报价与合同不得将2028年注册误当作2027年无CBAM成本。
items.impact_en: UK-bound steel exporters should prepare commodity codes, importer and emissions records for 2027 and avoid treating 2028 registration as tax deferral.
items.status: 英国官方执行指南更新
items.source_excerpt: Find out what to do if you import specific goods from the aluminium, cement, fertiliser, hydrogen, and iron and steel sectors into the UK from 1 January 2027. The Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism ( CBAM ) comes into effect on 1 January 2027. It will tax embodied emissions in specific carbon intensive goods imported into the UK. If you import CBAM goods into the UK from the aluminium, cement, fertiliser, hydrogen, iron and steel sectors: you’ll have to keep records — from 1 January 2027 you may need to register — registration opens on 1 January 2028 If you import CBAM goods into the UK from the aluminium, cement, fertiliser, hydrogen, iron and steel sectors: Find out about CBAM rates and default values for aluminium, cement, fertilisers, hydrogen and iron and steel.
items.coverage: 2026-11-10读取HMRC官方集合页正文及更新历史，确认2027-01-01记账、2028-01-01注册；未据集合页推断特定钢种税率。
items.follow_up: 【待确认】按实际UK商品编码、进口责任人及HMRC税率/默认值指南逐票核对2027年义务和成本。

items.title_zh: 英国CBAM注册判断指南更新：进口货值门槛5万英镑
items.title_en: UK CBAM registration guidance: £50,000 threshold and 2027 records
items.title_original: Check if you’ll need to register for Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)
items.summary_zh: 【事实】HMRC于2026年11月10日更新注册判断指南，明确2027年1月1日起需保存CBAM相关记录、2028年1月1日起开放注册。注册判断包括：商品编码是否属于CBAM范围、谁是进口责任人、哪些进口不计入门槛，以及符合条件的CBAM进口货物累计或预计货值是否超过50,000英镑。门槛并非所有钢铁进口统一豁免，应按指南计算。
items.summary_en: HMRC's updated registration guide confirms records from 1 January 2027 and registration opening on 1 January 2028. Liability checks include commodity codes, importer identity, excluded transactions and whether relevant imports exceed or are expected to exceed £50,000.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】英国客户应按进口主体汇总适用CBAM货值，避免把单票货值、全部钢材货值或中国出口商销售额直接当作注册门槛依据；中国供货方应配合提供可追溯排放及产品信息。
items.impact_en: UK importers should calculate threshold exposure by liable importer and in-scope goods; Chinese suppliers should provide traceable product and emissions information.
items.status: 英国官方执行指南更新
items.source_excerpt: Find out if you need to register for CBAM when you import selected CBAM goods from the aluminium, cement, fertiliser, hydrogen, iron and steel sectors from 1 January 2027.
items.coverage: 2026-11-10读取HMRC官方注册指南步骤1至4及更新历史，确认50,000英镑门槛和2027/2028节点；未逐项核验全部税号或例外清单。
items.follow_up: 【待确认】核对具体UK商品编码、进口主体、门槛排除项和适用期间，结合客户2027年进口计划判断是否需要2028年注册。

items.title_zh: 美国对柬埔寨加工的中越钢丝衣架作出反规避肯定终裁
items.title_en: US final circumvention finding on wire hangers finished in Cambodia with Chinese/Vietnamese inputs
items.title_original: Steel Wire Garment Hangers From the People's Republic of China and the Socialist Republic of Vietnam: Final Affirmative Determination of Circumvention of the Antidumping Duty Order on Steel Wire Garment Hangers From the People's Republic of China and the Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Orders on Steel Wire Garment Hangers From the Socialist Republic of Vietnam
items.summary_zh: 【事实】美国商务部2026年11月6日联邦公报文号2026-22658（91 FR 70055）认定：使用中国或越南生产的钢丝，或钢丝及纸质附件，在柬埔寨完成制造并出口美国的钢丝衣架，构成规避原有中国反倾销令或越南反倾销/反补贴令。美国海关继续对2025年8月12日及以后尚未最终清算的相关进口暂停清算并收取保证金。涉案命令A-570-918、A-552-812、C-552-813；并非对全部钢丝或钢卷出口新征税。
items.summary_en: Commerce's final 6 Nov 2026 decision (FR 2026-22658) finds Cambodia-finished wire garment hangers using Chinese or Vietnamese wire inputs circumvent existing AD/CVD orders; CBP continues suspension and cash deposits for relevant unliquidated entries from 12 Aug 2025. It is not a blanket duty on wire or flat steel.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】涉及中国钢丝—柬埔寨衣架加工—美国进口链条的客户应立即梳理投入原产地、最终用途和进口批次；普通钢卷/钢丝并不因本案自动纳入衣架税令。需以文字产品范围为准，而非仅凭HTS归类。
items.impact_en: Review Cambodia assembly and US entry records if supplying hanger wire; distinguish covered hangers from standalone steel inputs.

items.status: 反规避终裁／继续保证金
items.source_excerpt: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) determines that imports of steel wire garment hangers (hangers), completed in Cambodia using: (1) steel wire or (2) steel wire and paper accessories, produced in the People's Republic of China (China) or the Socialist Republic of Vietnam (Vietnam), are circumventing the antidumping duty (AD) order on hangers from China, or the AD and countervailing duty (CVD) orders on hangers from Vietnam.

items.title_zh: 美国启动9月周年反倾销/反补贴行政复审：涉及中国钢制货架及耐火砖，非钢卷普遍加税
items.title_en: US initiates September-anniversary AD/CVD reviews including Chinese steel racks and magnesia carbon bricks
items.title_original: Initiation of Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Administrative Reviews
items.summary_zh: 【事实】美国商务部2026年11月5日发布《启动反倾销和反补贴税行政复审》（91 FR 69796，文号2026-22629），对9月周年日的多项现行AD/CVD命令启动复审。中国涉案产品包括钢制货架及零部件（Certain Steel Racks and Parts Thereof，A-570-088，复审期2025-09-01至2026-08-31）和镁碳砖（A-570-954，同期），并非中国热轧、冷轧、镀锌钢卷全面启动新调查。公告同时列有韩国冷轧板、韩国/墨西哥/土耳其厚壁矩形焊管等其他原产地产品。复审启动不等于最终税率改变。公告要求符合条件的非市场经济体出口商原则上于刊登后14个日历日内提交单独税率申请或认证；无销售通知原则上30日内；预计2027-09-30前公布终裁。
items.summary_en: Commerce's 5 Nov 2026 initiation notice (91 FR 69796; document 2026-22629) covers September-anniversary administrative reviews, including China-origin certain steel racks and parts (A-570-088, POR 1 Sep 2025–31 Aug 2026) and magnesia carbon bricks (A-570-954). It also lists Korea-origin cold-rolled steel and heavy-walled rectangular welded pipes from Korea, Mexico and Türkiye. Initiation is not a new blanket tariff or final rate change. Eligible NME exporters generally have 14 calendar days from publication for separate-rate applications/certifications, and no-sales notices are generally due within 30 days. Final results are intended by 30 Sep 2027.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】对首钢冷轧、热轧及镀锌卷出口美国，不能由该公告推导新增普遍税负；重点检查是否直接或通过下游客户出口涉案钢制货架及零部件，以及相关企业是否被列名。被列名出口商应立即与美国贸易救济律师核对单独税率资格和申报期限。其他国家原产钢管/冷轧案仅在对应原产地及产品范围内有直接影响。
items.impact_en: Do not treat this notice as a new across-the-board duty on Chinese flat steel. Check direct or downstream shipments of covered steel racks and listed exporters. Affected exporters should promptly review separate-rate filing eligibility and deadlines with US trade counsel.

items.title_zh: 美国对华钢钉2024—2025年度反倾销复审初裁：悦达9.27%，9家企业终止复审
items.title_en: US preliminary AD review of Chinese steel nails: Yueda 9.27%; nine companies rescinded
items.title_original: Certain Steel Nails From the People's Republic of China: Preliminary Results and Rescission, in Part of Antidumping Duty Administrative Review; 2024-2025
items.summary_zh: 【事实】美国商务部11月4日发布A-570-909行政复审初裁，复审期2024年8月1日至2025年7月31日。上海悦达钢钉及其滁州关联公司获单独税率资格，初步加权平均倾销幅度9.27%；中国统一税率118.04%本轮未复审、不变。因无可复审的暂缓清算进口记录，对附录II所列9家企业终止本次复审。案情摘要和名单均为官方初裁，并非终裁或对所有中国钢钉统一改税。公告规定利害关系方书面案情陈述须在公布后21日内提交，反驳陈述在此后5日内；听证申请应在公布后30日内通过ACCESS提交。
items.summary_en: Commerce published preliminary results for A-570-909 on 4 November 2026, covering 1 August 2024 to 31 July 2025. Shanghai Yueda Nails and its Chuzhou affiliate received a preliminary separate rate of 9.27%; the China-wide 118.04% rate was not reviewed. Nine companies were rescinded for lack of reviewable suspended entries. Case briefs are due within 21 days of publication, rebuttals five days later, and hearing requests within 30 days. These are preliminary findings, not final duty changes for all Chinese nail exports.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】涉美钢钉业务应逐家核实生产商/出口商身份、适用现金保证金和进口批次，不应把悦达9.27%用于其他钢钉企业；终止复审也不等于取消反倾销令。相关企业应在法定时限内由美国代理律师评估陈述、复核计算和听证；本次未独立取得ACCESS完整产品范围备忘录，具体HTSUS归类及适用边界须另行确认。
items.impact_en: Check exporter-specific treatment, deposits and entry history; do not apply Yueda's 9.27% to other exporters. A rescission does not revoke the AD order. Counsel should review briefing and hearing deadlines and verify product scope against the ACCESS memorandum.

source.name: U.S. Federal Register / 美国联邦公报

items.status: 美国反倾销行政复审初裁
items.source_excerpt: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) preliminarily determines that Shanghai Yueda Nails Co., Ltd., (Shanghai Yueda) and Shanghai Yueda Nails (Chuzhou) Ltd. (Chuzhou Yueda) (collectively, Yueda Nails), an exporter of certain steel nails (nails) from the People's Republic of China (China), made sales of subject merchandise at less than normal value (NV) during the period of review (POR), August 1, 2024, through July 31, 2025. In addition, we are rescinding the review with respect to nine companies. Interested parties are invited to comment on these preliminary results of review.

items.title_zh: 英国钢材贸易措施官方说明11月3日更新：20类配额、超额50%税及10月税号调整仍适用
items.title_en: UK steel trade measure: 3 November official page confirms 20 quota categories and 50% out-of-quota duty
items.title_original: UK's steel trade measure from 1 July 2026
items.summary_zh: 【事实】英国政府《UK's steel trade measure from 1 July 2026》官方页面标示2026年11月3日更新。该措施自7月1日起取代原保障措施，免税进口总配额较原制度减少51%，适用于列示的20类钢材产品；超配额进口加征50%从价关税，按其他进口税前货值计算，原25%保障措施附加税已于6月30日停止。按7月—次年6月配额年度分四季度，原产国单独额度及剩余（residual）额度按先到先得办理；季度未用完额度可向下一季度结转，但不跨配额年度。官方正文也明确此前10月1日起将非合金钢丝税号72173049、72173090排除在措施范围外，该两项由50%降为0%，第28类相关额度不变。最新页面仍列有第1类授权用途专用配额与对应下游加工用途。
items.summary_en: The UK government's steel trade measure page states it was updated on 3 November 2026. The measure replaced the former safeguard on 1 July 2026, cutting aggregate duty-free quota volumes by 51% versus the old safeguard and applying a 50% ad valorem out-of-quota duty to listed goods across 20 categories. Quarterly country/residual quotas operate first come, first served; unused amounts roll to the next quarter but not into a new quota year. A previously effective 1 October change removed non-alloy wire codes 72173049 and 72173090 from the measure, without changing Category 28 quota quantities. Category 1 authorised-use rules also remain set out.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】对热轧、第4类金属涂镀、第5类彩涂及其他涉英出口钢材，应按英国8位税号、当季来源国/剩余额度和进口人实际报关时点计算配额风险。不得因11月3日网页标记更新而声称当天新推出50%税或上述10月税号调整；此次网页修订的逐项文本差异尚未取得。下一步核对HMRC实时配额余额、适用配额订单号及中国原产可用额度，再确定英国CFR/DDP报价中的超额税负。
items.impact_en: For UK-bound hot-rolled, coated and other scoped steel, check the exact UK commodity code, eligible country/residual quota and clearance date before pricing. The 50% duty was not newly imposed on 3 November; the 1 October wire-code exemption is also an earlier change. The full text diff for the 3 November page revision has not been established. Confirm live HMRC balances and quota order numbers rather than treating the published annual allocation as available stock.

items.title_zh: 英国CBAM 11月3日更新净重记录规则：以进口时不含包装的公斤净重申报
items.title_en: UK CBAM record guidance updated: net mass at import, excluding packaging, in kilograms
items.title_original: Keeping records for Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)
items.summary_zh: 【事实】英国HMRC 11月3日更新CBAM记录保存指南的重量章节。进口CBAM货物须记录进口时不含包装的净重，单位kg，最多保留6位小数。超过1kg且带小数的重量可按0.5kg阈值四舍五入到整数公斤；不足1kg应以0.开头、最多6位小数记录并去除末尾零。报关单、商业发票、运输重量记录、提单及装箱单均可作为重量证据。2027年1月1日起的进口记录义务、通常6年保存期及2028年1月1日开放注册的时间安排未因这次重量说明改变。
items.summary_en: HMRC updated its CBAM records guidance on 3 November 2026 to specify import-time net mass excluding packaging, in kg, up to six decimal places. Fractions above 1 kg may be rounded to the nearest kg with a 0.5 kg threshold; sub-1 kg values use up to six decimals without trailing zeroes. Import declarations, invoices, carrier records, bills of lading and packing lists can substantiate weight. Existing 2027 record-keeping and 2028 registration dates are unchanged.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】英国钢材订单需把轧厂卷净重、包装/托盘重量、提单重量及英国报关净重区分管理，避免将含包装毛重或船运重量直接用于CBAM申报。建议销售与货代对齐卷号级净重字段和公斤精度，留存原始称重与四舍五入记录；具体CBAM税额还需结合商品编码、排放强度及适用税率计算。
items.impact_en: Align mill coil net weights with UK customs net mass, keeping packaging and shipping gross weights separate. Retain traceable coil-level kg data and rounding records; weight alone does not determine the CBAM charge.
items.source_excerpt: Find out which records you must keep if you're the importer of CBAM goods. evidence of UK origin materials, already carbon taxed in reimported goods Keep records of any CBAM goods you import which are of UK origin (under the non-preferential rules of origin) . This could include:

items.title_en: UK CBAM: HMRC clarifies actual or default emissions values for Carbon Price Relief
items.title_original: Work out your Carbon Price Relief
items.summary_zh: 【事实】英国税务海关总署（HMRC）11月2日更新《Work out your Carbon Price Relief》。申请英国CBAM已付碳价抵扣，须证明进口货物的相关排放已受符合资格的碳定价制度约束，并持有涵盖进口前两个日历年度之一、经独立核验的碳价核验表。有效碳价按装置受不同碳价要素约束的排放量与相应价格加权计算，免费配额等无价格部分不计价，并扣除适用补偿。抵扣金额按有效碳价乘以符合条件的产品嵌入排放量计算；11月2日新增说明：该排放量应与CBAM申报一致，可按该批货物采用实际排放值或默认值。外币抵扣须使用HMRC公布的、进口前一季度适用汇率换算为英镑；总抵扣不得超过该批货物应缴英国CBAM税额。此为实施指南的解释性更新，并非宣布新增税率。
items.summary_en: HMRC updated its Carbon Price Relief (CPR) guidance on 2 November 2026. A claimant needs a qualifying carbon-pricing scheme and an independently verified carbon-pricing form covering one of the two calendar years preceding importation. The effective price accounts for differently priced emissions, excluding unpriced free allocations and deducting relevant compensation. The update clarifies that eligible embedded emissions used for relief must match the CBAM return and may use actual or default values as reported. HMRC's prior-quarter FX rate converts foreign-currency relief to GBP; relief cannot exceed the CBAM liability. This is guidance, not a new UK CBAM rate.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】对拟于2027年起向英国出口钢铁的中国生产商，应提前整理装置碳价缴纳、免费分配、补偿及排放核验材料，并确认采购方/英国进口商能否取得合格证明；不能因中国有碳市场或采用默认排放值，就推定必然可抵扣。报价和合同CBAM条款应分别列示毛CBAM成本与可能抵扣额。下一步核对HMRC认可的碳定价机制清单、钢材商品编码及最终适用核验文件。
items.impact_en: Chinese steel exporters should compile verified installation emissions, actual carbon-price payment, free allocation and compensation evidence, and confirm the importer can substantiate a qualifying scheme. Default emissions values do not automatically establish an entitlement to relief. Price UK business on gross CBAM exposure and separately evidenced relief, subject to the applicable commodity scope and HMRC documentation.

items.title_zh: 美国加速审查中俄乌定尺碳钢板措施：书面意见11月30日截止
items.title_en: US expedites reviews of CTL carbon steel plate measures; comments due 30 November
items.title_original: Cut-to-Length Carbon Steel Plate From China, Russia, and Ukraine; Scheduling of Expedited Five-Year Reviews
items.summary_zh: 美国国际贸易委员会（USITC）在第五次日落复审中决定采用加速程序，审查撤销中国定尺碳钢板反倾销令，以及终止俄罗斯、乌克兰同类产品暂停调查安排，是否会在可预见期间导致美国国内产业实质损害延续或再现。公告称国内产业答复充分、被调查方答复不充分，未发现需要全面复审的其他情形；案件被认定为“特别复杂”，复审期可延长最多90天。非公开工作人员报告拟于2026年11月23日提供给行政保护令名单人员，公开版随后发布；具备资格的当事方书面意见及非当事公众简短陈述原则上于11月30日17:15（美国东部时间）前提交，且不得加入新的事实资料。这是USITC程序安排，不是新税率或撤销措施决定。
items.summary_en: USITC has scheduled expedited fifth sunset reviews of the Chinese CTL carbon steel plate antidumping order and the suspended investigations concerning Russia and Ukraine. Domestic responses were adequate and respondent responses inadequate; the reviews were deemed extraordinarily complicated, permitting an extension of up to 90 days. The non-public staff report is scheduled for 23 November 2026 and eligible written comments are due by 5:15 p.m. ET on 30 November, without new factual information. This is a procedural notice, not a new duty rate or revocation decision.
items.impact_zh: 涉及对美定尺碳钢板业务的中国生产商、出口商和进口商不应把“加速审查”理解为现行反倾销令已经撤销或加税。应由美国案件律师核对当事方资格、行政保护令服务名单、书面意见权限及11月30日提交时限，并按书面产品范围判断具体货物；HTS编码只能辅助，不能替代范围描述。未参与前期答复的主体可能不具备提交评论资格，须逐案确认。
items.impact_en: Do not treat the expedited review as revocation or a new duty. Counsel should verify party eligibility, APO service-list status, filing rights and the 30 November deadline, and assess merchandise against the written scope rather than tariff codes alone.

source.name: U.S. Federal Register / 美国联邦公报

items.source_excerpt: The Commission hereby gives notice of the scheduling of expedited reviews pursuant to the Tariff Act of 1930 ("the Act") to determine whether revocation of the antidumping duty order on cut-to- length carbon steel plate from China and the termination of the suspended investigations on cut-to-length carbon steel plate from Russia and Ukraine would be likely to lead to continuation or recurrence of material injury within a reasonably foreseeable time.

follow_up.action_zh: 具备资格的当事方与律师核对USITC书面意见提交资格、APO服务和17:15美国东部时间截止；不得加入新事实资料。
follow_up.action_en: Eligible parties should confirm USITC filing rights, APO service and the 5:15 p.m. ET deadline; comments may not contain new factual information.

items.title_zh: 摩洛哥延长焊接钢管保障措施至2029年：中国等当前列入豁免清单
items.title_en: Morocco extends welded-pipe safeguard through 2029; China is currently exempt
items.title_original: Avis public n° DDC/12/2026 relatif aux résultats du réexamen de la mesure de sauvegarde sur les tubes et tuyaux en fer ou en acier
items.summary_en: Morocco's Ministry of Industry and Trade, in Notice DDC/12/2026, extends the safeguard on imported welded iron or steel tubes and pipes for three years from 6 November 2026. The measure covers conical or pyramidal welded pipes with circular, square or rectangular cross-sections under Moroccan tariff codes 7306191090, 7306199900, 7306301099, 7306309900, 7306501090, 7306509900, 7306611010, 7306611090, 7306619000, 7306691000, 7306699900, 7306902012, 7306902019, 7306902022, 7306902029, 7306902039, 7306909019 and 7306909099. Additional ad valorem duties are 19% from 6 November 2026 to 5 November 2027, 18% to 5 November 2028, and 17% to 5 November 2029. The annex currently exempts mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao and Chinese Taipei under the WTO developing-country import-share rule; the list may be revised using updated import data.
items.impact_zh: 对中国钢管出口商，当前关键结论是不能把19%直接套用于中国原产货物。应保留原产地、生产及运输链证据，并在每票出运前复核豁免附件是否调整。转口或非中国原产货物不得借用中国豁免；若某来源进口份额超过3%，清单存在调整风险。
items.impact_en: Chinese pipe exporters should not automatically apply the 19% duty to Chinese-origin goods because China is currently listed as exempt. Preserve origin, production and transport-chain evidence and recheck the annex before each shipment. Transshipped or non-Chinese-origin goods cannot rely on China's exemption, and the list may change if an origin's import share exceeds 3%.

items.title_zh: 泰国对中国预应力钢绞线启动反倾销调查，出口商问卷12月3日截止
items.title_en: Thailand opens anti-dumping investigation into Chinese PC strand; exporter questionnaire due 3 December
items.title_original: ลวดเหล็กกล้าตีเกลียวสำหรับคอนกรีตอัดแรง (PC Strand) - China - AD1057
items.summary_zh: 泰国商业部外贸厅（DFT）案件页面显示，反倾销案AD1057涉及原产于中国的预应力混凝土用钢绞线（PC Strand），泰国海关编码7312.10.91。公告于2026年10月22日刊登，调查自10月23日启动；目前状态为“调查中”，页面列示税率为0%，即尚未作出征税裁定。DFT页面把外国生产商／出口商问卷截止日列为2026年12月3日。中国商务部贸易救济信息网根据泰国政府公报编译称，利益相关方还应在公告发布之日起30日内提交书面评述意见和证据。
items.summary_en: Thailand's Department of Foreign Trade (DFT) case page shows that anti-dumping case AD1057 covers prestressed concrete steel wire strand (PC strand) originating in China under Thai customs code 7312.10.91. The notice was published on 22 October 2026 and the investigation started on 23 October. The case remains under investigation and the portal shows a zero duty, so no dumping duty has yet been imposed. DFT lists 3 December 2026 as the questionnaire deadline for foreign producers/exporters. China's MOFCOM trade-remedy portal, citing the Thai Gazette, also says interested parties have 30 days from publication to file written comments and evidence.
items.impact_zh: 这是正式立案调查，不是反倾销税终裁。向泰国出口涉案钢绞线的中国企业应立即按HS 7312.10.91和产品描述筛查调查期内交易、泰国客户及关联方，尽快完成利害关系方登记、律师授权和书面意见；不要把12月3日问卷期限与公告后30日的评述期限混为一谈。未按期、完整答卷可能使泰方依据可得事实裁定。报价和合同可预留贸易救济风险条款，但在出现初裁或终裁前不应自行假设税率。
items.impact_en: This is a formal initiation, not a final duty determination. Chinese exporters should screen transactions, Thai customers and affiliates using both the written product description and HS 7312.10.91, register as interested parties, retain counsel and prepare comments and questionnaire responses promptly. The 3 December questionnaire deadline is separate from the 30-day comment period. Incomplete or late responses may lead to facts-available findings. Contracts may allocate trade-remedy risk, but firms should not assume a duty rate before a preliminary or final determination.

items.title_zh: 欧盟就ETS市场稳定储备达成临时政治协议：保留上限拟由4亿增至7亿配额
items.title_en: Provisional EU ETS deal would raise the MSR retention buffer from 400m to 700m allowances
items.title_original: Commission welcomes political agreement on rules enhancing stability and long-term resilience of EU carbon market
items.summary_zh: 欧委会10月21日新闻稿IP/26/2206确认议会与理事会达成临时政治协议，拟将市场稳定储备（MSR）可保留的配额缓冲由4亿提高至7亿。现行规则对超过4亿的储备配额作废。协议仍须双方正式通过并在欧盟公报发布后生效，与7月17日提出的更广泛ETS/MSR改革分别推进。
items.summary_en: Commission release IP/26/2206 of 21 October confirms a provisional Parliament–Council deal to retain up to 700 million allowances in the MSR, rather than invalidate holdings above 400 million. Formal adoption and Official Journal publication remain necessary. The broader July ETS/MSR review is separate.
items.impact_zh: 增加的是储备缓冲，并非立即向市场投放3亿配额，也不是CBAM免征或税率下调。钢厂应跟进正式文本及后续供给规则；出口报价仍用适用期官方购证价格和产品排放数据。
items.impact_en: Retention is not an immediate release of 300 million allowances or a CBAM exemption. Track adoption and use applicable official certificate prices in export estimates.
items.status: 临时政治协议／待正式通过
items.source_excerpt: The European Commission welcomes the provisional political agreement reached by the European Parliament and the Council on a targeted amendment to strengthen the Market Stability Reserve (MSR) of the EU's Emissions Trading System (EU ETS).

items.summary_zh: HMRC于10月16日发布税率指引：铝、水泥、化肥、氢及钢铁分别适用行业税率，并根据英国ETS所反映的有效碳价按季度变化。适用税率由货物行业和进口季度决定，按商品编码判断行业；2027年起在每季度开始前后公布。当前示例税率不能替代正式季度税率。
items.summary_en: HMRC’s 16 October guidance sets separate sector rates for aluminium, cement, fertilisers, hydrogen, and iron and steel. Rates reflect the effective UK carbon price and vary quarterly. Product classification and the import quarter determine the applicable rate; illustrative figures are not live quarterly rates.

items.source_excerpt: Find out how sector-level CBAM rates are calculated under the CBAM rate methodology using illustrative rates and worked example. The UK Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism ( CBAM ) is designed to address the risk of carbon leakage as the UK decarbonises its economy. It does this by applying a carbon price to imported goods in covered sectors that reflects the carbon price faced by comparable domestic production. Unlike most taxes, CBAM does not have a single headline rate set out in primary legislation. Instead, the rate is determined using a methodology that combines recent carbon pricing data, sector-level emissions information and the extent to which domestic producers continue to receive free allowances under the UK Emissions Trading Scheme. This methodology is set out in law, via the Finance Act 2026. The purpose of this note is to explain how sector-level CBAM rates are calculated under the CBAM rate methodology. It is intended as a transparency tool to help businesses understand…

items.summary_en: The 16 October guide seeks feedback by 13 November 2026 at cbampolicyteam@hmrc.gov.uk, subject MRV technical guidance feedback. Its steel chapter distinguishes sinter, ferroalloys, pig iron, DRI, crude steel and processed products, with relevant precursors. Post-consumer scrap can carry zero embedded emissions, but EAF fuel, electrodes and other carbon inputs remain relevant. UK electricity indirect emissions are out of scope.

items.impact_en: Map process boundaries and precursors and prepare annual carbon balances. Excluding cutting emissions does not remove precursor emissions or yield losses. Submit unresolved steel-process questions before the deadline.

items.summary_en: The 16 October summary covers five sectors from 1 January 2027. The £50,000 registration test uses previous-12-month and next-30-day imports, with the first-year lookback starting January 2027. Registration opens 1 January 2028, with a first-year deadline of 31 January; the 2027 return/payment is due 31 May 2028. Quarterly periods follow. The importer is liable; actual verified data or defaults and eligible carbon-price relief determine the charge.
items.impact_zh: 钢厂现在就应与英国客户确定8位编码、原产地、数量、排放年度、核查和合同分工。2028年才注册不代表2027年无需留档；£50,000是相关进口货值门槛，不是税额免征额度。
items.impact_en: Agree eight-digit codes, origin, weight, emissions year and evidence with UK buyers now. Delayed registration does not delay 2027 records, and £50,000 is goods value, not tax relief.
