items.title_original: Getting the emissions intensity when importing Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) goods
items.summary_zh: 进口隐含排放由重量乘排放强度计算；实际值须有合格核查机构出具的报告，注明强度和完整日历年监测期。可选生产年份口径，或按进口年份关联：2027年进口使用可取得的最新2027年核查数据，未取得时可用2026年数据；2028年起进口使用此前两个日历年中最新可用的核查数据。也可使用政府默认值。
items.summary_en: Embodied emissions equal product weight multiplied by emissions intensity. Actual data require an eligible verifier’s report identifying intensity and the calendar-year monitoring period. Data may link to production year, or import year: for 2027 imports use available verified 2027 data, otherwise 2026; from 2028 use the latest available verified year within the preceding two calendar years. Default values are an alternative.
items.impact_zh: 钢厂须与英国进口商约定采用哪一种年度关联方式，匹配产品、生产年份、报告和供货记录。不能把一次检测、单炉废钢比例或未经核查的内部估算直接当成年度排放强度。
items.impact_en: Agree the year-linking method with the importer and match product, production-year, verification and shipment records. A spot test or unverified scrap-ratio estimate does not establish annual intensity.
items.source_excerpt: Find out how to get your emissions intensity as an importer (also known as a liable person) when importing Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) goods into the UK.
items.coverage: 2026-10-22：已核对官方指导网页全部实质正文；未将所链接法规、证书或企业数据视为已经逐项审计。

items.title_zh: 欧盟10月版CBAM问答澄清钢材加工与前体口径：切割后净重不能替代投入量
items.title_en: October EU CBAM Q&A clarifies steel processing and precursor mass before cutting
items.title_original: CBAM Questions and Answers
items.summary_zh: 10月15日问答的钢铁问题4.11、4.31说明：切割等排除工序不计其工序排放，但前体仍按进入工序、切割前质量核算；再加热、再熔、铸造、热冷轧、锻造、酸洗、退火、涂覆、镀锌、拉丝等属于相关系统边界，电镀、切割、焊接及精整排除。财务章节确认2026年对应购证自2027年2月开始，2026年度首次申报及清缴为2027年9月30日；购证量须考虑免费配额调整及有效已付碳价。
items.summary_en: The 15 October Q&A says excluded cutting emissions do not permit using only post-cut precursor mass. Relevant boundaries include rolling, forging, pickling, annealing, coating, galvanising and drawing; plating, cutting, welding and finishing are excluded. Certificate sales start February 2027; the first 2026 annual declaration and surrender are due 30 September 2027, with free-allocation and eligible paid-carbon-price adjustments.
items.impact_zh: 钢厂应统一前体投入重量、成品产量和外包工序台账，不能只以出口净重回推全部排放。为欧盟客户预留2027年购证资金和年度核查时间；问答为解释材料，个案仍依现行法规及正式指南。
items.impact_en: Reconcile precursor input, output and outsourced processing and plan verified data and buyer funding. The Q&A explains rules; it is not a substitute for governing legislation.
items.source_excerpt: CBAM - Questions and Answers 15 October 2026 English Download (604.21 KB - PDF)
items.coverage: 2026-10-22：已读PDF版本日期、财务第3章和钢铁相关问题4.11、4.31、4.32；未全文解读其他行业及全部问答。本条为明确范围的钢铁和首次清缴要点。

items.title_zh: 美国延续对华预包装无螺栓钢制货架反倾销与反补贴令
items.title_en: United States continues AD and CVD orders on prepackaged boltless steel shelving from China
items.title_original: Boltless Steel Shelving Units Prepackaged for Sale From the People's Republic of China: Continuation of Antidumping Duty Order and Countervailing Duty Order
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部在第二次五年日落复审后，因商务部与美国国际贸易委员会分别认定撤销措施可能导致倾销、可诉补贴和实质损害继续或再现，决定自2026年9月29日起延续A-570-018、C-570-019反倾销与反补贴令。美国海关将继续按进口时有效税率征收现金保证金。本令覆盖预包装销售、主要无需螺母螺栓或螺钉组装的钢制货架单元及加装套件，可带或不带层板；书面范围优先于列示的HTSUS 9403.20.0018、9403.20.0020、9403.20.0025、9403.20.0026及可能使用的9403.10.0040。壁挂式货架、一体式金属丝货架、散装零部件和定制货架系统明确排除。
items.summary_en: Following the second sunset reviews, Commerce continued AD order A-570-018 and CVD order C-570-019 effective 29 September 2026 because Commerce and the ITC found that revocation would likely cause dumping, countervailable subsidies and material injury to continue or recur. CBP will keep collecting cash deposits at the rates in effect on entry. The written scope covers prepackaged boltless steel shelving units and add-on kits, with or without decks; cited HTSUS lines are 9403.20.0018, 9403.20.0020, 9403.20.0025 and 9403.20.0026, with possible entry under 9403.10.0040. Wall-mounted units, integrated wire shelving, bulk-packed parts and made-to-order systems are excluded.
items.impact_zh: 这是现有贸易救济令的正式延续，不是新立案，也未在本通知中公布统一新税率。对美出口货架及套件应先按书面产品描述核对范围，再确认出口商/生产商对应的现行AD和CVD现金保证金率；不能只凭HTSUS编码或“无螺栓”商品名称判断是否落入措施。
items.impact_en: This formally continues existing trade-remedy orders; it is not a new investigation and does not announce a single new rate. U.S.-bound shelving and kits require written-scope analysis and confirmation of the exporter/producer-specific current AD and CVD cash-deposit rates; HTSUS codes or a boltless trade name alone are not dispositive.

source.name: U.S. Federal Register / 美国联邦公报

items.source_excerpt: As a result of the determinations by the U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) and the U.S. International Trade Commission (ITC) that revocation of the antidumping duty (AD) and countervailing duty (CVD) orders on boltless steel shelving units prepackaged for sale from (boltless steel shelving) the People's Republic of China (China) would likely lead to the continuation or recurrence of dumping, countervailable subsidies, and material injury to an industry in the United States, Commerce is publishing a notice of continuation of these AD and CVD orders.
items.coverage: 2026-10-14已读取《联邦公报》91 FR 65162-65163官方全文，核对案号、生效日、完整书面范围、排除项、HTSUS提示和现金保证金安排；本通知未列示企业具体税率，未以其他行政复审结果代替进口时适用税率。

items.title_zh: 美国国际贸易委员会认定撤销对华非重复充装钢瓶措施将导致损害再现
items.title_en: USITC finds injury likely to recur if China non-refillable steel-cylinder orders are revoked
items.title_original: Non-Refillable Steel Cylinders From China; Determinations
items.summary_zh: 美国国际贸易委员会在701-TA-644和731-TA-1494五年复审中认定，撤销对华非重复充装钢瓶反倾销与反补贴令，可能在可合理预见期间导致美国国内产业实质损害继续或再现；一名委员未参加。复审于2026年4月1日启动、7月6日决定采用快速复审，委员会于10月8日完成并提交决定，意见载于USITC Publication 5799。本通知是损害复审结论，不含企业税率，也不是新的调查。
items.summary_en: In five-year review investigations 701-TA-644 and 731-TA-1494, the USITC determined that revoking the AD and CVD orders on non-refillable steel cylinders from China would likely lead to continuation or recurrence of material injury within a reasonably foreseeable time; one commissioner did not participate. The reviews began on 1 April 2026, were expedited on 6 July and were completed and filed on 8 October, with the Commission's views in USITC Publication 5799. The notice is an injury-review determination, not a new investigation or company duty-rate notice.
items.impact_zh: 该肯定性结论支持现有AD/CVD令继续维持；受影响出口商不能据此推导自身税率。对美出口便携式非重复充装钢瓶，应核对商务部书面范围、容量和充装状态，以及出口商/生产商对应的最新行政复审与现金保证金率；等待商务部发布正式延续通知并更新报关指引。
items.impact_en: The affirmative injury finding supports continuation of the existing AD/CVD orders but does not establish an exporter-specific rate. Exporters of portable non-refillable steel cylinders should check Commerce's written scope, capacity and filling status, and the current review/cash-deposit rate for the exporter-producer combination, then monitor Commerce's continuation notice and entry guidance.

source.name: U.S. Federal Register / 美国联邦公报

items.follow_up: 跟踪美国商务部正式延续A-570-126/C-570-127措施的通知，并以届时报关日期、生产商和出口商组合核对现金保证金率。
items.coverage: 2026-10-14已读取《联邦公报》91 FR 65253官方全文，核对调查号、程序日期、肯定性损害结论和Publication 5799引用；本条未取得Publication 5799全文，产品范围与税率须结合商务部命令和后续延续通知。

items.title_zh: 美国：更正中国拉制不锈钢水槽日落复审余项补贴率为8.51%
items.title_en: US corrects Chinese drawn stainless-steel sink sunset-review rate to 8.51%
items.title_original: Drawn Stainless Steel Sinks From the People's Republic of China: Final Results of the Expedited First and Second Sunset Reviews of the Countervailing Duty Order; Correction
items.summary_zh: 10月6日公告2026-20481纠正2018和2023两次反补贴日落复审终裁中的错误：其他企业补贴率原写8.61%，应为8.51%。这是历史公告数字更正，不是对所有中国钢材新增税率。
items.summary_en: Notice 2026-20481 corrects the all-others subsidy rate in the 2018 and 2023 sunset results from 8.61% to 8.51%. It is a correction of historical notices.
items.impact_zh: 水槽出口及美国进口商应更新案件档案，由律师核对现行保证金、清算指令及历史记录，不能直接把8.51%当所有企业当前税率。
items.impact_en: Update case records and have counsel check current deposits and liquidation instructions. Do not apply 8.51% indiscriminately.

source.name: U.S. Federal Register / 美国联邦公报

items.source_excerpt: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) published notice in the Federal Register of July 25, 2018 and October 20, 2023 in which Commerce announced the final results of the first and second sunset reviews of the countervailing duty (CVD) order on drawn stainless steel sinks from the People's Republic of China (China). These notices incorrectly stated an all-others rate of 8.61 percent.
items.coverage: 已核对Federal Register正文及公开审阅PDF；未核对各企业当前CBP保证金指令。

items.title_zh: 美国对华定尺碳钢板第五次日落复审终裁：撤令可能导致倾销延续
items.title_en: US fifth sunset review finds dumping likely to recur for Chinese cut-to-length carbon steel plate
items.title_original: Certain Cut-to-Length Carbon Steel Plate From the People's Republic of China and the Russian Federation: Final Results of the Expedited Fifth Sunset Reviews of the Antidumping Duty Orders
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部第五次快速日落复审终裁（A-570-849；91 FR 63265）认定，撤销对中国和俄罗斯定尺碳钢板反倾销令可能导致倾销继续或再现；可能继续或再现的加权平均倾销幅度最高为中国128.59%、俄罗斯185.00%。由于没有被调查方提交实质答复，商务部采用120天快速复审程序；结果自2026年10月5日起适用。
items.summary_en: Commerce's expedited fifth sunset-review results (A-570-849; 91 FR 63265) find that revoking the China and Russia CTL-plate AD orders would likely lead to continuation or recurrence of dumping. Margins likely to prevail are up to 128.59% for China and 185.00% for Russia. No respondent interested party filed a substantive response, so Commerce used the 120-day expedited procedure. The results apply from 5 October 2026.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：128.59%是日落复审中的“可能继续或再现”幅度，不是所有中国出口商自本公告起统一适用的新现金保证金率。本公告支持维持现有反倾销令，但仍应跟踪USITC损害复审及后续续令公告；涉美定尺板业务应继续按企业适用税率报价，不应假设措施即将撤销。
items.impact_en: Assessment: 128.59% is the sunset-review margin likely to prevail, not a new uniform cash-deposit rate for every Chinese exporter. The finding supports continuation of the order, subject to the injury-side review and subsequent continuation notice. US CTL-plate business should keep using company-specific applicable rates and not assume the order will lapse.

source.name: U.S. Federal Register / 美国联邦公报

items.source_excerpt: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) finds that revocation of the antidumping duty (AD) orders on certain cut-to-length carbon steel plate (CTL plate) from the People's Republic of China (China) and the Russian Federation (Russia) would be likely to lead to continuation or recurrence of dumping, at the levels indicated in the "Final Results of Sunset Reviews" section of this notice.
items.coverage: Official Federal Register full notice reviewed, including final-results margins; the linked Issues and Decision Memorandum was not treated as separately reviewed.

items.title_zh: 欧盟公布2026年第三季度CBAM证书价格：82.32欧元
items.title_en: EU publishes Q3 2026 CBAM certificate price of €82.32
items.title_original: Q3 2026 CBAM Certificate price now available!
items.summary_zh: 欧委会10月5日公布2026年第三季度CBAM证书价格为每张82.32欧元；第二季度为75.28欧元，环比上升约9.4%。季度价格按欧盟碳排放配额拍卖成交价加权平均计算，适用于对应季度进口CBAM商品的隐含排放；2026年证书从2027年2月起在统一中央平台购买。
items.summary_en: On 5 October the Commission published the Q3 2026 CBAM certificate price at €82.32, about 9.4% above Q2's €75.28. The quarterly price is the weighted average of EU ETS auction clearing prices and applies to embedded emissions in CBAM goods imported during the relevant quarter; 2026 certificates become purchasable on the common central platform from February 2027.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：钢铁出口商应把82.32欧元作为第三季度对应证书的官方价格输入，与欧盟进口商更新碳成本测算和合同调价假设；它不是钢材吨税，也不能脱离经核验的产品隐含排放、免费分配调整和已支付碳价直接换算应缴额。
items.impact_en: Assessment: use €82.32 as the official certificate-price input for Q3 and update carbon-cost and contract assumptions with EU importers. It is not a per-tonne steel tariff and cannot determine liability without verified embedded emissions, free-allocation adjustment and eligible carbon prices already paid.
items.source_excerpt: 05 Oct 2026 Q3 2026 CBAM Certificate price now available! Each 2026 quarterly price is calculated by the Commission in the first calendar week after the quarter ends, based on publicly available EU ETS auction information.
items.coverage: Official DG TAXUD price table and methodology page checked on 5 October 2026.

items.title_zh: 美国更正对华对焊管件公告：明确追溯暂停清算和现金保证金
items.title_en: US Commerce correction clarifies retroactive suspension for China-origin butt-weld pipe fittings processed in Vietnam
items.title_original: Certain Carbon Steel Butt-Weld Pipe Fittings From the People's Republic of China: Notice of Court Decision Not in Harmony With Final Covered Merchandise Determination and Notice of Amended Covered Merchandise Determination Pursuant to Court Decision; Correction
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部10月2日发布更正（A-570-814；91 FR 62700），补入8月28日公告遗漏的追溯执行段落。对在中国形成粗坯、在越南完成第二或第三阶段加工且物理特征相同的相关产品：已暂停的条目继续暂停并适用相应现金保证金；尚未暂停且未清算的条目，2022年9月26日及以后进口的须暂停清算并缴纳保证金；2021年11月4日之后、2022年9月26日之前进口且仍未清算的条目亦同。该认定按同一国家的出口商或进口商层面适用。
items.summary_en: Commerce's 2 October correction (A-570-814; 91 FR 62700) adds omitted retroactive implementation language to the 28 August notice. For China-formed rough shapes completed through second or third production stages in Vietnam and sharing the relevant physical characteristics, CBP is to continue existing suspensions and apply cash deposits; suspend still-unliquidated entries on or after 26 September 2022; and also suspend still-unliquidated entries after 4 November 2021 but before 26 September 2022, at the applicable rate. The finding applies on a country-wide exporter or importer basis.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：更正没有公布统一新税率，但显著扩大了需要追溯核对的未清算条目范围。相关出口商、越南加工商和美国进口商应立即按两个日期区间筛查历史未清算进口，核对保证金及海关指令，并保存粗坯物理特征、加工和原产链证据。
items.impact_en: Assessment: the correction sets no uniform new rate but materially clarifies the historical unliquidated entries subject to suspension. Exporters, Vietnamese processors and US importers should screen entries against both date windows, verify cash-deposit and CBP instructions, and preserve evidence on rough-shape characteristics, processing and origin.

source.name: U.S. Federal Register / 美国联邦公报

items.source_excerpt: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) published notice to the public in the Federal Register of August 28, 2026 that the U.S. Court of International Trade's (CIT) final judgment was not in harmony with Commerce's covered merchandise inquiry (CMI) determination. Specifically, Commerce amended the CMI determination to find that products cut to length and formed into the rough shape of certain carbon steel butt-weld pipe fittings (butt-weld pipe fittings) in the People's Republic of China (China) represent "unfinished" fittings, which are covered by the scope of the Order, and that when such products are further processed in the Socialist Republic of Vietnam (Vietnam), they remain subject to the antidumping (AD) order on butt- weld pipe fittings from China. This notice did not provide clear notice to parties that the liquidation of entries of these unfinished fittings will be retroactively suspended.
items.coverage: Official Federal Register correction and the linked 28 August notice checked; date windows are limited to still-unliquidated covered entries.

items.title_zh: 英国钢铁措施缩小范围：两项非合金钢丝编码税率降为 0%
items.title_en: UK steel measure removes two non-alloy wire codes from 1 October
items.title_original: UK's steel trade measure from 1 July 2026
items.summary_zh: 英国政府10月1日更新钢铁贸易措施，将非合金钢丝商品编码72173049和72173090移出适用范围，对应税率由50%降为0%；Category 28配额量保持不变。其他纳入范围的产品配额外税率仍为50%。
items.summary_en: The UK updated its steel trade measure on 1 October, removing non-alloy wire codes 72173049 and 72173090. Their tariff falls from 50% to 0%; Category 28 quota volumes are unchanged. The 50% out-of-quota tariff remains for other covered products.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：涉及上述两个编码的在途和新订单应立即复核英国报关税率及商品归类；该变化不适用于Category 28其他钢丝编码，也没有增加剩余配额。
items.impact_en: Assessment: recheck UK classification and entry treatment for shipments under these two codes. The change does not cover other Category 28 wire codes or increase the remaining quota.
items.source_excerpt: Details about a new steel trade measure from 1 July 2026, which limits tariff-free steel import quota volumes. On 19 March 2026, the government announced a new steel trade measure , taking effect from 1 July 2026. This measure has been implemented using powers in the Taxation (Cross Border Trade) Act 2018 , as amended. The government has carried out a programme of intensive industry engagement since the announcement. We have also engaged closely with the European Union ( EU ) ahead of their new steel trade measure coming into effect and agreed an approach that reflects the UK and EU ’s highly interconnected supply chains. From 1 July 2026, the government is limiting tariff-free steel imports, reducing overall quota volumes by 51% compared with the steel safeguard measure. Any imports above these levels will face a 50% tariff. The measure applies to imports of steel products that can also be made in the UK. The steel safeguard quotas and the 25% additional safeguard duty ceased to appl…
items.coverage: Official GOV.UK collection update history and current measure page reviewed.

items.title_zh: 美国启动多项行政复审：涉及中国钢钉、制动鼓和金属储物柜
items.title_en: US opens administrative reviews covering Chinese steel nails, brake drums and metal lockers
items.title_original: Initiation of Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Administrative Reviews
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部10月1日启动8月周年月的反倾销/反补贴行政复审。其中对华涉钢项目包括钢钉A-570-909（复审期2025年8月1日至2026年7月31日）、制动鼓A-570-174/C-570-175及金属储物柜A-570-133/C-570-134。公告预计最终结果不晚于2027年8月31日。
items.summary_en: Commerce's 1 October omnibus notice opens August-anniversary AD/CVD reviews. China-related steel cases include steel nails A-570-909 (POR 1 August 2025–31 July 2026), brake drums A-570-174/C-570-175 and metal lockers A-570-133/C-570-134. Final results are intended by 31 August 2027.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：被列名企业应让美国律师立即核对独立税率申请或证明、Q&V问卷及APO等个案期限；独立税率材料原则上须在公告后14个日历日内提交。此次是复审立案，不是新税率终裁。
items.impact_en: Assessment: listed firms should have US counsel check separate-rate applications/certifications, Q&V questionnaires and APO deadlines immediately. Separate-rate filings are generally due within 14 calendar days of publication. This is review initiation, not a new final rate.

source.name: U.S. Federal Register / 美国联邦公报

items.source_excerpt: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) has received requests to conduct administrative reviews of various antidumping duty (AD) and countervailing duty (CVD) orders with August anniversary dates. In accordance with Commerce's regulations, we are initiating those administrative reviews.

follow_up.action_zh: 被列名企业由美国律师核对独立税率申请/证明及Q&V等实际提交期限
follow_up.action_en: US counsel to confirm case-specific separate-rate and Q&V filing deadlines.

items.coverage: Official Federal Register full notice reviewed; summary is limited to China-related steel cases in the omnibus tables.

items.title_zh: CBAM 证书操作说明：2026 年排放于 2027 年购证清缴
items.title_en: CBAM certificate factsheet: 2026 emissions settled in 2027
items.summary_zh: 9 月 30 日发布的说明：证书拟于 2027 年 2 月 1 日开售；2026 年无季度持证义务，相关证书须于 2027 年 9 月 30 日前购买并清缴。此后季度末持证覆盖至少 50% 的年内累计隐含排放；最终数量按适用规则调整。
items.summary_en: The 30 September factsheet schedules sales for 1 February 2027. No quarterly holding obligation applies in 2026; certificates for that year's emissions must be purchased and surrendered by 30 September 2027. Subsequent quarter-end holdings cover at least 50% of year-to-date embedded emissions, subject to applicable adjustments.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：与进口商分别安排 2026 年排放资料和 2027 年资金；购证延后不代表 2026 年进口免除碳成本。
items.impact_en: Assessment: separate 2026 emissions documentation from 2027 funding. Deferred certificate purchases do not exempt 2026 imports from carbon costs.
items.source_excerpt: How CBAM certificates work Starting in 2027, CBAM importers must submit their annual CBAM declaration by 30 September for imports of CBAM goods during the preceding year. The CBAM declaration reports the quantity of goods imported, their embedded emissions, and the corresponding number of certificates. General publications 30 September 2026 English Download (2.97 MB - PDF)
items.coverage: Official two-page factsheet reviewed; explanatory guidance, not a new regulation.

items.title_zh: GFSEC 通过密尔沃基框架：加强贸易救济、反规避与熔炼浇铸地透明度
items.title_en: GFSEC Milwaukee Framework: trade remedies, anti-circumvention and melt-and-pour transparency
items.title_original: Ambassador Greer Issues Statement Following the Ministerial Meeting of the Global Forum on Steel Excess Capacity
items.summary_zh: USTR 9 月 30 日确认 GFSEC 部长会议通过联合行动框架。正式文件提出在各自法律框架下减少扭曲市场的支持、强化熔炼浇铸地数据、开展反倾销/反补贴/保障措施调查并协调反规避；各成员实施力度可因国内情况不同。
items.summary_en: USTR confirmed agreement on 30 September. The framework calls for reducing distortive support, improving melt-and-pour data, trade-remedy investigations and coordinated anti-circumvention, within national legal frameworks; implementation may differ by member.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：中国钢材及含钢下游产品的多市场贸易救济与溯源风险上升。准备真实熔炼浇铸地、生产商及加工链证明，关注各国后续公告；框架本身没有设定统一新增税率，也不是 G20 全体已一致加税。
items.impact_en: Assessment: monitor trade-remedy and traceability risks across markets. Prepare melt-and-pour and processing-chain evidence and check subsequent national measures. The framework itself sets no uniform new tariff and is not a unanimous G20 tariff decision.
items.source_excerpt: MILWAUKEE – Today, Ambassador Jamieson Greer chaired the Ministerial Meeting of the Global Forum on Steel Excess Capacity, which reached consensus on a comprehensive framework for joint action (“the Milwaukee Framework”). Ambassador Greer highlighted the effective actions taken by the Trump Administration to address global steel excess capacity and its impacts, including on U.S. manufacturers and workers, and invited like-minded partners to take similar steps to more fully address excess capacity and the global market distortions it causes. Ambassador Greer Issues Statement Following the Ministerial Meeting of the Global Forum on Steel Excess Capacity “Under President Trump, the U.S. steel industry is undergoing a renaissance on the strength of tariffs, trade deals, favorable tax treatment, improved energy policy, and the American entrepreneurial spirit,” said Ambassador Greer . “If like-minded partners adopt similar policies, they can hold accountable those countries that are contrib…
items.coverage: USTR release and final GFSEC framework/ministerial statement checked.

items.title_zh: 美国对华预包装无螺栓钢货架复审：撤税可能导致损害延续或再现
items.title_en: US Chinese boltless shelving review: injury likely to continue or recur if duties revoked
items.title_original: Boltless Steel Shelving Units Prepackaged for Sale From China; Determinations
items.summary_zh: USITC 于 9 月 29 日公布第二次日落复审裁定，案号 701-TA-523、731-TA-1259：撤销对华预包装无螺栓钢货架反倾销、反补贴令，可能导致美国行业实质损害延续或再现。裁定于 9 月 24 日完成。
items.summary_en: The 29 September notice publishes USITC's second sunset-review determination in cases 701-TA-523 and 731-TA-1259: revoking the Chinese boltless shelving AD/CVD orders would likely lead to continuing or recurring material injury. The determination was completed on 24 September.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：不能按即将撤税报价；具体税率与商务部续令须另查。本裁定针对预包装货架，不等同于对所有钢材新增双反税。
items.impact_en: Assessment: do not price on an assumed duty removal; check Commerce's continuation notice and applicable rates. The determination concerns prepackaged shelving.

items.title_zh: 欧委会发布 CBAM 核查机构资源汇总，涵盖注册与培训

items.title_original: New resources available for CBAM verifiers
items.summary_zh: DG TAXUD 于 9 月 28 日的官方新闻列表说明，新资源汇总包含核查与认可指南、CBAM 注册系统访问说明、已获认可核查机构的操作文件，以及 O3CI 门户培训视频。
items.summary_en: The official DG TAXUD news listing dated 28 September describes a resource overview covering verification and accreditation guidance, registry access, operational documents for accredited verifiers and O3CI training videos.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：可作为钢厂与核查服务商确认系统访问、资料准备及配合流程的资料入口。以上依据官方新闻列表摘要，详细要求需查阅所链接文件。
items.impact_en: Monitoring assessment: use the resources to coordinate registry access, documentation and workflows with verifiers. This brief is based on the official listing; consult the linked documents for full requirements.
items.source_excerpt: 28 Sep 2026 New resources available for CBAM verifiers The Commission has published an overview of the latest resources available to support CBAM verifiers. It brings together guidance on verification and accreditation, information on access to the CBAM Registry, operational documents for Accredited Verifiers and training videos on the use of the CBAM Registry - O3CI portal. Consult the overview and access all the available resources.
items.coverage: Official news-list summary; full article not accessible during review.

items.title_zh: 美国镀锡板等调查进入最终阶段：12 月 4 日举行产业损害听证
items.title_en: US tin mill investigations: final-phase injury hearing on 4 December
items.title_original: Tin Mill Products From China, Taiwan, and Turkey; Scheduling of the Final Phase of Countervailing Duty and Antidumping Duty Investigations
items.summary_zh: USITC 公告安排中国、台湾和土耳其镀锡板等产品调查最终阶段，案号 701-TA-792、731-TA-1786-1788；范围包括镀锡及镀铬/氧化铬薄板。听证 12 月 4 日，听证申请 11 月 25 日前、庭前陈述 11 月 27 日前、庭后书面意见 12 月 11 日前；书面产品描述优先于 HTSUS 编码。
items.summary_en: USITC schedules the final phase in cases 701-TA-792 and 731-TA-1786-1788 concerning tin- and chromium-coated tin mill products. Hearing: 4 December; hearing requests: 25 November; prehearing briefs: 27 November; posthearing submissions: 11 December. Written scope controls over tariff codes.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：对美镀锡板及 TFS 业务应交由应诉团队核对产品范围、参加调查和提交期限；本公告是程序安排，没有公布最终税率。
items.impact_en: Assessment: coordinate scope and participation deadlines with counsel for US tinplate/TFS business. This is a procedural schedule, not a final duty rate.

source.name: U.S. Federal Register / 美国联邦公报

items.source_excerpt: The Commission hereby gives notice of the scheduling of the final phase of antidumping and countervailing duty investigation Nos. 701-TA-792 and 731-TA-1786-1788 (Final) pursuant to the Tariff Act of 1930 to determine whether an industry in the United States is materially injured or threatened with material injury, or the establishment of an industry in the United States is materially retarded, by reason of imports of tin mill products from China, Taiwan, and Turkey, provided for in subheadings 7210.11.00, 7210.12.00, 7210.50.00, 7212.10.00, 7212.50.00, if of non-alloy steel and under HTSUS subheadings 7225.99.00, and 7226.99.01 of the Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States, preliminarily determined by the Department of Commerce ("Commerce") to be subsidized and sold at less-than-fair-value. Commerce's preliminary determinations with respect to tin mill products from Taiwan and Turkey, alleged to be sold in the United States at less-than-fair- value, are pending.

follow_up.action_zh: 应诉团队核对参加调查登记及 APO 申请期限：公告要求不晚于听证前 21 天；后续听证申请截止 11 月 25 日
follow_up.action_en: Counsel to check appearance/APO deadlines (at least 21 days before hearing); hearing request deadline is 25 November.

items.title_zh: CBAM 核查机构培训入口更新：通过 O3CI 连接工厂与核查数据
items.title_en: CBAM verifier training resources: connect installations through O3CI
items.title_original: New training videos for accredited verifiers
items.summary_zh: 9 月 28 日新闻入口指向注册系统页。页面说明，已获认可核查机构通过 O3CI 申请登记，连接非欧盟装置、审阅排放数据与证明材料并出具核查报告；工厂与核查机构虽使用同一门户，职责不同。
items.summary_en: The 28 September resource link points to the Registry page. Accredited verifiers use O3CI to request registration, connect to non-EU installations, review emissions and supporting evidence, and issue verification reports. Operators and verifiers share a portal but perform different roles.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：协调工厂和核查服务商的账户、访问权限及资料交付，系统登记不等同于取得认可资质。
items.impact_en: Assessment: coordinate accounts, access and evidence delivery; Registry registration is distinct from accreditation.
items.source_excerpt: 28 Sep 2026 New training videos for accredited verifiers The videos provide guidance on applying to become a registered verifier, submitting requests for change, and managing collaboration requests with operators of Third Country Installations in the CBAM Registry.
items.coverage: Official Registry page reviewed; individual training videos not watched.

items.title_zh: 欧盟钢铁新规运行情况咨询已关闭，进入后续评估跟踪阶段
items.title_en: EU steel regulation monitoring consultation has closed; follow-up assessment now pending
items.title_original: Monitoring the functioning of the new EU Steel Regulation
items.summary_zh: 欧委会页面现已标为“Closed”，并确认回复期于2026年10月11日23:59（CEST）结束。该定向咨询围绕条例（EU）2026/1384实施首个季度的实际影响，面向上游钢企、下游用户、协会、第三国政府和出口商；不同产品类别原可分别提交回复。页面尚未公布反馈汇总、评估结论或配额、税率调整。
items.summary_en: The Commission page is now marked Closed and confirms that responses ended on 11 October 2026 at 23:59 CEST. The targeted consultation covered first-quarter implementation impacts of Regulation (EU) 2026/1384 and invited producers, users, associations, third-country governments and exporters, with separate product-category responses allowed. No response summary, assessment conclusion, quota change or rate change has yet been published.
items.impact_zh: 提交窗口已经结束。已参与企业应保存问卷、附件和提交回执，后续核对欧委会评估及任何正式修法；未参与企业不能再把该页面当作仍可提交的入口，可整理配额、交付与成本证据供后续监测或下一轮咨询使用。咨询关闭本身不改变现行配额或税率。
items.impact_en: The submission window has ended. Participants should retain responses, attachments and receipts and monitor the Commission's assessment and any formal amendment. Non-participants should not treat the page as an open submission route; preserve quota, delivery and cost evidence for later monitoring or consultations. Closure itself changes no quota or duty rate.
items.source_excerpt: A targeted consultation seeking stakeholders' feedback on the implementation of the new EU Steel Regulation Steel producers (upstream), steel users (downstream), business associations, third country governments and exporters, and any other interested stakeholders. EU Regulation 2026/1384 establishes a tariff rate quota system to protect the Union steel market from negative trade-related effects of global overcapacity. Considering the end of the first quarter of application of the Regulation and in order to establish a strong and targeted monitoring mechanism enabling an ongoing assessment of the implementation and functioning of the Regulation, the Commission is launching this targeted consultation which aims to gather detailed information on the immediate impact on all industry potentially affected, including steel producers (upstream), steel users (downstream), business associations, third country governments and exporters, and any other interested stakeholders. Trade isn't just abo…

follow_up.action_zh: 保存已提交材料与回执，跟踪欧委会反馈汇总、运行评估及任何正式调整
follow_up.action_en: Retain submissions and receipts; monitor the Commission's response summary, assessment and any formal change.

items.coverage: 2026-10-12已读欧委会咨询页面当前全文，核对Closed状态、原开放日期、截止时间、目标受众及回复期结束提示；页面尚无反馈汇总、评估结果或规则调整。

items.title_zh: 美国初裁柬埔寨组装钢丝衣架规避中越贸易救济令
items.title_en: US preliminarily finds Cambodian-assembled steel wire hangers circumvent China and Vietnam orders
items.title_original: Steel Wire Garment Hangers From the People's Republic of China and the Socialist Republic of Vietnam: Preliminary Affirmative Determination of Circumvention of the Antidumping Duty Order on Steel Wire Garment Hangers From the People's Republic of China and the Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Orders on Steel Wire Garment Hangers From the Socialist Republic of Vietnam
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部初步认定（A-570-918、A-552-812、C-552-813；91 FR 60086），在柬埔寨使用中国或越南产钢丝，或钢丝及纸配件完成并出口美国的钢丝衣架，在全国范围构成规避。2025年8月12日及以后进入美国且尚未清算的相关条目须暂停清算并缴纳保证金。未能按双重认证计划证明使用中国原料的，公告拟按越南全国反倾销率220.68%及反补贴其他企业率31.58%处理；证明使用中国原料的按对华衣架反倾销令适用税率处理。
items.summary_en: Commerce preliminarily finds (A-570-918/A-552-812/C-552-813; 91 FR 60086) that hangers completed in Cambodia from Chinese- or Vietnamese-origin steel wire, or steel wire and paper accessories, circumvent the respective orders on a country-wide basis. Relevant unliquidated entries on or after 12 August 2025 are suspended. Entries not certified under the dual program as using Chinese inputs are intended to face the Vietnam-wide AD rate of 220.68% plus the CVD all-others rate of 31.58%; certified Chinese-input entries use the applicable China hanger AD rate.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：这是初裁，但已产生追溯暂停清算、保证金和认证义务。中国钢丝经柬埔寨组装的供应链应核对原料原产、生产记录、ACE/DIS申报和第三国案号；历史未清算条目的认证及证明材料原则上最迟须在11月6日前完成，听证申请原则上10月22日前提交。Alpha Hanger、Everbrit和Kaining在本初裁下不能使用该认证。
items.impact_en: Assessment: although preliminary, the finding already creates retroactive suspension, cash-deposit and certification obligations. China-to-Cambodia supply chains should verify input origin, production records, ACE/DIS filings and third-country case numbers. Certifications for historical unliquidated entries are generally due by 6 November; hearing requests are generally due 22 October. Alpha Hanger, Everbrit and Kaining are ineligible for the certification under this preliminary finding.

source.name: U.S. Federal Register / 美国联邦公报

items.source_excerpt: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) preliminarily determines that imports of steel wire garment hangers (hangers), completed in Cambodia using: (1) steel wire or (2) steel wire and paper accessories, produced in the People's Republic of China (China) or the Socialist Republic of Vietnam (Vietnam), are circumventing the antidumping duty (AD) order on hangers from China, or the AD and countervailing duty (CVD) orders on hangers from Vietnam. Interested parties are invited to comment on this preliminary determination.

follow_up.action_zh: 相关方由美国律师确认听证申请；历史条目认证及证明材料原则上于11月6日前完成
follow_up.action_en: US counsel to confirm hearing request; historical-entry certifications and evidence are generally due by 6 November.

items.coverage: Official Federal Register full notice and certification requirements reviewed; company eligibility and entry treatment remain subject to the preliminary determination and CBP/Commerce instructions.

items.title_zh: 美国初裁中国球墨铸铁制动鼓规避双反令，追溯至2026年1月27日
items.title_en: US preliminarily finds Chinese CGI brake drums circumvent AD/CVD orders
items.title_original: Certain Brake Drums From the People's Republic of China: Preliminary Affirmative Determination of Circumvention of the Antidumping Duty and Countervailing Duty Orders
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部初步认定（A-570-174、C-570-175；91 FR 60082），中国制致密石墨铸铁（CGI）制动鼓属于后续发展商品，在全国范围规避对华制动鼓反倾销和反补贴令。调查产品内径14.75英寸至16.6英寸、重量超过50磅，包括公告所举M328D557型号。2026年1月27日及以后进入美国且尚未清算的条目将暂停清算；一般情况下按中国全国反倾销率150.25%和反补贴“其他企业”率11.94%收取保证金，已有企业单独税率的按其适用税率。
items.summary_en: Commerce preliminarily finds (A-570-174/C-570-175; 91 FR 60082) that Chinese compacted graphite iron brake drums are later-developed merchandise circumventing the China brake-drum AD/CVD orders on a country-wide basis. Covered inquiry merchandise has an inside diameter of 14.75–16.6 inches and weighs more than 50 pounds, including model M328D557. Unliquidated entries on or after 27 January 2026 are to be suspended; generally the China-wide AD rate is 150.25% and the CVD all-others rate 11.94%, while company-specific rates apply where available.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：这是规避调查初裁，不是最终结论，但已触发暂停清算和保证金要求。相关制造商、出口商和美国进口商应立即核对材质、尺寸、重量、型号及历史未清算条目；评论原则上于10月6日前、听证申请于10月22日前通过ACCESS提交，具体期限应由美国律师确认。
items.impact_en: Assessment: this is a preliminary circumvention finding, not a final determination, but suspension and cash-deposit requirements already apply. Producers, exporters and US importers should review material, dimensions, weight, model numbers and historical unliquidated entries. Comments are generally due 6 October and hearing requests 22 October; US counsel should confirm the filing dates.

source.name: U.S. Federal Register / 美国联邦公报

items.source_excerpt: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) preliminarily determines that imports of compacted graphite iron (CGI) brake drums, from the People's Republic of China (China), constitute later-developed merchandise that is circumventing the antidumping duty (AD) and countervailing duty (CVD) orders on certain brake drums (brake drums) from China. Interested parties are invited to comment on this preliminary determination.

follow_up.action_zh: 相关方由美国律师确认并提交评论；听证申请期限原则上为10月22日
follow_up.action_en: US counsel to confirm and file comments; hearing requests are generally due 22 October.

items.coverage: Official Federal Register full notice reviewed; listed rates are the stated order rates, not inferred transaction-specific liability.

items.title_zh: 美国钢制货架复审终裁：Nova及JISE为10.34%，Urgo适用全国实体税率
items.title_en: US steel racks final review: Nova and JISE 10.34%; Urgo in China-wide entity
items.title_original: Certain Steel Racks and Parts Thereof From the People's Republic of China: Final Results and Rescission, in Part, of Antidumping Duty Administrative Review; 2023-2024
items.summary_zh: A-570-088的2023年9月1日至2024年8月31日复审终裁于2026年9月15日发布。江苏Nova/南京金时代/河北Nova单一实体及江苏JISE的倾销幅度为10.34%；Urgo不获单独税率，适用144.50%全国实体税率。公告日起所列企业保证金采用对应幅度，其他企业按既有单独或全国实体规则；Nova历史进口适用进口商特定清算税率。
items.summary_en: For September 2023–August 2024, Nova's three-company entity and JISE receive 10.34%; Urgo is subject to the 144.50% China-wide rate. Listed deposits apply from 15 September; Nova historical assessment is importer-specific.
items.impact_zh: 核对企业名称与报关案号，更新对应保证金报价依据，并检查历史进口清算及诉讼禁令。10.34%不能推广到全部中国货架，也不等于最终全部进口税负。
items.impact_en: Update company-specific deposit assumptions and check historical liquidation; 10.34% is neither universal nor the total import tax burden.

source.name: U.S. Federal Register / 美国联邦公报

items.source_excerpt: The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) determines that the exporters under review either sold certain steel racks and parts thereof (steel racks) from the People's Republic of China (China) in the United States at prices below normal value (NV) during the period of review (POR) September 1, 2023, through August 31, 2024, or have not established their eligibility for a separate rate and are part of the China-wide entity.
items.coverage: 已核对Federal Register公告正文相关范围、结论和程序条款；未阅读另附ACCESS决定备忘录，完整产品范围及后续海关指令需单独核对。

items.title_zh: 英国2026/26：延长中国线材反倾销税，7.9%或24%；到期表述待澄清
items.title_en: UK notice 2026/26 extends Chinese wire-rod duties; expiry wording needs clarification
items.title_original: Trade remedies notices: anti-dumping duty on wire rod products originating from China
items.summary_zh: 9月10日公告、9月11日生效，延长中国热轧盘条反倾销措施并调整描述：铁、非合金或除不锈钢外合金钢不规则盘卷。华菱集团7.9%（A930），其他24%（A999），特定税率需合格发票声明。所列税号为72131000、72132000、72139110/20/41/49/70/90、72139910/90、72271000、72272000、72279010/50/95。公告复审段写2031年1月30日，期限段却写1月28日且误称反补贴税。
items.summary_en: Notice 2026/26 extends duties on Chinese hot-rolled wire rod: Valin 7.9% (A930), residual 24% (A999), subject to invoice conditions. It covers listed 7213 and 7227 codes. The review text and expiry section conflict on 28 versus 30 January 2031, with inconsistent duty terminology.
items.impact_zh: 当前报价按企业税率和产品范围核对；2031最终到期日须由TRA/HMRC澄清，不将正文冲突自行抹平。中国其他钢厂不可套用华菱税率。
items.impact_en: Check product scope, producer and invoice conditions. Seek official clarification of the conflicting 2031 expiry dates; other mills cannot assume Valin's rate.

Voluntary entry into a qualifying mandatory scheme differs from a voluntary carbon-pricing scheme; flat fuel duties do not qualify.

items.impact_en: Check scheme eligibility and obtain carbon-pricing verification. Voluntary credits and ordinary flat fuel taxes are not substitutes for qualifying costs.

items.title_en: US Commerce brings China-formed butt-weld pipe fitting rough shapes processed in Vietnam within the AD order
items.title_original: Certain Carbon Steel Butt-Weld Pipe Fittings From the People's Republic of China: Notice of Court Decision Not in Harmony With Final Covered Merchandise Determination and Notice of Amended Covered Merchandise Determination Pursuant to Court Decision
items.summary_zh: 美国商务部公告（A-570-814；91 FR 55518）落实美国国际贸易法院2026年7月29日判决，自2026年8月8日起修正覆盖商品认定：中国境内切割并形成对焊管件粗坯的产品属于反倾销令范围内的“未制成品”；随后在越南完成第二、第三阶段加工，仍受对华碳钢对焊管件反倾销令约束。商务部将要求海关暂停相关成品和未制成品清算并按适用税率收取现金保证金。
items.summary_en: Commerce's notice (A-570-814; 91 FR 55518) implements the CIT's 29 July 2026 judgment and applies from 8 August 2026. Rough shapes cut to length and formed in China are unfinished butt-weld pipe fittings within the order; subsequent second- or third-stage processing in Vietnam does not remove them from the China AD order. CBP is to suspend liquidation and collect cash deposits at the applicable rate.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：这是法院判决后的覆盖范围修正，不是新立案或统一新税率。中国粗坯经越南后加工的供应链应立即核对报关、原产地和现金保证金安排，保存中国成形及越南加工阶段记录，并由美国律师确认具体条目适用税率与诉讼进展。
items.impact_en: Assessment: this is a court-driven scope amendment, not a new investigation or a uniform new duty rate. China-to-Vietnam processing chains should review entries, origin evidence and cash-deposit treatment, retain records for each processing stage, and have US counsel confirm the entry-specific rate and litigation status.

items.summary_zh: 8月24日指南第4.9节要求核验方通过现场访问检查装置和过程边界、排放源、计量及控制系统。虚拟访问或豁免须满足规定条件和风险评估，不能两种例外叠加。原文列示可采用首次实地、次年虚拟交替，或连续两年实地后第三年豁免的安排，仍须满足其他条件。
items.summary_en: Section 4.9 requires physical checks of boundaries, sources and monitoring. Virtual visits and waivers require stated conditions and risk assessment and cannot be combined cumulatively. The guide gives conditional alternating or third-year waiver patterns.
items.impact_zh: 钢厂应为核验安排现场准入、仪表及数据流程证据，不把远程审核当默认权利。初次核验、过程重大变更或证据不足应与核验方确认实地要求。
items.impact_en: Plan site access and monitoring evidence. Remote auditing is not a default entitlement; confirm requirements for initial checks and material process changes.

items.summary_en: Accreditation precedes Registry access, with competent-authority checks. Verifiers must register within two months of CBAM accreditation, no earlier than 1 September 2026, and issue reports in the Registry from January 2027.

items.source_excerpt: Guidance on CBAM verification and accreditation now available On 24 August 2026, the European Commission published new Guidance on CBAM verification and accreditation for verifiers and National Accreditation Bodies to support stakeholders in understanding the requirements applicable to verification and accreditation under the CBAM definitive period.

Covered circular welded iron/non-alloy tubes have an outside diameter up to 168.3 mm, with stated exclusions. Codes: 7306304120, 7306307280, 7306307780, 7306304920. China: 90.6%, additional code 8A91; Belarus: 38.1%, 8A90, on net frontier price before duty.

items.impact_zh: 中国钢厂应组织制造、碳数据和出口团队联合阅读钢铁指南及方法文件，形成给进口商的统一数据包。本条只核对发布新闻；具体公式、边界和示例仍需读PDF，不能据新闻计算税额。

items.source_excerpt: Guidance documents on CBAM implementation for installation operators outside the EU On 14 August 2026, the European Commission published a series of ten guidance documents to help non-EU operators with the implementation of the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) during its definitive period.

items.title_zh: CBAM方法指南3：年度计算、生产过程划分和废钢数据是关键
items.title_en: CBAM guidance 3: annual calculation, process boundaries and scrap data
items.title_original: Guidance No. 3 - CBAM methods for the calculation of emissions embedded in goods
items.summary_zh: 8月14日非约束性指南明确正式期以生产日历年为基准；同一装置相同功能单位而不同生产路线的货物须按规定平均，生产过程划分不能只看CN编码。第4.9节说明钢铁活动水平用货物吨数，并要求提供合金元素、废钢量和其中消费前废钢比例等信息。
items.summary_en: The non-binding guide uses calendar-year production data and prescribed averaging for the same functional unit across routes. Process definition is not based solely on CN codes. Steel reporting includes mass, alloy and scrap information.
items.impact_zh: 高废钢产品不能仅凭单票名称或TARIC号单独认定低碳值。工厂应记录实际投入、年度产量和过程边界，与核验方确认可分列条件；不能据本要点直接测算税額。
items.impact_en: A high-scrap label or tariff code alone does not establish a separate low-carbon value. Document inputs, annual output and boundaries with the verifier.
items.source_excerpt: Guidance No. 3 - CBAM methods for the calculation of emissions embedded in goods 14 August 2026 English Download (1.86 MB - PDF)

items.title_zh: CBAM指南1：区分嵌入排放、免费配额调整与已付碳价

items.title_original: Guidance No. 1 - Introduction to CBAM concepts
items.summary_zh: 欧委会指南说明CBAM覆盖商品及生产装置的基本概念。证书义务须结合商品嵌入排放、对应免费配额调整和符合条件的第三国实际已付碳价，不能简单将钢材重量乘证书价格；指南是操作解释，不能替代法规。
items.summary_en: The guidance explains covered goods and installations. Certificate liability depends on embedded emissions, the free-allocation adjustment and eligible carbon price already paid abroad; tonnes of steel times certificate price is not the calculation.
items.impact_zh: 出口团队先建立CN编码、生产装置、前体材料和排放数据对应关系；与进口商分别核算排放、调整和碳价扣减。
items.impact_en: Map CN codes, installations, precursors and emissions; keep the three calculation components distinct.

items.coverage: 核读35页PDF中概念与证书计算关键章节；不声称逐项复算全部示例。

items.title_zh: CBAM指南2：境外钢厂须准备监测计划和可核查数据

items.title_original: Guidance No. 2 - Quick guide for non-EU operators on CBAM implementation
items.summary_zh: 境外生产者应识别覆盖商品、工艺边界和前体材料，制定监测计划并向欧盟进口商提供所需排放信息。生产者可通过O3CI登记或沟通模板分享数据；交易商同样需要协调实际生产装置。
items.summary_en: Non-EU operators should identify covered goods, process boundaries and precursors, prepare monitoring plans and provide emissions information. O3CI registration or communication templates support data sharing; traders must coordinate with producing installations.
items.impact_zh: 把数据责任落实到生产厂、前体供应商和进口商，提前安排核查；贸易商自己的说明不能替代生产装置数据。
items.impact_en: Assign data responsibilities across mills, precursor suppliers and importers; arrange verification early.

items.coverage: 核读15页PDF中境外生产者实施流程、数据沟通和内控要点；登记为自愿数据沟通渠道，不等于核查认可。

items.title_zh: CBAM指南4：免费配额调整须按商品、工艺和年份计算
items.title_en: CBAM Guidance 4: free-allocation adjustment is product and year specific
items.title_original: Guidance No. 4 - CBAM calculation of the free allocation adjustment to the number of CBAM certificates to be surrendered
items.summary_zh: 指南将商品免费配额调整表示为单位商品调整量SEFA乘进口量M；生产工艺基准、CBAM因子、跨行业修正因子及前体材料共同影响结果。使用默认排放值时须配套默认调整量；实际数据须有相应核查依据。2026年进口按2026申报年度的调整规则处理，不因商品生产年份更早自动采用旧因子。
items.summary_en: FAA equals specific adjustment SEFA times imported quantity M. Benchmarks, the CBAM factor, cross-sectoral correction and precursors affect the result. Default emissions require matching default adjustment values. The reporting year governs the adjustment for 2026 imports, even for earlier production.

items.summary_zh: 指南涵盖铁钢工艺边界和前体排放，单位为tCO₂e/t商品。钢铁通常计直接排放，但烧结矿CN26011200需计间接排放；不能把该例外扩大到所有矿石。钢坯、粗钢相关CN7206、7207、7218、7224及下游产品应按各自边界追溯；废钢不作为收费覆盖商品并不意味着工艺中的废钢碳完全不计。加工损耗和成材率会影响吨成品排放。
items.summary_en: The guidance addresses boundaries and precursor emissions in tCO2e/t goods. Steel generally uses direct emissions, while agglomerated ore CN26011200 includes indirect emissions. Crude/semi-finished steel codes include 7206, 7207, 7218 and 7224. Scrap scope exclusions do not erase process carbon; yield affects product intensity.

items.impact_en: Collect route-level annual reports, precursor evidence and mass balances; check scrap and yield treatment.

items.title_en: US proposes up to 25% Section 301 tariff for India, with exclusions for steel already under Section 232
items.title_original: US proposes 25% tariff on Indian goods under Section 301, keeps aluminium and steel duties separate
items.summary_zh: 美国贸易代表办公室11月25日公布对印度产能过剩的301调查认定及拟议行动。一般拟议税率最高25%，扣除现有301关税，按豁免范围执行。公告第V节明确拟排除已适用232关税的钢、铝、铜制品及相关钢铝衍生品，另有附件A所列豁免。若美印达成回应本案认定的互惠贸易协议，USTR另考虑17%的情景。听证申请和书面意见均于2027年1月5日截止，听证拟于1月25日召开。公告尚未确定新税适用日。
items.summary_en: USTR's 25 November India determination proposes duties up to 25%, net of existing Section 301 tariffs. Section V proposes to exclude steel, aluminium and copper articles and specified derivatives already subject to Section 232, alongside Annex A exclusions. USTR is also considering 17% if a qualifying reciprocal trade agreement is reached. Comments and hearing requests are due 5 January 2027, with a hearing scheduled for 25 January.
items.impact_zh: 与印度供应商比较输美热卷、冷轧、镀层板或钢制品报价时，先按具体HTSUS确认其是否实际适用232，再看附件A及已有双反税。现阶段维持原报价和清关口径。跨年合同可单列非232衍生品在不同税率情景下的成本。中国原产钢材继续按中国案及现行税则核对。
items.impact_en: For U.S. quotes against Indian hot-rolled, cold-rolled and coated steel or fabricated products, confirm Section 232 coverage by HTSUS line and check Annex A and existing trade remedies. Keep existing entry treatment and model tariff scenarios separately for derivatives outside Section 232.

items.title_en: DAkkS accredits TÜV SÜD for CBAM verification covering crude steel and iron and steel products
items.title_original: TÜV南德正式获得德国DAkkS欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）核查机构认可资质
items.summary_zh: TÜV南德11月26日公告称，德国认可机构DAkkS已于11月18日认可TÜV SÜD Industrie Service GmbH为欧盟CBAM核查机构。DAkkS证书附件D-VS-14153-01-01有效期为2026年11月18日至2028年12月10日。第5页的CBAM范围包括V组（烧结矿、生铁、直接还原铁及粗钢）、VI组所列铁合金和VIII组（钢铁制品等），核查现场所在国按Flex B管理。公开附件未列明该机构当前可在中国开展现场核查的具体范围。欧盟2026年度首份CBAM申报及交证截止日均为2027年9月30日。
items.summary_en: On 26 November TÜV SÜD announced that DAkkS had accredited TÜV SÜD Industrie Service GmbH on 18 November. Annex D-VS-14153-01-01 runs to 10 December 2028 and lists CBAM groups V (including crude steel), VI (specified ferroalloys) and VIII (including iron and steel products). Site-visit countries are managed under Flex B and the published annex does not specify current on-site coverage in China. The first CBAM declaration and surrender for 2026 are due 30 September 2027.
items.impact_zh: 对于输欧板坯、热卷、冷轧及镀层板等适用CBAM的产品，若进口商拟用实际排放申报，可把该德国法人列入询价名单。委托前请其书面确认中国所在厂区、对应产品组和前体覆盖、现场档期及出具报告的主体，并与进口商确认报告交付节点。现有成本报价仍按合同所用的排放情景测算。
items.impact_en: For EU-bound slabs and flat steel using actual emissions, request a quote from the accredited German entity and obtain written confirmation of Chinese plant coverage, activity groups, precursors, site-visit capacity and the entity issuing the report. Agree report delivery timing with the EU importer.

items.title_en: USTR proposes Section 301 tariffs for 14 economies; China and EU steel require separate scope checks
items.title_original: US tariff investigation covering China and the EU in focus this week
items.summary_zh: 11月25日，美国贸易代表办公室公布14个经济体的产能过剩301调查认定及征求意见案，承接3月启动的调查。对中国货物，通常情景为附件外最高20%（扣除相同货物在强迫劳动301案下的相应税率）、附件A最高10%、附件B拟免征本项税；谈判结果不足时另考虑最高40%的替代方案，并作同项强迫劳动301扣减。对欧盟方案考虑15%，扣除最惠国与既有301税率，且拟排除已适用232的钢、铝等及相关衍生品；谈判结果不足时另考虑最高20%的方案。韩国最高15%，越南最高35%并可能按谈判及既有措施调整。中国与欧盟的书面意见和听证申请均在2027年1月5日截止，听证拟于1月25日召开。公告未定新措施实施日期。
items.summary_en: USTR issued determinations and proposals for 14 economies on 25 November. For China, it proposes up to 20% outside the annexes net of the forced-labour Section 301 duty, up to 10% for Annex A and exemption under Annex B, with an alternative up to 40% if talks prove insufficient. For the EU, the proposal uses 15% net of MFN and existing Section 301 duties and would exclude steel and derivatives already subject to Section 232; a higher alternative is under consideration. The initial comment and appearance-request deadline is 5 January 2027; the hearing starts 25 January.
items.impact_zh: 输美板坯、热卷、冷轧、镀层板及下游钢制品先由进口商按美国HTSUS逐码比对附件、原产地和现行232、301、双反。现阶段按现行税费报价，对跨年合同另做拟议税率情景并约定税费变更责任。欧盟232排除条款需按欧盟案核对，中国货物按中国案附件处理。
items.impact_en: Keep current duties in quotes. For US-bound slabs, HRC, CRC, coated steel and downstream products, check the US tariff line, origin, the applicable country annex and existing Section 232, Section 301 and AD/CVD. Model the proposed changes separately in 2027 contracts.

B（≥50毫米）。附则将修订条款同样适用于2025年11月24日至2026年11月19日已办理进口申报的符合条件货物。征税范围原则上仍针对对应税号下厚度≥4.75毫米、宽度≥600毫米的非卷状、未经冷轧中厚板。此前官方附件3列示适用一般税率为宝钢27.91%、沙钢29.62%、湘钢32.32%、Sino Commodities、厦门国贸及兜底供应商34.10%，另有特定用途零税率及附件2价格承诺安排，需按供应商和货物条件匹配。
items.summary_en: South Korea promulgated and brought Ministry of Economy and Finance Ordinance No. 55 into force on 20 November 2026. It adds Korean tariff lines 7225.40.9010, 7225.40.9091 and 7225.40.9099 to Annex 1(1), alongside 7208.51.1000 and 7208.51.9000. The stated rationale highlights the existing ASME SA302 Grades B and C exclusions. The official draft and prior annex also list SA516-70 (≥134 mm) and SA299 Grade B (≥50 mm) in the same item. The transitional clause extends the change to qualifying entries filed from 24 November 2025 through 19 November 2026. The earlier official Annex 3 lists general duties of 27.91% for Baoshan, 29.62% for Jiangsu Shagang, 32.32% for Xiangtan and 34.10% for Sino Commodities, Xiamen ITG and residual suppliers, subject to special end-use and price undertaking provisions.
items.impact_zh: 对中国输韩压力容器用厚板逐票匹配牌号、厚度、韩国10位税号和钢厂质保书。请韩国进口商或报关行筛查追溯期内已缴反倾销税的符合条件货物，书面确认是否可更正申报或申请退税、截止日期及所需材料。新单在确认适用排除条款后再调整到岸成本；其余货物按既有措施及对应供应商条件核算。

items.title_zh: 挪威、冰岛2027年1月起实施欧盟CBAM，钢铁等50吨门槛跨境合计
items.title_en: Norway and Iceland to apply EU CBAM from 1 January 2027 with a combined 50-tonne threshold
items.title_original: EU extends Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism to Iceland and Norway from 2027
items.summary_zh: 欧洲经济区联合委员会第283/2026号决定于2026年11月18日生效，将经修订的欧盟CBAM条例纳入欧洲经济区协定。自2027年1月1日起，挪威和冰岛适用同一套机制。钢铁、铝、化肥和水泥的50吨年度净重门槛按同一进口商在欧盟、挪威和冰岛的相关进口量合计，氢和电力不适用吨位门槛。授权在三地互认。当地设立的进口商在2027年3月31日前提交申请可按规定使用本地进口的过渡安排；欧委会同时提示地方进口身份标识TIN与欧盟EORI应分别核对。列支敦士登不适用本决定纳入的条例。
items.summary_en: EEA Joint Committee Decision 283/2026 entered into force on 18 November 2026 and extends EU CBAM to imports into Norway and Iceland from 1 January 2027. The 50-tonne annual net-mass threshold for covered goods in four sectors, including iron and steel, is aggregated per importer across the EU, Norway and Iceland. Electricity and hydrogen have no mass threshold. Authorisations are mutually recognised. Importers established in Norway or Iceland may qualify for local transitional treatment if they submit their application by 31 March 2027. Local TIN and EU EORI requirements should be checked separately. Liechtenstein is excluded.
items.impact_zh: 首票预计在2027年清关的对挪威、冰岛板坯、热卷、冷卷或涂镀订单，按附件税号、当地进口商的跨境累计吨位和预计进口季度估算CBAM成本，要求进口商确认授权、当地TIN及适用的过渡条件。DDP订单应在合同中落实碳成本和钢厂排放数据交付责任。
items.impact_en: For covered slab, HRC, CRC or coated products entering Norway or Iceland in 2027, verify the tariff line, the importer’s combined volumes, authorisation and local TIN. Build CBAM into landed costs for the expected entry quarter and specify carbon-cost and emissions-data responsibilities for DDP orders.

items.title_en: ECIU compares illustrative UK and EU CBAM costs for hot-rolled steel
items.title_original: Steel on the Border: Trade exposure and the implications of UK and EU CBAM for UK Steel
items.summary_zh: ECIU报告引用CBI Economics分析。按贸易额计，2024年欧盟占英国钢材出口的67%、进口的66%。报告表1用英国热轧卷产品默认排放值2.649–3.778 tCO₂e/吨和HMRC示例费率£9.69/tCO₂e，测得约£26–37/吨。中国热轧卷按欧盟默认值及2026年第三季度证书价€82.32测得约€179/吨（2026年进口），同一证价套用2027年参数约€208/吨。上述为报告情景，币种、年份及免费配额调整口径不同。
items.summary_en: ECIU draws on CBI Economics analysis. In 2024 the EU accounted for 67% of UK steel exports and 66% of imports by value. Table 1 models UK hot-rolled coil at around GBP 26–37/t using product defaults of 2.649–3.778 tCO₂e/t and HMRC’s illustrative GBP 9.69/tCO₂e rate. Chinese hot-rolled coil using EU defaults and the Q3 2026 certificate price of EUR 82.32 is modelled at about EUR 179/t for 2026 imports or EUR 208/t under 2027 parameters at the same price. The scenarios use different currencies, years and free-allocation adjustments.
items.impact_zh: 对英国和欧盟分别按进口期、商品编码、对应排放数据及进口商可申报扣减核算到岸成本，再叠加各自的配额关税和贸易救济措施。报告所示差异值得纳入英国与欧盟报价的情景敏感性，实际订单按当期公布参数复算。欧英ETS联动及可能的互惠豁免见欧委会公告，按各项原产地规则及生效日期确认适用性。
items.impact_en: Calculate landed costs separately for each market using the import period, commodity code, applicable emissions data and relief available to the importer. Add any applicable tariff-quota and trade-remedy charges. Use the report as a sensitivity case and reprice against the rates in force. Check the Commission notice and applicable origin and effective-date rules for the ETS link and possible reciprocal exemptions.

items.title_en: EU ETS industrial emissions down 3.3% in 2025; extension of CBAM to around 180 downstream steel and aluminium goods remains proposed
items.title_original: EU industrial emissions fall as Commission outlines proposed CBAM extension to 180 downstream steel and aluminium products
items.summary_zh: 【媒体报道与官方立法背景】EUROMETAL 2026年11月18日转载SteelOrbis报道：根据欧委会11月9日碳市场年度报告，2025年ETS覆盖工业设施排放同比下降3.3%，钢铁、水泥、化工为主要贡献行业。报道提及欧委会2025年12月提议自2028年将CBAM扩展到约180类钢铝密集型下游产品（例如洗衣机、工业散热器、铸造机械）。欧盟议会研究处2026年7月资料确认这是COM(2025)989、程序2025/0419(COD)的立法提案，而非已经生效的产品清单；截至本次核验未取得三方最终通过文本，不应称180项已经纳入。
items.summary_en: EUROMETAL's 18 Nov report cites a Commission ETS report showing 2025 industrial emissions down 3.3%. The Commission's proposed CBAM extension to roughly 180 downstream steel/aluminium products from 2028 remains a legislative proposal (COM(2025)989, 2025/0419(COD)), not an adopted list.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】如最终通过，下游金属制品出口企业将新增碳排放数据、前驱体与证书成本合规需求，改变欧盟客户对钢材及加工制品的采购比较；当前不能直接把拟议180类产品计入现行CBAM征收范围。应关注欧盟三方谈判最终CN编码、废钢前驱体、反规避和2028年拟议起始日期。
items.impact_en: If adopted, expanded downstream CBAM would affect metal-fabricated goods and precursor data; the 180-product list is not currently binding. Monitor the final trilogue text, CN codes and scrap rules.

items.title_original: Australia launches review of antidumping duties on steel plate imports from China and South Korea
items.summary_zh: 澳大利亚反倾销复审委员会于2026年11月18日应宝山钢铁股份有限公司和宝钢湛江申请，对9月24日公布的第2026/103号反倾销决定启动复审。争议涉及巴西板坯基准是否应覆盖铁矿石成本、能否采用经核实的浦项板坯成本及损害归因。范围为未包覆或涂镀、非卷状、厚度≥4.75毫米、宽度≥600毫米的非合金或其他合金扁平轧材，包括钢坯直轧板和热卷开平板。参考税号7208.40.00、7208.51.00、7208.52.00、7208.90.00、7225.40.00。不锈钢、硅电工钢、工具钢、高速钢、调质板及指定调质母板排除，登记册还列有部长豁免，例如符合标准的S355JR且厚度超过115毫米的部分热轧板，须结合生产方式及具体豁免文书核对。现行登记册公布的有效税率为宝山18.8%、湛江9.4%、涟钢26.4%、中国其他出口商55.1%、韩国浦项豁免、韩国其他出口商21.6%。宝山和中国其他出口商栏包含独立反补贴措施，组合反倾销税的实际税负可能高于公示有效税率。复审尚未修改现行措施。书面意见截止2026年12月18日，复审报告预计2027年1月18日提交部长。
items.summary_en: On 18 November 2026, Australia’s Anti-Dumping Review Panel opened a review of the 24 September decision ADN 2026/103 on applications from Baoshan and Baosteel Zhanjiang. It will examine slab benchmarking and injury attribution. The scope includes uncoated, non-coiled non-alloy and other alloy plate, at least 4.75 mm thick by 600 mm wide, including cut-to-length plate made from coil, subject to material and grade exclusions. A ministerial instrument also exempts certain S355JR plates over 115 mm meeting the specified production and standard requirements. Published effective rates are 18.8% for Baoshan, 9.4% for Zhanjiang, 26.4% for Hunan Valin Lianyuan, 55.1% for other Chinese exporters, exempt for POSCO and 21.6% for other Korean exporters. Baoshan’s and the Chinese residual rate include a separate countervailing measure; actual combination duties can exceed the published effective rates. Submissions close on 18 December 2026 and the panel’s report is due on 18 January 2027.
items.impact_zh: 有在手输澳中厚板、花纹板或开平板询单时，先由进口商逐票匹配牌号、尺寸、出口商和DSN，并核实组合反倾销税适用的出口价格基准及实际税负。继续按现行措施核算DDP或到岸总成本；拟提交意见的企业及早准备成本和损害证据，并按公告要求提供可公开版本。
items.impact_en: For Australian plate or cut-to-length orders, have the importer match the grade, dimensions, exporter and DSN and check the applicable price basis and combination duty. Keep current trade-remedy costs in landed quotes, and prepare supporting evidence and a public version if making a submission.

items.title_zh: 墨西哥加强钢材进口追溯，11月19日版官方名录仍列首钢京唐及迁安
items.title_en: Mexico tightens steel import traceability; 19 November official catalogue lists Shougang Jingtang and Qian’an
items.title_original: Mexico says crackdown on Asian steel shipments is paying off as US tariff talks advance
items.summary_zh: 路透社11月11日报道，墨西哥经济部负责外贸的副部长Luis Rosendo Gutiérrez称，墨方加强钢材追溯以防经墨转运至美国并利用协定优惠，已清理约1,100个钢厂登记。该数字为官员表述，报道所述美国第232条关税减免仍在谈判阶段。墨西哥经济部SNICE将钢厂名录更新日期列为2026年11月19日。该版PDF列有首钢京唐（SE00551）和首钢迁安（SE00552，企业栏为北京首钢股份有限公司）。SNICE现行指南要求在适用税号下办理钢铁产品自动进口通知（AAIPS），选取生产钢厂并提交适用的证书。对适用钢厂证书要求且加工未改变钢材性质的货物，指南要求以原料钢厂证书及加工各环节质量证书核对炉号。
items.summary_en: Reuters reported on 11 November that Mexican deputy economy minister Luis Rosendo Gutiérrez said Mexico had tightened steel traceability to prevent diversion through Mexico into the US using trade preferences and removed around 1,100 mill registrations. That figure is attributed to the official. The reported US Section 232 tariff relief remained under negotiation. Mexico’s Economy Ministry lists its SNICE mill catalogue as updated on 19 November 2026. The published PDF lists Shougang Jingtang (SE00551) and Shougang Qian’an (SE00552, with Beijing Shougang Co., Ltd. in the company field). Current SNICE guidance requires selection of the producing mill and applicable certificates for steel lines subject to automatic import notices (AAIPS). For covered material further processed without changing the nature of the steel, it calls for linked mill and processing certificates to trace the heat.
items.impact_zh: 对墨西哥冷轧、镀锌等板卷订单，先由进口商或报关行按实际牌号、规格和用途确认墨西哥税号及适用手续，并在VUCEM核对实际生产钢厂编号、证书抬头和炉号后再锁定报价或安排装运。涉及售美下游产品时，另行核查适用的原产地和美国第232条要求。SNICE列名可作核对依据，实际可选状态及具体货物能否清关须以申报核对为准。
items.impact_en: For cold-rolled or galvanised coil orders for Mexico, have the importer or broker confirm the Mexican tariff line and applicable procedure from the specification and end use. Before fixing quotes or shipping, match the actual mill ID, certificate identity and heat numbers in VUCEM. For downstream goods destined for the US, check applicable origin and US Section 232 rules separately. A public catalogue entry supports the check; confirm live eligibility for the shipment.

items.title_original: Saudi Arabia Anti-Dumping Investigation: Hot-Rolled Steel Sections from China and Turkiye
items.summary_zh: 沙特外贸总局（GAFT）2026年11月9日发布第15号立案公告（AD-26-3），涉及原产于或出口自中国、土耳其的热轧中轻型结构型钢，包括H、I、W、UB型钢、UPN/UPE槽钢、高度不超过220毫米的等边角钢和宽度不超过300毫米的扁钢。立案援引10个沙特12位参考税号：721621000001、721621000002、721631100001、721631100002、721632100001、721632100002、721633100001、721633100002、721640100001、721640100002。申诉中另外列出的税号未列入立案公告的参考税号清单。倾销调查期为2025年4月1日至2026年3月31日。公告要求利害关系方自公告日起15天内登记，按日历推算为11月24日；已登记境外生产商及出口商的抽样答卷为公告日起21天，按日历推算为11月30日。正式答卷和对申诉的意见自立案通知及非保密申诉文本发出之日起37天内提交，以个案送达通知为准。GAFT公开案件页仍列为调查中，立案公告未规定反倾销税。
items.summary_en: Saudi Arabia’s GAFT initiated case AD-26-3 on 9 November 2026 under Notice No. 15. It covers light and medium hot-rolled H, I, W and UB sections, UPN/UPE channels, equal angles up to 220 mm in height, and flat bars up to 300 mm wide, originating in or exported from China or Türkiye. GAFT cited ten Saudi 12-digit tariff lines for reference. The dumping investigation period runs from 1 April 2025 through 31 March 2026. The 15-day interested-party registration and 21-day sampling response periods run from publication, pointing to 24 and 30 November respectively. The standard questionnaire and comments on the complaint are due 37 days after dispatch of the initiation notice and non-confidential complaint. The public case record shows an ongoing investigation. Notice No. 15 imposes no duty.
items.impact_zh: 有沙特在途单、长交期订单或新询价时，今天与钢厂、沙特进口商一起按断面形状、尺寸和当地12位税号逐票核对。涉案企业立即向GAFT确认当地提交时点、登记材料及抽样问卷。复核跨期合同中临时或最终反倾销措施的责任分配，现阶段按已实际生效的税费报价。
items.impact_en: For Saudi orders, match section geometry, dimensions and Saudi tariff lines with the mill and importer. Affected companies should confirm the local cut-off, registration documents and sampling form with GAFT immediately. Review how contracts allocate any future provisional or definitive anti-dumping duties. Price shipments using currently applicable charges.

items.summary_en: Serbia's official fiscal strategy estimates €140.2m of 2026 EU CBAM exposure under baseline assumptions, with €89.1m attributed to iron and steel, €19.5m to aluminium and €21.8m to electricity. These are scenario estimates, not assessed taxes.

items.title_zh: 加拿大对中国碳钢及合金钢管线管启动反倾销、反补贴措施到期复审（RR-2026-008）
items.title_en: Canada starts expiry review RR-2026-008 of China carbon and alloy steel line pipe
items.title_original: Canadian tribunal opens review of China steel line pipe order
items.summary_zh: 【事实】加拿大国际贸易法庭（CITT）2026年11月2日宣布启动RR-2026-008到期复审，审查其2022年1月6日就中国碳钢及合金钢管线管作出的既有反倾销、反补贴命令若到期，是否可能再次发生倾销或补贴并损害加拿大产业。加拿大边境服务署（CBSA）最迟于2027年4月1日认定倾销/补贴继续或再发的可能性；如认定为肯定，CITT最迟于2027年9月8日作出损害可能性结论。有意参与者须提交Form I参与通知。该程序是对现有措施的到期复审，不是11月2日新征一个税率，也不是已决定撤销措施。
items.summary_en: On 2 November 2026 the Canadian International Trade Tribunal initiated expiry review RR-2026-008 of its 6 January 2022 order regarding dumping and subsidizing of carbon and alloy steel line pipe from China. CBSA must decide by 1 April 2027 whether dumping or subsidizing is likely to continue or recur. If affirmative, CITT must decide likely injury by 8 September 2027. Interested parties may participate by filing Form I. This is an expiry review of existing measures, not a new duty rate or a revocation.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】面向加拿大的中国管线管生产商和出口商应尽快核对现行措施适用的产品定义、生产商税率与出口记录，联络加拿大进口商/律师评估是否提交参与通知和证据。由于公告摘要没有列具体HS税号、公司税率和Form I截止日，不宜推断所有7304/7305/7306钢管均涉案，也不得擅自公布应诉期限。下一步阅读CITT正式Notice、CBSA产品定义与当前征税指令。
items.impact_en: Chinese line-pipe exporters should confirm product scope, producer-specific duty treatment and transaction history and assess participation with Canadian counsel/importers. The press release does not specify HS scope, company duty rates or the filing cut-off; consult the formal notice and CBSA instructions before declaring applicability or deadlines.
items.source_excerpt: Canadian tribunal opens review of China steel line pipe order Traders Union
items.coverage: 2026-11-03核对CITT 11月2日官方新闻稿与在办案件表中的RR-2026-008程序和关键日期；正式决定索引访问受限，未对完整涉案税号或Form I提交截止日作具体认定。
items.follow_up: 向相关加拿大进口商发送案件预警；取得CITT正式参与通知及CBSA产品定义后核实Form I截止日、税号和现行措施。关键审查节点：2027-04-01及2027-09-08。

items.title_original: Chinese Steel Group Chides Mills for Ignoring Output Curb Calls
items.summary_zh: 中钢协10月30日三季度发布会及《中国冶金报》评论显示，前三季度全国粗钢产量7.25亿吨、同比下降2.9%，折合粗钢表观消费量6.25亿吨、下降3.8%，需求降幅大于产量降幅；重点会员企业平均钢材库存1,685万吨，为近四年同期最高，9月会员企业利润总额22.4亿元、环比下降55.8%，钢铁主业亏损46.1亿元。中钢协评估约10家企业执行“以销定产、以效定产、以现定销”等原则不够坚决，将进行行业自律提醒，并要求控制生产节奏、降低库存。该安排是行业协会自律与经营倡议，不是政府下达的全国强制减产指标。
items.summary_en: At its 30 October briefing, CISA said Jan–Sep crude steel output was 725Mt, down 2.9%, while apparent consumption fell 3.8% to 625Mt. Key member mills' average finished-steel inventory was 16.85Mt, the highest in four years. September member profits fell 55.8% month on month to CNY2.24bn and core steel operations lost CNY4.61bn. CISA said about ten mills had not followed its sales-, efficiency- and cash-based production principles firmly enough and would receive self-discipline reminders. This is an industry-association initiative, not a mandatory nationwide government cut.
items.impact_zh: 若会员钢厂后续真正减产并去库存，短期可能缓解国内钢价和出口低价竞争压力，同时压低铁矿石、焦煤和焦炭需求；但目前没有统一减产量、企业名单或强制执行期限，不能据此推断供应必然收缩。中国钢厂应按订单、边际利润和现金回款安排产量；出口商需关注约11月7日海关数据、11月中旬10月粗钢产量及库存是否实际下降，再调整远期报价和原料采购。
items.impact_en: If mills actually cut output and destock, domestic and export price pressure may ease while raw-material demand weakens. No uniform tonnage target, named mill list or mandatory deadline exists, so supply contraction is not assured. Base production on orders, margins and cash collection, and verify customs, October output and inventory data before changing forward offers.

items.title_zh: 埃及4月终止对中土冷轧、镀锌及彩涂板反倾销调查，进口保障措施继续执行
items.title_en: Egypt ended the Chinese and Turkish CRC, galvanized and pre-painted steel anti-dumping case in April while safeguards continued
items.title_original: 埃及终止涉华冷轧卷、镀锌卷和彩涂卷钢材反倾销调查，不征反倾销税
items.summary_zh: 埃及投资和对外贸易部官方统计确认，第7/2026号公告终止对原产于或出口自中国和土耳其的冷轧卷、镀锌和彩涂钢材的反倾销调查，未征收反倾销税。该公告载于2026年4月1日埃及公报第72号增刊D，11月2日为中文报道刊发日期。独立的第120/2026号保障决定自4月2日起执行。按埃方向WTO的通报，2026年9月14日至2027年9月13日，对符合范围的货物，冷轧为CIF的13%且最低79美元/吨，镀锌为13.5%且最低90美元/吨，彩涂为14%且最低118美元/吨。
items.summary_en: Egypt’s Ministry of Investment and Foreign Trade confirms that Notice 7/2026 ended the anti-dumping investigation into CRC, galvanized and pre-painted steel from China and Türkiye without duties. The Gazette lists the notice in the 1 April 2026 supplement, while the Chinese report is dated 2 November. Separate safeguard Decision 120/2026 took effect on 2 April. Egypt’s WTO notification sets the 14 September 2026–13 September 2027 rates for covered shipments at 13% of CIF with a USD 79/t minimum for CRC, 13.5% with a USD 90/t minimum for galvanized steel, and 14% with a USD 118/t minimum for pre-painted steel.
items.impact_zh: 埃及冷轧、镀锌、彩涂报价仍要计入适用的保障税。请进口商按当地税号、镀层成分及重量和报关日期核对。WTO通报的保障排除项包括符合条件的冷硬卷、铝硅镀层和部分锌铝镁镀层；对中国供货逐票确认产品条件及进口商的证明材料。
items.impact_en: Include applicable safeguards in Egyptian CRC, galvanized and pre-painted steel quotes. Ask the importer to verify local tariff lines, coating chemistry and weight, and entry dates. The safeguard notification lists exclusions for qualifying full-hard CRC, aluminium-silicon coatings and certain zinc-aluminium-magnesium coatings. Confirm specifications and supporting documents for each shipment.

items.title_zh: 英国钢贸会议预计2027年价格承压上行，CBAM与配额风险正进入合同条款
items.title_en: UK steel meeting expects 2027 price pressure as CBAM and quota risks move into contracts
items.title_original: UK steel industry expects higher prices in 2027; concerns that fabricated goods imports undermine safeguards and CBAM
items.summary_zh: EUROMETAL对10月22日ISTA与NSA利兹年会的报道显示，参会者认为英国钢市仍由供应主导、终端需求偏弱但未继续收缩，2027年价格可能上升。报道援引英国商务与贸易部截至10月26日数据称，热轧卷“其他国家”配额已用尽，印度8,364吨配额使用94%，韩国2,196吨配额使用20.3%，欧盟93,750吨配额已使用65,700吨。由于英国CBAM最终成本受核查和轧制料投入透明度影响，买卖双方正讨论成本分摊或事后调整条款；部分卖方转向DAP以限制超配额税费风险。参会者还担心制成钢品进口绕开上游配额并削弱CBAM效果，但该说法是行业风险判断，不是政府已认定规避或已经扩围。
items.summary_en: EUROMETAL's report on the 22 October ISTA/NSA meeting in Leeds said the UK market remained supply-driven, with weak but not contracting demand and expectations of higher 2027 prices. Citing DBT data as of 26 October, it said the residual HRC quota was exhausted, India had used 94% of 8,364t, South Korea 20.3% of 2,196t, and the EU 65,700t of 93,750t. Verification and input-transparency uncertainty is prompting CBAM true-up or risk-sharing clauses and some DAP offers. Concerns about fabricated-goods imports are industry views, not a government circumvention finding or enacted scope expansion.
items.impact_zh: 对输英钢材业务，2027年报价应把配额外关税、英国CBAM、核查失败和港口滞期费拆开列示，并在合同中明确DAP/DDP责任、适用配额时点、碳数据交付、最终税额调整及发票凭证。不能把会议上的涨价预期当成确定行情，也不能假定制成钢品已纳入现行配额或英国CBAM；实际报关前须按英国官方8位商品编码、实时配额余额和正式税率复核。
items.impact_en: For UK-bound steel, separate out-of-quota duty, UK CBAM, verification failure and demurrage risks, and define DAP/DDP responsibility, quota timing, emissions-data delivery and tax true-ups. Treat the price outlook as market opinion and verify 8-digit codes, live quota balances and enacted rates before customs clearance.

follow_up.action_en: Before 1 January 2027, update contracts against official UK codes, final CBAM rates and importer responsibility; recheck live quota balances before each shipment.

items.coverage: 2026-11-02已通读EUROMETAL公开全文并与SMM转载交叉核对会议日期、配额数字、合同与物流表述；另以GOV.UK确认英国钢铁措施与英国CBAM为并行且独立制度。未独立取得ISTA/NSA会议纪要、DBT 10月26日原始余额快照或港口数据，预测与规避担忧均按参会者观点呈现。

items.title_zh: 宝钢股份前三季度归母净利润67.39亿元，同比下降15.33%
items.title_en: Baosteel's nine-month net profit falls 15.33% to CNY 6.739bn
items.title_original: Baosteel’s net profit fell by 15.3% y/y in nine months
items.summary_zh: 宝钢股份2026年第三季度报告显示，第三季度营业收入849.16亿元、同比增长4.75%，归母净利润21.67亿元、同比下降29.67%，扣非归母净利润19.61亿元、同比下降40.50%；前三季度营业收入2456.48亿元、同比增长5.68%，归母净利润67.39亿元、同比下降15.33%，扣非归母净利润64.93亿元、同比下降19.20%。前三季度铁产量3660.5万吨、钢产量3863.2万吨、商品坯材销量3915.0万吨、合并利润86.1亿元；出口接单量587.3万吨，同比增加70.4万吨。公司称单位铁水、物流、能源及质量成本同口径分别下降3%、6%、4%和16%。财务报表未经审计。
items.summary_en: Baosteel's unaudited third-quarter report shows Q3 revenue of CNY 84.916bn (+4.75% y/y), attributable net profit of CNY 2.167bn (-29.67%) and adjusted attributable profit of CNY 1.961bn (-40.50%). For January–September, revenue was CNY 245.648bn (+5.68%), attributable net profit CNY 6.739bn (-15.33%) and adjusted profit CNY 6.493bn (-19.20%). Nine-month steel output was 38.632Mt, saleable billet and product sales 39.150Mt, consolidated profit CNY 8.61bn, and export orders 5.873Mt, up 0.704Mt.
items.impact_zh: 收入增长但利润下降，说明吨钢盈利仍受钢价、原燃料及结构因素挤压；与此同时，产销量和出口接单增长并不支持简单推断宝钢正在减产。采购方和竞争对手应把5.873百万吨出口接单视为公司口径的订单量，而非已报关出口量，并继续跟踪第四季度交付、价格和库存。成本改善是公司披露的同口径指标，不能替代外部审计或推导单个产品利润。
items.impact_en: Revenue growth alongside lower profit indicates margin pressure, while higher output, sales and export orders do not support a simple production-cut conclusion. Treat the 5.873Mt figure as company-reported export orders, not customs-cleared exports, and monitor Q4 delivery, pricing and stocks. Company cost-improvement metrics are not an audit of product-level margins.

items.title_zh: 中钢协：前三季度钢铁供强需弱、库存高位，重点企业利润下降27.4%
items.title_en: CISA says nine-month steel supply outpaced demand as key-member profits fell 27.4%
items.title_original: 【新华解读】供需失衡、成本上涨 钢铁行业低利润运行
items.summary_zh: 新华财经对中钢协三季度信息发布会的完整报道显示，2026年前三季度全国粗钢产量7.25亿吨、同比下降2.9%，折合粗钢表观消费量6.25亿吨、下降3.8%；钢材出口8564万吨、下降2.6%，出口均价709美元／吨、上升1.8%。重点统计企业平均钢材库存1685万吨，为近四年最高；CSPI平均92.28点、同比下降1.48%，为近十年同期最低。重点企业营业收入4.57万亿元、下降2.3%，营业成本4.29万亿元、下降1.9%，利润总额718亿元、下降27.4%。炼焦煤、冶金焦、喷吹煤和国产铁精矿采购成本分别上涨20.45%、16.66%、16.06%和0.15%，进口粉矿下降1.31%。中钢协副会长唐祖君称行业主要矛盾仍是供强需弱，并倡导“以销定产、以效定产、以现定销”。
items.summary_en: Xinhua Finance's full report on CISA's Q3 briefing says January–September crude-steel output was 725Mt (-2.9%), apparent crude-steel consumption 625Mt (-3.8%), steel exports 85.64Mt (-2.6%) and average export price USD 709/t (+1.8%). Key-member average finished-steel stocks were 16.85Mt, the highest in four years, while the average CSPI was 92.28, the lowest comparable level in a decade. Key members reported CNY 4.57tn revenue (-2.3%) and CNY 71.8bn total profit (-27.4%). Coking-coal, coke and PCI-coal purchase costs rose 20.45%, 16.66% and 16.06%.
items.impact_zh: 需求降幅大于产量降幅、库存高位和焦煤焦炭成本上升共同压缩利润，出口量下降但出口均价回升，不能只凭出口均价判断盈利改善。钢厂应按订单、现金回款和边际贡献落实动态产销平衡，控制成品库存与高成本原料敞口；出口部门应继续按目的国贸易救济、配额和CBAM要求筛选订单。协会“三定三不要”属于行业自律和经营倡议，不是行政限产或新的出口配额。
items.impact_en: Consumption fell faster than output, high stocks and higher coal/coke costs squeezed margins, while a higher average export price does not prove better profitability. Mills should align output with orders, cash collection and marginal contribution, manage finished-goods and raw-material exposure, and screen exports for trade remedies, quotas and CBAM. CISA's operating principles are industry guidance, not an administrative production cut or export quota.

items.title_zh: 欧英不锈钢进口配额趋紧：部分配额已用尽，英国CBAM默认值将放大数据不足成本
items.title_en: EU and UK stainless quotas tighten; UK CBAM defaults raise the cost of missing data
items.title_original: EU & UK Stainless Steel Quotas Tighten: Higher Tariffs, CBAM Costs Ahead
items.summary_zh: MEPS对2026年第四季度配额使用情况的分析显示，欧盟不锈钢棒及轻型材的“其他国家”溢出配额2,399吨已用尽，截至10月15日超额申请14,858吨；印度国别配额23,139吨也已用尽，而中国、日本和韩国国别配额尚有余额。欧盟无缝不锈钢管的FTA/国别溢出配额亦超额申请逾750吨，印度3,832吨和“其他国家”774吨配额已用尽。英国方面，截至10月15日，欧盟来源不锈钢棒及轻型材4,135吨配额约78%尚未使用，但其他来源棒材/轻型材590吨和盘条59吨已用尽；土耳其“其他焊管”第四季度3,629吨配额已用尽。英欧自7月1日起缩减钢铁配额并将超额税率提高至50%。MEPS按英国官方示例税率£9.69/tCO₂e测算，部分冷轧不锈钢默认值5.347—6.746 tCO₂e/t对应约£51.81—£65.36/t；这只是示例税率乘默认值的情景，不是正式2027年应缴税额。英国首季正式CBAM税率仍须在2026年底前发布。
items.summary_en: MEPS reports that the EU's 2,399t overflow quota for stainless bars and light sections was exhausted and over-allocated by 14,858t by 15 October; India's 23,139t country quota was also exhausted, while China, Japan and Korea still had balances. EU seamless stainless tube overflow and India/other-country quotas were likewise exhausted. In the UK, about 78% of the 4,135t EU quota for stainless bars and light sections remained, but small residual quotas and Türkiye's 3,629t other-welded-tube quota were exhausted. MEPS multiplies official UK default values by the illustrative £9.69/tCO2e rate to show roughly £51.81–£65.36/t for certain cold-rolled stainless products. This is a scenario, not the official 2027 liability.
items.impact_zh: 中国不锈钢出口商不能只看50%超额税率，应按目的市场、产品类别、原产地和到港季度逐票核对配额余额；中国国别配额尚有余额不等于所有不锈钢品类均可免税。对英订单应立即向客户提供8位CN编码、净重、生产装置和可核证实际排放，并在合同中明确配额用尽、CBAM默认值、核查费及碳价减免的承担方。缺少实际排放数据时，英国进口商可用默认值，但由此测算的成本可能高于企业实际排放；正式报价须等待季度正式税率并核对具体编码，不能把£51.81—£65.36/t直接套用于所有产品。
items.impact_en: Check quota balances by market, product category, origin and arrival quarter; remaining China-specific balances do not cover every stainless product. For UK orders, provide the eight-digit CN code, net mass, installation and verifiable actual emissions, and allocate quota, default-value, verification and carbon-price-relief risks in contracts. Do not apply the modelled £51.81–£65.36/t universally; use the official quarterly rate and product code.

items.title_en: Thailand sets 3 December questionnaire deadline in anti-dumping investigation on Chinese PC strand
items.title_original: 泰国对华预应力钢绞线启动反倾销调查
items.summary_zh: 泰国商业部外贸厅（DFT）就原产于中国的预应力混凝土用钢绞线（PC Strand，泰国税号7312.10.91）启动反倾销调查，案号AD1057。泰国政府公报2026年10月22日刊登立案公告，10月23日启动。DFT案件页列明，境外生产商及出口商、泰国进口商和买方的问卷截止日为2026年12月3日。DFT公开状态为调查中，暂未列示开始征收反倾销税的日期或企业税率。
items.summary_en: Thailand’s DFT opened anti-dumping case AD1057 on prestressed concrete steel strand originating in China, under Thai tariff line 7312.10.91. The Gazette published the notice on 22 October 2026 and the investigation started on 23 October. DFT lists 3 December 2026 as the questionnaire deadline for foreign producers and exporters and for Thai importers and buyers. The case remains under investigation, with no company-specific duty or duty start date listed.
items.impact_zh: 优先核对输泰成品钢绞线的产品描述、泰国报关税号及实际生产商。涉及订单时，立即与钢厂和泰国进口商确定答卷分工，核对各自公告、送达记录和附表。DDP或固定到岸总价订单可复核后续税负分配条款，现阶段按已生效税费核算。
items.impact_en: Check the product description, Thai declaration code and actual mill for PC strand shipments. The mill and Thai importer should coordinate responses and reconcile their notices, service records and appendices. Review who bears any future duties on DDP or fixed landed-price contracts.

items.title_zh: 日本决定对中国及台湾镍系冷轧不锈钢征收五年反倾销税，10月31日起实施
items.title_en: Japan decides five-year definitive anti-dumping duties on Chinese and Taiwanese nickel-added cold-rolled stainless steel from 31 October
items.title_original: Japan to Impose Anti-Dumping Duties of Up to 42.1% on Chinese, Taiwanese Stainless Steel Plate for 5 Years from Oct. 31
items.summary_zh: 日本财务省10月27日宣布，内阁已决定对原产于或从中国、台湾出口的镍系冷轧不锈钢带及冷轧板征收最终反倾销税；政令拟于10月30日公布，课税期为2026年10月31日至2031年10月30日。调查范围为含铬10.5%以上、镍0.6%以上的合金钢，涉及HS 7219.31—7219.35、7219.90、7220.20及7220.90项下22个税目。中国山西太钢及未抽样合作企业税率为27.7%，浦项（张家港）不锈钢（PZSS）及其他供应商为42.1%；台湾YUSCO及未抽样企业为3.6%，Walsin及其他供应商为20.1%。最终税率与7月9日起的临时税率相同。
items.summary_en: Japan's Ministry of Finance announced on 27 October that the Cabinet had decided definitive anti-dumping duties on nickel-added cold-rolled stainless steel coil, sheet and strip originating in or exported from China and Taiwan. The Cabinet Order is due to be promulgated on 30 October and duties will apply from 31 October 2026 through 30 October 2031. Scope covers alloy steel with at least 10.5% chromium and more than 0.6% nickel under 22 tariff lines within HS 7219.31-7219.35, 7219.90, 7220.20 and 7220.90. Rates are 27.7% for Shanxi Taigang and cooperating non-sampled Chinese suppliers, 42.1% for PZSS and other Chinese suppliers, 3.6% for YUSCO and cooperating non-sampled Taiwanese suppliers, and 20.1% for Walsin and other Taiwanese suppliers. These rates are unchanged from the provisional measure.
items.impact_zh: 这是已由日本内阁决定、即将公布并按明确日期实施的最终措施，不是提案。向日本出口相关冷轧不锈钢的中国钢厂和贸易商应在10月31日前按制造商身份、原产地/出口地和日本税目逐票复核适用税率；尤其不要把27.7%合作税率误用于PZSS或未获该待遇的供应商。报价和合同应明确反倾销税承担、在途货物清关日期及错误归类风险，并保存材质成分、宽度、轧制状态、制造商和原产地证明。该措施仅覆盖上述镍系冷轧不锈钢范围，不能外推到所有不锈钢板材。
items.impact_en: This is a definitive measure decided by Japan's Cabinet with a specified implementation date, not a proposal. Chinese mills and traders shipping covered cold-rolled stainless steel to Japan should verify the producer, origin/export route and Japanese tariff classification shipment by shipment before 31 October. Do not apply the 27.7% cooperating rate to PZSS or suppliers not entitled to it. Contracts and quotations should allocate anti-dumping duty, customs-clearance timing and misclassification risk, while retaining composition, width, rolling condition, producer and origin evidence. The measure covers the specified nickel-added cold-rolled products only, not all stainless plate.
items.status: 最终反倾销措施／10月31日起实施
