follow_up.action_en: Check the promulgated Cabinet Order and detailed Japanese tariff lines on 30 October; from 31 October confirm the rate by producer, origin/export route and customs-clearance date. The measure runs through 30 October 2031.

items.title_zh: EUROMETAL等21方呼吁扩大CBAM下游覆盖，属于行业主张并非已生效清单
items.title_en: EUROMETAL and 20 co-signatories seek broad downstream CBAM coverage
items.title_original: European steel and downstream industries call for comprehensive EU CBAM expansion
items.summary_zh: EUROMETAL10月19日原始联合声明称，与19家行业协会及industriAll欧洲工会共同呼吁，在10月20日三方谈判前推动尽可能广泛的下游产品覆盖。其担忧是免费配额退坡后，欧盟钢铝使用者与未受同等碳成本约束的进口制成品竞争失衡。声明涉及建筑、机械、汽车、能源等价值链，是游说立场，不是新增产品已经正式纳税。
items.summary_en: A 19 October joint statement from EUROMETAL, 19 other associations and industriAll urges broad downstream coverage ahead of the 20 October trilogue. They warn of competitive imbalance as free allowances decline. This is an industry position, not an enacted new product list.
items.impact_zh: 中国钢厂及下游出口商应按实际CN编码跟踪最终法案；先准备钢铝前体追溯和客户数据，不把行业要求当成2027或2028年确定义务。
items.impact_en: Track final CN-code coverage and prepare precursor traceability. Do not treat an association demand as a settled future tax obligation.

items.title_zh: 韩国对中国合金钢棒作肯定性反倾销初裁，临时税率仍待财政部门决定
items.title_en: South Korea preliminarily finds injury from Chinese alloy-steel bars; provisional duties await finance-ministry action
items.title_original: China Steel Bar Duties Near, Squeezing Small Forging Firms
items.summary_zh: 韩国贸易委员会于2026年9月17日第477次会议对中国合金钢棒作出倾销和产业损害肯定性初裁，并建议财政经济部门在调查期间征收25.08%—27.96%的临时反倾销税。涉案棒材用于汽车、工程机械、造船、轴承和工业机械零部件；申请人为世亚贝斯特与世亚昌原特殊钢，调查对象包括中国大冶、江苏永钢和金腾三组供应商。委员会预计于2027年2月作出终裁。该初裁及建议不等同于临时税已经生效。
items.summary_en: At its 477th meeting on 17 September 2026, the Korea Trade Commission made an affirmative preliminary dumping and injury determination on alloy-steel bars from China and recommended provisional anti-dumping duties of 25.08%–27.96% during the investigation. The bars are used in automotive, construction-equipment, shipbuilding, bearing and industrial-machinery parts. SeAH Besteel and SeAH Changwon Special Steel filed the petition; the investigated supplier groups include Daye, Jiangsu Yonggang and Jinteng. A final determination is planned for February 2027. The preliminary finding and recommendation do not by themselves put provisional duties into force.
items.impact_zh: 对韩出口合金钢棒的中国生产商和贸易商应立即按韩国书面产品范围核对牌号、制造方式、HSK编码、生产商—出口商组合及关联企业，并保存内销、对韩销售、成本和产能数据以应对后续核查。报价和到港安排不得直接套用媒体列示的企业税率；只有韩国财政部门发布实施公告后，才能确认临时税的生效日、征收期和报关适用税率。同步跟踪2027年2月终裁节点。
items.impact_en: Chinese producers and traders exporting alloy-steel bars to Korea should immediately map grades, manufacturing method, HSK codes, producer-exporter combinations and affiliates against the written scope, and preserve home-market sales, Korean sales, cost and capacity data for the continuing investigation. Do not apply media-reported company rates to quotations or arrivals until the Korean finance authority publishes an implementing notice confirming the effective date, collection period and entry rate. Monitor the planned February 2027 final determination.
items.status: 反倾销肯定性初裁／临时税建议
items.source_excerpt: China Steel Bar Duties Near, Squeezing Small Forging Firms Seoul Economic Daily
items.coverage: 2026-10-24已通读韩国贸易委员会经韩国政策简报发布的官方新闻稿全文，并核对会议日期、初裁性质、25.08%—27.96%建议区间、申请企业、三组调查对象、用途及2027年2月终裁计划；官方新闻稿未列16个HSK编码和逐企业税率，Yieh报道中的细分税率仅作相关线索，不作为已生效征税依据；截至本轮未发现财政部门临时措施实施公告。

follow_up.action_zh: 立即核对韩国调查产品范围、HSK及企业组合；持续检查财政部门临时税实施公告，并准备2027年2月终裁前的调查答卷和核查材料。
follow_up.action_en: Verify Korean scope, HSK codes and company combinations now; monitor the finance authority's provisional-duty notice and prepare submissions and verification records ahead of the planned February 2027 final determination.

items.title_zh: 首钢股份拟不超30.15亿元增持首钢智新19.60%股份，尚待股东会批准
items.title_en: Shougang Co. proposes up to CNY 3.015bn purchase of a 19.60% additional stake in Shougang Zhixin, subject to shareholder approval
items.title_original: Beijing Shougang to Boost Stake in Electrical Steel Unit for Up to 3 Billion Yuan
items.summary_zh: 首钢股份公告编号2026-047显示，公司拟以自有及自筹资金，按5.1269元/股受让首钢智新11家股东合计587,911,257股，占首钢智新总股本19.60%，预计总价不超过30.15亿元。若按拟议范围完成，首钢股份持股比例将由66.23%升至85.83%，仍为控股股东。九届八次董事会已于2026年10月15日通过，关联董事回避表决；交易构成关联交易、不构成重大资产重组，仍须2026年11月3日临时股东会批准，最终股份数量和价款还取决于实际签署协议。
items.summary_en: Announcement No. 2026-047 says Shougang Co. proposes to acquire 587,911,257 shares in Shougang Zhixin from 11 shareholders at CNY 5.1269 per share, representing 19.60% of the subsidiary, for up to CNY 3.015 billion using internal and raised funds. If completed as proposed, its stake would rise from 66.23% to 85.83%. The board approved the related-party transaction on 15 October 2026 with related directors abstaining; it is not a major asset restructuring but still requires approval at the extraordinary shareholders' meeting on 3 November. Final shares and consideration depend on executed agreements.
items.impact_zh: 这项交易首先是控股权和治理结构调整，不等同于新增30.15亿元电工钢产能，也不会直接改变出口关税、CBAM或产品认证。若获批并完成，少数股东权益下降、决策权进一步集中，可能有利于高端取向及无取向电工钢研发、产能升级和全产业链协同；但具体产量、产品组合、资本开支和客户供货变化仍须以后续项目及经营公告为准。业务团队应在11月3日后核对股东会结果及最终协议，再更新对客户的产能和供应判断。
items.impact_en: This is primarily a control and governance transaction, not CNY 3.015 billion of new electrical-steel capacity, and it does not directly change tariffs, CBAM treatment or product approvals. If approved and completed, greater control may support R&D, capacity upgrades and value-chain coordination in high-grade grain-oriented and non-oriented electrical steel, but output, product mix, capex and customer-supply effects require later operating disclosures. Recheck the shareholder vote and final agreements after 3 November before changing customer-facing capacity or supply assumptions.
items.status: 董事会通过／待股东会批准的关联交易

follow_up.action_zh: 2026年11月3日后核对临时股东会表决结果、实际签署的股份数量和最终价款；此后再跟踪工商/股东名册变更及具体电工钢产能升级公告。
follow_up.action_en: After 3 November 2026, verify the extraordinary shareholders' meeting result, executed share volume and final consideration; then monitor ownership registration and specific electrical-steel capacity-upgrade disclosures.

items.title_en: Ukraine cancels specified Chinese steel-fastener anti-dumping measures from 13 October
items.title_original: Ukraine has repealed anti-dumping measures on steel fasteners from China
items.summary_zh: 政府公报10月13日第215期第20页确认：委员会10月12日决定АД-609/2026/441-01，终止期终复审并撤销2020年对中国及2026年对马来西亚相关措施，自公告刊登当日生效。范围限所描述螺钉、螺栓及螺母：ex7318156890、ex7318158290、ex7318158890、ex7318159590、ex7318169290、ex7318169990，并有直径、头型和排除项条件；不是整个7318税目免税。
items.summary_en: Government Courier issue 215, page 20, publishes decision AD-609/2026/441-01 of 12 October, effective on publication on 13 October. It cancels the Chinese measure and its Malaysian extension. Coverage is limited to described screws, bolts and nuts under ex7318156890, ex7318158290, ex7318158890, ex7318159590, ex7318169290 and ex7318169990, subject to dimensions and exclusions.
items.impact_zh: 中国紧固件企业应按型号、直径和乌克兰10位编码让进口商核对适用性，更新撤销该项反倾销税后的报价。其他进口税、原产地、海关及制裁要求仍须分别满足；不得把撤销特定措施理解为全部税费为零。
items.impact_en: Check exact specifications and codes with the importer before repricing. Removal of this measure does not eliminate other taxes, origin requirements or sanctions controls.

items.title_zh: 巴西对中印预涂钢征最终反倾销税：农产品贸易不构成钢材豁免
items.title_en: Brazil imposes definitive anti-dumping duties on pre-painted steel from China and India; farm trade creates no steel exemption
items.title_original: 中国是巴西大豆与牛肉的最大买家，巴西为何还对中国钢材加关税？
items.summary_zh: 腾讯转载评论以中巴农产品、矿产和钢铁贸易反差为切入点。经巴西发展、工业、贸易和服务部（MDIC）官方案件页核验，GECEX第849号决议于2026年1月30日作出、2月2日刊登，正式对原产于中国和印度的预涂钢征收最终反倾销税，期限最长五年；该调查已经结束。文章关于大豆、牛肉和铁矿石采购的讨论属于作者观点，不能改变按产品、原产地和生产商适用的贸易救济措施，也不能据此推导中国钢材享有豁免。
items.summary_en: The syndicated commentary contrasts Brazil’s agricultural and mineral exports to China with its steel trade remedies. Brazil’s Ministry of Development, Industry, Trade and Services (MDIC) confirms that GECEX Resolution No. 849, dated 30 January 2026 and published on 2 February, imposed definitive anti-dumping duties for up to five years on pre-painted steel originating in China and India; the investigation is closed. The article’s discussion of soy, beef and iron-ore trade is the author’s opinion and does not alter product-, origin- or producer-specific trade-remedy treatment or create an exemption for Chinese steel.
items.impact_zh: 向巴西销售预涂钢的中国企业应把第849号决议视为已生效的正式措施，而非媒体所说的笼统“加关税”。报价和合同审查应由巴西进口商或贸易救济律师依据决议附件核对产品描述、NCM编码、生产商对应税额及排除项；本条未核验完整决议附件，因此不引用文章所称“超过60%”作为通用税率。农产品采购规模可用于宏观经贸研判，但不能替代个案应诉、复审或合规核对。
items.impact_en: Chinese exporters of pre-painted steel to Brazil should treat Resolution No. 849 as an effective formal trade-remedy measure, not a generic tariff increase. For quotations and contracts, the Brazilian importer or trade-remedy counsel should check the resolution annex for the exact product description, NCM code, producer-specific duty and exclusions. This review did not verify the full annex and therefore does not present the article’s “over 60%” claim as a general rate. Agricultural trade volumes are macro context, not a substitute for case-specific compliance or review procedures.

items.title_zh: 美国贸易代表办公室就欧盟CBAM及下游扩围征求意见，11月9日截止
items.title_en: USTR seeks comments on EU CBAM and downstream expansion; submissions due 9 November
items.title_original: USTR Seeks Business Input on the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism
items.summary_zh: 美国贸易代表办公室（USTR）以《联邦公报》通知（91 FR 64450，案卷USTR-2026-0661）征求欧盟CBAM对美国生产商、工人、直接和间接出口及美欧贸易的现有和潜在影响。问题覆盖合规成本、监管负担、欧盟市场准入、欧委会/理事会/欧洲议会下游扩围方案的影响、相对欧盟及第三国企业的竞争效果，以及是否应采取何种执法行动。通知说明扩围仍在三方谈判，尚未形成最终欧盟法律。意见须在2026年11月9日23:59（美国东部时间）前通过Regulations.gov提交，案卷号USTR-2026-0661。
items.summary_en: USTR's Federal Register notice (91 FR 64450; docket USTR-2026-0661) seeks evidence on the current and potential effects of EU CBAM on U.S. producers, workers, direct and indirect exports and U.S.-EU trade. It asks about compliance cost, regulatory burden, EU market access, the Commission/Council/Parliament downstream-extension proposals, competitive effects versus EU and third-country firms, and whether enforcement action may be appropriate. The extension remains in trilogue and is not final EU law. Comments are due through Regulations.gov by 11:59 p.m. ET on 9 November 2026.
items.impact_zh: 这不是美国已对欧盟或中国钢材采取新关税，而是正式取证程序。其问题设置表明美国可能把CBAM合规负担和下游扩围纳入对欧交涉或后续贸易执法评估。中国钢企虽非征询重点对象，也应让美国及欧盟客户分别量化CN产品、实际排放/默认值差额、核查成本、订单流失与供应链传导，避免把三方机构各自的扩围清单当成最终范围。
items.impact_en: This is a formal evidence-gathering process, not a new U.S. tariff on EU or Chinese steel. Its questions show that the United States may use CBAM compliance burdens and downstream expansion in EU engagement or later trade-enforcement assessment. Chinese mills should help U.S. and EU customers quantify CN products, actual-versus-default emissions, verification cost, lost orders and supply-chain pass-through, while not treating any institution's trilogue position as final scope.

items.title_zh: WTO成立欧盟CBAM争端专家组，中国保留第三方权利
items.title_en: WTO establishes panel on EU CBAM; China reserves third-party rights
items.title_original: WTO establishes CBAM dispute panel at Russia's request
items.summary_zh: WTO争端解决机构于2026年9月25日就俄罗斯诉欧盟案DS639成立专家组，审查欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）及俄罗斯所称欧盟排放交易体系下的出口补贴是否符合WTO义务。俄罗斯于2025年5月12日请求磋商、2026年7月10日请求设组；中国等成员保留第三方权利。专家组成立只是争端程序启动，尚无裁决。
items.summary_en: On 25 September 2026 the WTO DSB established a panel in DS639, Russia's challenge to the EU CBAM package and an alleged export subsidy under the EU ETS. Russia requested consultations on 12 May 2025 and a panel on 10 July 2026. China and other members reserved third-party rights. Panel establishment begins adjudication; no ruling has been issued.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：DS639不会自动暂停CBAM，欧盟现行申报、授权申报人和证书义务仍应照常准备。中国钢企可跟踪中国作为第三方提交的法律主张和后续报告，但当前不应据此延后碳数据、核证或客户合规安排。
items.impact_en: Assessment: DS639 does not automatically suspend CBAM. Existing EU reporting, authorised-declarant and certificate preparations should continue. Chinese steel exporters should monitor China's third-party submissions and later reports, but should not delay emissions-data, verification or customer-compliance work.

items.summary_zh: 欧委会2026/2538号实施条例于11月18日刊登欧盟官方公报，第1条将2025/1919号条例第1(2)条日本出口商名称从Tokyo Steel Co. Ltd.更正为Tokyo Steel Manufacturing Co., Ltd.；其6.9%单独反倾销税率和TARIC附加代码89MA均未变化。11月19日生效，追溯适用于2025年9月27日起。更正仅涉及企业名称，非埃及、日本、越南全体企业税率调整；原条例对印度调查终止状态亦未改变。
items.summary_en: Regulation (EU) 2026/2538, published on 18 November, corrects Tokyo Steel's exporter name to Tokyo Steel Manufacturing Co., Ltd. while retaining its 6.9% duty and TARIC code 89MA. Effective 19 November and applicable from 27 September 2025; no general rate change.
items.impact_zh: 欧盟进口商申报日本东京制铁热轧扁平材时应核对商业发票、出口商法定名称和89MA附加码，必要时检查历史申报名称。对中国热轧卷无自动关税优惠，也不意味着日本报价税负下降。
items.impact_en: EU importers should align exporter names on invoices and customs declarations with code 89MA, including historical entries where relevant. This creates no automatic advantage or tariff relief for Chinese hot-rolled steel.

items.summary_zh: 决定2026/2256于9月24日通过并生效，10月8日刊登公报，确定欧盟在EEA联合委员会的立场。附件是拟议的冰岛、挪威CBAM登记册及海关系统技术和财务安排，列支系统开发、运行与预算分摊；不能据此认定附件联合委员会决定已通过。

items.title_zh: 欧盟给予嘉善Carrey紧固件39.6%新出口商反倾销税率
items.title_en: EU grants Carrey Intelligent Manufacturing the 39.6% new-exporter fastener duty rate
items.title_original: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2089 of 18 September 2026 amending Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/191 imposing a definitive anti-dumping duty on imports of certain iron or steel fasteners originating in the People’s Republic of China following acceptance of a request for new exporting producer treatment
items.summary_zh: 欧盟实施条例(EU) 2026/2089确认Carrey Intelligent Manufacturing (Jiashan) Co., Ltd.满足新出口生产商待遇条件，并将其列入(EU) 2022/191附件，TARIC附加码88FN，适用未抽样合作企业39.6%的反倾销税率。该公司2022年成立、2023年获出口许可，并于2025年开始向欧盟出口涉案铁或钢制紧固件；条例自2026年9月22日起生效。
items.summary_en: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2089 confirms that Carrey Intelligent Manufacturing (Jiashan) Co., Ltd. meets the new-exporting-producer conditions and adds it to the annex to Regulation (EU) 2022/191 under TARIC additional code 88FN, applying the 39.6% rate for cooperating non-sampled producers. The company was founded in 2022, obtained an export licence in 2023 and began EU exports of the fasteners in 2025. The amendment took effect on 22 September 2026.
items.impact_zh: 事实与研判：39.6%是该公司凭88FN适用的企业特定待遇，不代表中国紧固件普遍降税；原措施中抽样企业税率22.1%至48.8%，未合作全国税率86.5%。出口和进口申报应准确使用生产商身份及附加码，并核对发票、产地和关联关系证据。
items.impact_en: Assessment: 39.6% is company-specific treatment linked to additional code 88FN, not a general reduction for Chinese fasteners. The original measure ranges from 22.1–48.8% for sampled producers and 86.5% country-wide for non-cooperators. Declarations should use the correct producer identity and code and retain invoice, origin and affiliation evidence.
items.coverage: Official EUR-Lex full text checked, including eligibility findings, company identity, duty rate, TARIC additional code and entry into force.

items.source_excerpt: The role of the UK Emissions Trading Scheme in UK decarbonisation and how the UK ETS Authority is developing the scheme. The UK Emissions Trading Scheme ( UK ETS ) currently covers the heavy industry, power and aviation sectors – approximately 25% of UK territorial emissions. The scheme incentivises investment in decarbonisation in line with climate targets across the UK, by setting a cap on emissions from these sectors and creating a carbon price. The UK ETS Authority (consisting of the UK, Scottish, and Welsh Governments, and the Northern Ireland Department of Agriculture, Environment and Rural Affairs) is working to expand and develop the scheme to incentivise additional sectors of the economy. This sets out: the policy aims of the UK ETS how it works the work the UK ETS Authority is doing to develop it We will update the content as further policy updates are published. It rescinded for 46 Appendix II firms after withdrawals, and for KG Dongbu due to no reviewable suspended entries. Scope is governed by the written order. items.title_en: EU and UK conclude ETS-linking talks with 2028 target; EU CBAM exemption still requires a legal act
items.title_original: Negotiations finalised to link EU and UK Emissions Trading Systems
items.summary_zh: 欧委会气候行动总司11月20日确认欧英完成ETS互联协议谈判，目标2028年1月1日开始适用，尚待双方完成批准及生效程序。欧委会税务与海关总司的配套说明指出，欧盟拟依CBAM条例第2条第11款以授权法案修订附件III，完成法律步骤后才可将英国列入并豁免英国原产货物。英国另在11月23日公布原产地豁免草案，拟在获御准后追溯适用于2027年1月1日起合格的欧盟、欧洲经济区及瑞士原产货物。两套制度的实施步骤和实际生效日分别判断。
items.summary_en: DG CLIMA confirmed on 20 November that the EU and UK concluded ETS-linking negotiations, targeting 1 January 2028 subject to ratification and entry into force. DG TAXUD says a delegated act under Article 2(11) must amend Annex III before UK-origin goods can be exempted from EU CBAM. The UK separately published its 23 November origin-exemption draft, with intended retrospective effect for qualifying EU, EEA and Swiss goods imported from 1 January 2027 after Royal Assent.
items.impact_zh: 2027年中国钢材经英国转运至欧盟时，继续按适用的非优惠原产地、报关税号和时间核算欧盟CBAM。英欧双向流转订单分别确认进口端规则，合同可约定正式豁免文件生效后的成本调整。
items.impact_en: For 2027 Chinese steel routed through the UK into the EU, apply the relevant non-preferential origin, customs classification and entry timing. Assess each direction of EU–UK trade independently and agree how contracts will reconcile any legally effective future exemption.

items.source_excerpt: The role of the UK Emissions Trading Scheme in UK decarbonisation and how the UK ETS Authority is developing the scheme. The UK Emissions Trading Scheme ( UK ETS ) currently covers the heavy industry, power and aviation sectors – approximately 25% of UK territorial emissions. The scheme incentivises investment in decarbonisation in line with climate targets across the UK, by setting a cap on emissions from these sectors and creating a carbon price. The UK ETS Authority (consisting of the UK, Scottish, and Welsh Governments, and the Northern Ireland Department of Agriculture, Environment and Rural Affairs) is working to expand and develop the scheme to incentivise additional sectors of the economy. This sets out: the policy aims of the UK ETS how it works the work the UK ETS Authority is doing to develop it We will update the content as further policy updates are published. items.title_en: UK imposes definitive anti-dumping duties on South Korean hot-rolled plate up to 2,100 mm
items.title_original: New measure imposed on hot-rolled steel plate from South Korea
items.summary_zh: 英国贸易救济署2026年11月19日官方新闻确认，贸易大臣决定对韩国原产热轧中厚板实施反倾销措施。英国TRA曾建议覆盖更宽产品，但政府因经济利益测试及英国境内宽于2100毫米产品缺乏持续生产，最终仅对宽度不超过2100毫米的产品征税，税率7.04%至23.07%。本次新闻稿未逐一列出各企业税率及所有税号，报关仍须依2026/32正式通知。
items.summary_en: UK TRA news dated 19 Nov confirms definitive AD measures of 7.04–23.07% only on Korean hot-rolled plate up to 2,100 mm, narrowed from the investigated scope on economic-interest grounds.
items.impact_zh: 韩国宽度≤2100毫米中厚板进入英国的到岸成本可能提高，宽度超过2100毫米的产品不能套用该税率。中国中厚板的潜在替代机会须另核英国对华措施、配额及认证；按宽度、生产企业和清关税号比较报价。
items.impact_en: Korean plate up to 2,100 mm faces higher UK costs. Chinese substitutes require separate origin-specific duties, quotas and qualification checks.
items.source_excerpt: Following a TRA investigation, the Secretary of State has decided to apply a new anti-dumping measure on imports of hot-rolled steel plate from South Korea. The Secretary of State has applied a new anti-dumping measure on imports of hot-rolled steel plate from South Korea, following an investigation by the TRA. The TRA determined that hot-rolled steel plate from South Korea has been or is being dumped into the UK and that this has caused or is causing injury to the UK production industry. The TRA was therefore required to recommend a measure on the full scope of hot-rolled steel plate from South Korea. In all investigations, the TRA is required to conduct an Economic Interest Test (EIT), which considers whether the imposition of a measure would be in the economic interest of the UK. In this investigation, the TRA assessed that the EIT was met for applying definitive measures to hot-rolled plate with a width lower than 2,500mm, but was not met for applying a measure to the full scope o…

items.title_original: Steel Grating From China; Determinations
items.summary_zh: 【官方裁定】美国国际贸易委员会2026年11月4日宣布，对原产中国的Certain Steel Grating开展第三次快速日落复审，认定撤销现行反倾销和反补贴命令很可能在可预见期间造成实质损害继续或再现，因此两项命令继续有效。案件编号701-TA-465及731-TA-1161。11月18日《联邦公报》出现相应裁定公告，为程序性发布，并非11月18日新增税率。USITC公告未提供个别企业税率，不能据此推断税率变化。
items.summary_en: On 4 Nov 2026 the USITC issued affirmative expedited third sunset review determinations (701-TA-465 and 731-TA-1161), keeping the existing AD/CVD orders on certain steel grating from China in place. The 18 Nov Federal Register notice is a procedural publication, not a new rate.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】对美国钢格板业务，贸易救济障碍未解除；报价应继续核对美国商务部当前命令、企业适用现金保证金及产品范围。此次日落复审不应扩展解释为普通热轧卷或全部钢材的新增税。
items.impact_en: Existing US AD/CVD barriers on Chinese steel grating remain; verify the current Commerce rates and product scope before quoting. No new rate is established by the ITC notice.

items.title_en: China and EU co-chair coalition on compliance carbon markets as COP31 declaration and working groups launch
items.title_original: Open Coalition on Compliance Carbon Markets adopts COP31 Declaration and launches its Working Groups to advance carbon pricing for emission cuts and investment
items.summary_zh: 【官方事实】欧委会气候行动总司2026年11月16日公告：合规碳市场开放联盟(OCCCM)在土耳其安塔利亚COP31会议通过宣言、启动工作组并确定2027年工作重点。巴西担任主席，中国与欧盟共同担任副主席；截至11月16日有13个成员和34个观察员。联盟致力于碳定价制度合作、相互理解及长期互操作性；其宣言不是欧盟CBAM抵扣、ETS互认或国际碳信用资格的直接实施条例。
items.summary_en: DG CLIMA confirms the OCCCM adopted its COP31 Declaration on 16 Nov 2026 and launched working groups. Brazil chairs, China and the EU co-chair; 13 members and 34 observers. This is a cooperation initiative, not a binding CBAM credit or ETS mutual-recognition rule.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】中欧在碳市场合作机制共同担任领导角色，可能改善未来排放数据、碳定价和信用标准的政策对话环境，但不能据此宣布中国碳配额价格可直接抵扣欧盟CBAM。钢铁出口企业仍须按照2026/2498等现行法规核算净已付碳价和提供证据。建议关注工作组2027年议题，特别是碳信用质量与跨境市场衔接。
items.impact_en: Potential longer-term policy dialogue on carbon-market interoperability; no automatic CBAM credit or ETS recognition. Steel exporters should follow binding CBAM rules and monitor 2027 workstreams.

items.title_en: UK CBAM registration guidance links to origin and recordkeeping updates
items.title_original: Check if you’ll need to register for Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)
items.summary_zh: HMRC注册汇总页标注最近更新为2026年11月10日。当前版本链接到11月23日更新的门槛排除和留档指引，分别解释原产地豁免草案下的计入规则与仍需保存的证据。英国CBAM自2027年1月1日起实施并开始留档，2028年1月1日开放注册。英国注册门槛为5万英镑。按到达税点的范围内货物计，预计未来30天内达到或超过门槛，或每月月初回看过去12个月达到或超过门槛，均触发注册义务。2027年触发注册义务者最迟于2028年1月31日注册。欧盟、欧洲经济区和瑞士原产货物排除安排目前仍为草案。
items.summary_en: HMRC’s registration collection still carries a 10 November 2026 update date, while its live links include the 23 November threshold and recordkeeping guidance. UK CBAM and recordkeeping start on 1 January 2027; registration opens on 1 January 2028. The £50,000 threshold uses a forward 30-day test and a monthly 12-month lookback. Importers becoming liable in 2027 have until 31 January 2028 to register. The EU, EEA and Swiss origin exclusion remains draft legislation.
items.impact_zh: 输英热卷、冷卷及涂镀产品先以英国商品编码判断覆盖，请进口商建立逐单台账，保存货值、净重及原产地证据，并按落入税点的时间测试门槛。中国原产钢材经欧洲转运仍应按对应原产地纳入判断；报价和留档应落实到合同约定的进口主体。
items.impact_en: Check UK commodity codes for HRC, CRC and coated sheet. Confirm the liable importer and record value, net mass, origin evidence and tax-point dates per entry. Use the actual origin for threshold calculations, including for Chinese steel routed through Europe.
items.source_excerpt: Find out if you need to register for CBAM when you import selected CBAM goods from the aluminium, cement, fertiliser, hydrogen, iron and steel sectors from 1 January 2027.

items.title_en: UK ETS free allocation guidance removes obsolete 2025 baseline data collection materials
items.title_original: UK ETS technical guidance: Free Allocation Regulation (FAR)
items.summary_zh: 【事实】英国能源安全与净零部（DESNZ）于2026年11月3日更新UK ETS免费配额规则（FAR）技术指南。官方更新日志明确，本次删除了不再适用的2025年基准数据收集相关指导。页面继续提供UKETS11（装置级免费配额计算）、UKETS13（监测报告）、UKETS14（核验）、UKETS15（跨界热流）、UKETS16A（停产）、UKETS17（废气与工艺排放）及UKETS18（行业专门指导）等材料。更新日志未宣布11月3日新增碳价、改变钢材进口税率或即时改变英国CBAM适用范围。
items.summary_en: On 3 November 2026 DESNZ removed guidance relating to the obsolete 2025 baseline data collection from the UK ETS Free Allocation Regulation technical-guidance page. The remaining documents cover installation-level allocation, monitoring, verification, heat flows, cessation, waste gases and sector benchmarks. The update log does not announce a new UK carbon price, steel import tariff or CBAM product scope.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】主要影响英国境内UK ETS受管制钢铁及相关装置的免费配额申请材料管理，对中国钢材直接出口英国的CBAM义务并非一项新税。若客户在英国有轧制、镀锌或其他受UK ETS覆盖装置，应检查其内部引用的2025基准收集模板是否已过期；出口报价不应因网页更新就增加所谓新碳税。
items.impact_en: The change primarily concerns UK ETS installation operators' allocation documentation, not a new UK CBAM charge on imported steel. UK manufacturing partners should check for outdated 2025 baseline forms; exporters should not price in an invented new levy.

items.source_excerpt: Technical guidance to assist UK ETS installation operators in complying with the requirements that relate to the Free Allocation Regulation (FAR). items.summary_zh: 【事实】英国HMRC官方政策汇总的更新记录明确：11月2日修订集中在“如何计算已付碳价抵扣”（How to calculate CPR）图13的计算说明。政策汇总维持2027年1月1日启动英国CBAM、覆盖指定铝、水泥、化肥、氢及钢铁商品；CBAM负担原则上为嵌入直接排放乘适用英国CBAM税率，再扣除符合条件且有证据的已付碳价抵扣。申报可按规定使用经核验实际排放数据或英国政府默认值。11月2日更新不是宣布新增商品税号、税率或提前注册。
items.summary_en: HMRC's 2 November 2026 change log identifies an update to Figure 13 in the Carbon Price Relief calculation section. The policy summary retains UK CBAM commencement on 1 January 2027 for specified goods in aluminium, cement, fertiliser, hydrogen and iron and steel. The charge is based on embedded direct emissions times the CBAM rate, less eligible evidenced CPR; verified actual emissions or government defaults may be used. This revision does not itself announce new scope, rates or earlier registration.

items.impact_en: Model gross UK CBAM exposure separately from verified qualifying carbon-price relief. Do not assume full credit for Chinese carbon-market costs without checking eligibility and documentation. This entry records the policy-summary version change, not a separate new tax.

items.summary_zh: 英国UK ETS主管机构于2026年10月30日更新装置运营商免费配额表，调整源于活动水平变化。表格覆盖2021—2026配额期；2026年按现有配额期延长一年处理。首次在2026年获得免费配额、或因发电设施规则变化而新增合格子装置的运营商，使用已核证的2023年活动数据确定2026年配额。已加入2026—2030年医院及小排放设施或超小排放设施名单的原免费配额接收者，2026年不再获得免费配额。部分2026年Standard (A)和NER (B)栏故意留空、只列Total (C)，表示其总量仍可能因2025年活动水平变化程序调整。
items.summary_en: On 30 October 2026 the UK ETS Authority updated the installation allocation table for activity-level changes. The table covers 2021–2026, with 2026 treated as an extension of the current period. Verified 2023 activity data determine 2026 allocations for first-time recipients and newly eligible sub-installations. Operators moving to the 2026–2030 Hospital and Small Emitter or Ultra-Small Emitter lists receive no free allocation in 2026. Blank Standard (A) and NER (B) cells with only Total (C) indicate figures still under review through the 2025 activity-level-change process.
items.impact_zh: 这不是英国CBAM税率表，也不直接给出中国钢材的进口税额；它反映英国同类装置获得的免费配额基础，相关变化可能影响英国生产者的有效碳成本和后续CBAM行业税率环境。对英出口企业应继续依据正式CBAM行业税率、默认值或核证实际排放报价，不能从单个英国装置的免费配额反推进口税负。英国客户和竞争分析可关注钢铁装置2026年Total (C)及后续复核结果。
items.impact_en: This is not a UK CBAM rate table and does not determine a Chinese shipment's tax. It records free allocation for UK installations and may affect domestic effective carbon costs and the broader CBAM rate environment. Exporters should use official sector rates, defaults or verified actual emissions rather than infer import tax from an individual installation's allocation.

items.title_zh: LME上线以上期所热轧卷板结算价为基准的美元现金结算合约
items.title_en: LME launches USD cash-settled Shanghai hot-rolled coil contract linked to SHFE settlement prices
items.title_original: “LME上海热轧卷板合约”正式上市交易 “上海价格”国际应用场景进一步扩展
items.summary_zh: 上海国际能源交易中心10月29日披露，伦敦金属交易所（LME）已于10月27日上线以上海期货交易所热轧卷板期货结算价为基准的合约。合约代码HS，每手10吨，以美元／吨报价并采用现金结算，提供连续12个月的月度合约；到期结算价以上期所热轧卷板期货次月到期合约在LME合约到期日的结算价为基础，按中国外汇交易中心公布的美元兑人民币中间价换算。LME提供的数据显示，上市首日截至伦敦时间18:00，LMEselect成交880手，叠加办公室交易后当日清算总成交量2513手。
items.summary_en: The Shanghai International Energy Exchange reported on 29 October that the London Metal Exchange launched a contract on 27 October using the Shanghai Futures Exchange hot-rolled coil futures settlement price as its reference. Contract HS is quoted in USD per tonne, cash settled, sized at 10 tonnes per lot and offered in 12 consecutive monthly maturities. Its final settlement is based on the SHFE HRC contract expiring in the following month on the LME expiry date, converted using the CFETS USD/CNY central parity rate. LME data cited by the official release showed 880 lots traded on LMEselect and 2,513 lots cleared in total by 18:00 London time on launch day.
items.impact_zh: 这是交易和风险管理工具上线，不是钢材关税、出口政策或现货指导价。以美元报价中国热卷的钢厂和贸易商可评估其用于订单定价参考或跨市场套保，但现金结算意味着它不能替代实物交割安排，也不能消除人民币／美元换算、上期所与出口现货之间的基差风险。实际使用前应核对经纪商接入、保证金、流动性、结算汇率时点和企业内部套保授权，先以小规模头寸验证套保相关性。
items.impact_en: This is a new trading and risk-management instrument, not a steel tariff, export policy or official spot-price directive. Mills and traders quoting Chinese HRC in US dollars may assess it as a pricing reference or cross-market hedge, but cash settlement does not replace physical-delivery arrangements or remove FX and SHFE-versus-export-spot basis risk. Before use, firms should check broker access, margin, liquidity, the FX conversion timing and internal hedge mandates, and validate hedge correlation with small positions.

items.title_original: Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM): a consultation on sectoral scope expansion to include refinery products
items.summary_zh: 英国财政部与税务海关总署发布开放咨询，拟在技术可行后尽快把部分炼油产品纳入英国CBAM；这不是已生效扩围，实施时间尚未确定。文件建议初期覆盖15个8位商品编码下的汽油、柴油、航空煤油和煤油：2710 1225、2710 1231、2710 1241、2710 1245、2710 1249、2710 1250、2710 1270、2710 1290、2710 1921、2710 1925、2710 1929、2710 1944、2710 1946、2710 1947、2710 1948；同时征询是否初期排除乙醇和FAME等低碳燃料，并按质量平衡扣除混合燃料中的低碳部分。拟议方法包括装置级统一强度、装置级重新分配以及生产过程级核算；氢可能作为前体计入。炼油产品默认值、原产炼厂/国家证明、行业税率及碳价减免仍待决定。咨询于2027年1月20日23:59截止。
items.summary_en: HM Treasury and HMRC opened a consultation on adding a subset of refinery products to UK CBAM as soon as feasible; no implementation date has been set and the scope expansion is not yet law. The proposal tests 15 eight-digit commodity codes covering petrol, diesel, jet fuel and kerosene: 2710 1225, 2710 1231, 2710 1241, 2710 1245, 2710 1249, 2710 1250, 2710 1270, 2710 1290, 2710 1921, 2710 1925, 2710 1929, 2710 1944, 2710 1946, 2710 1947 and 2710 1948. It asks whether neat low-carbon fuels such as ethanol and FAME should initially be excluded, with mass-balance treatment for blends. Installation-level and process-level emissions methods, hydrogen as a precursor, defaults, origin evidence, a refining-sector rate and carbon-price relief remain under consultation. Responses close at 11:59pm on 20 January 2027.
items.impact_zh: 本咨询不改变2027年起已覆盖钢铁的英国CBAM范围、钢铁税率或申报义务；对中国钢企的直接合规工作仍应按现行钢铁规则推进。间接影响可能来自英国物流、燃料和供应链成本，炼油方法也可能成为未来其他行业扩围的参考。集团如同时向英国出口成品油、经营贸易/仓储或掌握炼厂排放与原产追溯数据，应在2027年1月20日23:59前提交对商品编码、混合燃料质量平衡、炼厂追溯、默认值和成本传导的证据；不能据咨询稿预估确定税额。
items.impact_en: The consultation does not change the existing UK CBAM scope, rate or compliance duties for iron and steel from 2027. Steel exporters should continue preparing under the enacted steel rules. Indirect effects may arise through UK fuel, logistics and supply-chain costs, and the refinery methodology may inform later scope expansion. Groups that also export refined fuels, trade or store them, or hold refinery emissions/origin data should submit evidence on codes, blend mass balance, refinery traceability, defaults and cost pass-through by 11:59pm on 20 January 2027. Do not price a definite charge from this consultation.
items.source_excerpt: This consultation seeks views on the feasibility and impacts of CBAM sectoral scope expansion to refinery products. At Budget 2025, the government confirmed that it is considering the impacts and feasibility of including refinery products in CBAM in future. This consultation is the next stage of that ongoing assessment. This consultation is being undertaken jointly by His Majesty’s Revenue & Customs (HMRC) and His Majesty’s Treasury (HMT). The government invites views from interested parties, including the importers and their agents, other businesses, individuals, tax advisers, trade and professional bodies and other interested parties, including those overseas. Responses to the response form will be shared between HMRC and HMT. We use some essential cookies to make this website work. items.title_en: UK ETS overview updates the 2027 auction reserve price to £29.01
items.title_original: UK Emissions Trading Scheme (UK ETS): policy overview
items.summary_zh: 10月21日更新的UK ETS官方总览将2027年拍卖保留价列为£29.01/配额，相比2026年£28上调。该保留价是拍卖制度参数；市场另有成本控制机制和供给安排。UK ETS与英国CBAM存在碳价联系，但它们不是同一种义务或同一个价格。
items.summary_en: The 21 October policy overview sets the 2027 auction reserve price at £29.01 per allowance, compared with £28 in 2026. It is an auction parameter within the UK ETS, distinct from the cost containment and supply arrangements and from UK CBAM liability.
items.impact_zh: 英国生产基地应在合规采购和预算中使用对应年度参数。中国出口商不能把£29.01直接当作CBAM钢铁行业税率，更不能当作每吨钢材税额。
items.impact_en: Use the applicable year’s parameters for UK installation budgeting. Do not substitute the auction reserve price for the steel-sector CBAM rate or a per-tonne steel tax.
items.source_excerpt: The role of the UK Emissions Trading Scheme in UK decarbonisation and how the UK ETS Authority is developing the scheme. The UK Emissions Trading Scheme ( UK ETS ) currently covers the heavy industry, power and aviation sectors – approximately 25% of UK territorial emissions. The scheme incentivises investment in decarbonisation in line with climate targets across the UK, by setting a cap on emissions from these sectors and creating a carbon price. The UK ETS Authority (consisting of the UK, Scottish, and Welsh Governments, and the Northern Ireland Department of Agriculture, Environment and Rural Affairs) is working to expand and develop the scheme to incentivise additional sectors of the economy. This sets out: the policy aims of the UK ETS how it works the work the UK ETS Authority is doing to develop it We will update the content as further policy updates are published. Published an update outlining that expansion of the UK ETS to waste incineration will not take place in 2028 as o…

items.title_original: Resolución No. 00695 de 16 de octubre de 2026 - investigación antidumping sobre perfiles de hierro o acero en L y U
items.summary_zh: 【事实】哥伦比亚贸易工业旅游部第695号决议于2026年10月16日签署、10月19日登载官方公报第53663期，针对来自中国和土耳其、仅经热轧或热挤压、截面高度不超过101.60毫米的L形和U形合金及非合金钢型材立案，涉及7216100000、7216210000、7216310000、7216400000、7228700000。申请方DIACO和Ternium主张中国155%、土耳其28%倾销幅度；调查机关在立案阶段计算的初步倾销幅度分别为中国44.90%、土耳其27.94%，均不是已经征收的反倾销税率。10月23日参与公告报道提供30个工作日意见窗口，但未将其推算成未经确认的日历截止日。
items.summary_en: Resolution 695 of 16 October, published 19 October 2026, opened an investigation into specified hot-rolled/extruded L and U steel sections from China and Türkiye, up to 101.60 mm in height, under five tariff headings. Petitioners alleged 155%/28%; the authority's initiation-stage indicative dumping margins were 44.90%/27.94%, not imposed duties.

items.title_zh: 欧盟发布2027年ETS1修订拍卖日历及首份ETS2拍卖日历
items.title_en: EU publishes revised 2027 ETS1 and initial ETS2 auction calendars
items.title_original: Revised 2027 EU ETS1 and initial 2027 EU ETS2 auction calendars published
items.summary_zh: 欧委会10月1日确认EEX已发布2027年ETS1修订拍卖日历和首份ETS2拍卖日历。ETS1增加2500万份划拨希腊脱碳基金的配额；当前ETS2拍卖量含1.4亿份社会气候基金配额，年内还将因成员国立法进展调整。共同拍卖平台的ETS1和ETS2拍卖分别于2027年1月7日和1月18日开始。
items.summary_en: On 1 October the Commission confirmed EEX's revised 2027 ETS1 and first ETS2 auction calendars. ETS1 adds 25 million allowances for the Greek Decarbonisation Fund; the current ETS2 volume includes 140 million allowances for the Social Climate Fund and will be adjusted as national legislation progresses. Auctions start on 7 and 18 January 2027 respectively.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪判断：这是配额拍卖供应安排，不是钢铁CBAM证书价格、免费分配或清缴规则的调整。可作为2027年欧盟碳价和客户采购预算的市场信息跟踪，不应直接换算为钢材CBAM税额。
items.impact_en: Assessment: this concerns allowance auction supply, not a change to steel CBAM certificate pricing, free allocation or surrender rules. Use it as a 2027 carbon-market input, not as a direct steel CBAM charge.
items.source_excerpt: Yesterday, the European Energy Exchange (EEX) published the revised 2027 EU ETS1 and the new 2027 EU ETS2 auction calendars. The published calendar for ETS1 allowances reflects the addition of 25 million allowances allocated to the Greek Decarbonisation Fund pursuant to Article 10a(9) of the ETS Directive . The first published calendar for ETS2 allowances reflects the early auctioning of 2028 volumes in accordance with Article 8(5) of the Auctioning Regulation . Pursuant to Article 13(7) of the Auctioning Regulation, the current auction volume for 2027 includes 140 000 000 allowances allocated to the Social Climate Fund and allowances allocated to Member States that have implemented in their national legislation the obligation of regulated entities to surrender allowances and the penalties for excess emissions. Several Members States are finalising or have finalised the implementation of the surrender obligation and the penalties in their national legislation after the determination o…

items.title_en: EU consultation on first-quarter operation of its steel regulation has closed
items.title_original: Monitoring the functioning of the new EU Steel Regulation
items.summary_zh: 欧委会咨询页面确认，针对条例(EU) 2026/1384首季运行情况的咨询于9月28日开放，10月11日23:59（中欧夏令时）截止。参与者原可按附录I产品类别分别回复。当前页面显示已关闭，截至核验时未公布反馈汇总、评估结果或配额、税率调整。
items.summary_en: The Commission confirms the first-quarter monitoring consultation for Regulation (EU) 2026/1384 opened on 28 September and closed on 11 October at 23:59 CEST. The page offers no response summary or quota or rate change.
items.impact_zh: 按正式配额安排和有效税率继续执行赴欧订单。进口商可按配额类别留存清关量、延误和超配额成本资料，用于后续评估。
items.impact_en: Use current quotas and duties on EU orders. Retain records of customs volumes, delays and out-of-quota costs by category for future monitoring.
items.source_excerpt: A targeted consultation seeking stakeholders' feedback on the implementation of the new EU Steel Regulation Steel producers (upstream), steel users (downstream), business associations, third country governments and exporters, and any other interested stakeholders. EU Regulation 2026/1384 establishes a tariff rate quota system to protect the Union steel market from negative trade-related effects of global overcapacity. Considering the end of the first quarter of application of the Regulation and in order to establish a strong and targeted monitoring mechanism enabling an ongoing assessment of the implementation and functioning of the Regulation, the Commission is launching this targeted consultation which aims to gather detailed information on the immediate impact on all industry potentially affected, including steel producers (upstream), steel users (downstream), business associations, third country governments and exporters, and any other interested stakeholders.

items.title_zh: EU ETS：2025合规表已发布，生铁／钢生产记录完成限定范围核验
items.title_en: EU ETS: 2025 compliance workbook published; scoped iron/steel check completed
items.title_original: EU ETS – Publication of surrender and compliance data
items.summary_zh: 官方登记册于10月5日列出2025合规表。本轮读取XLSX的Export Worksheet及activity codes工作表，筛选COMPLIANCE_STATUS_LATEST_YEAR=2025、MAIN_ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE为5或24（生铁或钢生产），得到180条记录：合规代码A为175条、B为4条、C为1条。计数仅覆盖上述活动与年份筛选，不代表整个钢铁价值链；TOTAL_VERIFIED_EMISSIONS与TOTAL_SURRENDERED_ALLOWANCES字段不在本条中作为2025年度总量使用。代码含义与具体异常原因仍需结合EUTL说明和主管机关记录核实。
items.summary_en: The Registry listed the 2025 workbook on 5 October. Reading both worksheets and filtering latest compliance year=2025 and main activity code 5 or 24 (pig iron or steel) yields 180 records: code A 175, B 4, C 1. This is a scoped record count, not a whole steel value-chain total. Total emissions/surrender fields are not treated as annual 2025 totals. Code meanings and case-specific causes require EUTL guidance and authority records.
items.impact_zh: 这份表可支持核对欧盟钢铁装置的合规记录；不能据代码分布推导中国钢材CBAM税额、装置年度排放强度或行业违法比例。对合作装置逐一核对登记册标识、年份和官方解释，再判断是否需要补充尽调。
items.impact_en: Use the workbook to check EU installation records. Code counts do not establish Chinese steel CBAM charges, annual emissions intensity or an industry breach rate. Verify installation IDs, years and official interpretations before further due diligence.
items.source_excerpt: The Commission will publish the available surrender and compliance data 2025 on October 6, 2026, at the latest.
items.follow_up: 已完成发布入口和代码5/24、最新合规年份2025的限定计数核验；后续如需年度排放或装置风险结论，另查年度核验排放表、EUTL代码解释及主管机关记录。
items.coverage: 2026-10-09已读9月25日通知、登记册报告列表和10月5日官方XLSX两工作表；核对字段、活动代码及上述180条记录的代码分布，未核验各装置异常原因，未计算行业年度排放或清缴总量。

items.title_zh: 欧委会2025贸易救济报告：32项新调查，钢铁仍是重点领域
items.title_en: EU 2025 trade defence report: 32 new investigations, steel remains a focus
items.title_original: Demand for trade defence action, EU commitment to tackle unfair trade remain strong in 2025
items.summary_zh: 欧委会9月18日新闻称，9月17日通过的年度报告记录2025年启动32项调查、实施26项最终措施；年末有效措施232项，其中220项为最终措施。钢铁和化工的贸易救济需求突出，3案追溯实施措施；进口监测工作组跟踪因第三国高关税而转向欧盟的贸易。
items.summary_en: The Commission's news reports 32 investigations opened and 26 definitive measures imposed in 2025, with 232 measures in force at year-end, 220 definitive. Iron and steel remain prominent. Three cases involved retroactivity, and surveillance monitors trade diversion.
items.impact_zh: 这是年度执法回顾，未给中国钢材统一新增税率。出口团队应按具体产品和企业跟踪调查，保留价格、生产商及原产地资料，关注进口登记和追溯风险。
items.impact_en: This annual review creates no uniform new steel duty. Track product- and producer-specific cases and preserve pricing and origin evidence, including registration and retroactivity risks.
items.source_excerpt: News article 18 September 2026 Demand for trade defence action, EU commitment to tackle unfair trade remain strong in 2025 Strong demand for trade defence action continued in 2025, with the European Commission again opening an above-average number of investigations, reveals a new report. 2 min read

items.summary_zh: 9月4日通知解释，德国两处2022年关停发电设施对应2024年度拟注销量为零。因2025年TNAC在MSR缓冲区，MSR已移除关停造成的2024年剩余配额，无需额外国别注销；2025年对2023年度的注销情况不同。

items.impact_zh: 不能仅凭标题认定德国本轮额外收紧供给。EUA分析应区分MSR吸收与国家注销，避免重复计算供给减少。
items.impact_en: Do not infer extra supply tightening from the headline. Separate MSR absorption from national cancellation.

items.title_en: Dalian iron ore I2701 closes at CNY 659.5 per tonne on 27 November
items.title_original: Iron Ore Futures Fall Below CNY 660 on Weak Chinese Demand
items.summary_zh: Trading Economics 11月27日称铁矿石期价跌破660元/吨。上海有色网与Mysteel当日行情均显示，大连商品交易所主力I2701日盘收于659.5元/吨，较前一交易日结算价跌0.30%。路透早盘报道的654元/吨对应01:55 GMT。钢厂需求走弱及年末矿山可能增加发货，是行情报道及机构对走势的解释。
items.summary_en: Trading Economics reported a move below CNY 660/t. SMM and Mysteel both show the most-traded Dalian I2701 contract closing at CNY 659.5/t on 27 November, 0.30% below the previous settlement. Reuters reported CNY 654/t at 01:55 GMT. Soft demand and possible higher year-end shipments are market assessments.

items.title_zh: 印度证监会审视塔塔钢铁与APL Apollo交易，要约详细公告延至12月8日
items.title_en: SEBI examines Tata Steel–APL Apollo deal and extends the detailed open-offer statement deadline
items.title_original: SEBI Chairman says Examining Tata Steel – APL Apollo deal to safeguard minority shareholder rights - CNBC TV18
items.summary_zh: 印度国家证券交易所11月27日披露，要约管理人Kotak称印度证监会同意将塔塔钢铁向APL Apollo股东的详细要约公告由12月1日延至12月8日。向SEBI提交要约函草案仍为12月8日。CNBC TV18报道SEBI主席称正从中小股东保护角度审视该交易。塔塔钢铁11月23日公告称，APL Apollo拟承接170万吨/年钢管及80万吨/年表面涂镀卷产能。交易交割后合计750万吨/年为企业估算，2035年1550万吨/年为远期目标。
items.summary_en: A 27 November NSE filing says SEBI extended the publication deadline for Tata Steel’s detailed APL Apollo open-offer statement from 1 to 8 December; the draft offer letter is still due 8 December. CNBC TV18 reports that SEBI is examining minority shareholder interests. Tata Steel announced a transfer of 1.7 Mt/year of tube and 0.8 Mt/year of surface-coated coil capacity to APL Apollo, with 7.5 Mt/year projected at completion and a 15.5 Mt/year target by 2035.
items.impact_zh: 跟踪印度钢管、涂镀和彩涂板的后续交割、扩产和采购安排。需要更新竞争报价时，按已投产产线和实际出口报价比价。12月8日节点由交易方办理。
items.impact_en: Track completion, commissioning and procurement changes for Indian steel tubes and coated products. Base competitive pricing on operating lines and actual offers. The 8 December filings are for the parties to the transaction.

items.title_zh: 荷兰统计局估算上半年进口CBAM成本1.213亿欧元，钢铁占9330万欧元
items.title_en: Statistics Netherlands estimates H1 CBAM costs at EUR 121.3 million, including EUR 93.3 million for iron and steel
items.title_original: 2026年上半年荷兰CBAM成本达1.213亿欧元 - 新闻和统计
items.summary_zh: 荷兰统计局CBS于11月26日公布初步估算：2026年上半年，研究涵盖的荷兰进口企业CBAM成本估计为1.213亿欧元，其中钢铁类别9330万欧元。中国原产货物在全部被估算CBAM类别中占29.2%，约3540万欧元。CBS将企业数据与欧盟海关数据结合，并采用荷兰排放管理局的CBAM计算工具。国别与品类是不同拆分口径，以上金额均按研究估算理解。
items.summary_en: Statistics Netherlands estimates provisional H1 2026 CBAM costs for the covered Dutch importers at EUR 121.3 million, of which iron and steel accounted for EUR 93.3 million. Chinese-origin goods accounted for about EUR 35.4 million across all CBAM categories. CBS combined business and customs data and used the Dutch Emissions Authority's calculator.
items.impact_zh: 荷兰进口商可用该估算了解行业成本敞口。板坯、热卷、冷轧及镀层板的合同分摊仍按对应税号、核查排放和合同证价口径单独测算，保留实际排放和适用默认值两种情景供客户比价。
items.impact_en: Use the estimate as market context. Base slab and flat steel contract calculations on the relevant codes, verified emissions and agreed certificate pricing, with a separate default-value scenario where applicable.

items.title_zh: 欧盟拟于年底公布废料出口首份准许清单，美欧301争议仍处征求意见阶段
items.title_en: EU targets year-end for its first waste export list as proposed US Section 301 duties remain under consultation
items.title_original: New US tariffs: Brussels protests, but not at the rate
items.summary_zh: 欧盟《废物运输条例》(EU) 2024/1157第41条第3款原定2026年11月21日前通过首批准许清单，条文列有无人申请或无合格国家的例外。欧委会11月20日说明仍将年底作为公布目标，当前可查为9月18日草案。自2027年5月21日起，欧盟向不适用经合组织决定的国家出口受管非危险废物用于回收，须满足目的地、废物代码及获许可设施等条件。草案中印尼和越南条目未列B1010钢铁废料。11月21日开始适用的禁令涉及塑料废物。报道同时涉及美国11月25日产能过剩301提案，欧盟反对有关过剩产能的认定并要求遵守美欧约定的15%综合税率上限。USTR拟排除已适用232关税的欧盟钢铝制品及有关衍生品，书面意见和听证申请截至2027年1月5日，听证拟于1月25日举行。
items.summary_en: Article 41(3) of EU Regulation 2024/1157 specified 21 November 2026 for adopting the first authorised list, subject to stated exceptions. The Commission’s 20 November update retained a year-end target. The 18 September text remains a draft. From 21 May 2027, covered non-hazardous waste for recovery may be exported to non-OECD destinations subject to the listed destination, waste entry and licensed-facility conditions. The draft entries for Indonesia and Vietnam do not include B1010 ferrous scrap. The prohibition that began on 21 November concerns plastic waste. In a separate development, the EU rejected USTR’s excess-capacity premise and called for compliance with the agreed all-inclusive 15% ceiling. USTR’s 25 November proposal would exclude EU steel and aluminium articles and relevant derivatives already subject to Section 232. Comments and hearing requests are due on 5 January 2027, and the hearing is scheduled for 25 January.
items.impact_zh: 涉及欧盟废钢供往印尼、越南的2027年长协时，按货物废物属性、巴塞尔代码、目的地和回收设施逐单核对，给跨越5月21日的到货约定写明最终清单变化下的交付条件及备选货源。当地电炉原料到岸成本若上升，才可能传导至其长材出口报价。美向钢材报价沿用已核定税项，按HTSUS和原产地与进口商分别核查232覆盖和301草案，勿把欧盟拟排除规则套用于中国原产货物。
items.impact_en: For EU-origin ferrous scrap supply contracts to Indonesia or Vietnam extending past 21 May 2027, check the waste classification, Basel code, destination and recovery facility. Tie delivery provisions to the final list and identify alternative supply. Any effect on local EAF-based long-product export offers would depend on the landed scrap cost. Keep applicable US duties in current quotes and have the importer check the HTSUS and origin separately for Section 232 and the proposed Section 301 treatment.

items.title_en: Mysteel reports December maintenance plans for Jiujiang plate and Linyi special-bar lines
items.title_original: Mysteel早读：外交部回应美计划加征关税，多家钢厂拟检修减产
items.summary_zh: Mysteel 11月26日早读称，方大九江萍钢计划12月16日至30日检修中厚板线，预计影响产量8万吨。临沂特钢拟12月1日至31日轮修两座转炉并改造棒材线，预计影响直径28至160毫米的优特钢棒材9万至10万吨。Mysteel另报天津钢铁12月安排单线或双线检修，预计影响当月产量12万吨。上述为计划和估算。早读所引11月25日外交部答问重申协商立场，USTR有关301税率已在独立主条记录为提案。
items.summary_en: Mysteel’s 26 November overview reports planned plate-line maintenance at Fangda Jiujiang Pinggang on 16–30 December, with estimated output losses of 80,000 tonnes. Linyi Special Steel plans converter maintenance and a bar-line upgrade on 1–31 December, with an estimated impact of 90,000–100,000 tonnes for 28–160 mm quality and special steel bars. Tianjin Iron & Steel’s December maintenance is reported to affect about 120,000 tonnes of output. These figures are planned impacts. China’s foreign ministry reiterated its consultation position on the separate USTR proposal.
items.impact_zh: 有相关钢厂的中厚板或优特钢棒材12月订单时，向钢厂确认检修前可锁轧期、备坯和装船窗口。复核交期后再承诺新单，涉及替代钢厂时先确认客户认可的牌号和认证范围。
items.impact_en: For exposed December plate or special-bar bookings, confirm rolling slots, feedstock and vessel windows with the producing mill. Check customer qualification and grade coverage before switching suppliers.
items.source_excerpt: Mysteel早读：外交部回应美计划加征关税，多家钢厂拟检修减产 钢铁网
items.coverage: 核对Mysteel原文公开索引及11月25日分项检修稿（https://news.mysteel.com/a/26112517/096E0C85530242EF.html），与方大九江萍钢专题及临沂特钢检修信息交叉核对。检修及影响量均按Mysteel报道归因。中国外交部原文：https://www.mfa.gov.cn/web/gjhdq_676201/gjhdqzz_681964/zgzyjz_148218/fyrth_688966/202611/t20261125_12066982.shtml。源站以北京时间标注11月26日07:37，队列UTC日期为11月25日。

items.title_zh: 青岛62%铁矿石CFR评估报89.2美元每吨，大商所主力11月25日收657元
items.title_en: Qingdao 62% iron ore benchmark assessed at USD 89.20/t CFR; Dalian main contract ended 25 November at CNY 657/t
items.title_original: China Iron Ore Prices Fall 2% as Futures Hit Four-Year Low in November 2026
items.summary_zh: IndexBox转引Kallanish称，11月20日青岛62%品位铁矿石CFR评估为89.20美元/吨，较10月23日下降2%。报道所述四年低位对应11月中旬期货走势；中国煤炭资源网记录大商所铁矿石I2701合约11月16日盘中低点647.5元/吨。路透11月25日报道，大商所当日成交最活跃合约日盘收657元/吨。现货评估、期货盘中低点及日盘收盘采用不同市场与观察时点。
items.summary_en: IndexBox cited a Kallanish assessment of USD 89.20/t CFR Qingdao for 62% Fe ore on 20 November, 2% below 23 October. The four-year low refers to mid-November futures; Sxcoal reported an intraday low of CNY 647.50/t for Dalian I2701 on 16 November. Reuters reported a CNY 657/t daytime close for the most-traded Dalian contract on 25 November.
items.impact_zh: 铁矿走弱只影响钢厂成本的一部分。热卷、中厚板报价请保留现行实盘，并同步检查焦炭、钢厂排产和海运成本，待钢厂重新报价再判断是否调价。
items.impact_en: Treat softer iron ore as one input into steelmaking costs. For export HRC and plate, check coke, mill scheduling and freight and use fresh firm mill offers for repricing.
items.source_excerpt: China Iron Ore Prices Fall 2% as Futures Hit Four-Year Low in November 2026 - News and Statistics IndexBox
items.coverage: 核对IndexBox全文中Kallanish品位、港口、CFR条件和比价日期；对照中国煤炭资源网大商所行情（https://en.sxcoal.com/news/detail/2122234472789368834）及Mining Weekly刊载的路透报道（https://www.miningweekly.com/article/iron-ore-rangebound-coal-hits-one-month-high-on-supply-concerns-2026-11-25/page:2）。现货底表未独立复算，盘中和日盘报价分别归因。
items.follow_up: 跟踪铁矿现货、焦炭和钢厂实盘是否同步变化。

items.title_original: USTR GREER Q&A/CNBC: USA OPPOSED TO CANADA'S PROPOSED TARIFF EXEMPTIONS FOR CHINA STEEL, ALUMINUM; BALANCING NAT'L SECURITY, ECONOMY RE NVIDIA
items.summary_zh: 美国贸易代表格里尔在11月25日CNBC采访中谈到加拿大钢铁、铝和汽车领域磋商。加拿大媒体报道其对加方扩大部分中国钢铝减免表达保留。加方此前公布拟扩大23个钢铁及9个铝税目减免。此访谈反映谈判立场，具体进口待遇仍以两国具法律效力的清单及报关细则判断。
items.summary_en: Greer discussed Canada’s steel, aluminium and auto talks on CNBC on 25 November. Canadian reporting quotes reservations about Canada's planned relief for selected Chinese metal products. Canada previously announced proposed coverage for 23 steel and nine aluminium tariff items.
items.impact_zh: 中国钢材对加报价按既有附加税与实际减免资格核算。若涉及加拿大加工后销往美国，应另核美国原产地及法律要求，待官方税目和实施日期清楚后再改含税报价。
items.impact_en: Price shipments to Canada using effective remission rules and check any subsequent US import separately. Reprice once operative tariff lines and dates are confirmed.

items.summary_zh: 乌克兰经济与环境部11月23日通报，部长Oleksandr Kravchenko在柏林德乌商业论坛期间请德方在布鲁塞尔支持扩大乌克兰钢材配额及推迟本国生产商适用CBAM。双方还讨论联合工业项目、投资及战争风险保险。欧委会此前在COM(2025)783认为当时无须就乌克兰原产货物采取临时CBAM调整。本轮取得的是请求及会议通报，未查见相应的新配额、延期或生效文件。
items.summary_en: Ukraine’s economy and environment ministry says Minister Oleksandr Kravchenko asked Germany at the Berlin business forum to support higher EU steel quotas and delayed CBAM application for Ukrainian mills. The Commission previously considered a temporary CBAM adjustment unwarranted in COM(2025)783. The meeting announcement does not establish a change in treatment.
items.impact_zh: 欧盟板材及半成品采购比价继续按现行原产地配额和CBAM条件。后续欧委会若发布措施，再按实际产品、配额编号和生效日更新乌克兰供应商比价。
items.impact_en: Keep EU flat steel and semifinished sourcing comparisons on current origin quotas and CBAM rules. Reassess Ukrainian offers once an EU measure specifies the products, quotas and date.

items.title_en: Canadian steel distributors report difficulty obtaining case-by-case TRQ surtax relief
items.title_original: Steel distributors say they’re being left behind on tariff rebates
items.summary_zh: 11月25日报道引述加拿大钢材经销商Titus Steel与Cascadia Metals对超配额附加税减免个案的经历。Titus称其进口特定油淬钢的申请被拒，Cascadia称部分申请未获批准或答复。加拿大财政部现行程序规定，对加拿大、美国和墨西哥以外原产的适用钢材，超过配额的50%附加税在特殊情形下可提出逐案减免申请。财政部可咨询本地钢厂，申请应提供加拿大无法供应同规格或替代品的证据，减免需由总督会同行政会议批准减免令后生效。该程序与11月17日公布的拟扩大部分中国钢铝25%附加税减免安排的法律依据分别核对。
items.summary_en: A 25 November report cited distributors Titus Steel and Cascadia Metals on denied or unresolved tariff remission requests. Finance Canada assesses requests for relief from the 50% above-quota surtax in exceptional circumstances, including demonstrated lack of domestic production capability for a specific product. A remission order requires approval by the Governor in Council. The separate China surtax remission expansion announced on 17 November has its own legal basis.
items.impact_zh: 中国耐磨板、特殊钢或定制规格订单，先由加拿大进口商按10位税号、TRQ类别、当季配额、逐票许可及加拿大替代供应核算。若拟申请减免，请准备钢厂询价回复、技术要求和本地替代不可行证据。报价按实际适用附加税预算，在取得书面减免前保留税费调整条款。加拿大海关示例显示同一报关货物同时触发50% TRQ附加税和25%中国附加税时，仅适用TRQ附加税，反倾销等另核。
items.impact_en: For Chinese abrasion-resistant plate or specialty steel, have the importer check the 10-digit code, TRQ class, quarterly balance, shipment-specific permit and domestic substitutes. Document sourcing attempts before applying. Use the applicable duties in quotes pending written relief. CBSA’s example applies only the TRQ surtax when the same goods trigger both the TRQ and China surtaxes, with anti-dumping duties assessed separately.

items.title_en: UK metal packaging association sees lighter CBAM obligations if origin exemptions take effect
items.title_original: UK-EU ETS linkage set to ease CBAM requirements for metal packaging manufacturers, says MPMA
items.summary_zh: 11月25日AL Circle引述英国金属包装制造商协会（MPMA）负责人Jason Galley称，欧英碳市场互联及预期的原产地豁免有望减少跨海峡供应的CBAM成本与行政工作。英国已公布拟从2027年1月1日追溯适用的草案；欧盟对英国原产货物的豁免仍须另行履行法律程序。行业效益为协会判断。
items.summary_en: MPMA's Jason Galley told AL Circle that UK–EU ETS linkage and prospective origin exemptions could lower CBAM costs and paperwork for qualifying cross-Channel metal packaging supply. The UK draft targets 1 January 2027 retrospectively once enacted; EU relief for UK goods requires separate EU legal steps.
items.impact_zh: 面向英国制罐客户报价时，逐码核对金属包装基材的CBAM适用性及非优惠原产地。对中国原产供货保留碳成本与资料交付条款，并按各市场生效进度比较欧洲供货。
items.impact_en: For UK canmaker quotes, check CBAM scope and non-preferential origin for the specific packaging substrate. Preserve cost and data clauses for China-origin purchases.

items.title_zh: 美国热卷报价上涨，越南10月钢材进口许可量回升但美国进口总量仍承压
items.title_en: US hot-rolled coil offers rise as Vietnamese steel permits rebound while aggregate US imports lag
items.title_original: 关税也拦不住！AI热潮点燃美国“抢钢大战”，亚洲低价钢材大举回流
items.summary_zh: 彭博11月24日报道，美国数据中心及电力基建拉动用钢需求，Nucor当周公布的热卷现货标价升至每短吨1330美元。AISI据美国商务部SIMA数据发布，10月全部钢材进口许可申请量221.4万短吨，较9月许可低11%；越南为21.3万短吨，较9月最终进口量高119%，韩国为40.5万短吨，较9月最终进口量低22%。AISI所列前10个月韩国同比增长68%对应整体钢材来源统计，含10月许可，不能用作韩国板材单一品类实绩。同口径下美国前10个月钢材进口总量同比下降6%。数据中心推动采购为报道归因。
items.summary_en: Bloomberg reported on 24 November that data centres and power infrastructure were supporting US steel demand, and cited Nucor’s advertised HRC spot price of USD 1,330 per short ton. AISI’s SIMA release shows October total applications of 2.214 million net tons, down 11% from September permits; Vietnam was 213,000 net tons, up 119% against September final imports, while South Korea was 405,000, down 22% on that comparison. AISI’s 68% year-to-date increase for South Korea is a total-steel source-country figure; combined US steel imports were down 6% in the first ten months on the same preliminary basis.
items.impact_zh: 美国价格走强可能吸引部分日韩及越南热卷或涂镀资源，做这些来源的竞争报价时请区分许可、到货和最终进口量。考虑中国原产钢材输美订单时，先由进口商核对232措施、适用反倾销和反补贴及原产地，再复核实际可成交的到岸净价。
items.impact_en: Firmer US prices could attract some Asian HRC and coated products. Separate permits, arrivals and final entries when benchmarking competing offers. Have the importer confirm Section 232 exposure, applicable trade remedies and origin before pricing Chinese-origin shipments.
items.source_excerpt: 关税也拦不住！AI热潮点燃美国“抢钢大战”，亚洲低价钢材大举回流 Sohu
items.coverage: 核对财媒转引的彭博报道（https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/commodities/articles/soaring-us-steel-prices-drive-221257412.html）、智通财经同名报道（https://cn.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/article-3685060）与AISI 10月SIMA发布稿。热卷标价归因彭博，许可数据与最终实绩分开，未把新闻标题解读为总体进口反转。
items.follow_up: 按美国后续最终统计和钢厂实盘复核产品与来源变化。

items.title_en: South Korean parliamentary steel forum discusses import restrictions, local procurement and crude-steel origin reporting
items.title_original: “钢铁行业需实施全面进口限制、优先使用国产钢材”……国会钢铁论坛研讨会- 阿视亚经济
items.summary_zh: 韩国国会钢铁论坛于11月25日举办政策研讨会，韩国钢铁协会参与。韩国工业研究院研究员 Lee Jae-yoon（이재윤）在会上建议研究对钢材实行较广泛的进口限制，公共基础设施和能源项目优先考虑韩国本国钢材，并考虑将钢铁纳入国内生产税收抵免。行业媒体另引韩国产业通商部长金正官称，将推进粗钢生产国信息提交制度。会议讨论和部长发言尚无新税率、适用税号或报关起始日期。
items.summary_en: A South Korean National Assembly Steel Forum seminar on 25 November discussed broader steel import restrictions, preference for Korean steel in public infrastructure and energy projects, and extending domestic production tax credits to steel. Trade press separately reported that Industry Minister Kim Jung-kwan called for formalising reporting of the country where crude steel is produced. The reported discussion sets no new tariff rate, tariff code or customs start date.
items.impact_zh: 对输韩中厚板、热轧及面向基础设施客户的钢材，报价按现行措施核算。涉及第三国加工时，可先整理钢厂、炉号和粗钢生产地资料，并请韩国进口商跟踪产业通商部和海关是否发布申报字段或适用税号。
items.impact_en: For Korean plate, HRC and infrastructure orders, price under the measures currently in force. For third-country processing, retain mill, heat and crude-steel production country evidence and have the importer monitor Korean ministry and customs instructions.
items.source_excerpt: “钢铁行业需实施全面进口限制、优先使用国产钢材”……国会钢铁论坛研讨会- 阿视亚经济 아시아경제
items.coverage: 核对韩国钢铁协会活动信息的公开索引，并用SteelIN完整会议信息（https://www.steelin.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=13646）和《钢铁金属新闻》对部长发言的报道（https://www.snmnews.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=577912）交叉核对。所述进口及采购建议为报告人主张，熔炼生产地信息要求未见发布实施文件。

items.title_en: China rebar futures recover to CNY 3,030/t while winter spot demand stays soft
items.title_original: Chinese Steel Rebar Futures Rebound From 17-Month Low to CNY 3,030 per Tonne
items.summary_zh: IndexBox与Trading Economics 11月24日发布的机构行情称，中国螺纹钢期货从11月17日的2960元/吨低位回升至3030元/吨。两处采用相同数据来源。SMM同日现货日评指出，淡季需求下市场情绪仍谨慎，个别市场品牌通过降价促成交易。机构跟踪的期货价位和市场评论各有时间及样本口径。
items.summary_en: On 24 November, IndexBox and its source Trading Economics reported a rise in Chinese rebar futures to CNY 3,030/t from CNY 2,960/t on 17 November. An SMM daily spot report said off-season buying remained cautious, with some brands discounting to close transactions.
items.impact_zh: 对螺纹钢、方坯询单，用钢厂当天实盘、规格、船期和到岸成本重新确认有效报价；关注现货成交能否跟随盘面，判断此次回升是否传导至出口。
items.impact_en: For rebar or billet inquiries, check firm mill offers matched to specification and shipment date, then recalculate the landed cost. Watch executed spot trades before assuming futures gains will feed through to exports.

items.summary_zh: Cleantech for Europe发布11月19日公开信。22家钢铁、水泥、化工等企业负责人称，其已决定或等待最终投资决定的低碳项目超过380亿欧元。签署方要求保持有效碳价、覆盖受管产品价值链并防止规避，同时改善低碳产品需求和电力成本。投资额由签署方披露，包含未作最终投资决定的项目。
items.summary_en: In a 19 November open letter, leaders of 22 industrial companies said that more than EUR 38 billion in low-carbon investment had been decided or was awaiting final investment decision. They called for predictable pricing, broader value-chain coverage and anti-circumvention under CBAM, plus demand support and competitive electricity.

items.impact_en: Track the downstream CBAM file and buyers' low-emissions procurement standards. Apply enacted scope and import-period values to contracts.

items.title_zh: 欧盟CBAM实际排放核查须确认认可范围及独立性，咨询平台可协助准备数据
items.title_en: EU CBAM actual-emissions verification requires appropriate accreditation and independence
items.title_original: CBAM 合规链条上的三类机构：核查、咨询、数字化平台的能力边界与选型建议
items.summary_zh: 11月23日发布的服务商文章介绍咨询、数据平台及核查分工。欧盟CBAM条例规定，申报采用实际排放时须按要求经认可核查机构核查，适用默认值的路径仍应按现行规则判断。授权条例(EU) 2025/2551附件I第1.7节规定核查独立性与利益冲突要求，核查方参与为同一经营者制定排放监测、报告或技术支持等活动，可能产生不可接受的风险。服务商宣传中的效率数据、资质和产品覆盖需分别查证，报道提及的下游范围仍处立法阶段。
items.summary_en: A vendor article describes consulting, data platforms and verification roles. EU CBAM requires actual emissions used for reporting to be verified by an accredited verifier as applicable; default-value options remain subject to the rules. Annex I, Section 1.7 of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2025/2551 sets impartiality and conflict rules, including risks from the verifier’s involvement in emissions monitoring, reporting or related technical support. Vendor performance claims and accreditation scope require independent confirmation.
items.impact_zh: 钢厂和欧盟进口商在签约前核对实际签发机构、认可证书和产品活动范围，并确认拟核查排放数据与咨询成果之间的独立性。用热卷、冷卷和镀锌卷各自税号对应的设施与前驱体资料留档，按订单安排交付。
items.impact_en: Before engagement, have the mill and EU importer confirm the report issuer, accreditation and activity scope, and check independence from the team that prepared the emissions data. Map HRC, CRC and galvanized steel to the relevant plant and precursor records.
items.source_excerpt: CBAM 合规链条上的三类机构：核查、咨询、数字化平台的能力边界与选型建议 碳索储能网
items.coverage: 核读阳光慧碳发布的碳索储能网文章（https://cn.solarbe.com/news/20261123/50040082.html），核对CBAM基础条例（https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2023/956/2025-10-20/eng）及核查认可授权条例附件I第1.7节。不采纳服务商推荐、未核证商业数据或尚未完成立法的下游清单。
items.follow_up: 选聘前要求候选核查方提供可核验的认可证书及适用活动范围。

The 23 November recap pairs existing results with the EU's 9.5% definitive duty on covered Indian CRC, effective 17 November.

items.title_original: EU steel imports surged 65% ahead of CBAM launch, then fell 27%
items.summary_zh: 安永Alwyn Hopkins在2026年11月19日伦敦活动上称，欧盟钢铁产品进口在2025年12月比以往12月均值高65%，在2026年1月比以往1月均值低27%。两项数据分别与对应月份的历史均值比较。他认为，部分进口商可能在欧盟CBAM于2026年1月1日进入正式阶段前提前安排进口，钢铁保障措施和关税也可能影响同期变化。原报道未列明历史样本年份、纳入税号或各因素的贡献。
items.summary_en: At a London event on 19 November 2026, EY's Alwyn Hopkins said EU iron and steel imports were 65% above the historical December average in December 2025 and 27% below the historical January average in January 2026. He suggested CBAM front-loading could have contributed, alongside safeguards and tariffs. The report provides neither the baseline years nor the commodity-code coverage.
items.impact_zh: 评估中国热卷、中厚板等订单时，按欧盟海关税号和原产地核对月度进口量和到货计划，再结合预计进口季度的碳成本、配额和贸易救济措施核算报价。上述历史总量仅用于观察清关节奏，暂不据此调整单个品种的销量预期或报价。
items.impact_en: Check EU monthly imports and arrivals by CN code and origin before applying this historical signal to Chinese hot-rolled coil or plate. Price each order using the expected import quarter, carbon costs, tariff quotas and trade remedies.
items.source_excerpt: EU steel imports surged 65% ahead of CBAM launch, then fell 27% Металлургпром

items.title_en: BIMCO estimate puts Guinea third in seaborne iron ore exports in October at more than 5 Mt
items.title_original: A West African country overtakes South Africa and Canada to become world's third-largest iron ore exporter, with China as its biggest buyer
items.summary_zh: 航运媒体引述BIMCO估算，2026年10月几内亚铁矿石出口超过500万吨，约占当月全球海运铁矿量3%，单月排名第三，年内累计逾2200万吨，主要流向中国。力拓项目资料确认西芒杜首船于2025年12月离港，两个项目共用铁路及港口设计出口能力为每年最多1.2亿吨。单月航运排名、累计发运和设计产能为不同口径。
items.summary_en: BIMCO estimates Guinea shipped more than 5 Mt in October, around 3% of global seaborne iron ore that month, ranking third; reported 2026 shipments to date exceeded 22 Mt and went mainly to China. Rio Tinto confirms first shipment in December 2025 and shared rail and port design export capacity of up to 120 Mt per year.
items.impact_zh: 高品位进口矿来源增加对配矿和运费有潜在影响。关注中国到港量、品位溢价和几内亚至中国海运费，用实际到岸成本检验对高炉原料成本的影响。
items.impact_en: Track actual arrivals in China, grade premiums and freight from Guinea before revising blast-furnace feed cost assumptions.

items.title_zh: 研究称2019—2025年拉美直接及间接钢材进口增46.1%，中国在六大产钢国进口份额升至39%
items.title_en: Secondary analysis: Latin American direct and indirect steel imports rose 46.1% in 2019–25; China share of LAC6 imports reached 39%
items.title_original: 拉美钢铁进口增长46.1%至7200万吨，中国份额升至39% - 新闻和统计
items.summary_zh: 【研究报道，非海关钢材进口统计】IndexBox 2026年11月20日引述Mesteel和经合组织(OECD)研究称，2019—2025年拉美直接进口钢材及嵌入制成品的间接钢材进口合计增长46.1%，2025年达到约7200万吨；阿根廷、巴西、智利、哥伦比亚、墨西哥和秘鲁六国(LAC6)直接及间接钢材进口从3760万吨升至5540万吨，来自中国的对应供应从910万吨升至2160万吨，占比由24%升至39%。报道还称间接进口约占相关供应40%，LAC6钢厂产能利用率约60%。以上口径含汽车、机械、设备等成品所含钢材，不等于7200万吨钢材海关进口量；本轮核对了IndexBox全文，未取得并逐表复算OECD原始报告。
items.summary_en: IndexBox (20 Nov), citing Mesteel/OECD, reports Latin American direct-plus-indirect steel imports up 46.1% in 2019–25 to 72 Mt. China's share of LAC6 direct-plus-indirect imports reportedly rose from 24% to 39% (9.1 to 21.6 Mt). Figures include steel embedded in manufactured goods, not solely customs-recorded steel imports. Original OECD tables were not independently verified.
items.impact_zh: 【业务研判】拉美钢材竞争压力及贸易救济风险值得跟踪，但不能将39%直接用作中国成品钢材在拉美市场的海关进口份额。出口报价应分别分析各国热轧、冷轧、镀锌及板坯的直接进口量、原产地限制和贸易救济，特别关注墨西哥、巴西及哥伦比亚。该报告显示的进口渗透率变化可作为市场背景，不应替代逐国逐税号统计。
items.impact_en: The study signals competitive pressure in Latin America but the 39% figure is not China's customs share of steel imports. Validate direct imports and trade remedies by country and HS code before pricing.
items.source_excerpt: 拉美钢铁进口增长46.1%至7200万吨，中国份额升至39% - 新闻和统计 IndexBox
items.follow_up: 取得OECD原报告，分拆直接/间接进口并与Alacero、各国海关按HS编码核对；再分析首钢板卷、板坯目标市场。
items.coverage: 2026-11-21读取IndexBox 2026-11-20全文，核对72Mt、46.1%、LAC6 55.4Mt、中国21.6Mt与39%及直接/间接进口口径；仅为二手引用，未获得OECD原始表格及海关细项，故limited。原始队列为Google News RSS，不把转述统计标记为独立官方核验。

items.title_zh: 欧盟预告俄土特定耐腐蚀钢反倾销措施于2027年8月13日到期
items.title_en: EU gives notice of prospective expiry of Russian and Turkish corrosion-resistant steel measures
items.title_original: OJ: Commission announces impending expiry of anti-dumping duties on corrosion-resistant steel and silicon
items.summary_zh: 欧盟官方公报11月20日发布C/2026/6044。若未启动到期复审，俄罗斯、土耳其原产特定耐腐蚀钢的反倾销措施于2027年8月13日零时到期。欧盟生产商最迟可在到期前三个月提交复审申请。原令2022/1395涵盖规定成分、经化学钝化的特定热镀锌、铝或镁板带材，示例CN为ex 7210 49 00及ex 7210 61 00；土耳其企业税率2.4%—11.0%，俄方10.3%—37.4%。原令排除不锈钢、硅电工钢、高速钢及仅经热轧或冷轧的产品。适用企业单独税率须提交有效商业发票。同期C/2026/6045为独立金属硅案件，含对经韩国及台湾发运的适用扩展。
items.summary_en: The EU's 20 November notice C/2026/6044 sets potential expiry on 13 August 2027 for certain Russian and Turkish hot-dip corrosion-resistant steel, unless an expiry review is initiated. Original rates range from 2.4% to 11.0% for Türkiye and 10.3% to 37.4% for Russia. C/2026/6045 is a separate silicon notice.
items.impact_zh: 欧盟镀锌和部分合金涂镀板报价仍按当前土耳其供应商税率和实际配额比价。2027年三季度及以后可做竞争情景，待复审立案或到期确认后再调整。俄货仍需另核进口限制。
items.impact_en: Use current Turkish supplier duties and quotas for comparisons. Treat the expiry as a Q3 2027 scenario until the EU confirms a review or expiry; check Russian import restrictions separately.

items.title_original: Why China's Hot-Rolled Coil Export Price Fell to $480, Its Lowest Since March: Export Orders Dropped 9% as Buyers Wait
items.summary_zh: SMM于11月20日发布周度调查，11月17日中国热卷评估FOB天津480美元/吨，为其系列3月以来低位。样本钢材出口新订单环比降9.06%至约95.4万吨，长材订单下降拖累总量，板材订单则升至约48万吨。中东、南美和非洲市场存在询盘后观望现象。价格与订单为SMM评估和样本调查口径。
items.summary_en: SMM assessed Chinese HRC at USD 480/t FOB Tianjin on 17 November. Its weekly exporter sample fell 9.06% to about 954,000 tonnes, driven by longs; flat-product orders rose to about 480,000 tonnes. Both figures are SMM assessment or survey numbers.
items.impact_zh: 中东、南美与非洲热卷订单按牌号、装期和目的港校验成交。用480美元/吨作询价对比，结合实际海运、规制与客户接受度测算。样本总体订单变动不能用于推定热卷订单同比或环比下降幅度。
items.impact_en: Use the quote as a price reference for HRC in the Middle East, Latin America and Africa, then reprice by grade, shipment, freight and market. Do not transfer the total survey change to coil volumes.

items.summary_zh: Fastmarkets按2026年三季度价格测算，在英欧采用相同申报排放强度的假设下，高炉路线热卷在约1.5吨二氧化碳当量/吨钢处达到两地成本交点，超过该值时英国情景成本较低。该交点属于模型；英国HMRC发布的行业示例也不能作为2027年实际季度税率。欧英11月20日宣布完成ETS互联谈判，目标2028年实施。英国《欧洲伙伴关系法案》11月26日在下议院完成一读，二读安排在12月7日。英国CBAM仍按2027年1月1日启动；欧盟对英国原产货物的豁免仍需修改条例附件III。
items.summary_en: Fastmarkets models a crossover near 1.5 tonnes of CO₂e per tonne of blast-furnace hot-rolled coil using Q3 2026 prices and the same declared emissions intensity on both sides. The model gives the UK a lower cost above that point. The UK’s published indicative sector rates are illustrations for the methodology. On 20 November the EU and UK announced that ETS-link negotiations had concluded, with implementation targeted for 2028. The UK European Partnership Bill had its Commons first reading on 26 November and is scheduled for second reading on 7 December. The UK CBAM starts on 1 January 2027. An EU exemption for UK-origin goods requires an amendment to Annex III.
items.impact_zh: 中国原产热卷对英、对欧分别测算，要求钢厂提供生产路线与对应产品的实测排放，缺数据时由目的地进口商按各自商品编码和默认值复核，再约定合同碳成本分摊及季度调价。经英国转运仍按适用原产地规则审核，勿按原产地豁免重排清关。印度镀层板等竞争货源的流向变化可用于比价，仍需结合配额与反倾销等贸易措施。
items.impact_en: Model UK and EU landed costs separately for Chinese-origin hot-rolled coil. Request route-specific and product-specific emissions data. Where needed, have each importer check the local commodity code, default value and quarterly price before agreeing carbon-cost allocation. Account for applicable origin rules when evaluating shipments via Britain. Use shifts in competing coated flat steel offers as a market signal alongside quotas and trade remedies.

items.title_zh: 齐绍洲团队模拟欧盟CBAM对中国金属冶炼及加工出口的长期影响
items.title_en: Qi Shaozhou’s team models the long-term impact of EU CBAM on Chinese metals exports
items.title_original: 碳关税“规则革命”已至，钢铁行业如何作答？——齐绍洲详解CBAM对钢铁行业的影响及应对之策
items.summary_zh: 中国冶金报的会议报道显示，武汉大学齐绍洲于11月11日中国特殊钢产业发展大会介绍团队的GTAP-E情景模拟。高碳价差情景下，模型估算2040年中国对欧盟的金属冶炼及加工行业出口规模降幅约15.3%。该口径覆盖金属冶炼及加工，属于特定模型情景。欧盟下游扩围仍在立法程序中，欧洲议会于2026年9月15日表决后交回委员会进行机构间谈判。
items.summary_en: China Metallurgical News reported that Wuhan University’s Qi Shaozhou presented GTAP-E scenarios at the China Special Steel Industry Development Conference on 11 November. In a high carbon-price-gap scenario, the team modelled a decline of about 15.3% by 2040 for Chinese metal smelting and processing exports to the EU. The estimate is scenario-specific and covers the broader metals sector. The EU downstream extension remains in the legislative process, with the European Parliament referring the file back for interinstitutional negotiations after its 15 September 2026 vote.
items.impact_zh: 该情景可供评估长期输欧产品布局。热轧、冷轧、镀层板卷等具体合同的CBAM敞口应按进口年度、适用税号、经核查排放或默认值及合同分担条款计算。涉及进一步加工产品的中长期询单，核对扩围最终文件及附件后再反映到报价。
items.impact_en: Use the scenario for long-term EU product planning. For individual hot-rolled, cold-rolled and coated steel contracts, calculate exposure from the import year, applicable codes, verified emissions or default values, and contractual allocation. For downstream products, update long-dated pricing once the final legal text and annexes are available.
items.source_excerpt: 碳关税“规则革命”已至，钢铁行业如何作答？——齐绍洲详解CBAM对钢铁行业的影响及应对之策 中国钢铁新闻网
items.coverage: 核对中国冶金报可读全文转载、Mysteel转载及其署名（https://news.mysteel.com/a/26111916/F61E712D1DD73492.html）、中国金属学会的会议信息（https://www.csm.org.cn/col/col6362/art/2026/art_57b258ec5a1841e59d6aa4df74af5fc3.html）和欧洲议会立法程序（https://oeil.europarl.europa.eu/oeil/en/procedure-file?reference=2025%2F0419%28COD%29）。活动与报告内容由公开报道确认，未取得演示原件、模型输入及附件，降幅作为研究者情景估计。

items.summary_zh: EUROMETAL 11月19日转述配额统计。11月24日的TARIC镜像显示，FTA国别配额热卷1A（09.9500）、FTA其他国家热卷1A（09.9700）和4A（09.9714）账面余额均为零；普通其他国家4B（09.9606）及中国4B（09.9838）余额也为零。FTA其他国家4B（09.9719）仍约4,664.5吨、待分配约48.2吨，FTA国别4A（09.9505）仍约378.9吨。两类其他国家配额必须按各自适用规则区分。
items.summary_en: EUROMETAL's 19 November quota report was compared with the 24 November TARIC-derived snapshot. FTA HRC quotas 09.9500 and 09.9700, FTA-other 4A 09.9714, ordinary-other 4B 09.9606 and China 4B 09.9838 showed zero balances. The separate FTA-other 4B quota 09.9719 still showed about 4,664.5 tonnes and 48.2 tonnes awaiting allocation.
items.impact_zh: 热卷和镀层板年底清关需逐票核对配额编号、原产地和预计申报日。中国4B报价按该编号的余额和适用规则测算，FTA编号下的余额无需计入中国来源可用量。请报关行以当日TARIC及分配状态再确认。
items.impact_en: For year-end EU HRC and coated shipments, confirm the exact quota order, origin and customs date. Use the China-specific 4B order when pricing China-origin material and verify live allocations with the broker.

items.title_original: 直面CBAM冲击，碳定价是产业必修课 ——美国开展欧盟CBAM产业影响分析带来的启示
items.summary_zh: 美国贸易代表办公室10月8日依据案卷USTR-2026-0661，就欧盟CBAM对美国生产商、就业、直接及间接出口的影响征求意见，公告意见期截至11月9日。征询同时覆盖欧委会、理事会与欧洲议会不同的下游扩围方案。中国冶金报评论引用机构测算讨论碳价与竞争力。该案卷所核公告为征求意见程序，欧盟现行范围按条例附件I执行。
items.summary_en: USTR’s 8 October notice in docket USTR-2026-0661 sought public input on the effect of EU CBAM on US producers, workers and direct or indirect exports, including three different EU proposals to expand coverage. The published comment deadline was 9 November. A China Metallurgical News commentary discusses carbon pricing and competitiveness using external estimates. The notice is a request for comments. Annex I of the EU regulation governs current product coverage.
items.impact_zh: 对欧钢材按现行商品编码和进口商核查结果履约。涉及钢制汽车零部件及其他下游制品的长单，分别标注现行覆盖与各版提案可能覆盖的税号，预先准备钢材前体排放数据，并为最终扩围后的碳成本分摊留出合同调整条款。
items.impact_en: Base EU steel shipments on current product codes and importer checks. For longer contracts covering steel-intensive auto components or other downstream goods, distinguish live CBAM coverage from each proposal’s product list, prepare steel precursor emissions data and allow for potential adjustments to carbon-cost allocation.

items.title_en: Commission's 2025 carbon market report: industrial ETS emissions down 3.3%; extension of CBAM to 180 downstream goods remains proposed
items.title_original: Industrial emissions in the EU fell by 3.3%; CBAM to be extended to 180 products
items.summary_zh: 【官方报告事实】欧委会于2026年11月9日发布COM(2026)596 final《2025年欧洲碳市场运行报告》。报告以截至2026年6月30日的核证数据指出，2025年欧盟ETS工业设施排放较2024年下降3.3%，主要由钢铁、水泥和化工部门推动；陶瓷和铝业排放则增加逾2%。整个ETS1（含电力、工业、航空、航运）2025年排放量约11.63亿吨二氧化碳当量，较2024年下降2%。报告第3.4节回顾欧委会2025年12月提出的CBAM下游扩围方案，拟自2028年覆盖约180类钢铝密集型产品（如洗衣机、工业散热器、铸造机械），并拟设临时脱碳基金；此处是既有立法提案回顾，尚非2026年11月新增已生效税目。报告提及CBAM覆盖行业免费配额逐步退出，不能把工业排放下降直接等同于钢铁单吨排放强度下降。
items.summary_en: COM(2026)596 final, published 9 Nov 2026, reports verified 2025 industrial ETS emissions down 3.3% y/y, mainly in steel, cement and chemicals; ceramic and aluminium emissions rose over 2%. Total ETS1 emissions were 1,163 MtCO2e, down 2%. The report reiterates the December 2025 Commission proposal to extend CBAM to around 180 steel/aluminium-intensive downstream goods from 2028; this remains a proposal, not an enacted new product list.
items.impact_zh: 【业务研判】欧盟钢铁排放下降可能同时反映减产、结构调整和减排，不能据此推断欧洲钢厂竞争成本必然下降。中国钢材及下游出口企业应监测欧盟ETS免费配额和CBAM扩围立法进度，预先建立钢铝前驱体、产品CN编码及嵌入排放数据映射；扩围尚未生效，不应提前按180项方案向客户计征CBAM。欧盟拟设出口脱碳补助若获通过可能改变欧洲制造商的海外竞争报价，但具体资金和适用条件须待立法落地。
items.impact_en: The 3.3% drop may reflect lower output as well as decarbonisation, not necessarily lower unit emissions or costs. Chinese steel and downstream exporters should track free-allocation reforms and the CBAM expansion proposal, map CN codes and embedded emissions, and avoid treating the 180 proposed goods as currently taxable.

items.title_zh: 中国SS400热轧卷FOB评估约485美元每吨，欧盟到岸报价需逐票核对配额
items.title_en: Chinese SS400 HRC assessed near $485/t FOB as EU quota access constrains buying
items.title_original: Why China's Hot-Rolled Coil Is Stuck at $485 a Tonne as Buyers Wait and Europe's Quota Is Full
items.summary_zh: 据Kalkine，11月16日中国SS400出口热卷评估在485美元/吨FOB。SEAISI刊载的Mysteel评估显示，11月13日天津港SS400 3毫米规格同样为485美元/吨FOB。Kalkine将欧洲买家观望与进口配额压力联系起来。欧盟法规规定，适用品类配额用尽或无可用配额时适用50%配额外税；实际配额须按原产地、产品分类、配额号和清关日查验。
items.summary_en: Kalkine reported a $485/t FOB assessment for Chinese SS400 HRC on 16 November. SEAISI’s Mysteel report placed 3 mm SS400 at the same level, FOB Tianjin, on 13 November. Kalkine linked cautious European buying to quota limits. The EU regulation specifies a 50% out-of-quota duty for covered categories when quota is exhausted or unavailable. Check the relevant origin, product category, quota order and entry date.
items.impact_zh: 低价FOB可作为中东、北非和南美热卷海运报价的市场参照。欧盟订单请先用具体CN、原产地和预计清关日请进口商核对TARIC额度，再分别计入适用的配额外税、贸易救济及CBAM。
items.impact_en: Use this FOB assessment as a reference for HRC offers into the Middle East, North Africa and South America. For EU orders, check the actual quota and model any out-of-quota duty, trade-remedy duty and CBAM separately before quoting.

items.title_original: Iron Ore Futures Near Four-Year Lows on Weak China Demand, Rising Supply
items.summary_zh: IndexBox援引Trading Economics称，2026年11月17日铁矿石期货接近640元/吨，徘徊在约四年低位。截至11月15日当周全球铁矿石发运量据该机构引用的行业数据增加453万吨至3444万吨。国家统计局另公布，10月中国粗钢产量7083万吨，同比下降1.6%。期货价格和发运量为机构跟踪口径。
items.summary_en: IndexBox, citing Trading Economics, reported that iron ore futures traded near CNY 640/t on 17 November 2026, close to a four-year low. Industry data cited by the report put global shipments at 34.44 million tonnes in the week to 15 November, up 4.53 million tonnes. China’s National Bureau of Statistics reported October crude steel output at 70.83 million tonnes, down 1.6% year on year.
items.impact_zh: 铁矿下跌提示高炉原料成本面临下行压力。中国热卷和商品级冷轧出口报价先跟踪钢厂最新盘价和交期，再结合焦炭、汇率及海运更新成本；现有实盘以钢厂书面确认价为准。
items.impact_en: Lower ore prices point to possible pressure on blast-furnace input costs. For Chinese commodity-grade HRC and CRC offers, check current mill prices and lead times and update the costing for coke, FX and freight. Use confirmed mill quotes for firm offers.

items.title_zh: 中国10月铁矿石进口量环比降3.79%，机构预计11月到港回升
items.title_en: China’s October iron ore imports fell 3.79% month on month; SMM expects arrivals to recover
items.title_original: China October Iron Ore Imports Fall 3.79% MoM; November Arrivals Seen Rebounding
items.summary_zh: IndexBox转引SMM及海关数据，2026年10月中国铁矿石及精矿进口量为1.05658亿吨，环比下降3.79%、同比下降4.96%；1—10月累计约10.61亿吨，同比增长3.1%。SMM按发运到港周期推算，11月平均到港可能高于10月，海关口径进口量或小幅回升。
items.summary_en: IndexBox cited SMM’s reading of China Customs data: October imports of iron ore and concentrates reached 105.658 million tonnes, down 3.79% from September and 4.96% year on year. January–October imports were about 1.061 billion tonnes, up 3.1%. Based on shipment schedules, SMM expected November arrivals to recover and customs-basis imports to rise modestly.
items.impact_zh: 采购和热轧出口报价可关注后续到港、港存、钢厂铁水产量和焦炭成本，判断矿价压力是否传导至厂价。11月到港为机构推算，待海关实绩发布后更新。
items.impact_en: Watch arrivals, port stocks, hot-metal production and coke costs before applying the ore signal to HRC export pricing. Treat the November figure as an SMM outlook pending customs data.
items.source_excerpt: China October Iron Ore Imports Fall 3.79% MoM; November Arrivals Seen Rebounding - News and Statistics IndexBox
