items.title_zh: 乌克兰与欧委会商谈钢铁配额调整及战时CBAM特殊安排，尚未形成豁免
items.title_en: Ukraine seeks EU steel quota adjustment and wartime CBAM terms; no exemption agreed
items.title_original: 乌克兰与欧盟商讨钢铁配额、CBAM缓解及工业免签制度 - 新闻和统计
items.summary_zh: 【乌克兰政府2026-11-16公告】乌总理与欧委会执行副主席讨论乌克兰工业进入欧盟市场、钢铁配额及CBAM。乌方称2026年7月1日起的新钢铁配额限制了市场准入，已提出技术方案，争取年底前就配额分配达成安排；同时探讨战争和重建期CBAM特殊条款。乌方还称欧盟理事会对工业产品合格评定互认(ACAA)的技术准备给出积极结论。以上属于磋商与准备，不是欧盟已批准钢铁配额增加或CBAM豁免。
items.summary_en: On 16 Nov Ukraine's government reported talks with the Commission on post-July steel quota access and potential wartime CBAM arrangements. Ukraine seeks a quota solution by year-end; neither a quota increase nor a CBAM exemption is established by this announcement.
items.impact_zh: 【业务研判】乌克兰钢铁对欧盟的配额及碳成本条件可能影响欧洲板坯、长材与钢管竞争，但任何特别安排须以欧盟正式法规或配额公告为准；中国原产钢材不会因乌克兰谈判获得相同待遇。关注年末谈判结果及乌克兰出口对欧盟采购价格的影响。
items.impact_en: Monitor formal EU quota/CBAM decisions and possible sourcing impacts for slabs, long products and tubes; talks do not confer exemptions on Ukraine or China.
items.source_excerpt: 乌克兰与欧盟商讨钢铁配额、CBAM缓解及工业免签制度 - 新闻和统计 IndexBox
items.coverage: 2026-11-17读取乌克兰政府2026-11-16官方新闻，核对会谈主体、7月1日配额和年底前争取安排的表述；未取得欧盟批准任何新豁免或修订的法规。
items.follow_up: 跟踪欧委会正式提案、欧盟配额分配调整及CBAM特别条款文本，不以乌方谈判诉求作已生效规则。

items.title_zh: 中加延长并扩大部分中国钢铝产品进口附加税减免至2028年底
items.title_en: Canada and China extend and expand tariff remission for selected Chinese steel and aluminium products through 2028
items.title_original: 中加再降部分商品关税 涉猪鱼海鲜与钢铁铝
items.summary_zh: 【加拿大总理办公室2026-11-17官方公告】双方将双边初步经贸安排延长至2028年12月；加拿大把原定仅适用于2026年12月31日前进口的部分中国钢铝产品附加税减免延长至2028年12月31日，并扩大至32个税目，其中钢铁23个、铝9个，针对加拿大国内供应不足或无法供应的产品。中国则对约4亿加元加拿大猪肉和海产品出口给予进一步减税便利。官方公告未在本轮材料中列出23个钢铁税目的全部编码及逐项适用条件；不能理解为中国所有钢材普遍免税。
items.summary_en: Canada's Prime Minister announced on 17 Nov that selected Chinese steel and aluminium surtax remissions will run through 31 Dec 2028, expanded to 32 tariff items (23 steel, nine aluminium) for goods in short supply domestically. The announcement does not itself establish blanket duty-free access for all Chinese steel.
items.impact_zh: 【业务研判】这是中国钢材进入加拿大的定向机会，应优先让加拿大进口商/报关行核对23个钢铁税号、实际产品描述、减免令和附加税条件，评估首钢热轧、冷轧及特殊品种能否适用；未确认税号前不得以免税价报价。
items.impact_en: Check the 23 steel tariff lines, remission orders and eligibility with Canadian customs brokers before offering duty-relieved quotations; no general exemption is implied.
items.source_excerpt: 中加再降部分商品关税 涉猪鱼海鲜与钢铁铝 8world
items.coverage: 2026-11-17读取加拿大总理办公室当日官方背景说明，核实延期至2028-12-31、32项中钢铁23项、适用理由和原措施截止日；未核对具体23个HS编码和海关实施细则。
items.follow_up: 取得加拿大海关减免令及23个钢铁税目清单，按品种、钢厂、进口时间和原附加税核算。

items.title_zh: 斯凯孚与中国宝武签署备忘录，拟合作开发低碳产品与下一代轴承钢
items.title_en: SKF and China Baowu sign memorandum on lower-carbon products and next-generation bearing steel
items.title_original: SKF and Baowu Partner on Lower-Carbon Steel Innovation
items.summary_zh: 斯凯孚11月16日公告确认与中国宝武签署谅解备忘录。拟合作领域包括低碳产品、下一代轴承钢、产品碳足迹透明度、钢铁生产设备状态监测，以及轴承再制造与回收。公开公告披露合作方向，未披露具体钢厂、产品牌号、采购量或交付时间。
items.summary_en: SKF announced on 16 November that it and China Baowu had signed a memorandum of understanding. Planned work includes lower-carbon products, next-generation bearing steel, product carbon footprint transparency, monitoring of steelmaking equipment, and bearing remanufacturing and recycling. The announcement gives no plant, grade, order volume or delivery timetable.
items.impact_zh: 欧洲轴承及工业设备客户编制低碳钢采购规格时，可向钢厂核查拟报牌号、样件计划和订单对应的排放边界及证据。按实际供货认证和产品核查材料决定能否报低碳溢价或支持进口商申报。
items.impact_en: For bearing and industrial equipment customers developing lower-carbon specifications, ask mills about grade, trial material and emissions evidence for the proposed supply. Base any low-carbon premium or importer declaration on qualified supply and substantiated product data.

items.title_en: German steel summit calls for grid support, green-steel demand and stronger trade defence, not enacted tariffs
items.title_original: German Steel Summit: Subsidies First, Then a Tariff Wall
items.summary_zh: 【2026-11-16行业报道】德国钢铁联盟、IG Metall及德国钢铁协会在萨尔茨吉特钢铁峰会上提出共同诉求，包括提高电网费用联邦支持至65亿欧元、推动欧洲低排放钢需求市场、氢能应用及加强针对不公平进口的保护。属于行业政策建议和政治倡议，不能把“关税墙”标题理解为德国已单独颁布新进口关税。
items.summary_en: Industry groups at the 16 Nov German steel summit urged €6.5bn grid-charge support, lead markets for low-emission steel, hydrogen and trade defence. These are demands, not enacted German tariffs.
items.impact_zh: 【业务研判】欧洲钢厂若获能源补贴及绿色钢采购支持，中长期可能改变中国钢材在汽车、公共采购等领域的价格竞争；近期报价仍以欧盟已生效法规、配额和CBAM为准。
items.impact_en: Potential medium-term competitive impact from energy support and green-steel procurement; do not price in any new German tariff absent enacted EU law.

items.title_zh: 媒体称中国热卷出口LME次月合约报478.50美元每吨，现货评估另有口径
items.title_en: Kalkine cites $478.50/t for LME China HRC second-month futures
items.title_original: Why China's Export Hot-Rolled Coil Has Slipped to $478.50 as Ore Stocks Build and Seasonal Demand Eases
items.summary_zh: 11月17日Kalkine将478.50美元/吨归于11月13日LME中国热卷FOB次月合约，并认为冬季需求偏弱、铁矿石库存增加令价格承压。LME合约规格确认该产品为以Argus评估为基础的现金结算期货。同期Mysteel的天津SS400 3毫米品种现货FOB评估为485美元/吨。两组价格的合约或商品口径不同。
items.summary_en: Kalkine attributed $478.50/t to the second-month LME China HRC FOB contract on 13 November and cited seasonal demand and high ore stocks as pressures. LME specifications identify the product as a cash-settled futures contract based on Argus pricing. Mysteel’s contemporaneous Tianjin FOB assessment for physical 3 mm SS400 coil was $485/t. The two prices measure different instruments.
items.impact_zh: 中东或北非询单请以实际牌号、装港和船期的可执行FOB报价为准。期货可观察方向；合同若引用指数，需写明价格发布方、品种和取价窗口。
items.impact_en: For Middle East or North Africa inquiries, use a firm quote matched to grade, load port and shipment window. Use futures as a market indicator. Define the publisher, product and pricing window for any index-linked contract.

items.title_zh: Vysus以海上风电钢结构为例测算英国CBAM成本，项目报价应按税号和排放数据单独核算
items.title_en: Vysus models UK CBAM costs for offshore-wind steel; project pricing depends on classification and emissions
items.title_original: UK CBAM: What does it mean for your business?
items.summary_zh: Vysus UK Limited于2026年11月16日在阿伯丁及格兰扁商会发布案例，假设一项海上风电工程进口约1.875万吨加工钢材，对应超过11.3万吨二氧化碳当量的隐含排放，测得初期英国CBAM负担约110万英镑，制度发展后潜在敞口约660万英镑。公开稿未披露各产品税号、排放取值、碳价、减免及远期测算期间。英国自2027年1月1日起对范围内商品实施CBAM，政府产品表列有英国税则品目7308的钢铁结构体及零部件等。
items.summary_en: On 16 November 2026, Vysus UK Limited published an illustrative offshore-wind case through the Aberdeen & Grampian Chamber of Commerce. Some 18,750 tonnes of imported fabricated steel were associated with more than 113,000 tCO₂e, an initial UK CBAM estimate of about £1.1 million and potential exposure of around £6.6 million as the scheme develops. The note does not disclose the tariff lines, emissions inputs, rate, relief or time horizon behind the estimate. UK CBAM starts on 1 January 2027. The government’s product list includes iron or steel structures and parts under heading 7308.
items.impact_zh: 对输英风电塔筒、支架及加工钢构，先与进口商核对成品英国税号及适用范围，再按拟进口季度、经核查实际排放或适用默认值测算。确定排放材料交付时点和合同成本分担。上述工程估值仅适用于Vysus的公开示例，项目报价仍需按本单产品和主管机关发布的季度税率核算。
items.impact_en: For towers, supports and fabricated steel for UK wind projects, confirm the finished-good commodity code and coverage with the importer. Price the shipment by import quarter using applicable verified actual emissions or default values. Agree on data delivery and contractual cost allocation. Build the quote from the order and published quarterly rates.

items.title_en: Indonesia opens interim review of anti-dumping duties on non-alloy hot-rolled coil from Kazakhstan and Belarus
items.title_original: Indonesia reviews anti-dumping duties on hot rolled steel from Kazakhstan and Belarus
items.summary_zh: 印尼反倾销委员会（KADI）2026年11月12日以情势变化为由启动期中复审，涉及白俄罗斯、哈萨克斯坦原产非合金热轧卷，覆盖18个印尼税目，包括7208.10.00、7208.25.00、7208.26.00、7208.27.11/19/91/99、7208.36.00、7208.37.00、7208.38.00、7208.39.10/20/30/40/90及ex 7208.90.10/20/90。KADI公告预计程序最长12个月。既有PMK第103/2024号及其修订第31/2026号的合并国别表对俄罗斯、哈萨克斯坦和白俄罗斯列出5.58%至20%的企业差异税率，其他企业为20%。本次复审覆盖其中两个原产地，KADI公告未调整税率。修订附表中中国企业的适用税率列为20%。
items.summary_en: KADI opened a changed-circumstances interim review on 12 November 2026 covering non-alloy hot-rolled coil from Belarus and Kazakhstan across 18 Indonesian tariff lines. KADI expects the investigation to run for no more than 12 months. Regulations PMK 103/2024 and 31/2026 list company-specific rates of 5.58% to 20% in the combined Russia, Kazakhstan and Belarus schedule, with 20% for other companies. The review covers two origins and announces no new rates. The amended schedule lists 20% for Chinese suppliers.
items.impact_zh: 中国同类热卷输印尼仍应按现行措施和实际报关产品核算。若复审降低哈萨克斯坦或白俄罗斯货源的到岸税负，相关规格可能对中国热卷报价形成更大竞争。请印尼进口商跟踪复审正式结果，再调整报价。
items.impact_en: Continue pricing Chinese coil into Indonesia under the current duty schedule and confirm product coverage with the importer. A reduced duty could make competing Kazakh or Belarusian coil more price-competitive. Track the official outcome before repricing.

items.title_en: Where extending the EU’s carbon border adjustment mechanism does – and does not – make sense
items.title_original: Where extending the EU’s carbon border adjustment mechanism does – and does not – make sense
items.summary_zh: 欧洲改革中心（CER）11月16日研究比较欧委会、理事会及欧洲议会CBAM下游扩围提案，统一编码后研究386类产品，其中378类数据足够；作者估算103类产品碳成本低且进口依赖不集中，33类同时达到其碳成本与集中依赖阈值。该分类和碳费估算属于智库模型，不是欧盟法律认定。三方拟于11月30日继续谈判，2028年适用仍属拟议安排。
items.summary_en: CER's 16 November analysis compares competing downstream CBAM proposals, grouping 386 products and assessing 378 with sufficient data. Its 103 low-risk and 33 dual-threshold findings are model estimates, not legal determinations. Negotiations are expected on 30 November; 2028 implementation remains proposed.
items.impact_zh: 对中国钢材出口的直接税率没有新增变化。若下游制品扩围，欧盟钢材加工客户与中国制成品供应商的碳成本、排放追溯和报价竞争可能改变。建议按最终CN清单跟踪冰箱、金属家具、机械零件等下游客户，切勿把CER估算当成实际CBAM应缴金额。
items.impact_en: No new duty is established for Chinese steel. A future extension may alter costs and reporting for downstream manufacturers; monitor the final CN list and avoid treating CER modelled charges as actual liabilities.

items.title_en: Kazakhstan prepares steel and aluminium exporters for EU CBAM; QazTrade denominates model results in euros
items.title_original: Kazakhstan’s exporters are being prepared to operate under CBAM
items.summary_zh: 哈萨克斯坦贸易和一体化部、生态和自然资源部与QazTrade在COP31讨论钢铝出口排放监测、报告及核证。该国政府称2025年对欧盟出口钢铁约39.63万吨、3.37亿欧元，铝约11.02万吨、2.74亿欧元。QazTrade披露，ITC与QazTrade在碳价80欧元/吨的假设下，对四个商品税目估算的默认值情景年成本最高约1.14亿欧元，经核证实际排放情景约5700万欧元。上一版金额币种写作美元，本次按研究参与方披露改为欧元。
items.summary_en: Kazakhstan’s trade and environment ministries and QazTrade used COP31 to discuss emissions monitoring, reporting and verification for steel and aluminium exporters. The government reports 396,318 tonnes of iron and steel exports to the EU in 2025, worth EUR 337 million, and 110,184 tonnes of aluminium, worth EUR 274 million. QazTrade cites an ITC/QazTrade model at EUR 80/tCO₂ for four tariff lines: annual exposure of up to EUR 114 million under defaults and about EUR 57 million for verified actual emissions. This corrects the currency in the prior entry.
items.impact_zh: 哈萨克斯坦钢厂核证实际排放后，在欧洲的竞争成本可能改善。比较板坯或长材报价时，按具体钢厂、产品和前驱体经核证排放测算，并让进口商核对适用免费配额调整和申报口径。模型总额不用于单吨报价。
items.impact_en: Verification could improve the competitiveness of Kazakh steel in Europe. Compare landed costs for slab or long products using verified mill, product and precursor emissions. Have the importer confirm the applicable free-allocation adjustment and reporting basis.

items.title_en: SMM iron ore stocks at 35 Chinese ports rose in mid-November, then eased to 153.45 million tonnes on 27 November
items.title_original: China Iron Ore Port Inventory Rises to 152.12 Mt by Mid-November 2026
items.summary_zh: IndexBox 11月16日文章援引上海有色网（SMM）：11月13日中国35个主要港口铁矿石库存为1.5212亿吨，日均疏港量308万吨。SMM同口径库存11月20日升至1.5375亿吨，11月27日降至1.5345亿吨，较前一周减少30万吨，仍比11月13日多133万吨。11月27日日均疏港量为302.5万吨。
items.summary_en: IndexBox’s 16 November article cited Shanghai Metals Market (SMM) data showing 152.12 million tonnes of iron ore at 35 major Chinese ports on 13 November and daily port withdrawals of 3.08 million tonnes. In the same series, stocks rose to 153.75 million tonnes on 20 November and eased to 153.45 million on 27 November, down 0.30 million on the week and still 1.33 million above 13 November. Daily withdrawals were 3.025 million tonnes on 27 November.
items.impact_zh: 库存可用于跟踪长流程钢厂原料采购。制定热轧及下游板卷出口报价时，结合现货矿价、焦炭成本、钢厂接单和交期判断，单次库存回落不足以支持调价。
items.impact_en: Use port stocks to monitor raw-material procurement conditions for blast-furnace producers. Consider spot ore prices, coke costs, mill order books and lead times when pricing hot-rolled and downstream flat steel for export. One weekly stock decline does not establish a pricing trend.
items.source_excerpt: China Iron Ore Port Inventory Rises to 152.12 Mt by Mid-November 2026 - News and Statistics IndexBox
items.coverage: 核对IndexBox全文（https://www.indexbox.io/blog/china-iron-ore-port-stocks-build-to-15212-million-tons-as-of-november-13/）及SMM原始35港数据。11月20日（https://news.metal.com/newscontent/WABPNANGSHRPEZ5RK2VQADAMRK2NZIOB3SAWQIQ-iron-ore-port-inventory-and-port-pick-up-volume-on-november-20-2026）和27日（https://steel.smm.cn/news/090/TLXFLI5DAULT6MHCV7A4GD7OPXUFXDONOBDE2FI）为同口径后续观察。中英文来源对11月13日增量的比较期间表述不一致，本条仅采绝对存量及疏港量，使用各日期绝对存量计算期间变化。

items.title_original: China’s steel exports find new routes amid rising trade barriers
items.summary_zh: 【事实】标普全球能源11月13日发布金属市场视频专题，指出面对不断增加的贸易壁垒，中国钢厂正更多关注钢坯等半成品、新出口目的地以及通过制成品实现的间接出口，以吸收国内需求疲弱下的钢材供给。官方公开页面列出上述三个趋势，但没有提供可独立核实的目的国吨数、增长率或具体税号；本条属于市场观察，不是新的关税或贸易法规。
items.summary_en: S&P Global's 13 November metals video highlights shifts to semis, new destination markets and indirect exports via manufactured goods as trade barriers rise. Its public description supplies no verified destination-level tonnage, tariff codes or new legal measure.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】钢材出口目的地和产品形态可能持续调整。中国钢厂可比较板坯/钢坯与成品卷板在不同市场的贸易救济、配额及CBAM成本，但不得将简单改报品名、第三国转运或轻加工视为合法规避原产地及反规避规则的手段。
items.impact_en: Mills should compare lawful export routes and products under destination-specific safeguards, anti-circumvention and carbon rules; transshipment alone does not change origin.

items.summary_zh: 中国日报11月13日网页原报道引述中钢协副会长兼秘书长蒋维在10月28日论坛称，极致能效工程涉及143家企业，过去三年累计节约标准煤超2400万吨、减少二氧化碳排放6000万吨。数据为协会发言所述项目汇总，报道未列各厂区和产品的核查数据。

items.title_zh: 意大利钢贸协会要求将欧盟CBAM小额豁免门槛从50吨提高至500吨
items.title_en: Assofermet asks EU to raise CBAM de minimis threshold from 50 to 500 tonnes
items.title_original: Assofermet calls on EU to raise CBAM exemption threshold to 500 tonnes
items.summary_zh: 【事实】意大利钢铁贸易、分销与加工行业协会Assofermet致函欧委会，建议将CBAM每进口商每年小额豁免门槛从50吨提高至500吨，理由是拟扩围至钢铝下游制成品后，中小进口商面临较高行政成本。协会还要求针对下游产品重新开展影响评估，研究差异化门槛和防规避措施。该要求属于行业倡议，欧盟尚未据此修改现行50吨门槛；欧洲议会有关扩围的修正案亦不等于最终生效法规。报道所称约500个新增类别及97%进口商豁免等均为协会/媒体口径，非本轮独立核实的最终法定范围。
items.summary_en: Italian steel distribution association Assofermet urged the Commission to raise the annual CBAM de minimis threshold from 50 to 500 tonnes per importer in view of proposed downstream steel/aluminium coverage. This is an industry request, not an adopted threshold change; downstream product scope remains subject to the legislative process.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】若未来获采纳，小批量钢制品进口商的CBAM合规负担可能下降；目前对中国钢材及制品出口欧盟的报价、客户年度进口量判断仍应沿用现行50吨规则，不得按500吨假设免税。
items.impact_en: No immediate change to CBAM obligations; use the current 50-tonne rule until legislation is formally amended.
items.status: 行业政策倡议／尚未立法
items.source_excerpt: Assofermet calls on EU to raise CBAM exemption threshold to 500 tonnes GMK Center
items.coverage: 2026-11-12核对BricoMagazine 11月11日意大利语原始报道、SteelOrbis及GMK Center报道，并对照欧盟理事会2025年50吨简化协议和2026年下游扩围谈判说明；未取得协会致函全文，具体协会估算和扩围清单仅有限覆盖。
items.follow_up: 跟踪欧盟理事会与议会就CBAM下游扩围的最终法案及豁免门槛；核对最终CN编码、产品重量计算与防规避规定。

items.summary_zh: 【事实】台湾中国钢铁公司（CSC）披露2026年第三季净利润约11.21亿新台币、基本每股盈余0.07；前三季净利润约7.44亿新台币、基本每股盈余0.05，较上年同期净亏损转正。Yieh Corp报道称中钢连续两个季度实现盈利，并将2026年12月月盘价每吨上调300新台币。财务业绩为已报告结果，12月价格调整属于内销报价，不能据此推断出口报价全线涨价。
items.summary_en: CSC reported Q3 net income near NT$1.121bn and nine-month net income near NT$743.7m, with nine-month EPS NT$0.05, turning from a prior-year loss. Reports also cite a NT$300/t rise in December domestic monthly steel prices.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】台湾主要钢厂盈利转正及连续调价可能提高东亚板卷报价韧性，但仍需分品种核对中国大陆钢厂对出口市场的竞争影响。
items.impact_en: Stronger regional mill financials may support Asian steel quotes, but export pricing must be verified by product.

items.title_zh: 意大利Ecomondo讨论欧盟CBAM与50%配额外税对钢材产业链的双向影响
items.title_en: Ecomondo speakers weigh EU CBAM and 50% out-of-quota steel duty
items.title_original: Ecomondo 2026: EU steel competitiveness under pressure as ETS and CBAM reshape market dynamics
items.summary_zh: 【事实】11月5日意大利Ecomondo活动上，siderweb及RICREA组织行业讨论，指出EU ETS免费配额逐步退出、CBAM和新钢铁进口限制将改变生产商、贸易商及下游加工商成本。与会者认为进口压力减弱可能改善欧盟钢厂盈利，但能源、碳成本和下游竞争力仍受挤压。欧盟委员会官方文件确认2026年7月1日起年度免税钢材配额1830万吨，配额外税率50%。会议观点不等于新增法规。
items.summary_en: At the 5 Nov Ecomondo industry conference, speakers said EU CBAM, phased ETS free-allocation changes and tighter steel trade measures may support mills but increase downstream costs. Official EU guidance confirms the 18.3 Mt annual quota and 50% above-quota duty effective 1 July 2026; the conference itself created no new law.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】欧洲钢贸与加工中心可能面临库存成本、碳成本及替代进口制品压力，首钢钢卷订单应同时评估配额、CBAM和终端客户定价权。
items.impact_en: Assess combined quota, CBAM and distributor margin effects instead of treating conference views as legal amendments.
items.source_excerpt: Ecomondo 2026: EU steel competitiveness under pressure as ETS and CBAM reshape market dynamics SteelOrbis
items.follow_up: 与德国、意大利钢贸客户确认2027年报价能否转嫁配额外关税和CBAM；以欧盟最新法条核对实际产品范围。
items.coverage: 2026-11-07阅读全文核对SteelOrbis 11月6日Ecomondo报道，并交叉查验欧委会官方钢铁新措施页面；演讲意见明确标为行业观点。

items.title_zh: 台湾中钢12月内销热冷轧、镀锌产品月价每吨上调300新台币

items.title_original: Taiwan's China Steel Raises December Domestic Steel Prices by NT$300 Across the Board, Citing Stronger Global Steel Prices and Rising Export Orders
items.summary_zh: 【事实】Yieh Corp 11月5日报道，台湾中国钢铁公司（CSC）宣布2026年12月月度计价产品统一上调300新台币/吨，涉及一般热轧板卷、轧制用热卷、一般冷轧卷、电镀锌及建筑/预涂用途热镀锌产品。报道归因于国际价格、出口订单及新台币变化。该信息是台湾内销定价，不是台湾进口税率变更。
items.summary_en: Yieh reported CSC's NT$300/t Dec 2026 monthly domestic price increase for selected HRC, CRC, electrogalvanized and hot-dip galvanized products. The announcement concerns domestic prices, not Taiwan import duties.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】对东亚镀锌、冷轧卷价格谈判具有区域市场参考意义，但需单独核实出口报价和中国大陆客户竞争状态。

items.title_zh: 印尼Krakatau与青山推动120万吨/年不锈钢板坯项目
items.title_en: Krakatau and Tsingshan advance 1.2 Mtpa stainless slab project at Morowali
items.title_original: [SMM Stainless Steel Flash] Indonesia’s Krakatau Steel details stainless slab project with Tsingshan at Morowali
items.summary_zh: 【事实】SMM 11月5日报道，印尼国企Krakatau Steel在10月下旬论坛介绍：其与青山在Morowali印尼工业园（IMIP）筹建镍基不锈钢板坯生产项目，目标年产能120万吨，投资估计3.5亿美元；报道称已于4月底动工。报道还提及Krakatau与印度SAIL在7月签署不锈钢板坯合资意向备忘录。投资、收入均为项目规划或估计，非已投产产量。
items.summary_en: SMM reports Krakatau Steel's Morowali stainless slab plan with Tsingshan: 1.2 Mt/year proposed capacity and roughly US$350m investment; groundbreaking was reportedly in April. Planned figures are not verified current output.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】印尼依托镍资源的不锈钢板坯产能扩张可能改变亚洲板坯供给，但不能直接与首钢普碳板坯产能或欧洲碳钢订单混同。
items.impact_en: Monitor Southeast Asian stainless slab supply separately from carbon-steel slab markets.

items.title_zh: 台湾地区研议本地CBAM及排放交易机制：钢材进口碳成本尚无正式新税率
items.title_en: Taiwan discusses domestic CBAM and emissions trading; no enacted new steel import rate confirmed
items.title_original: Taiwan plans to develop its own CBAM
items.summary_zh: 【事实】GMK Center 2026年11月4日报道，台湾地区当局正研究本地碳边境调节机制和排放交易制度。台湾环境主管部门2026年1月官方政策材料已说明正在规划借鉴欧盟的产品碳排放申报试点，水泥优先，并将与钢铁业讨论后续机制。现行对大型排放源的碳费与拟议的进口CBAM是不同制度；目前核验到的官方材料不构成已经公布对进口钢材征收新CBAM税率、正式生效日期或完整HS税号清单的证据。
items.summary_en: GMK Center reported on 4 November that Taiwan is considering its own CBAM and emissions trading framework. Taiwan's environmental ministry had already described a planned product-emissions declaration pilot in January, initially focused on cement and with steel-sector consultations to follow. Existing domestic carbon fees and a proposed import CBAM are distinct. The reviewed official material does not establish an enacted steel-import CBAM rate, commencement date or tariff-code scope.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】向台湾地区出口冷轧、镀锌、彩涂及其他钢材的企业应关注产品级碳足迹申报和后续进口碳成本制度，但现阶段不应在报价中直接加入未经公布的“台湾CBAM税”。可先准备产品碳排放核算与装置数据，等待主管部门正式草案、商品范围、豁免和时间表。
items.impact_en: Steel exporters should monitor product-level emissions declarations and potential future import carbon costs, but should not apply a hypothetical Taiwan CBAM levy to current quotations. Prepare auditable emissions data and wait for an official legal text, tariff scope and effective date.
items.status: 政策规划／尚非进口钢材新税
items.source_excerpt: Taiwan plans to develop its own CBAM GMK Center
items.coverage: 2026-11-04阅读全文核对GMK Center 11月4日报道，并交叉查阅台湾环境主管部门2026年1月英文政策材料关于水泥试点和钢铁协商的原文；未取得2026-11-04当日新增法令、税率或实施日期的官方原文，故仅作规划级有限结论。
items.follow_up: 跟踪台湾环境主管部门及经济主管部门正式法规草案、钢铁产品适用清单和申报试点进度；对客户询价仅披露政策不确定性。

items.title_zh: 中国钢铁业由规模转向质量：前三季产量下降、板材占比与高端需求上升
items.title_en: China's steelmaking pivots to quality as output and demand diverge
items.title_original: China’s steel industry is shifting to a quality-driven growth model
items.summary_zh: 【事实】GMK Center 11月4日转述中国日报和中钢协数据：2026年前三季度钢产量约7.25亿吨，同比下降2.9%；国内消费约6.25亿吨，下降3.8%；主要钢企合计利润约718亿元，同比下降27.4%。报道指出基建地产用材弱于机械制造，高性能及专用钢成为产品结构调整方向；9个月钢材出口量约8564万吨，同比下降2.6%。上述是行业统计及政策方向，不是出口税或配额公告。
items.summary_en: GMK, drawing on China Daily and CISA data, reported nine-month steel output of roughly 725 Mt (-2.9% y/y), consumption of 625 Mt (-3.8%) and leading producers' profit around CNY71.8bn (-27.4%). Steelmakers are shifting toward specialist higher-value grades. This is industry analysis, not a new tariff.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】首钢汽车板、家电板、高强钢产品与高端需求契合，但行业高端化未必形成全面溢价；需结合欧洲客户认证周期与出口净回款测算竞争力。
items.impact_en: Product-mix upgrading supports differentiated automotive and advanced steels but does not ensure margin expansion.
items.source_excerpt: China’s steel industry is shifting to a quality-driven growth model GMK Center
items.follow_up: 跟进中钢协正式统计口径及汽车板出口净售价，避免将行业报道等同正式新出口政策。
items.coverage: 2026-11-07核对GMK Center 11月4日原始报道和中国日报/中钢协数据引用；尚未独立取得所有月度统计原表，统计按注明来源的媒体分析披露。

items.title_zh: Isometric推出Ready for CBAM：为钢铁等六大行业提供排放数据整理与核验准备服务
items.title_en: Isometric launches Ready for CBAM emissions-data preparation service for six sectors
items.title_original: Isometric Launches New CBAM Data Preparation and Reporting Service for Exporters
items.summary_zh: 【事实】Isometric于2026年11月3日宣布推出Ready for CBAM服务，面向向欧盟出口水泥、钢铁、铝、化肥、氢及电力的企业，帮助编制装置级排放监测计划和排放报告，在正式核验前使用软件检查数据、由专家复核，并协助处理核验机构提出的问题。公司称Cementir已使用该服务。该服务是商业数据准备与核验支持方案，**不等于欧盟主管机关认可的独立核验机构资质，也不是欧盟新出台的CBAM规则**。欧盟进口商须为2026年进口货物在2027年9月30日前申报；使用实际排放值需要符合适用核验要求。
items.summary_en: Isometric announced its Ready for CBAM service on 3 November 2026 to help exporters in the six CBAM sectors prepare plant-level monitoring plans and emissions reports, detect data gaps and support the subsequent verification process. Cementir is an early customer. This is a commercial preparation service, not itself evidence of accredited independent verification or a new EU legal requirement. The first 2026-import CBAM declarations are due by 30 September 2027.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】中国钢厂可把此类服务视为准备监测计划、排放因子及证据链的工具，但须分别审查数据保密、核算方法、核验人独立性和欧盟认可资质。尤其不应把“Ready for CBAM”服务商的预审等同于最终核验报告；可将其作为现有第三方核验方案的备选，而非直接替换。
items.impact_en: Steel mills may use such providers for emissions-data readiness and audit trails, subject to confidentiality, methodology and independence checks. Preparation support must not be mistaken for final verification by an accredited verifier.
items.status: 商业服务发布／非新法规

items.coverage: 2026-11-04核对Isometric 11月3日公司原始发布及ESG Today、Agg-Net两家同期报道；已区分数据准备服务与法定独立核验，未审查Isometric或合作方的具体认可核验资质。

items.title_en: India's Apr–Sep steel exports to EU decline 19.8%, causal impact of quota/CBAM not isolated
items.title_original: [India's H1 steel exports to EU fall ~20% YoY as EU quotas tighten and CBAM applies]
items.summary_zh: 【事实】SMM 11月3日转述印度商务部贸易数据分析：2026年4—9月印度对欧盟钢铁出口约153万吨，同比下降19.8%，其中9月约19.74万吨，同比下降50.4%；同期向非洲和美洲出口增长。欧委会官方确认2026年7月1日起新钢铁配额总量约1830万吨、配额外关税50%。但贸易数据本身不能证明9月下降全部由配额或CBAM导致，也未逐产品核对具体配额耗尽情况。
items.summary_en: SMM's analysis of Indian trade figures puts Apr–Sep 2026 EU-bound iron/steel exports at 1.53 Mt, -19.8% y/y; September fell about 50%. The EU confirms a new steel quota regime from 1 July 2026, but the shipment decline cannot be causally attributed solely to quotas or CBAM without product-level evidence.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】印度钢材可能向非洲、美洲分流，并加剧与中国出口竞争；对欧报价要核对实际产品类别、国家份额、配额占用和CBAM排放成本，而非用总量反推单品种税负。
items.impact_en: Monitor diversion to Africa/Americas and product-specific EU quota consumption; avoid causal overstatement.
items.status: 贸易数据／非单因果结论

items.summary_zh: 【事实】Scaffmag 11月2日刊登Tube Industries负责人Trevor Inns的企业成本专栏：其脚手架钢管到岸成本指数由夏季77升至81（2023年6月=100），主要受运费和英镑影响；作者结合当时HMRC示例CBAM费率，估算2027年第一季度相关管材成本可能净增约6%。文中“每吨钢均征收CBAM”等概括不是法律精确范围；估算值非HMRC最终公布的税率。
items.summary_en: Tube Industries' Nov 2 column says its UK scaffold-tube landed-cost index rose from 77 to 81, driven by freight/FX. The author models a roughly 6% net 2027-Q1 cost rise using indicative CBAM rates. This is a private scenario, not HMRC's definitive tariff or product classification.

items.impact_en: Separate freight, FX and legal CBAM liability in UK tube quotations; verify commodity codes and final rates.

items.title_zh: 印度钢铁对欧盟出口量上半财年降19.8%，对美洲和非洲出口转增
items.title_en: India's steel exports to the EU fall 19.8% as shipments shift toward the Americas and Africa
items.title_original: India's steel exports to EU fall 20% amid CBAM, quotas; Americas surge 262%, Africa 96%
items.summary_zh: Moneycontrol按印度商务部数据分析称，2026/27财年4—9月印度对欧盟钢铁出口量由上年同期191万吨降至153万吨，同比下降19.8%；出口额由17.9亿美元降至14.8亿美元，下降17%。9月出口量同比下降50.4%至197,433吨，是二季度出口收缩的主要来源。同期对非洲出口量增长96%、出口额增长76.5%至3.342亿美元；对美洲出口量增长262%、出口额增长117.1%至14.2亿美元。欧盟2026/1384号条例及2026/1457号实施条例确认，7月1日起26类钢材年度免附加税配额总量为18,345,922吨，超配额附加税率为50%；但贸易数据本身不能证明印度某一产品配额已在9月耗尽，也不能把出口下降全部归因于配额或CBAM。
items.summary_en: Moneycontrol's analysis of Indian commerce-ministry data says April–September 2026/27 steel exports to the EU fell 19.8% by volume to 1.53Mt from 1.91Mt and 17% by value to USD1.48bn. September volume fell 50.4% year on year to 197,433t. Over the same period, volumes to Africa rose 96% and to the Americas 262%. EU Regulations 2026/1384 and 2026/1457 confirm an annual 18,345,922t quota across 26 categories and a 50% out-of-quota duty from 1 July, but the trade data do not prove that a particular Indian product quota was exhausted or that quotas and CBAM caused the entire decline.
items.impact_zh: 印度出口向美洲和非洲加速转移，可能增加中国钢材在这些市场的价格、交期和贸易救济竞争；中国出口商应按目的国、产品和季度跟踪印度流量、当地进口措施及自身利润，不能把印度总量变化直接套用于中国订单。对欧业务仍须逐产品核对欧盟季度配额余额、50%超配额附加税及CBAM产品排放数据；本条没有形成新的中国适用税率或配额。
items.impact_en: India's shift toward the Americas and Africa may intensify price, delivery and trade-remedy competition for Chinese steel in those markets. Chinese exporters should track flows by destination, product and quarter rather than extrapolate India's aggregate data to their own orders. EU sales still require product-level quota, 50% out-of-quota duty and CBAM data checks; this report creates no new China-specific rate or quota.
items.status: 媒体贸易数据分析／非新规
items.source_excerpt: India's steel exports to EU fall 20% amid CBAM, quotas; Americas surge 262%, Africa 96% Moneycontrol.com
items.coverage: 2026-11-02已通读Moneycontrol全文，核对4—9月、9月及地区流向的数量、金额和同比变化；并与欧盟2026/1384、2026/1457号法规核对18,345,922吨总配额、26类产品、7月1日适用及50%超配额附加税。印度贸易明细为媒体对商务部数据的分析，未逐行复算印度官方底表，也未确认9月具体产品配额是否耗尽。

items.title_zh: 中国铁水产量降幅小于预期，铁矿石期价小幅反弹但四季度供应压力仍在
items.title_en: Iron ore edges higher as China's hot-metal decline proves smaller than expected
items.title_original: Iron-Ore Prices Rise After Sharp Declines as Chinese Demand Holds Up
items.summary_zh: 11月2日市场报道显示，大商所主力铁矿石合约在北京时间早盘上涨0.59%至679元/吨，新交所12月合约上涨0.61%至91.3美元/吨；此前两者在9月和10月均连续下跌。Mysteel样本钢厂截至10月29日的日均铁水产量环比仅下降0.2%至约232万吨，降幅小于市场对检修、亏损及北方环保减产的预期。国信期货认为价格接近支撑位后情绪有所恢复，但四季度供应过剩和钢厂盈利偏弱仍限制上行。同期上期所螺纹钢、热卷分别下跌0.59%和0.57%，不锈钢上涨0.34%。
items.summary_en: A 2 November market report said DCE iron ore rose 0.59% to CNY679/t and SGX December iron ore gained 0.61% to USD91.3/t after two monthly declines. Mysteel's surveyed daily hot-metal output fell only 0.2% week on week to about 2.32Mt as of 29 October, less than expected despite maintenance, weak margins and temporary northern output cuts. Guoxin Futures saw support-level stabilisation, while Q4 surplus risk and weak mill margins still capped upside. SHFE rebar and HRC fell 0.59% and 0.57%, while stainless rose 0.34%.
items.impact_zh: 本次反弹主要反映铁水降幅不及预期和技术性支撑，不能据此判断钢材终端需求或出口订单已转强。中国钢厂应把铁水、利润、港口库存和到港量共同纳入采购节奏，避免用单日DCE/SGX涨幅锁定中长期矿价；出口报价仍应基于钢材实际成本、汇率和目标市场贸易措施。
items.impact_en: The move reflects a smaller-than-expected hot-metal decline and technical support, not proof of stronger end demand or export orders. Mills should combine hot-metal output, margins, inventories and arrivals when planning ore purchases rather than extrapolate one trading session.

items.title_original: 今年前三季度 我国钢铁品种不断调整优化
items.summary_zh: 央视网稿件经中新网转载显示，2026年前三季度中国粗钢产量7.25亿吨；中板产量同比增加491万吨，是增量最大品种，钢筋产量同比减少1718万吨，是减量最大品种。制造业用钢占比在2025年首次超过建筑业、达到51%，2026年上半年升至52%。同期钢材出口8564万吨、同比下降2.6%，出口均价709美元／吨、上升1.8%，进口钢材407万吨、下降10.5%。截至9月底，307家钢企完成或部分完成超低排放改造和评估监测，其中282家全过程完成、涉及粗钢产能约9.4亿吨；143家企业、7.5亿吨粗钢产能参加极致能效培育，三年累计节能超过2400万吨标准煤、减排二氧化碳6000万吨。
items.summary_en: A CCTV report republished by China News Service says China produced 725Mt of crude steel in January-September 2026. Plate output rose 4.91Mt year on year, the largest product increase, while rebar fell 17.18Mt, the largest decline. Manufacturing's share of steel use first exceeded construction in 2025 at 51% and reached 52% in H1 2026. Steel exports were 85.64Mt (-2.6%) at an average USD 709/t (+1.8%), while imports fell 10.5% to 4.07Mt. By end-September, 307 mills had completed all or part of ultra-low-emission retrofits and assessment, including 282 fully completed sites covering about 940Mt of crude-steel capacity. CISA's three-year efficiency programme involved 143 firms and 750Mt of capacity, reporting more than 24Mtce of energy savings and 60Mt of CO2 reductions.
items.impact_zh: 中板增、钢筋减以及制造业用钢占比上升，说明需求和产品结构正从地产相关长材向制造业板材、高性能和特种钢倾斜；钢厂应按真实订单、认证周期和产品盈利调整品种，而不是把协会数据理解为行政性品种配额。出口量下降、均价上升也不等同于所有企业利润改善。超低排放和节能数据是中钢协汇总口径，不能直接作为单厂、单产品的CBAM实际排放值或第三方核查结果；出口企业仍需建立产品级排放数据和可验证证据链。
items.impact_en: Higher plate and lower rebar output, together with a rising manufacturing share, point to a shift from property-linked long products toward manufacturing plate and higher-specification steel. Mills should adjust their mix against real orders, qualification cycles and margins rather than treat association data as an administrative quota. Lower export volume and a higher average price do not prove better margins for every producer. CISA's aggregate retrofit and energy-saving figures are not installation- or product-level CBAM actual emissions or third-party verification; exporters still need auditable product data.
items.status: 行业协会数据／媒体转述
items.source_excerpt: 今年前三季度 我国钢铁品种不断调整优化 中国新闻网
items.follow_up: 跟踪四季度中板、钢筋产量与制造业用钢占比；如用于CBAM或绿色采购，另行核对企业级核查报告和产品碳数据。
items.coverage: 2026-11-01已通读中新网转载的央视网全文，核对中板、钢筋、制造业用钢占比、进出口、超低排放改造和极致能效数据；稿件将数据归于中钢协，未提供企业清单、逐厂核查报告或产品级排放明细，因此按行业协会汇总数据和媒体转述呈现。

items.title_zh: 意大利铸造业协会称欧盟钢铁配额和CBAM造成上下游成本不对称
items.title_en: Italian foundry association says EU steel quotas and CBAM create an upstream-downstream cost asymmetry
items.title_original: Steel: Confimi’s Italian foundries take on Brussels – tariffs and the CBAM are hurting the supply chain
items.summary_zh: Eunews完整报道及Confimi Industria Meccanica声明称，参加帕多瓦会议的铸造和机械企业中“近30%”出现订单下降；协会认为，原材料钢进口超过欧盟配额后承担50%从价税，而部分半成品、铸件和下游部件未受到同等贸易防御或CBAM约束，造成成本不对称。协会主席Flavio Lorenzin还称，自2025年11月以来，碳钢、不锈钢和铝成本平均分别上升13%、16%和37%，并要求调整进口税、能源和监管成本，同时在CBAM谈判中纳入半成品、铸件和部件。官方交叉核对确认：Regulation (EU) 2026/1384自2026年7月1日起实施18.3百万吨年度免税配额及配额外50%税率；CBAM下游扩围仍是2025/0419(COD)立法提案，不能把协会诉求写成已通过规则。
items.summary_en: Eunews and Confimi Industria Meccanica report that nearly 30% of foundry and engineering companies represented at a Padua event had lost orders. The association argues that the 50% out-of-quota steel duty and CBAM leave some semi-finished goods, castings and components outside equivalent treatment, creating a cost asymmetry. It cites average cost increases since November 2025 of 13% for carbon steel, 16% for stainless steel and 37% for aluminium. Official checks confirm that Regulation (EU) 2026/1384 applies an 18.3Mt annual quota and 50% out-of-quota duty from 1 July 2026; downstream CBAM expansion remains proposal 2025/0419(COD), not adopted law.
items.impact_zh: 这是意大利行业协会的调查和政策立场，不是欧盟对损失订单、成本涨幅或扩围范围的官方认定。对中国钢厂而言，现行钢铁配额外50%税率已构成实际市场准入约束；同时，若未来CBAM扩大到更多下游制成品，原材料与部件之间的成本差可能收窄。出口商应按CN产品类别和配额余额核价，并跟踪2025/0419(COD)最终附件；不能根据协会发言预设半成品或部件已纳入CBAM。
items.impact_en: This is an association survey and policy position, not an EU finding on lost orders, cost inflation or final CBAM scope. Chinese exporters already face the 50% out-of-quota steel duty where quotas are exhausted. They should price by CN category and quota balance and monitor the final annex to 2025/0419(COD), without assuming downstream goods are already covered.
items.source_excerpt: Steel: Confimi’s Italian foundries take on Brussels – tariffs and the CBAM are hurting the supply chain Eunews
items.follow_up: 跟踪2025/0419(COD)三方谈判及最终CN附件，并核对欧盟各钢铁产品配额余额；协会所称订单和成本数据仅作行业样本信号。
items.coverage: 2026-10-31已通读Eunews英文全文并核对Confimi原始声明摘要；另以Regulation (EU) 2026/1384、Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1457及EUR-Lex程序2025/0419(COD)核对50%配额外税率和CBAM扩围法律状态。未获得“近30%”及13%/16%/37%的样本量、计算方法或企业明细，故只按协会陈述呈现。

items.title_zh: 中国35港铁矿石库存升至1.4805亿吨，日均疏港量回落
items.title_en: China's 35-port iron ore stocks reach 148.05Mt as daily port pick-up slows
items.title_original: China Iron Ore Port Stocks Rise to 148.05 Million Tons as Demand Softens
items.summary_zh: SMM 10月30日数据显示，中国35个主要港口铁矿石库存为1.4805亿吨，环比增加30万吨；日均疏港量减少3.5万吨至317.5万吨。本周港口到货明显增加，而钢厂高炉铁水产量下降，下游采购偏谨慎，供需边际走弱并带来小幅累库。SMM预计下一周钢厂需求仍偏弱、铁水产量可能继续下降，疏港量难明显改善，港口库存或继续增加；这一段属于机构短期判断，不是已发生的确定结果。
items.summary_en: SMM data for 30 October put iron ore inventories across 35 major Chinese ports at 148.05Mt, up 0.30Mt on the reported comparison, while average daily port pick-up fell by 0.035Mt to 3.175Mt. Port arrivals rose notably during the week, blast-furnace hot-metal output declined and downstream purchasing remained cautious, producing a slight inventory build. SMM expects subdued mill demand, potentially lower hot-metal output and little improvement in port pick-up next week, but that is a short-term forecast rather than an observed outcome.
items.impact_zh: 35港口径的库存上升、疏港回落和铁水下降共同显示钢厂补库意愿偏弱，短期不利于铁矿石需求和价格支撑。钢厂可继续按生产节奏和边际利润安排刚需采购，贸易商应同步跟踪港口到货、钢厂利润、铁水复产及成材需求。该数据来自SMM模型和市场调研，并非海关或统计局官方数据；也不能与其他机构覆盖港口数量不同的库存口径直接比较。
items.impact_en: Rising stocks on SMM's 35-port measure, slower port pick-up and lower hot-metal output point to weak mill restocking and softer near-term support for ore demand and prices. Mills can keep procurement aligned with production and marginal profitability, while traders should monitor arrivals, mill margins, hot-metal restarts and finished-steel demand. These are SMM market-research data, not customs or official statistical data, and should not be compared directly with inventory series covering a different port universe.
items.source_excerpt: China Iron Ore Port Stocks Rise to 148.05 Million Tons as Demand Softens - News and Statistics IndexBox
items.coverage: 2026-10-31已通读SMM原始页面正文，核对35港覆盖范围、库存、环比变化、日均疏港量及供需解释；IndexBox仅作为发现线索。SMM声明其数据结合公开信息、市场沟通和内部数据库模型，故按行业数据呈现，不冒充中国官方统计。
items.follow_up: 下周复核SMM 35港库存、疏港量和铁水变化，并与其他机构口径分开记录。

items.title_zh: Fastmarkets：CBAM可能扩大高品位铁矿石价值差，核证数据优先于矿石品位优化
items.title_en: Fastmarkets: CBAM may widen high-grade iron ore value gap, but verified data comes first
items.title_original: How CBAM will widen the premium for high-grade iron ore
items.summary_zh: Fastmarkets建模认为，高品位矿可减少渣量、熔剂、焦炭或电耗及铁损，CBAM与欧盟ETS免费配额在2026—2038年逐步退出可能放大其价值。在其敏感性情景中，DRI-EAF由67.5% Fe球团改用65% Fe球团，2026年非碳成本约增加41欧元/吨热轧卷，到2035年约85欧元/吨；相应额外CBAM成本按其碳价和政策假设约由1欧元增至13欧元/吨。BF-BOF路线使用较低品位矿的额外排放约25千克CO₂/吨热轧卷，额外CBAM成本模型值约为2026年2欧元、2030年3欧元、2035年7欧元/吨。上述均为行业模型结果，不是欧盟法定加价或所有中国钢材的税额。欧盟官方规则确认：钢铁使用默认值时，2026、2027、2028年及以后分别加成10%、20%、30%。
items.summary_en: Fastmarkets models how higher-grade ore can reduce slag, fluxes, coke or electricity use and iron losses, with CBAM and the 2026–2038 phase-out of EU ETS free allocation potentially widening the value gap. Its DRI-EAF sensitivity puts the non-carbon penalty from switching 67.5% Fe pellets to 65% at about EUR41/t HRC in 2026 and EUR85/t by 2035, with additional modelled CBAM cost rising from about EUR1 to EUR13/t. For BF-BOF, it models roughly 25kg CO2/t HRC of extra emissions and additional CBAM cost of EUR2 in 2026, EUR3 in 2030 and EUR7 in 2035. These are model outputs, not statutory EU surcharges or universal China rates. Official EU rules apply default-value mark-ups of 10% in 2026, 20% in 2027 and 30% from 2028 for iron and steel.
items.impact_zh: 对中国高炉—转炉及DRI/EAF钢厂，第一优先不是为CBAM盲目追高品位矿，而是取得欧盟可接受的装置级及产品级实际排放核证；使用默认值时，企业自身的矿石优化不会直接反映在申报排放值中。完成核证后，再把矿价、成材率、渣量、焦比或电耗、实际排放、EU ETS价格和合同责任纳入同一测算。文中的2、7、13、41和85欧元/吨均不能直接套用于首钢或任何具体订单。
items.impact_en: For Chinese BF-BOF and DRI/EAF producers, securing acceptable verified installation and product emissions data comes before paying blindly for higher-grade ore. If defaults are used, a producer's own ore optimisation is not reflected directly in the declared value. After verification, compare ore premiums against yield, slag, coke or electricity use, actual emissions, ETS prices and contractual responsibility. The article's EUR figures cannot be applied directly to a specific mill or order.
items.source_excerpt: How CBAM will widen the premium for high-grade iron ore Fastmarkets
items.coverage: 2026-10-30已通读Fastmarkets全文，核对两条工艺路线、矿石品位、成本与排放敏感性数字；并对照欧委会CBAM立法指南、实施条例(EU) 2025/2621（经(EU) 2026/1740修正）及欧盟气候行动页面核实默认值加成和2026—2038免费配额退出区间。未独立审计Fastmarkets模型底稿、矿价和碳价假设，所有前瞻数字均按情景而非确定税额处理。
items.follow_up: 继续跟踪欧委会对默认值、基准值、核证方法及免费配额调整的正式修订；如模型假设或欧盟法规变化，按新版本重算，不能沿用本文情景值。

items.title_zh: 首钢股份三季度转亏：前三季归母净利同比下降69.87%，采购现金支出增加
items.title_en: Beijing Shougang swings to a Q3 loss; nine-month attributable profit falls 69.87%
items.title_original: Beijing Shougang Co : Q3 swung to a net loss as weaker steel profitability drove sharp YTD earnings and cash-flow declines
items.summary_zh: 首钢股份正式发布2026年第三季度报告（未经审计）。第三季度营业收入248.34亿元，同比增加0.36%；归母净亏损2.61亿元，上年同期经重述为盈利2.99亿元；扣非净亏损2.55亿元。前三季营业收入757.54亿元，同比下降2.04%；归母净利润2.89亿元，同比下降69.87%；扣非净利润2.69亿元，同比下降72.80%；经营活动现金流净额11.22亿元，同比下降79.55%。公司称利润下滑主要因钢材产品吨钢利润及参股企业盈利水平降低；经营现金流下滑主要因支持采购市场运作的现金支付增加，预付款增加还受煤、焦炭价格上涨影响。报告未披露新增产能、停产安排或出口计划。
items.summary_en: Beijing Shougang's unaudited Q3 2026 report shows quarterly revenue of RMB24.834bn, up 0.36%, and an attributable net loss of RMB260.7m versus a restated RMB298.9m profit a year earlier. Nine-month revenue fell 2.04% to RMB75.754bn; attributable profit fell 69.87% to RMB288.9m, adjusted profit fell 72.80% to RMB268.8m, and operating cash flow fell 79.55% to RMB1.122bn. The company cited lower per-ton steel profitability and investee earnings, while higher procurement-related cash payments reduced operating cash flow. The report discloses no new capacity, shutdown or export plan.
items.impact_zh: 这是主要钢企经营信号，不是贸易政策。中国钢厂和出口业务不应把单季亏损直接转化为确定的减产或涨价判断；应跟踪吨钢利润、煤焦成本、采购现金占用以及后续产销安排。涉及欧盟或其他海外订单，仍须按具体产品、合同、配额、贸易救济和CBAM成本独立报价。在公司披露产量、出口或供应策略前，不能据本报告推断供应收缩。
items.impact_en: This is a corporate operating signal, not a trade rule. Do not infer definite production cuts or price rises from one quarterly loss. items.title_en: Shougang Jingtang plans September 2027 startup for No. 2 slab-caster revamp
items.title_original: Shougang Jingtang selects Primetals for slab caster revamp to improve automotive steel quality
items.summary_zh: Primetals Technologies 10月29日公告称，首钢京唐选择其对河北曹妃甸基地2号双流板坯连铸机实施全面改造，目标是提高汽车钢板坯中心质量、后续轧制质量、浇铸速度和生产率，计划于2027年9月投运。项目包括DynaGap Soft Reduction、LevCon结晶器液位控制、带水平段干式浇铸能力的新导向段、EcoStar Spiral辊及Level 1/Level 2自动化系统。现有设备半径9.5米，冶金长度39.5米、未来可延长至44.26米；板坯规格250毫米×1100—2150毫米，最高浇铸速度1.7米／分钟。公告未披露合同金额、改造后年产能或确定的新增产量。
items.summary_en: Primetals Technologies said on 29 October that Shougang Jingtang selected it for a comprehensive revamp of the No. 2 two-strand slab caster at Caofeidian, with startup scheduled for September 2027. The project adds DynaGap Soft Reduction, LevCon mold-level control, a new strand guide with horizontal dry casting, EcoStar Spiral rolls and new Level 1/2 automation. Existing specifications include a 9.5m radius, 39.5m metallurgical length (44.26m future extension), 250mm by 1,100–2,150mm slabs and speeds up to 1.7m/min. No contract value or post-revamp annual capacity was disclosed.
items.impact_zh: 改造重点是汽车钢板坯质量和过程稳定性，可能提升首钢京唐在汽车外板、内板等高附加值产品上的成材率和一致性，但公告不足以证明新增产能或2027年前供应量变化。汽车钢采购方可在2027年投运和认证阶段关注质量指标、客户验证及爬坡进度；竞争分析不得把设备最高速度或未来冶金长度直接换算成年产量。
items.impact_en: The revamp targets slab quality and process stability for automotive grades and may improve yield and consistency, but the release does not establish added capacity or near-term supply changes. Buyers should monitor commissioning, customer qualification and ramp-up in 2027; equipment speed and metallurgical length should not be converted directly into annual output.

items.title_zh: 印度学者建议为中小企业建立英欧CBAM编码、排放核算与核证支持体系
items.title_en: Indian policy commentary calls for SME support on UK and EU CBAM data and verification
items.title_original: CBAM: Let's get ready
items.summary_zh: 印度贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁大学学者Amita Batra的评论认为，英欧CBAM对中小出口企业的主要障碍是商品编码映射、供应链排放计量、核证能力和碳价减免证明，建议政府或行业协会提供基础设施、培训、技术和融资支持。经官方交叉核对：英国CBAM将于2027年1月1日覆盖铝、水泥、化肥、氢、钢铁；印度CCTS列入英国现行合格碳定价机制清单，但减免仍取决于实际应付碳价及合格证据；间接排放最早到2029年才纳入。英国法规要求核查机构独立并由合格认可机构认可，文章将“Global Accreditation Cooperation正式成员”的要求直接写到核查人员身上并不准确。欧盟证书自2027年2月起购买，首份2026年度申报和证书清缴截止2027年9月30日。文中“180多种下游产品拟扩围”属于政策进程表述，不代表已经纳入现行范围。
items.summary_en: Amita Batra argues that SMEs need public or industry support for product-code mapping, value-chain emissions measurement, verification, finance and training. Official checks confirm that UK CBAM starts on 1 January 2027 and India's CCTS is on the qualifying carbon-pricing list, but relief still depends on actual payable carbon costs and evidence. Indirect emissions are delayed until at least 2029. The article conflates verifier and accreditation-body eligibility: UK law requires an independent verifier accredited by an eligible accreditation body. EU certificates go on sale from February 2027 and the first 2026 declaration/surrender deadline is 30 September 2027. Proposed downstream expansion is not current scope.
items.impact_zh: 对中国中小钢企同样适用的动作是：先按英欧各自8位编码建立产品清单，将工厂、工艺、前体材料、排放年度和客户逐项映射；再选择认可范围覆盖相应钢铁活动的核查机构，并保存境外碳价实际支付证明。英国与欧盟的口径、期限和减免机制不能混成一套模板。行业评论可作为能力建设建议，但不应据此认定中国ETS已自动获得英国减免、欧盟已完成扩围，或某一核查人员天然合格。
items.impact_en: Chinese SMEs should build separate UK and EU code maps, link products to installations, processes, precursors and reporting years, appoint verifiers with the correct steel scope, and retain evidence of carbon prices actually paid. Do not assume automatic relief, completed EU scope expansion or universal verifier eligibility from this commentary.
items.source_excerpt: CBAM: Let's get ready Business Standard
items.coverage: 2026-10-30已通读Business Standard全文，并对照英国Finance Act 2026、SI 2026/995、GOV.UK合格碳定价机制清单及欧委会CBAM官方页面核对实施时间、行业范围、间接排放、认可/核查关系、证书购买和首份申报期限。本文为作者个人政策评论；未将印度—欧盟FTA时间表或“180多种”扩围说法当成已生效法律。

follow_up.action_zh: 英国正式税率发布后复核减免和核证指引；欧盟扩围仅在正式法规通过后更新产品清单。

items.title_en: Iron ore futures near four-year lows as Chinese mill profitability weakens
items.title_original: Iron Ore Futures Near Four-Year Low on Weak Chinese Steel Demand
items.summary_zh: IndexBox 10月27日市场简报称，铁矿石期货周一跌向每吨670元人民币，接近四年低位；其引用的行业数据称，上周247家中国钢厂高炉开工率为80%，同比下降4.3%。同时，中国港口到货量偏高、全球发运增加，供应较充裕。报道还提到中国矿产资源集团与力拓达成新的供应安排，但具体条款未公开。
items.summary_en: IndexBox reported on 27 October that iron-ore futures moved toward CNY 670 per tonne on Monday, near four-year lows. It cited an 80% blast-furnace operating rate across 247 Chinese mills last week, down 4.3% year on year, alongside elevated port arrivals and rising global shipments. It also mentioned a new CMRG-Rio Tinto supply arrangement whose terms were not disclosed.
items.impact_zh: 这是市场信号，不是政策文件。原料价格下行有助于降低长流程钢厂采购成本，但其成因同时反映钢材需求和钢厂利润偏弱，不能据一日价格判断出口订单或利润已经改善。钢厂应分别跟踪现货矿价、钢材售价、库存和高炉利润；涉及中矿集团—力拓安排的采购判断，须等待双方可核实披露，不能把媒体所称口头通知当成公开合同条款。
items.impact_en: This is a market signal, not a policy measure. Lower ore prices can reduce blast-furnace input costs, but also reflect weak steel demand and mill margins; one day's price does not establish improved export profitability. Track spot ore, steel prices, inventories and furnace margins separately, and do not treat reported verbal notice of the CMRG-Rio Tinto arrangement as disclosed contract terms.

items.title_zh: GMK称乌克兰CBAM损失已高于欧委会预测，主张重算影响评估
items.title_en: GMK says Ukraine's CBAM losses already exceed the Commission forecast and calls for a reassessment
items.title_original: CBAM for Ukraine: why the European Commission should revise its impact assessment
items.summary_zh: GMK Center 10月27日分析称，2026年上半年乌克兰对欧盟、覆盖全部CBAM钢铁编码的出口额同比减少1.49亿欧元；其把供应链效应计入后，估算相当于约0.3%的GDP损失。GMK还预计，扁平材平均CBAM支付可能由2026年的78欧元/吨升至2030年的198欧元/吨，长材由61欧元/吨升至173欧元/吨，并主张欧委会把战争破坏、停产、能源和物流约束纳入重新评估。上述数据和预测是GMK模型结果及政策主张，不是欧盟正式豁免或税率决定。欧委会正式报告的基准是到2035年GDP影响约负0.01%，并非GMK文中所写的2031年。
items.summary_en: GMK Center said on 27 October that the value of Ukrainian iron and steel exports to the EU across all CBAM-covered codes fell by EUR 149 million year on year in H1 2026; including supply-chain effects, it estimates a GDP loss of about 0.3%. GMK projects average CBAM payments rising from EUR 78/t in 2026 to EUR 198/t in 2030 for flat products and from EUR 61/t to EUR 173/t for long products, and calls on the Commission to reassess war damage, shutdowns, energy and logistics constraints. These are GMK modelling results and policy requests, not an EU exemption or tariff decision. The Commission's formal report states an estimated GDP effect of about -0.01% by 2035, not 2031 as written in GMK's article.
items.impact_zh: 对中国钢厂的直接规则没有变化。该争议提示，第三国行业会以战争、发展水平和投资能力争取特殊或过渡安排；若乌克兰最终获得可执行优惠，可能改变其钢材在欧盟市场相对中国货源的竞争条件。但中国企业不能据此预期同等待遇，应继续准备经核查的产品级排放数据、测算不同EU ETS价格情景，并在DDP等合同中明确最终CBAM差额和核查失败风险。
items.impact_en: No rule for Chinese steel changes. The dispute shows that third-country industries may seek special or transitional treatment based on war damage, development level and investment capacity; any enforceable Ukraine-specific relief could alter its competitive position versus Chinese supply in the EU. Chinese firms should not assume comparable treatment and should continue preparing verified product-level emissions data, modelling ETS-price scenarios and allocating final CBAM and verification risks in DDP contracts.

follow_up.action_en: Monitor whether the Commission formally reopens its Ukraine CBAM assessment or proposes an enforceable temporary measure under Article 30(7); assume no exemption before an official act.

items.title_zh: 土耳其贸易部长：前三季对欧钢铁出口下降6.7%，对非欧盟市场增长10%
items.title_en: Türkiye says nine-month steel exports to the EU fell 6.7% while non-EU shipments rose 10%
items.title_original: Turkish Trade Minister slams tighter EU steel quotas as exports fall 6.7%
items.summary_zh: 土耳其贸易部长Ömer Bolat在Steel Networking Summits 2026表示，2026年1—9月土耳其对欧盟的CBAM覆盖钢铁产品出口同比下降1.7%，全部钢铁出口下降6.7%，对欧盟以外市场出口增长10%；欧盟仍占土耳其钢铁出口的42.3%。他把变化与欧盟钢铁配额自7月1日起收紧及CBAM正式期实施并列讨论，并批评单边限制增加成本。官方讲话还称，土耳其2025年粗钢产量38.1百万吨，钢材出口额171亿美元，约78%的产能采用废钢电弧炉，电炉粗钢产量27.5百万吨、废钢进口18.8百万吨。这是土耳其政府对贸易流向和政策压力的判断，不是欧盟修改配额、CBAM减免或新增税率的决定。
items.summary_en: Trade Minister Ömer Bolat said Türkiye's January–September 2026 exports of CBAM-covered steel products to the EU fell 1.7%, total iron and steel exports to the EU fell 6.7%, and non-EU shipments rose 10%; the EU still represented 42.3% of Turkish steel exports. He linked the pressure to tighter EU quotas and definitive CBAM and criticised unilateral restrictions. The ministry also reported 38.1Mt of 2025 crude steel output, $17.1bn of steel exports, 78% scrap-EAF capacity, 27.5Mt EAF output and 18.8Mt scrap imports. This is a Turkish government trade assessment, not a new EU rule or exemption.
items.impact_zh: 土耳其钢材对欧受限并向非欧盟市场转移，可能加剧中东、北非、英国及其他第三国市场的竞价和贸易转移风险；但现有数据不能证明这些增量全部流向中国企业的目标市场。中国钢厂应按产品和目的地监测土耳其报价、到货量及贸易救济案件，同时比较废钢电炉路线的核证排放优势。不能把土耳其部长的批评当作欧盟将给予豁免或调整CBAM的信号。
items.impact_en: Diversion from the EU may intensify competition in third-country markets, but the data do not show where all additional shipments went. Chinese exporters should monitor Turkish offers and arrivals by product and destination, trade-remedy exposure and verified EAF emissions. The minister's criticism is not evidence of an EU exemption or CBAM amendment.

items.follow_up: 跟踪欧盟按产品和原产地的配额使用、土耳其月度出口流向及第三国贸易救济；只有出现正式欧盟文本时才更新法律状态。

items.title_zh: 中国钢材出口仍处高位、贸易救济增多：调查、裁决与已征税须逐案区分
items.title_en: China’s steel exports remain high as trade remedies rise; case status must be checked individually
items.title_original: China’s steel exports remain high as trade remedies rise; case status must be checked individually
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇市场评论，不是政府措施或新的贸易救济决定。文章所引核心外贸数据可核对：2025年中国出口钢材11901.9万吨，同比增长7.5%，出口均价约693.8美元/吨、同比下降8.2%；2026年1—9月累计出口8564.1万吨，同比下降2.6%。文中“20多个国家和地区、98起贸易救济案件”可追溯至Mysteel依据中国贸易救济信息网公开记录所作的不完全汇总，其中混合了调查、裁决等不同节点，并非商务部发布的一项官方汇总统计，更不能理解为98项已经生效的新税。文章同时指出，发起调查不等于已经认定倾销或开始征税，这一区分是正确的；其关于行业“寒冬”和转型路径的表述属于作者判断。
items.summary_en: This is market commentary, not a government measure or a new trade-remedy decision. Core trade data can be cross-checked: China exported 119.019 million tonnes of steel products in 2025, up 7.5%, at an average price of about USD 693.8 per tonne, down 8.2%; exports in January–September 2026 were 85.641 million tonnes, down 2.6%. The claim of 98 trade-remedy cases across more than 20 jurisdictions traces to a Mysteel incomplete aggregation of public China Trade Remedies Information records. It combines investigations and determinations at different stages, is not a single official MOFCOM aggregate release, and does not mean 98 new duties are in force. The article correctly distinguishes initiation from a dumping finding or an effective duty; its broader “winter” and transformation narrative is commentary.
items.impact_zh: 中国钢厂和出口商不应把“98起”当作统一税负或市场关闭程度。实务上应建立按国家／地区、产品、HS税号、生产商—出口商组合、案件编号和法律阶段管理的台账，分别标注立案、初裁、临时措施、终裁、期终复审、保障措施及生效日期；报价前逐案核对税率、保证金、配额、原产地及熔炼浇铸证据。高端化和海外加工可以改善产品与市场结构，但境外加工并不会自动改变原产地或规避反规避审查，不能据评论稿直接调整税率、合同或投资判断。
items.impact_en: Chinese mills and exporters should not treat “98 cases” as a uniform tariff burden or a measure of market closure. Maintain a case matrix by jurisdiction, product, HS code, producer-exporter combination, case number and legal stage, separating initiation, preliminary determination, provisional measures, final measures, reviews, safeguards and effective dates. Before quoting, verify the applicable rate, deposits, quotas, origin and melt-and-pour evidence case by case. Higher-value products and overseas processing may improve market positioning, but foreign processing does not automatically change origin or avoid anti-circumvention scrutiny.
items.coverage: 2026-10-29已通读搜狐公开全文，并以国家统计局2025年公报、中钢协/海关数据核对2025全年及2026年1—9月出口量价；以Mysteel基于中国贸易救济信息网的汇总核对“98起/20多个国家”出处。未取得商务部发布的同口径结构化汇总，也未逐项复算98条案件，故明确保留为媒体/行业汇总。
items.follow_up: 持续按商务部中国贸易救济信息网及各调查机关原始公告更新案件台账；每个订单以适用产品、生产商、原产地、法律阶段和清关日期为准，不存在适用于全部“98起案件”的统一期限或税率。

items.title_zh: 韩国庆尚南道研讨制造业应对CBAM：强调碳数据与企业现场支持
items.title_en: South Gyeongsang forum highlights carbon data and practical CBAM support for manufacturers
items.title_original: South Korea forum urges on-site support as CBAM threatens Gyeongnam exports - CHOSUNBIZ
items.summary_zh: 韩国国家气候危机应对委员会与庆尚南道于10月26日在昌原举办第三次区域论坛，约200名政府、产业、学术和专家代表讨论全球碳监管、当地制造业转型和碳竞争力。韩国政府原始新闻稿显示，议题包括庆尚南道制造业EU CBAM应对、全球CBAM与韩国政策、世亚昌原特殊钢的低碳转型实践、出口竞争力以及企业碳数据利用。地方政府表示将加强机构协作并扩大企业可实际获得的支持。该活动是政策讨论和支持方向，不是新增税率、补贴方案或具有约束力的合规规则。
items.summary_en: South Korea's National Climate Crisis Response Commission and South Gyeongsang Province held their third regional forum in Changwon on 26 October, with about 200 government, industry, academic and expert participants. The official release lists sessions on EU CBAM strategy for regional manufacturing, global and Korean policy trends, SeAH Changwon Integrated Special Steel's transition, export competitiveness and corporate carbon data. Authorities promised stronger coordination and practical support. This is a policy forum and support direction, not a new duty, subsidy programme or binding compliance rule.
items.impact_zh: 对向欧盟供应钢铁、机械和金属制品的中国企业，这一消息本身不改变CBAM义务，但反映韩国同类出口商正把装置排放、核查、产品碳数据和地方支持结合起来。中国钢厂可据此检查与下游客户的数据接口和核查准备，但不应把论坛表态当作韩国已经推出具体补贴，亦不能据新闻推导产品税额或竞争成本。
items.impact_en: The forum does not change CBAM obligations but shows Korean competitors integrating installation emissions, verification, product data and local support. Chinese suppliers should test data interfaces and verification readiness without assuming a concrete Korean subsidy or inferring product-level costs.

items.follow_up: 关注韩国国家气候危机应对委员会、庆尚南道及产业主管部门是否把论坛方向转化为具名支持项目、申请条件或资金安排；届时另行核验正式文件。

items.title_zh: 印度商务部长批评欧盟钢铁限制与CBAM：属于谈判立场，不是规则变更
items.title_en: India's commerce minister criticises EU steel curbs and CBAM; remarks do not change the rules
items.title_original: 'EU shooting itself in the foot': Piyush Goyal warns Europe over CBAM, import duty
items.summary_zh: 印度商务与工业部长皮尤什·戈亚尔（Piyush Goyal）在10月22日柏林全球对话上批评欧盟钢铁进口限制、CBAM及其他监管要求，认为这些措施会推高钢、铝、水泥及基础设施成本，削弱欧洲竞争力，并可能引发贸易伙伴的对等措施。他同时强调印度希望获得欧洲电解槽等技术以发展绿氢和绿色钢铁。印度政府官方访问预告确认了戈亚尔10月22日至24日在柏林参加该对话及讨论印欧FTA市场准入，但没有宣布CBAM豁免、钢铁配额调整或新关税决定。
items.summary_en: India's Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal criticised EU steel import restrictions, CBAM and other regulatory requirements at the Berlin Global Dialogue on 22 October, arguing that they could raise steel, aluminium, cement and infrastructure costs, weaken European competitiveness and invite reciprocal measures. He also sought European technology for green hydrogen and green steel. India's official visit notice confirms his Berlin participation and India-EU FTA market-access discussions, but announces no CBAM exemption, quota change or new tariff decision.
items.impact_zh: 这是印度政府的公开政策立场和谈判信号，不改变中国钢材现行欧盟配额、50%超配额税或CBAM义务。中国出口商不应据此假定印度将获得豁免、欧盟会撤回措施，或印欧FTA会自动改变中国产品待遇。应继续按现行CN、原产地、配额和排放规则报价，同时跟踪印欧FTA是否形成针对印度钢材的可执行安排及其对欧盟市场竞争格局的影响。
items.impact_en: This is an Indian policy and negotiating position, not a change to EU treatment of Chinese steel. Chinese exporters should not assume an Indian exemption, EU withdrawal or automatic effect from an India-EU FTA. Continue pricing under current CN, origin, quota and emissions rules, while monitoring any enforceable India-specific outcome and its competitive effect in the EU market.

items.title_zh: 欧洲热卷：北欧钢厂一季度报800—830欧元/吨，CBAM资金占用压制采购
items.title_en: European HRC: Nordic Q1 offers at EUR 800–830/t as CBAM working-capital needs weigh on buying
items.title_original: [SMM Steel] European HRC: Nordic Mills Push Higher Q1 Offers, CBAM Capital Tie-Up and High Stocks Drag Buying Momentum
items.summary_zh: SMM 10月22日市场报告称，北欧主要钢厂对2027年2—3月交付的热卷报价为800—830欧元/吨DDP；西北欧热卷评估价维持740欧元/吨EXW，意大利市场降1欧元至743欧元/吨EXW。报道认为终端需求偏弱、库存偏高，同时CBAM证书余额要求占用买方和贸易商流动资金，抑制补库。欧委会CBAM Registry页面确认系统已提供监测“50%规则”的功能；但SMM所称“预购并冻结至少全年义务的50%”是媒体对资金影响的概括，不应替代法规的季度账户余额计算。
items.summary_en: SMM reported on 22 October that major Nordic mills offered HRC for February-March 2027 delivery at EUR 800-830/t DDP; Northwest European HRC was assessed at EUR 740/t EXW and Italian HRC at EUR 743/t EXW, down EUR 1. It attributed weak restocking to soft end demand, high inventories and the working-capital effect of CBAM certificate-balance requirements. The Commission's CBAM Registry page confirms tools for monitoring the '50% rule', but SMM's description of pre-purchasing and freezing 50% of annual obligations is a media characterisation, not a substitute for the legal quarterly account-balance calculation.
items.impact_zh: 这是一份市场报价与采购情绪报告，不是官方基准价格或新法规。对中国热卷出口商而言，欧盟买方可能把CBAM证书持有和融资成本计入报价、付款条件或采购节奏；企业应给客户提供可核查的实际排放资料，并分别测算EXW/DDP、配额和CBAM资金成本。不得把800—830欧元/吨视为全欧统一成交价，也不得据此给中国订单加上固定“50%融资附加费”。
items.impact_en: This is a market and sentiment report, not an official benchmark or new law. EU buyers may incorporate CBAM certificate holdings and financing costs into quotations, payment terms or purchasing schedules. Chinese HRC exporters should provide verifiable actual-emissions data and model EXW/DDP, quota and CBAM working-capital effects separately. Do not treat EUR 800-830/t as a Europe-wide transaction price or add a fixed '50% financing surcharge' to Chinese orders.

follow_up.action_en: Track Q1 2027 transaction prices, Commission operational guidance on the 50% rule and buyer contract terms; change compliance assumptions only on official guidance or legislation.

items.title_zh: HKTDC：香港转口英国CBAM商品需准备核证排放与合同分工
items.title_en: UK CBAM: What Hong Kong Traders Need to Know
items.title_original: UK CBAM: What Hong Kong Traders Need to Know
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇香港贸发局行业解读，并非新法规。文章梳理英国CBAM自2027年1月1日起适用于铝、水泥、化肥、氢及钢铁五个行业；法律责任由英国进口商承担，但境外生产商和香港贸易商需要提供产品与生产装置对应关系、净重、实际隐含排放及已支付碳价等证据，否则进口商可能使用默认值计税。英国进口商在过去12个月或未来30日内受管商品净重达到50,000英镑价值门槛时须注册；2027年首个年度申报期的申报和付款截止日为2028年5月31日，此后改为季度申报。英国政府当前合格碳定价制度名单包含中国全国碳排放权交易市场，但这不等于自动或足额减免：可抵扣金额取决于实际有效碳价及可核验证据，免费配额、补贴或返还会降低可主张金额。
items.summary_en: This is an HKTDC industry explainer, not a new legal measure. It outlines the UK CBAM starting on 1 January 2027 for aluminium, cement, fertiliser, hydrogen and iron and steel. UK importers bear the legal liability, but overseas producers and Hong Kong traders will need product-to-installation links, net mass, verified embedded-emissions data and evidence of carbon prices actually paid; otherwise defaults may be used. Registration applies when relevant imports cross the GBP 50,000 value threshold over the relevant look-back or forward-looking test. The first 2027 return and payment are due on 31 May 2028, followed by quarterly periods. The current UK qualifying-schemes list includes the China National ETS, but relief is not automatic or necessarily full: it depends on the effective price and verified evidence, and is reduced by free allocation, subsidies or rebates.
items.impact_zh: 对向英国出口钢铁、经香港转口或由香港贸易商组织交易的中国企业，重点不是仅向英国客户提供一个企业平均排放数，而是尽快按8位商品编码、生产企业和具体装置建立可追溯数据包，保存净重、实际直接/间接排放边界、核证文件及中国全国碳市场实际支付碳价证明，并在销售合同中明确数据提供、第三方核证、默认值风险、税负转嫁和更正责任。中国全国碳市场被列入合格制度只提供申请减免的制度入口，不能据此在报价中预设固定抵扣额；应由英国进口商依据实际有效碳价和证据申报。英国与欧盟CBAM的申报、价格和认可机制不同，不能直接共用税额结论。
items.impact_en: Chinese steel producers exporting to the UK, including Hong Kong-routed trades, should build traceable data packs by 8-digit commodity code, producer and installation rather than provide only a company-wide average. Retain net mass, boundary-consistent direct and indirect emissions data, verification records and evidence of carbon prices effectively paid under China's national ETS, and allocate data, verification, default-value, pass-through and correction risks in contracts. Inclusion of China's ETS on the qualifying-schemes list creates a route to claim relief but does not justify assuming a fixed credit in pricing; the UK importer must substantiate the effective price. UK and EU CBAM rules remain separate.
items.source_excerpt: UK CBAM: What Hong Kong Traders Need to Know HKTDC Research
items.coverage: 2026-10-28已通读HKTDC原文，并核对GOV.UK英国CBAM政策汇总、当前合格碳定价制度名单和记录保存指南；未替任何具体企业核算税额或确认实际可获减免。
items.follow_up: 2027年1月1日前完成英国受管商品编码、生产装置、净重、排放与实际碳价证据映射；跟踪英国政府对合格碳定价制度名单及申报细则的更新。英国进口商2028年1月1日起办理注册，2027年度首份申报及付款截止2028年5月31日。

items.title_zh: 南非研究：CBAM冲击取决于产品排放强度与进口价格，不宜只看国家平均值
items.title_en: South African study says CBAM exposure depends on product emissions and import prices, not country averages alone
items.title_original: LAWRENCE EDWARDS AND NICOLA WILLS | The CBAM wake-up call: decarbonisation is now an export survival issue
items.summary_zh: Business Day刊发开普敦大学Lawrence Edwards与Nicola Wills的评论，基于ERSA产品层面局部均衡研究。作者指出，同类产品的排放强度可在国家和企业间显著不同，固定的每吨碳成本对低价、高排放产品造成的价格涨幅更大。其南非情景以80欧元/吨CO₂e并计入直接与间接排放时，模拟钢铁平均欧盟进口价格上升约31%；直接排放情景下南非钢铁进口量约降48%，纳入间接排放后约降76%。这些是南非模型结果，不是对中国产品的税额或销量预测。
items.summary_en: Business Day published commentary by UCT researchers Lawrence Edwards and Nicola Wills based on an ERSA product-level partial-equilibrium study. They argue that emissions vary across products and firms, while a fixed carbon cost causes a larger percentage price increase for cheaper, emissions-intensive goods. In their South African scenario using EUR 80/tCO2e and both direct and indirect emissions, the model raises average EU import prices for iron and steel by about 31%; estimated South African steel imports fall about 48% with direct emissions only and 76% when indirect emissions are included. These are South African model results, not Chinese duty or volume forecasts.
items.impact_zh: 对中国钢厂的可用启示是，应按产品、装置和工艺准备实际排放数据，并把产品单价、排放强度和客户替代弹性一起纳入欧盟报价情景；提升产品附加值可以降低固定碳成本占售价的比例。但不得把文中的31%、48%或76%直接套用于中国订单。若欧盟未来正式纳入更多间接排放，应再依据最终法规、CN范围、实际排放和届时EU ETS价格重算。
items.impact_en: For Chinese mills, the useful lesson is to model EU quotations using product-, installation- and process-level verified emissions together with unit value and demand substitution. Higher-value products may reduce the carbon charge as a share of price. Do not apply the article's 31%, 48% or 76% South African estimates to Chinese orders. Recalculate only against final EU rules, CN scope, actual emissions and the relevant ETS price if indirect-emissions coverage changes.

items.summary_zh: SMM10月16日报道，一些第三国供应商难以取得板坯、生铁等前体的核查数据，买方因默认值和配额风险对一季度订单趋谨慎。其当日报价为西北欧热卷€740/吨EXW、意大利€742/吨EXW，部分一二季度到货进口报价€780—800/吨DDP；这些为特定时点市场观察，不是官方价格或通用税差。

These are dated market observations, not official prices or a universal carbon-tax spread.

items.impact_en: Close precursor-data gaps and specify quota, verification and carbon-cost risks in contracts. EXW, CFR and DDP quotations are not directly comparable tax measures.

items.impact_en: Distinguish grade, magnetic performance, approvals and delivery terms, and refresh this historical forecast against current orders.

items.title_zh: 非洲出口商碳足迹评论须区分CBAM与EUDR，原文2024年适用日期已过时
items.title_en: African-exporter footprint commentary conflates CBAM and EUDR; its 2024 application date is obsolete
items.title_original: CBAM and EUDR: why European buyers now demand carbon footprints from African exporters
items.summary_zh: 已读Capmad全文并核对欧委会环境总司现行说明：原文把EUDR适用日写为2024年12月30日，已过时；当前大中型经营者为2026年12月30日，多数微小型经营者为2027年6月30日，原EUTR覆盖的微小型经营者为2026年12月30日。EUDR针对所列农林商品及衍生品的无毁林尽调，不能当作钢铁CBAM一般碳足迹义务。CBAM对钢铁核算则须用其规定的产品和装置排放边界，不能把运输、土地利用等全生命周期数据直接照搬。
items.summary_en: Capmad’s full article was checked against DG Environment’s current guidance. Its 30 December 2024 EUDR date is obsolete: large/medium operators apply from 30 December 2026, most micro/small operators from 30 June 2027, and EUTR-covered small operators from 30 December 2026. EUDR due diligence for listed agricultural/forest products is distinct from steel CBAM accounting; transport and land-use lifecycle footprints cannot simply replace CBAM product/installation boundaries.
items.impact_zh: 中国钢厂应向欧洲客户交付适合CBAM口径的可核查数据，先按商品编码确认法定义务，再区分客户自愿采购要求。不要因文章并列两项制度，就给全部钢铁出口增加EUDR地块定位要求；涉及具体农林产品时另查其清单及适用日期。
items.impact_en: Provide steel customers with CBAM-compatible verified evidence and distinguish law from voluntary buyer requirements. This combined commentary does not impose EUDR plot-geolocation requirements on all steel exports; separately check any actual agricultural/forest product.
items.status: 媒体评论／已纠正旧日期

items.summary_zh: IndexBox10月15日转引GMK及行业工程师消息，称中国钢研相关临沂示范装置交付360吨以氢还原的直接还原铁，拟经电炉熔炼用于汽车钢。报道将其描述为商业批次和国产设备应用进展；文中没有产品级第三方核定强度、氢源全生命周期数据或独立证明“全国首次”的材料。
items.summary_en: IndexBox cites GMK and an industry engineer on a 360-tonne hydrogen-DRI batch from a Linyi demonstration facility for EAF automotive steel. The article provides no verified product intensity, hydrogen lifecycle evidence or independent proof of a national first.
items.impact_zh: 这是一条技术商业化线索。采购方应索取化学成分、金属化率、交货证明、氢源及核查报告；氢替代还原剂不等于从矿山到成品全链条零排放，不能据此认定CBAM税额为零。
items.impact_en: Seek specifications, metallisation, delivery and verified emissions evidence. Hydrogen reduction does not establish zero lifecycle emissions or zero CBAM liability.

items.title_zh: 中国9月钢材出口1049万吨、环比增3.3%；前三季度仍同比下降2.6%
items.title_en: China September steel exports rise 3.3% month on month; nine-month exports remain down 2.6%
items.title_original: 2026年9月中国钢材出口增长3.3% | 进口与铁矿石数据 - 新闻和统计
items.summary_zh: IndexBox10月15日援引中钢协/GMK数据：9月钢材出口约1049万吨，环比+3.3%、同比+0.3%；1—9月8564万吨、同比−2.6%。9月进口钢材49.2万吨、环比+13.4%、同比−10.2%；铁矿石进口1.0982亿吨、同比−5.6%。这反映单月出口回升与累计收缩并存，不能把环比反弹写成全年需求复苏。
items.summary_en: IndexBox reports approximately 10.49m tonnes in September, +3.3% m/m and +0.3% y/y; January–September exports were 85.64m tonnes, −2.6% y/y. September steel imports were 492,000 tonnes and iron ore imports 109.82m tonnes. A monthly rebound coexists with a cumulative decline.
items.impact_zh: 出口业务应分别跟踪数量、售价、目的地和贸易救济风险。进口矿价格回落可能改善成本，但汇率、运费及产品结构仍影响实际利润；这些统计不构成新增关税或配额。
items.impact_en: Track destinations, prices and trade measures alongside volumes. These are reported statistics, not new tariff or quota rules.

items.title_en: Hasçelik reports 2025 Osmaneli pre-verification; it is not formal accredited CBAM verification

items.summary_zh: SteelOrbis10月15日报道Hasçelik称SGS对土耳其Osmaneli装置2025年排放作预核查，结论为在所列意见条件下数据公允。报道同时明确这不是由获CBAM认可的核查机构进行的正式核查，未披露可用于逐产品申报的核定排放强度。
items.summary_en: SteelOrbis reports an SGS pre-verification of 2025 Osmaneli emissions, fairly stated subject to comments. The article distinguishes this exercise from formal CBAM-accredited verification and supplies no verified product-specific intensity.
items.impact_zh: 中国钢厂可把预核查用于查漏补缺，但向欧盟或英国客户交付正式实际值前仍须确认核查资格、钢铁工艺范围和年度报告。不能把该新闻解读为企业已经获得CBAM免税或低税资格。
items.impact_en: Use pre-checks to close data gaps, then confirm accreditation, steel scope and annual evidence before actual-value reporting. No CBAM exemption follows from this news.

items.title_en: Chery and Shougang launch parts using 55% recycled steel
items.title_original: Chery, Shougang roll out jointly developed parts made with 55% recycled steel
items.summary_zh: 据Mysteel转载奇瑞集团消息，10月13日双方在龙山试验中心举行55%再生钢汽车零部件首发仪式，推进高再生比例汽车钢应用。企业披露每吨再生钢可减少约1.2吨CO₂、约1.6吨铁矿石使用；这些为企业陈述，正文未给出对应CBAM核查报告及完整计算边界。
items.summary_en: Mysteel republishes Chery Group’s account of a 13 October launch at Longshan. The companies cite approximately 1.2 tonnes less CO2 and 1.6 tonnes less iron ore per tonne of recycled steel, without providing a CBAM verification report or full accounting boundary in the article.
items.impact_zh: 关注汽车客户对再生成分、质量和供应链闭环的采购要求。55%再生成分不是55%碳减排，宣传减排量也不能直接抵扣CBAM；出口仍需年度、装置和产品匹配的核查数据。
items.impact_en: Track customer recycled-content and quality requirements. A 55% recycled share is not a 55% emissions reduction, and marketing figures cannot directly offset CBAM.

items.title_en: Mysteel analyses changing Chinese export destinations; regional opportunities remain scenarios
items.title_original: Mysteel：中国钢材出口正在重画版图
items.summary_zh: 10月15日Mysteel分析认为，出口总量韧性掩盖目的地重排：北美壁垒、东南亚供给缺口及贸易救济并存，中东板材和非洲需求值得跟踪。文章提出2026年出口1.14—1.17亿吨等预测，这不是已实现数量或政府目标；其多个国家关税、调查及原产地说法未在本条逐案完成官方文件核验。
items.summary_en: The 15 October analysis highlights regional shifts and forecasts 114–117m tonnes of 2026 steel exports. That is an analyst scenario, not realised trade or a government target. Its multiple country-specific legal claims were not independently established in this review.
items.impact_zh: 企业可按目的地、产品和客户偿付能力建立机会清单，但不要照搬文章预测承诺销量。具体订单的反倾销、反规避、原产地和最终税率需单独核对主管部门文本；将钢材加工为制成品也不自动消除监管风险。
items.impact_en: Use the market framework for prospecting, then verify official product, duty and origin rules for each order. Processing into finished goods does not automatically remove regulatory risk.

items.title_zh: Mysteel：10月6—12日钢材出口发运304.67万吨，周度船运数据不能等同海关出口
items.title_en: Mysteel reports 3.0467m tonnes of weekly steel export shipments; customs data are a different series
items.title_original: Mysteel早读：本期中国钢材出口发运创年内新高，焦煤期货大跌超4%
items.summary_zh: 10月15日Mysteel早读称，10月6—12日中国钢材出口发运304.67万吨、环比+46.2%，创其年内周度新高；同期全球钢材到港546.53万吨、环比−12.53%。其转引9月海关出口1049.2万吨、前三季度8564.1万吨。周度发运、全球到港与月度海关统计口径不同；标题中的焦煤期货下跌也是历史时点行情。
items.summary_en: The 15 October briefing reports Chinese shipments of 3.0467m tonnes for 6–12 October, +46.2% w/w, alongside global arrivals of 5.4653m tonnes, −12.53%. Shipping flows and monthly customs exports are different measures.
items.impact_zh: 可将周度船运作为交付节奏信号，结合目的港库存及清关配额安排订单。节后反弹可能含假期基数影响，不宜将46.2%外推全年出口增速；本文不据综合早读新增认定任何反倾销措施。
items.impact_en: Use weekly flows to plan deliveries, considering holiday base effects, destination stock and clearance windows. Do not extrapolate the weekly rebound to annual exports.
items.source_excerpt: Mysteel早读：本期中国钢材出口发运创年内新高，焦煤期货大跌超4% 我的钢铁

items.title_zh: 10月14日矿价报道指向高炉检修及澳巴库存增加，所谓低位纪录须核对序列
items.title_en: 14 October ore report links weakness to furnace maintenance and Australia/Brazil port stocks
items.title_original: Iron Ore Futures Fall to Four-Year Low on China Blast Furnace Maintenance and Ample Supply
items.summary_zh: IndexBox10月14日转引Trading Economics称铁矿石期货趋近670元/吨，受高炉检修及供给宽松影响；报道称10月10—16日预计铁水检修损失连续第三周增加，9月底以来累计增逾27万吨；截至10月11日澳巴7港矿石库存1258万吨、周增199万吨。“四年低位”为该报道所用序列描述。
items.summary_en: IndexBox cites expected maintenance-related hot-metal losses and stocks of 12.58m tonnes at seven Australian/Brazilian ports for the week to 11 October, +1.99m. Its near-CNY670 futures/four-year-low description is a reported series, not a universal benchmark.
items.impact_zh: 注意部分检修数据为报道时的预计周度数据，非事后实际产量；澳巴7港库存也不能与中国35港库存直接作增减比较。采购决策需回到同口径库存、订单及具体合约。
items.impact_en: Projected maintenance losses are not realised output. Compare identical port samples and contract definitions before purchasing.
items.source_excerpt: Iron Ore Futures Fall to Four-Year Low on China Blast Furnace Maintenance and Ample Supply - News and Statistics IndexBox

items.title_en: Post-holiday restocking remains modest; 62% ore Qingdao CFR reported at US$90.6 on 13 October
items.title_original: China Iron Ore Prices Fall Post-Holiday: Q4 Supply Rise to Weigh
items.summary_zh: IndexBox10月14日转引GMK/Kallanish称，62%品位铁矿石青岛到岸报价10月12日91.31美元/吨CFR，13日90.6美元；Mysteel观察8—10日港口成交日均约60.9万吨，同比同期低32.2%。报道认为钢厂利润偏弱、按需补库与四季度矿山增发运预期限制上涨，属于市场观察及预测。
items.summary_en: IndexBox cites GMK/Kallanish prices of US$91.31/t CFR on 12 October and US$90.6 on 13 October, with modest 8–10 October port trading. Weak mill margins and expected Q4 shipment growth cap its outlook.
items.impact_zh: 出口钢厂应将矿价、运费、钢材售价和交付周期一起做敏感性测算；62%矿CFR报价与大商所人民币期货不能直接相减推导成本节约。
items.impact_en: Model ore, freight, steel prices and delivery together. A dollar CFR ore quote is not directly comparable with a renminbi futures price.

items.title_zh: Julius Baer观点：铁矿石较初夏高点回落约20%，低价展望不是价格保证
items.title_en: Julius Baer sees ore down around 20% from early-summer highs; forecasts remain conditional
items.title_original: Global iron ore prices fall 20% as China's steel demand weakens: Julius Baer
items.summary_zh: 10月14日TradingView转载Refinitiv报道，Julius Baer分析师Carsten Menke称矿价较初夏110美元/吨以上的高点回落约20%，中国建筑需求偏弱、部分进口进入库存；其认为高80至低90美元区间生产成本可能约束价格下沿，印度增产与中国减产趋于对冲。这是分析师判断，不是官方预测或钢厂成本普查。
items.summary_en: TradingView/Refinitiv reports analyst Carsten Menke’s view that ore fell around 20% from above US$110/t, with weak Chinese construction and stockbuilding. His cost-based high-US$80s/low-US$90s outlook is an analyst scenario, not an official forecast or guaranteed floor.
items.impact_zh: 可作为供需情景输入，但不能以预测区间设定无风险采购底价。其跨地区热卷报价未统一规格、税费和交货条件，不能直接据此计算中国钢材出口套利利润。
items.impact_en: Use as one scenario, not a risk-free procurement level. Regional HRC quotes with differing terms do not establish export arbitrage profits.

items.title_original: UK considering reforms to its upcoming CBAM framework
items.summary_zh: EUROMETAL10月14日转引Dow Jones Energy所见演示材料，称英国考虑未来扩围、产品基准和国家特定默认值等改革，且不预计首年实施。原始演示材料未公开取得。10月16日HMRC随后发布的官方安排已明确按产品编码、非国家特定默认值准备2027—2028年，并计划2029年国家特定值；这纠正了报道对“单一行业默认值”的早期推测。
items.summary_en: EUROMETAL’s 14 October account cites an unpublished presentation on future reform. HMRC’s later 16 October publications establish product-code, non-country-specific defaults for 2027–28 and planned country-specific values from 2029, superseding the article’s earlier single-sector-default assumption.
items.impact_zh: 按HMRC现行公布安排准备，不把演示讨论视为已修法或英欧互免落地。为双市场客户保留独立核查和编码数据，后续有正式提案再更新合同假设。
items.impact_en: Prepare under current official publications. Presentation discussions do not establish an amendment or reciprocal exemption; retain separate jurisdictional evidence.

items.title_original: Mysteel晚餐：9月中国出口钢材1049.2万吨，江苏象屿不锈钢正式挂牌
items.summary_zh: 10月14日晚报称，江苏德龙镍业破产重整资产处置后，相关不锈钢经营主体更名为象屿不锈钢；并转引9月钢材出口1049.2万吨、1—9月8564.1万吨同比−2.6%。另列10月6—12日出口发运304.67万吨、周增46.2%，这是船运样本而非同一海关月度指标。企业更名及接管叙述为媒体披露，未据此认定全部债务及合同已移转。
items.summary_en: The 14 October briefing reports renamed Jiangsu Delong-related stainless operations following restructuring and repeats September customs exports and a separate weekly shipment series. The report does not establish transfer of every debt or contract.

items.title_zh: 宝武11月板材价格总体平盘，媒体称以减产稳价和出口分流为支撑
items.title_en: Baowu keeps November flat-product prices unchanged, with output restraint and exports cited as support
items.title_original: Baowu Steel announced flat prices for November
items.summary_zh: Yieh公开报道显示，中国宝武11月价格采取全面平盘策略。报道把这一决定解释为成本上升、利润受压背景下以减产稳价，并称国内消费增长仍温和、年末刺激尚未充分显效，10—11月出口分流、海外制造业补库及对四季度政策的预期提供支撑。Mysteel另确认宝钢股份10月10日价格通知维持11月国内销售主要板材（包括热卷）牌价不变。报道未列出各产品、规格、基地的绝对出厂价或出口报价。
items.summary_en: Yieh reports that China Baowu kept November prices unchanged across the board, describing the move as price support through output restraint amid higher costs and compressed margins. It cites modest domestic consumption, incomplete year-end stimulus effects, October-November export diversion, overseas restocking and fourth-quarter policy expectations. Mysteel separately confirms that Baosteel's 10 October notice held November domestic list prices for major flat products, including HRC, unchanged. Neither public excerpt supplies absolute mill prices by product, specification or works, or export quotations.
items.impact_zh: 平盘是月度定价信号，不等于所有宝武基地、钢种和出口合同价格不变，也不证明已执行统一减产。中国出口业务可把它作为短期底价和钢厂利润压力参考，但仍应按具体牌号、基地、数量、交期、退税/运费和目的地重新询价；对“出口增长”和政策预期属于媒体市场判断，不应当作确定订单或政策。
items.impact_en: The rollover is a monthly pricing signal, not proof that every Baowu mill, grade or export contract is unchanged, nor evidence of a uniform production cut. Export teams can use it as a short-term floor and margin signal but should re-quote by grade, works, volume, delivery, tax/freight and destination. Media commentary on exports and policy expectations is not confirmed order flow or policy.

items.summary_zh: IOM3于10月13日刊登材料行业说明：欧盟2026年进入正式期，以CBAM证书履约；英国2027年启动，以税款履约。欧盟一般按进口商年度累计50吨门槛（电力、氢另有规则），英国相关进口货值门槛£50,000；欧盟首次2026年度申报清缴为2027年9月30日，英国2027年度首次申报缴款为2028年5月31日。相关日期已与两地官方指南交叉核对。

items.title_en: Trasteel CEO estimates steel CBAM costs could reach €5bn a year; this is not an official calculation
items.title_original: CBAM costs for steel products could reach €5 billion a year — Trasteel CEO
items.summary_zh: GMK转述Trasteel首席执行官Gianfranco Imperato接受Platts采访时称，钢铁产品CBAM总成本可能达到每年50亿欧元，并最终更多转嫁给消费者。他表示欧洲需求疲弱目前抑制明显涨价，供应地正在按进口配额调整；俄乌板坯供应缺失后，公司增加了远东采购。他还认为不确定性压制新增产能投资，PPGI等短缺更可能通过提高既有产能利用率弥补。50亿欧元没有披露计算模型、产品范围、排放强度或证书价格假设，属于企业高管情景判断。
items.summary_en: GMK reports that Trasteel CEO Gianfranco Imperato told Platts total CBAM costs for steel products could reach €5bn annually and ultimately be passed to consumers. He said weak European demand currently limits price increases, sourcing is adapting to import quotas, and Trasteel increased Far East slab purchases after Russian and Ukrainian supply disappeared. He also sees uncertainty deterring new capacity, with shortages such as PPGI more likely met through higher utilisation. No model, product scope, emissions intensity or certificate-price assumption is disclosed for the €5bn figure; it is an executive scenario, not an official estimate.
items.impact_zh: 该观点提示欧洲买方可能把CBAM与配额成本纳入报价和供应地调整，但不能用50亿欧元直接计算中国某一订单税额。报价时仍应按产品CN码、经核验内含排放、已支付碳价和当期证书价格逐单测算，并关注远东板坯竞争与配额可用量。
items.impact_en: The view signals that European buyers may incorporate CBAM and quota costs into pricing and sourcing, but €5bn cannot calculate any Chinese shipment's charge. Price each order using CN scope, verified embedded emissions, eligible carbon price paid and the applicable certificate price, while monitoring Far East slab competition and quota availability.

items.title_original: 有诊断称,为了应对欧盟(EU)的碳国境调整制度(CBAM),政府的企业支援项目正常启动,必须确保劳务执行机关的持续运营预算。 有人指出,即使构建程序,如果不能及时反映欧盟改变的规定,支援排放量计算和报..
items.summary_zh: 《每日经济》报道，韩国能率协会咨询受韩国关税厅委托完成“EU CBAM应对支持碳排放量计算程序改善方案”最终报告。报告建议把欧盟规则影响分析、数据库和计算逻辑更新列为经常性运营事项，预先安排年度维护和升级预算，并配置制度专家或年度外部顾问。报道说明本次工作仍是菜单和管理项目的规划设计，实际系统建设需另行开发。文中称欧盟默认值最迟将在2027年12月重新评估，并提到下游扩围提案以2028年1月为目标；这些属于报道对欧盟进程的概述，不是韩国已出台新的强制规则。
items.summary_en: Maeil Business Newspaper reports that Korea Management Association Consultants completed a Korea Customs Service-commissioned final study on improving a CBAM emissions-calculation support programme. It recommends recurring processes and budgets for EU-rule impact analysis, database and calculation-logic updates, plus specialist staff or annual external advice. The work remains a planning and design exercise; actual system development requires a separate project. The article says EU default values are due for reassessment by December 2027 and describes a downstream-extension proposal targeting January 2028; these are reported EU-process points, not a new binding Korean rule.
items.impact_zh: 韩国正在强化对欧出口企业的数据基础设施，可能提升韩国钢企在排放申报和客户服务上的竞争力。中国钢企可借鉴持续更新机制，但不能直接采用韩国系统或其规则判断；应由自身欧盟客户、核查机构和最新欧盟法规确认产品边界、计算逻辑与数据格式。
items.impact_en: Korea is strengthening data infrastructure for EU exporters, potentially improving Korean steelmakers' reporting and customer support. Chinese mills can learn from the recurring-update model but cannot rely on a Korean system or interpretation; confirm scope, calculation logic and data format with EU customers, verifiers and current EU law.

items.title_original: 姜维与韩国钢铁协会执行副会长李京镐举行会谈
items.summary_zh: 中国钢铁工业协会副会长兼秘书长姜维与韩国钢铁协会执行副会长李京镐举行会谈，议题包括两国钢铁业运行、双边钢铁贸易及绿色低碳合作。姜维称中国钢铁业处于减量发展、存量优化阶段，出口呈“量减价升”，并建议通过协会机制和对话处理贸易问题、加强绿色合作；双方还讨论了2026年中韩政府—行业钢铁对话。中方参会者包括中钢协副会长骆铁军、副秘书长苏长永，以及沙钢、首钢代表；韩方包括韩国钢协和POSCO人员。会议没有公布关税、配额、贸易救济或强制性低碳规则。
items.summary_en: CISA vice president and secretary-general Jiang Wei met Korea Iron & Steel Association executive vice president Lee Kyung-ho to discuss industry conditions, bilateral steel trade and green transition. Jiang described China's sector as being in a phase of lower-volume development and stock optimisation, with export volume down and price/value up, and called for association dialogue on trade issues and green cooperation. The parties also discussed a 2026 China-Korea government-industry steel dialogue. CISA, Shagang, Shougang, KOSA and POSCO representatives attended. No tariff, quota, trade-remedy or binding low-carbon rule was announced.
items.impact_zh: 这属于行业协调和前置信号，并非政策落地。首钢等企业可关注2026年官民对话是否涉及韩国贸易救济、原产地、低碳材料标准或供应链合作；在正式文件发布前，不应据会谈推断韩国进口政策或订单条件已改变。
items.impact_en: This is industry coordination and an early signal, not an adopted policy. Shougang and other suppliers should watch whether the 2026 dialogue covers Korean trade remedies, origin, low-carbon material standards or supply-chain cooperation. Do not assume Korean import rules or order terms changed without formal documents.
items.source_excerpt: 姜维与韩国钢铁协会执行副会长李京镐举行会谈 中国钢铁新闻网
items.follow_up: 跟踪2026年中韩政府—行业钢铁对话的日期、议题和正式成果。
