items.title_zh: SNS模型研究：CBAM对出口型欧洲重工业的保护弱于免费配额，并非现实产量预测
items.title_en: SNS model: CBAM protects export-oriented European heavy industry less than free allocation; not an observed forecast
items.title_original: CBAM undermines the protection of European heavy industry — study
items.summary_zh: SNS 10月8日报告以多部门、多区域CGE模型比较免费配额与类CBAM碳关税。相对“无气候政策”的假设基准，瑞典排放密集、贸易暴露行业产出在碳关税情景下降1.3%，免费配额情景下降0.6%；欧洲其他地区分别下降2.6%和1.3%。模型碳泄漏率为碳关税16.0%、免费配额16.9%，碳关税叠加出口返还时降至10.6%。这些是模型情景结果，不是已观测产量、确定预测或现行法规变更；GMK转述的钢铁下降1.7%也应按部门模型结果理解。
items.summary_en: The 8 October SNS report compares free allocation with CBAM-style carbon tariffs in a multi-sector, multi-region CGE model. Relative to a hypothetical no-policy baseline, Swedish EITE output falls 1.3% with tariffs versus 0.6% with free allocation; the rest of Europe falls 2.6% versus 1.3%. Modelled leakage is 16.0% with tariffs, 16.9% with free allocation and 10.6% when export rebates are added. These are scenario results, not observed output, a firm forecast or a regulatory change; GMK's 1.7% steel figure is likewise a sector-model result.
items.impact_zh: 研究可能强化欧盟出口型钢企争取出口补偿或调整CBAM设计的政策诉求，但目前没有改变进口商的CBAM义务、证书安排或具体税费。中国钢厂可关注未来咨询和立法讨论，不应把模型百分比直接用于订单需求、到岸成本或税额测算。
items.impact_en: The study may strengthen EU exporters' calls for export relief or CBAM redesign, but it does not change current importer obligations, certificates or charges. Chinese mills should monitor consultations and legislation without using model percentages as shipment demand, landed cost or tax estimates.

items.title_en: RINA announces ACCREDIA accreditation for CBAM verification; certificate scope still needs checking
items.title_original: RINA获得ACCREDIA CBAM核查认可- 船级社
items.summary_zh: RINA于9月30日公告，其已取得ACCREDIA对CBAM核查活动的认可，并称其为ACCREDIA首家获此认可的机构、也是全球首批之一。公告称实际排放数据采用时须由获认可的CBAM核查机构验证，并列出2026年9月开始核查活动、2027年2月起可购买证书及2027年9月30日完成首次申报和清缴等节点。这是RINA自身公告；本轮未在ACCREDIA证书附件中独立确认全部行业、国家和活动范围。
items.summary_en: RINA announced on 30 September that ACCREDIA had accredited it for CBAM verification, describing itself as ACCREDIA's first such body and among the first worldwide. It says accredited verification is required when actual emissions are used and lists September 2026 verification activity, February 2027 certificate availability and the first declaration/surrender by 30 September 2027. The full sectoral and geographic certificate scope was not independently confirmed in ACCREDIA's annex.
items.impact_zh: 中国钢厂可把RINA列为候选核查机构，但签约前仍应查ACCREDIA有效证书、钢铁活动范围、签字权限以及能否服务第三国装置；企业“首家”说法不等于对所有CBAM行业均具资质。
items.impact_en: Chinese mills may treat RINA as a candidate verifier, but should check the live ACCREDIA certificate, iron-and-steel scope, signatory authority and ability to serve non-EU installations before engagement. The 'first' claim does not establish universal sector coverage.

items.title_zh: Gerber Group观点：欧盟钢铁配额快速耗尽或挤压中小进口商
items.title_en: Gerber Group argues rapid EU steel-quota exhaustion disadvantages smaller importers
items.title_original: Thorsten Gerber: Who Really Eats the EU Steel Quotas
items.summary_zh: Gerber Group首席执行官Thorsten Gerber在企业自办媒体采访中称，新钢铁措施使免税进口量减少47%、配额外税率为50%，部分供应国第四季度配额在5天内申报超量；他主张当前先到先得且无单一进口商上限的分配方式有利于大型进口商，并指称部分欧盟钢厂也大量进口。文章还批评欧洲议会拟把CBAM扩至457项下游产品，并建议为中小企业预留配额或设置进口商上限。文章未提供按产品类别和原产地的TARIC配额使用明细、EORI分配数据或计算方法，且网站声明部分内容为观点或互联网信息，因此这些数字和归因属于企业立场，不是欧委会监测结论。
items.summary_en: In an interview on its own trade-news site, Gerber Group CEO Thorsten Gerber says the new steel measure cuts duty-free volume by 47%, applies a 50% out-of-quota duty and left some supplier-country Q4 quotas oversubscribed within five days. He argues first-come-first-served allocation without an importer cap favours large importers and alleges that EU mills also import heavily. He also criticises Parliament's proposed CBAM extension to 457 downstream products and calls for SME reservations or importer caps. The article supplies no category/origin TARIC utilisation data, EORI allocation data or calculation method, and the site disclaims that some content is opinion or internet information; the claims are a company position, not a Commission monitoring conclusion.
items.impact_zh: 对中小进口商和中国出口商的实际风险在于特定产品类别、原产地和季度的配额可能迅速转入等待分配或触发配额外税，但不能把“5天”外推到全部配额。每票出运前应核对TARIC配额余额、分配状态、原产地与产品分类，并在合同中明确配额耗尽、等待分配和税负承担；对47%、457项及大型企业占用比例应以正式法规、三方谈判文本和官方配额数据复核。
items.impact_en: The practical risk for SMEs and Chinese exporters is that a specific product/origin/quarter quota may rapidly move into waiting allocation or incur the out-of-quota duty; the five-day claim cannot be generalised to all quotas. Before shipment, verify TARIC balance and allocation status, origin and product classification, and allocate quota-exhaustion, waiting-allocation and duty risk in the contract. Check the 47%, 457-product and importer-concentration claims against legislation, trilogue texts and official quota data.

The syndicated Chinese article frames this as an opportunity, but GMK identifies no origins, products, tenders or confirmed Chinese orders.

items.impact_en: Treat the possible Ukrainian supply gap as a market lead and verify reconstruction finance, standards, sanctions, logistics and actual tenders. Do not equate the $1.5bn scenario with orders available to Chinese suppliers.

items.title_zh: Stegra呼吁欧盟维持ETS碳价信号并强化CBAM，反对人为压低碳价
items.title_en: Stegra urges the EU to preserve the ETS carbon-price signal and strengthen CBAM
items.title_original: Swedish steelmaker laments tone of EU ETS reform talks
items.summary_zh: Montel公开导语称，已投资脱碳的企业担忧欧盟放松碳市场规则。Stegra随后公开的完整公司立场明确：EU ETS提供的清晰、可预期政策框架，是其等企业投入数十亿欧元建设低碳钢产能的重要基础；公司要求欧盟在下一轮ETS修订中避免人为压低碳价，将更大比例的ETS拍卖收入用于工业投资，并继续强化CBAM。该内容属于企业及行业政策主张，不是欧盟已经通过的新法规或税率调整。
items.summary_en: Montel's public lead reports concern among companies that have invested in decarbonisation about loosening EU carbon-market rules. Stegra's full public company statement says the predictable EU ETS framework has underpinned billions of euros of low-carbon steel investment and calls on the EU to avoid measures that artificially depress the carbon price, recycle a much larger share of auction revenues into industrial investment, and continue strengthening CBAM. This is corporate and industry policy advocacy, not an enacted EU rule or duty change.
items.impact_zh: 对中国钢厂和输欧业务而言，该主张说明欧洲低碳钢投资者会推动维持较强ETS价格信号和CBAM约束，企业仍应完善产品级排放数据、核查证据及低碳产品商业方案。但本声明没有新增CN/HS范围、CBAM计价方法、证书购买期限或钢材税率，不能据此调整具体报价税负。后续应以欧委会ETS修订提案、欧洲议会和理事会谈判文本及最终法规为准。
items.impact_en: For Chinese mills and EU-bound business, the statement indicates that European low-carbon steel investors will press for a strong ETS price signal and robust CBAM, reinforcing the need for product-level emissions data, verification evidence and a commercial low-carbon offering. It creates no new CN/HS scope, CBAM calculation rule, certificate deadline or steel duty and should not be used to change transaction-level tax assumptions. Monitor the Commission proposal, Parliament and Council negotiating texts, and the final legislation.
items.status: 企业政策主张／非正式法规
items.source_excerpt: Swedish steelmaker laments tone of EU ETS reform talks Montel News

items.title_zh: SMM测算印尼304冷轧不锈钢CBAM约626欧元/吨：仅为特定假设情景
items.title_en: SMM models a €626/t CBAM scenario for Indonesian 304 CRC
items.title_original: [SMM Analysis] SMM Launches Stainless Steel CBAM Calculator — Indonesian 304 CRC carries a €626/mt CBAM bill into the EU
items.summary_zh: SMM于10月1日推出测算工具。示例为CN 72193310的印尼304冷轧不锈钢，采用第二季度75.28欧元/吨CO₂价格，以含10%加成的9.559吨CO₂/吨默认排放量减去1.238吨调整量，得到约8.32张凭证、626欧元/吨。该数字是媒体模型示例，不是所有钢厂的应缴税额，也不是当前季度价格。
items.summary_en: SMM's CN72193310 scenario uses the Q2 €75.28/tCO₂ price, 9.559 tCO₂/t default emissions including a 10% uplift and a 1.238-t adjustment, yielding about 8.32 certificates or €626/t. It is a model scenario, not a universal liability or current-quarter price.
items.impact_zh: 用进口季度、产品编码、实际或默认排放、工艺路线与对应基准重新核算；默认值及调整参数仍须核对正式附件。反倾销、反补贴与配额税负分别核实，不能直接套用626欧元报价。
items.impact_en: Recalculate using the import quarter, classification, verified emissions and applicable benchmarks. Verify legal annex parameters and other trade remedies separately.
items.source_excerpt: [SMM Analysis] SMM Launches Stainless Steel CBAM Calculator — Indonesian 304 CRC carries a €626/mt CBAM bill into the EU news.metal.com
items.coverage: 已核读SMM发布的韩文正文及模型假设；未独立审计计算器或核实所引用法规附件全部默认值，仅完成报道与情景解读。

items.title_zh: Federacciai呼吁暂缓燃气发电ETS成本：行业诉求，不是ETS已暂停
items.title_en: Federacciai calls for temporary relief from ETS costs for gas-fired power; ETS has not been suspended
items.title_original: Italian steel association Federacciai warns rising energy costs threaten production continuity and urges EU ETS suspension
items.summary_zh: Federacciai在9月22日理事会后警告，电力和天然气涨价可能影响意大利钢厂连续生产，并要求意大利推动在能源紧急期暂时停止燃气火电部门承担ETS成本，同时保留Energy Release等国内缓解工具。原始报道所述对象是燃气发电环节的ETS成本，并非宣布暂停钢厂的EU ETS义务、停止配额拍卖或修改CBAM。
items.summary_en: After its 22 September council meeting, Federacciai warned that electricity and gas prices could disrupt Italian steel production and asked Italy to seek temporary relief from ETS costs for gas-fired thermal power during the emergency, while retaining domestic tools such as Energy Release. The request concerns power-generation costs; it is not an adopted suspension of steel-mill ETS obligations, allowance auctions or CBAM.
items.impact_zh: 该诉求反映欧洲钢企能源成本压力，可能影响竞争和报价，但中国出口业务不应据此假定欧盟钢厂已免除碳成本；继续跟踪欧盟及意大利是否形成正式措施。
items.impact_en: The request signals energy-cost pressure that may affect competition and pricing, but exporters should not assume EU mills have received carbon-cost relief. Track any formal EU or Italian measure.
items.source_excerpt: Italian steel association Federacciai warns rising energy costs threaten production continuity and urges EU ETS suspension Yieh Corp.

items.title_zh: 马林斯访谈：以排放数据和贸易协作应对CBAM挑战
items.title_en: Mullins interview advocates emissions evidence and trade cooperation
items.title_original: 国际钢铁周 | 开阑公司联合创始人保罗·马林斯：以开放协作对冲CBAM等新规则挑战
items.summary_zh: 《中国冶金报》访谈由Mysteel于9月29日转载。马林斯认为库存缓冲使CBAM影响尚未完全释放，并建议中国钢厂完善排放证明、加强与欧洲客户和政策机构对话。文章涉及下游产品扩围谈判；访谈意见及议会谈判立场不能等同最终生效法规或确定税额。
items.summary_en: A China Metallurgical News interview republished by Mysteel says inventories cushion CBAM effects and recommends credible emissions documentation and dialogue. Interview views and negotiating positions do not establish final downstream coverage or tax liabilities.
items.impact_zh: 保留设施、工艺及产品排放证据，向进口商核查核验要求；海外建厂必须单独评估真实熔炼浇铸地及原产地规则。扩围范围与日期以最终法规为准。
items.impact_en: Prepare facility, process and product emissions evidence. Assess overseas production and origin rules separately; rely on final legislation for scope and timing.
items.source_excerpt: 国际钢铁周 | 开阑公司联合创始人保罗·马林斯：以开放协作对冲CBAM等新规则挑战 csteelnews.com

items.title_zh: 中钢协控产倡议相关原文已恢复：属于行业自律信号，不能当作新的强制配额
items.title_en: CISA restraint-report source recovered; the call is an industry signal, not a new mandatory quota
items.title_original: China Iron and Steel Association (CISA) urged mills to restrain output
items.summary_zh: 已找到SMM9月25日原始报道，称中钢协呼吁约束产量，并讨论钢铁需求偏弱对铁矿石及干散货的影响。报道明确倡议本身不是强制命令；其援引9月中旬高炉样本盈利率7.8%、澳矿对华周发运+6.2%等行业数据。这些为特定样本和时间窗口，不能推广为全国所有钢厂当前状态。
items.summary_en: The original 25 September SMM article is now accessible. It explicitly describes the restraint call as non-mandatory and links weaker steel demand to ore and dry-bulk flows, citing dated profitability and shipment samples.
items.impact_zh: 该条此前缺失原始入口的问题已解决。钢厂可结合订单和库存评估自律经营与原料需求，但正式产量调控仍须核对主管部门文件，不把倡议推导为出口禁令、具体减产比例或新增许可证要求。
items.impact_en: The missing-source block is resolved. Assess orders and inventories, but confirm any binding production requirements separately; the article establishes no export ban or mandated cut percentage.

items.title_zh: ORF评论：印度碳市场难以单独抵消CBAM成本，建议强化MRV、融资与欧印合作
items.title_en: ORF commentary: India's carbon market alone may not offset CBAM costs; stronger MRV, finance and EU-India cooperation proposed
items.title_original: Can India Turn the CBAM Challenge into an Opportunity?
items.summary_zh: 印度观察家研究基金会（ORF）9月24日评论估算，印度2023年约64亿美元CBAM覆盖出口中钢铁约54.1亿美元、铝约9.7亿美元；作者引用的钢铁排放强度为4.68吨CO₂/吨，对比EU27约2.3吨。文章认为印度碳信用交易计划（CCTS）的基准与信用架构、预计11—15美元/吨的价格，与作者引用的2026年第二季度CBAM证书均价75.28欧元/吨之间仍有差距；同时指出欧盟对印度CCTS尚无《CBAM条例》第9条意义上的正式承认。作者建议加强价格发现和MRV、扩大转型融资，并提出设立印度CBAM征费产业脱碳基金及深化欧印合作。上述金额、强度、价格与法律评价均为作者分析，不是欧盟或印度新规。
items.summary_en: The 24 September ORF commentary estimates that steel accounted for about $5.41bn of India's $6.4bn in CBAM-covered exports in 2023, with aluminium at $0.97bn. It cites steel emissions intensity of 4.68 tCO2/t versus about 2.3 in the EU27 and contrasts estimated CCTS prices of $11–15/t with a cited Q2 2026 CBAM certificate average of €75.28/t. The authors argue that India's CCTS has not received formal Article 9 recognition and propose stronger MRV and price discovery, transition finance, an India CBAM Levy Industrial Decarbonisation Fund and EU-India cooperation. These figures and legal views are analysis, not a new EU or Indian rule.
items.impact_zh: 对中国钢企的直接合规要求没有变化。文章可用于比较印度竞争对手的碳成本和政策应对，但不能据其价格差直接计算中国订单CBAM费用，也不能把印度方案视为已获欧盟认可。对印欧供应链有业务敞口时，可跟踪CCTS方法学、欧盟第三国碳价抵扣认定和具体MRV规则。
items.impact_en: No direct compliance requirement for Chinese mills changes. The piece is useful for comparing Indian competitors' carbon-policy exposure, but its price gap cannot be used to calculate CBAM charges on Chinese shipments or imply EU recognition of India's regime. Monitor CCTS methods, EU treatment of third-country carbon prices and detailed MRV rules where relevant.
items.source_excerpt: Can India Turn the CBAM Challenge into an Opportunity? orfonline.org

items.title_zh: EPICO/KAS报告：CBAM应保持聚焦，并以收入回投和MRV合作构建第三国伙伴关系
items.title_en: EPICO/KAS: keep CBAM targeted and build third-country partnerships through revenue recycling and MRV cooperation
items.title_original: CBAM: Think tanks call for closer cooperation with non-member countries
items.summary_zh: EPICO与Konrad-Adenauer-Stiftung在22页政策简报中认为，CBAM可防止欧盟碳价引发的碳泄漏，但不能单独解决出口缺口、融资成本、技术转移和国际合作。报告引用Sandbag估算：现有范围下CBAM年收入在贸易照常情景约113亿欧元，若发生资源重配约73亿欧元，若伙伴国引入碳定价约70亿欧元；这些是引用的情景估算，不是已实现收入。作者建议“保护—伙伴—投资”：有证据才扩围、强化反规避和海关数据、研究符合WTO规则的出口退款；把有意义的CBAM资源追加用于伙伴国减碳，优先MRV互认、简化小企业程序，并以担保、长期承购、风险分担和共同投资提高项目可融资性。
items.summary_en: A 22-page EPICO/Konrad-Adenauer-Stiftung policy brief argues that CBAM can protect EU carbon pricing against leakage but cannot alone close the export gap, reduce financing costs, transfer technology or build partnerships. Citing Sandbag scenarios, it gives annual revenue estimates of €11.3bn under business-as-usual trade, €7.3bn with resource shuffling and €7.0bn when partners introduce carbon pricing; these are modelled estimates, not realised revenue. Its protect-partner-invest agenda calls for evidence-based scope extensions, stronger anti-circumvention and customs data, assessment of a WTO-compatible export refund, meaningful additional revenue recycling abroad, MRV interoperability and SME simplification, plus guarantees, offtake, risk-sharing and co-investment.
items.impact_zh: 这是智库政策建议，不改变现行CBAM缴费、核查或产品范围。对中国钢企更现实的信号是：欧盟政策讨论可能同时沿着反规避/下游扩围和第三国MRV互认/合作融资两条线推进。企业应继续建设可核验的工厂级排放数据，并关注欧中方法互认、绿色铁矿/氢/废钢等上游合作机会；不能据报告假定CBAM收入会返还中国或出口退款已经获批。
items.impact_en: This think-tank proposal does not change current CBAM payment, verification or product scope. For Chinese mills, the practical signal is that EU debate may advance both anti-circumvention/downstream extension and third-country MRV/financing partnerships. Continue building verifiable installation-level emissions data and monitor EU-China methodology recognition and upstream cooperation in green ore, hydrogen and scrap; do not assume CBAM revenue will be returned to China or that export rebates are approved.
items.source_excerpt: CBAM: Think tanks call for closer cooperation with non-member countries Table.Briefings

items.summary_zh: 队列为11月26日版本，同名可读报道在7月19日已刊登，关注威尔士Llanwern钢厂的竞争压力。英国现行钢铁措施的表3明确，2026年7月1日至2027年6月30日，第4类印度国别配额125,796吨，每季31,449吨，配额号058605。韩国和越南分别为100,753吨和174,367吨。英国第4类金属涂镀板税号包括72104100、72104900、72106100等，超配额税率50%。现行表中该品类的中国货需按适用的剩余配额及其准入条件核查。该内容对应7月措施，未发现11月另行扩大印度配额的公告。
items.summary_en: The matching Welsh report was published on 19 July and discusses Llanwern. The UK measure for 1 July 2026–30 June 2027 gives India 125,796 tonnes of Category 4 metallic-coated sheet quota, 31,449 tonnes per quarter under order 058605. Korea and Vietnam receive 100,753 and 174,367 tonnes. The out-of-quota duty is 50%. No later November increase was identified.
items.impact_zh: 比较英国镀锌和部分合金镀层板订单时，分别按印度国别配额和中国货适用配额核查可用性。让英国进口商在报关前按完整税号与配额号确认适用资格和实时余额，再确定含税报价。
items.impact_en: For UK galvanised and other metallic-coated sheet orders, check India's country quota and the applicable residual quota and availability for Chinese-origin goods. Ask the importer to verify the full commodity and quota order numbers at entry.
items.source_excerpt: Fears for Welsh steel plant after India handed expanded import quota Herald.Wales

items.title_original: New guidance on electricity imports under Centralised Clearance for Import
items.summary_zh: 【事实】欧盟税务与海关总司发布集中进口清关（CCI）框架下电力进口操作指南，涉及集中申报、记入申报人记录（EIDR）、授权及监督，并说明电力进口的CBAM合规衔接。属于进口手续技术指南，不是对钢材新设CBAM税率，也不等于新增钢铁HS商品范围。
items.summary_en: The Commission's customs guidance explains centralised clearance and entry-in-records procedures for electricity imports and interfaces with CBAM. It concerns electricity customs handling, not a new steel CBAM levy or changed steel tariff codes.
items.impact_zh: 【研判】直接影响电力进口商；钢铁出口商可借鉴报关数据与CBAM授权衔接，但不应将电力指引直接套用板坯、热卷或镀锌卷。
items.impact_en: Relevant directly to electricity importers; steel traders should not transfer electricity-specific rules to steel customs codes.
items.status: 技术指引／非钢材新措施
items.source_excerpt: 22 Oct 2026 New guidance on electricity imports under Centralised Clearance for Import The European Commission has published a Guidance for import of Electricity under the Centralised Clearance for Import (CCI) framework to support a harmonised approach across the EU. It covers authorisation, declaration and supervision measures under CCI and Entry in the Declarant’s Records (EIDR), as well as CBAM requirements and compliance obligations for electricity imports.
items.follow_up: 电力进口项目可查阅CCI/EIDR操作流程；钢材进出口继续按适用的钢材报关及CBAM规则执行。

items.summary_zh: 【事实】IndexBox 11月4日援引Ursa Shipbrokers分析：2025年中国房屋新开工面积约5.88亿平方米，相较2019年约22.7亿平方米大幅回落；2026年前三季度新开工约3.40亿平方米，同比下降约25%。报道同时提及铁矿进口维持一定韧性和更长运输距离，说明地产需求与航运吨海里需求并非同步。数据属于二手研究与市场分析，非官方钢铁进口措施。

items.title_zh: 港口库存升至1.5372亿吨，铁矿石期货跌破680元／吨
items.title_en: Iron ore futures fall below CNY 680/t as port stocks reach 153.72Mt
items.title_original: Iron Ore Futures Near Four-Year Lows on Rising China Port Stocks, Weak Mill Profitability
items.summary_zh: IndexBox 10月30日市场简报称，铁矿石期货跌破680元／吨、接近四年低位；其引用的行业数据称，中国主要港口库存周环比增加近1%至1.5372亿吨，澳大利亚和巴西以外生产国发运维持高位，钢厂盈利比例为11.26%、与前一周持平。北方部分省份环保限制继续压低铁水产量，但限制解除后可能恢复；淡水河谷另报第三季度核心利润下降20%，归因于矿价走低及燃料、运费成本偏高。该文是即时市场报道，价格、库存和盈利比例并非官方统计序列。
items.summary_en: IndexBox reported on 30 October that iron ore futures fell below CNY 680/t toward four-year lows. Cited industry data put major Chinese port stocks at 153.72Mt, up nearly 1% week on week, and the share of profitable steel mills at 11.26%, unchanged. Environmental curbs constrained hot-metal output in northern provinces, while Vale reported a 20% fall in third-quarter core profit. These are market-series figures, not official statistics.
items.impact_zh: 库存增加和低盈利比例说明矿价反弹基础仍弱，但单日价格不能直接证明钢厂利润将改善或必须减产。钢厂应同时看焦煤、焦炭、成材价格、库存结构和到港节奏，按采购窗口管理原料风险；贸易商应标明期货合约、交割月份和数据来源，避免把“接近四年低位”当作长期价格底部。
items.impact_en: Higher stocks and a low profitable-mill ratio point to weak support, but a one-day futures move does not prove margins will recover or mills must cut output. Mills should assess coking coal, coke, finished-steel prices, stock composition and arrivals together, and traders should identify the contract and data source rather than treat a near-four-year low as a durable floor.
items.source_excerpt: Iron Ore Futures Near Four-Year Lows on Rising China Port Stocks, Weak Mill Profitability - News and Statistics IndexBox
items.follow_up: 跟踪后续港口库存、到港量、铁水产量及钢厂盈利比例；价格结论仅适用于报道时点。
items.coverage: 2026-10-31已通读IndexBox公开全文，核对680元／吨、1.5372亿吨、近1%和11.26%等数字及淡水河谷表述；原始行业数据库和Trading Economics序列未逐笔审计，故按媒体引用的市场数据处理。

items.title_original: EUROFER president meets Turkish steel executives to discuss CBAM and competitiveness
items.summary_zh: 会议主办方ALMAMET的原始公告显示，EUROFER时任主席Henrik Adam于9月6日在伊斯坦布尔与土耳其钢企和行业组织交流CBAM、碳成本、排放管理、绿色投资及欧洲市场竞争力。参会者包括Çolakoğlu、Tosyalı、Kardemir、HABAŞ等企业代表。公告没有发布共同政策文件、税率、配额或监管决定。
items.summary_en: The host ALMAMET's original notice says then-EUROFER president Henrik Adam met Turkish mills and associations in Istanbul on 6 September to discuss CBAM, carbon costs, emissions management, green investment and European-market competitiveness. Participants included representatives of Çolakoğlu, Tosyalı, Kardemir and HABAŞ. No joint policy text, rate, quota or regulatory decision was issued.
items.impact_zh: 中国钢企可关注土耳其低碳钢和对欧出口竞争，但不能据闭门行业交流推导欧盟CBAM或钢铁配额发生变化；业务判断仍以欧盟正式法规和企业实际排放数据为准。
items.impact_en: Chinese suppliers should monitor Turkish low-carbon steel and EU-market competition, but a private industry meeting does not change CBAM or quotas. Base decisions on formal EU law and verified emissions data.
items.source_excerpt: EUROFER president meets Turkish steel executives to discuss CBAM and competitiveness Steel Orbis
